chapters.title: Chapter 4301: Strange Incident
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
A raft appeared on the great river. There was a boatman on it, and he was presently holding onto a bamboo pole.
Ling Han had witnessed this scene many times before. The boatman’s skin was green, and it was as if he had been dead for countless years. Just the sight of him was harrowing.

There was something very strange about this place. On one hand, it was easier for those with a lower cultivation level to pass through, but the stronger their abilities, the more bizarre things they would encounter. At the slightest provocation, they would lose their lives.
Otherwise, would the Imperial Clans miss out on something as valuable as the Source Dao Stone?
It was not that they did not want it, but rather that they could not obtain it.
Now that two Venerate Tier elites had appeared here, not only did they not retract their aura, but they even attacked wantonly. Would this lead to a strange incident happening?
In Ling Han’s eyes, the boatman in front of him was already strange enough.
Xiu, xiu! He and Ding Shu moved quickly, and had already surpassed the boatman.

The Blood Crow Venerate and the Crimson Moon Venerate quickly caught up to Ling Han and Ding Shu. Their speed was astonishing, and if it weren’t for the fact that they kept howling uncontrollably like wolves, they would have caught up to Ling Han and Ding Shu in a single step.
But when they passed by that boatman, a strange thing happened.
The boatman’s turbid eyes suddenly lit up. Then, he waved the bamboo pole, sweeping it towards the two Venerates.

The bamboo pole was clearly only that long, but as the boatman waved it, it seemed to have turned into a divine rod that was extraordinarily long, rapidly smashing into the backs of the two Venerate Tier elites.
Regulations glowed, which was incredibly terrifying.
The two Venerate Tier elites both exclaimed in surprise. They had no choice but to turn around and charge at the bamboo pole.
Peng!
The two great Venerate Tier elites struck the bamboo pole at the same time. They both grunted, and were sent flying.
In this attack, even if they joined forces, they were still no match for the boatman.

The boatman didn’t stop, and with a turn of the bamboo pole, it shot towards Crimson Moon Venerate. Meanwhile, his left hand pressed down, turning into a large, decaying hand that grabbed out at Blood Crow Venerate.
The Crimson Moon Venerate and the Blood Crow Venerate both humphed coldly. In the first attack, they had only been caught off guard. If they really came to blows, what did they have to fear?
Boom, the two Venerate Tier elites both unleashed their battle prowess. Instantly, a terrifying might overflowed. They displayed battle prowess on the level of Venerate Tier.
A great battle broke out, and the boatman battled the two Venerate Tier elites alone, not falling into a disadvantage at all.
However, the two Venerate Tier elites were also very aggressive, launching a powerful counterattack and steadying their footing.
Ling Han stopped, and turned around to watch the battle.
“F***, do you want to die?” Ding Shu also stopped, “Aren’t you going to run?”
Ling Han cracked a smile, “After being hunted down for so long, don’t you want to take revenge?”
“Venerate Tier elites are engaged in a great battle. If you want to seek death, I’m not going to accompany you,” Ding Shu shrugged.
Ling Han smiled, and blew the horn of the Great Emperor. The two shockwaves immediately shot towards the Crimson Moon Venerate and Blood Crow Venerate like arrows.
“Ao!” Even at this moment, the two Venerate Tier elites couldn’t help but howl like wolves.
It was completely irresistible.
However, the boatman was unaffected, and did not stop attacking, continuing to attack the two Venerate Tier elites.

This caused the two Venerate Tier elites to feel awkward. Merely one boatman was enough to become a strong rival for them, and now they had to howl like wolves from time to time. How could they hold up to this?
This was fatal!

In a battle between elites, in a situation when their abilities were more or less equal, even the slightest mistake would be fatal. Thus, it was really too dangerous for them to be howling like wolves now. They were constantly wandering on the border between life and death.
Ling Han also went all out, and attacked from the sidelines like crazy.
He definitely had to suppress the two Venerate Tier elites. Only then would he be able to create a chance for the boatman.

Only a few minutes had passed, but the two Venerate Tier elites kept encountering dangerous situations — it should be known that under the influence of the Great Emperor Horn, they couldn’t even take down a True Self Tier, which showed how much strength they could only unleash.
Pu!
The Blood Crow Venerate’s lower abdomen was struck by the bamboo pole, causing him to throw up blood madly. Even his spirit was almost beaten out out him.
“I am a Venerate Tier, the fourth pinnacle suppresses the heaven and earth!” The Blood Crow Venerate roared loudly, and four pillars of Dao appeared in his body, suppressing his soul.
However, Ling Han blew the bugle horn, and he couldn’t help but howl at the sky. Instantly, his four pillars of Dao immediately disappeared into his body.
Peng, a bamboo pole shot over, and the Blood Crow Venerate was ruthlessly hit. With a somersault, peng, he fell into the eerie river.
With a splash, this Venerate Tier instantly disappeared, as if he had been swallowed by the river waters.
Crimson Moon Venerate couldn’t help but feel chills all over his body. This was too f****** strange.

He naturally knew that after leaving the City of Death, there was a great misfortune outside. However, previously, due to his fury, he had been so focused on hunting Ling Han that he had completely forgotten about this matter.
Now, he finally realized that the situation was not good.
Once Blood Crow fell into the water, it was hard to say whether he would live or die!
Crimson Moon Venerate only hesitated for a moment before immediately turning around to flee.
Under Ling Han’s influence, he was no match for the boatman at all. Thus, it was best to retreat as soon as possible.
He retreated, and the boatman gave chase. However, without the influence of the Great Emperor Horn, Crimson Moon Venerate was extremely fast, and the boatman couldn’t catch up to him either.
After chasing for a while, the boatman returned and landed on the small raft again. He stretched out a bamboo pole and stirred in the river water, as if he was fishing out something.
“What the hell?” Ding Shu murmured.
When the boatman raised the bamboo pole again, a strange scene appeared. There was actually a hand holding onto the end of the bamboo pole.
A person was lifted up. He had greenish-white skin, but had a pair of wings on his back.
Was it the Blood Crow Venerate?
But now, the Blood Crow Venerate seemed to have become a walking corpse. Though his eyes were open, his gaze was extremely turbid. He just stood there numbly on the ship, completely motionless.
The boatman held onto the paddle, and slowly headed down the river’s course.
This scene caused both Ling Han and Ding Shu to hold their breaths.
A Venerate, after falling into the river, had become like this after he was fished up?
That was a Venerate Tier elite!
This was truly strange.
Just like that, the two of them watched the small raft disappear into the distance, right until it disappeared from their sight.
“How f*cking strange!” Ding Shu couldn’t help but curse again.
In truth, Ling Han also very much wanted to curse. This scene caused his scalp to go numb.
What exactly was going on here?
He took a few deep breaths to calm his emotions, then asked Ding Shu, “Next, do you still plan to go to the City of Death?”

“What would I be going there for? To seek death?” Ding Shu said in irritation, “You are quite awesome yourself, to actually draw out Venerate Tier elites to hunt you down. And now, great, even I have been implicated.”
Ling Han cracked a smile, and said, “All right, all right. You have plenty of Source Dao Stones, and as for Han Di, I’ve already killed him. You won’t have the chance to get revenge either.”
“F***!” Ding Shu almost jumped up to strangle Ling Han, “Compensate me! Compensate me! Compensate me!”
Ling Han simply laughed loudly.
After making a fuss for a while, Ding Shu said, “At first, I was still going to stay here for eight to ten years, but now, I have to leave in advance. When will your people pick you up?”
“There are about two months left.”
“All right then, let me take a ride.”
“No problem.” Ling Han nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 4302: Great Change in the World
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han and Ding Shu walked back together.

Their cultivation levels were low, so they didn’t trigger any strange events. They followed the eerie river and entered the forest, staying in the stone house to avoid those strange creatures. Then, they hurried on their way. A month later, they entered the swamp.
Another few days later, they passed through this place, and saw the path that led out.
Then, they pushed open the stone door, and arrived inside the black hole.

Ling Han and Ding Shu both sat down in cross-legged positions. At present, all they could do was wait, but with their habits, they naturally would not waste the slightest bit of time. This little bit of time was also enough for them to comprehend Dao and cultivate.
This wait took over a dozen days.
All of a sudden, this peaceful space bubbled, and then a large hand stretched in, exuding an overwhelming aura.
A Saint!
“Let’s go,” Ling Han said softly. He immediately dashed toward the large hand.
Ding Shu didn’t hesitate, and he immediately dashed over as well.
The two of them landed in the palm of the large hand. The large hand immediately curled up, clenched into a fist, and then retracted.

Though the power of the black hole was terrifying, and even a Sect Master could not escape its attraction, it was not enough in front of Saint-level power, and could not affect this giant hand at all.
Very quickly, this large hand brought Ling Han and Ding Shu out of the black hole.
The large hand loosened, and then dissipated.

“Old man!” Ling Han called out. Ahead of him, the Nine Mountains Saint was standing in midair, and there were a considerable number of people standing beside him. They were the empress, Hu Niu, the large black dog and the others.
“Yi, Little Han, who is this?” the large black dog immediately asked.
“Ding Shu,” Ling Han replied.
“En?” The large black dog was shocked. This was Ding Shu, the other Genesis World’s Master?
Meanwhile, the empress and Hu Niu came over, one on the left and one on the right. They surrounded Ling Han. They had been apart for ten years, so they naturally missed him very much.
“Let’s go back first,” the Nine Mountains Saint said. He tore a rip into space and led everyone away.
With the Saint’s guidance, their speed was naturally very fast. Only a few days later, they had returned to the Nine Suns Holy Land.
“Thank you, old man. I’ll take my leave first. There’s no need to see me out.” Ding Shu immediately waved his hand in farewell, as if someone was holding a saber to his neck.
This was Ling Han’s base camp, so he naturally had to be careful.
However, Ling Han had never thought of using this kind of method to get rid of his competitors. He merely smiled.
“Was it successful?” the Nine Mountains Saint asked Ling Han.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “Just look at what you’re saying. How could it not be successful when it is me?”
“Brat!” The Nine Mountains Saint shook his head with a smile, saying, “Don’t be cheeky.”
Ling Han immediately recounted his experiences in these ten years. In truth, he spent the majority of his time refining the Source Dao Stones, so this part only needed to be glossed over.
Everyone listened quietly. When they found out that Ling Han had actually advanced into the Tenth Form, they all inhaled sharply.
The Ninth Form only existed in legends, but Ling Han actually advanced into the Tenth Form.
This was too awesome.

Meanwhile, the Nine Mountains Saint frowned and placed a hand on Ling Han’s shoulder. He extended his Spiritual Power, and after a careful examination, he said in a solemn voice, “You can’t refine the Source Dao Stone anymore. Although the lifespan lost is negligible compared to the increase in lifespan brought by the increase in cultivation level, the Source Power of your lifespan has been greatly weakened.”
“Even now, your foundations have already been damaged, and you need to use Great Herbs to heal it. If you continue to refine them, I’m afraid it will cause an irreversible and eternal injury.”
Only now did Ling Han become serious.
He knew that his life force had been damaged, and had already decided to find a Great Herb to compensate for it, but he had not thought that the situation would actually become so serious.
He sighed, took out all the remaining Source Dao Stones, and said, “You guys split them among yourselves, but use them carefully.”

The Nine Mountains Saint picked up a Source Power Dao Stone, examined it closely, and said, “This contains Regulations, which is both related to time and even contains a sliver of karma. It’s the only thing that can allow a cultivator to sacrifice their lifespan in exchange for time.”
He paused for a moment, then continued, “At most, three days to refine one, so that the life force that has been expended can slowly recover, and should not hurt the foundations.”
Everyone nodded. Ling Han was a good example.
“Oh, that’s right. How’s the situation in the universe now? Have those Imperial Clan elites become aggressive again?” Ling Han asked. He had already been away from this world for ten years.

“There really has been a great change,” the large black dog said. “In the sixth year after you entered the Dark Clouds Hell, the Mountain Sea Heaven broke apart, and a large number of Yin souls wreaked havoc, stirring up boundless winds and clouds.”
Ling Han couldn’t help but frown. A large number of Yin souls were invading. This was really a big matter.
“And now?” he asked.

“In the beginning, everyone acted as if it had nothing to do with them.” The little azure dragon continued, “However, this Yin soul army advanced like a hot knife through butter, attacking cities and plundering land. The territory of their force rapidly expanded, and even those Imperial Clans could no longer sit still.”

“Now, with the Imperial Clans taking the lead, they have formed an alliance against the Yin soul army. The whole universe has laid down everything else, and are united against the Yin soul army,” the perverted pig also said.
Ling Han was even more surprised. Under the pressure of the invasion of the Yin souls, the various great forces had actually joined forces?
“The Imperial Clans and the Imperial Weapons are still unable to expel the Yin souls?” He felt it strange.
This was the Imperial Weapon. Once it unleashed its might, it was equivalent to a Great Emperor coming back to life. Yet, it was still unable to suppress the Yin souls?

“Sigh, there are too many Yin souls. Moreover, they use the Mountain Sea Heaven as their base, and when they encounter the might of the Imperial Weapon, they hide back into the Netherworld,” the large black dog said. “Moreover, there are also Saints among the Yin souls, as well as Imperial Weapons!”
Ling Han almost spluttered. Yin souls also had Imperial Weapons?
F***, don’t tell him that Yin souls could even cultivate to Great Emperor-level.

“It’s said that it’s transformed from the remains of a Divine Beast from the ancient times. It’s different from the Imperial Weapon of the later generations,” the little azure dragon explained. In this aspect, he had a lot of say.
Ling Han took a deep breath, and concluded, “In other words, the present situation is considerably dire.”

“We have to have a new Emperor appear, and only then would we be able to completely chase those Yin souls back. Otherwise, sigh!” The large black dog shook his head. Otherwise, things would not be good.

“Thus, all the great Imperial Clans have put down their airs now. In fact, they have even spared no expense, and established a so-called Ancestral King Academy, focusing fully on nurturing prodigies, so as to stimulate the world of cultivation to enter into an era of prosperity. Prodigies from various places have appeared, all of them competing for the imperial throne.”
Though the heaven and earth were already prepared to welcome a new Emperor, the appearance of the Imperial Path still needed an opportunity, such as enough prodigies.
In the Imperial Path, there was no lack of competition. If there were only a few people, then what was the point of competing?

When one became Emperor, it was never one that was outstanding among the mediocre, but rather countless prodigies would fight tooth and nail to become Emperor. Only the most outstanding, the most naturally talented, and the most fortunate would be able to stand out.
“Ancestral King Academy?” Ling Han was slightly interested, “Can anyone go?”

“Moreover, there are also Saints among the Yin souls, as well as Imperial Weapons!”
Ling Han almost spluttered.
Yin souls also had Imperial Weapons?
F***, don’t tell him that Yin souls could even cultivate to Great Emperor-level.
“It’s said that it’s transformed from the remains of a Divine Beast from the ancient times.
It’s different from the Imperial Weapon of the later generations,” the little azure dragon explained.
In this aspect, he had a lot of say.
Ling Han took a deep breath, and concluded, “In other words, the present situation is considerably dire.”
“We have to have a new Emperor appear, and only then would we be able to completely chase those Yin souls back.
Otherwise, sigh!” The large black dog shook his head.
Otherwise, things would not be good.
“Thus, all the great Imperial Clans have put down their airs now.

In fact, they have even spared no expense, and established a so-called Ancestral King Academy, focusing fully on nurturing prodigies, so as to stimulate the world of cultivation to enter into an era of prosperity.
Prodigies from various places have appeared, all of them competing for the imperial throne.”
Though the heaven and earth were already prepared to welcome a new Emperor, the appearance of the Imperial Path still needed an opportunity, such as enough prodigies.
In the Imperial Path, there was no lack of competition.
If there were only a few people, then what was the point of competing?
When one became Emperor, it was never one that was outstanding among the mediocre, but rather countless prodigies would fight tooth and nail to become Emperor.
Only the most outstanding, the most naturally talented, and the most fortunate would be able to stand out.
“Ancestral King Academy?” Ling Han was slightly interested, “Can anyone go?”

chapters.title: Chapter 4303: Ancestral King Academy
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“Theoretically, yes.” The large black dog nodded.

“However, brat, you’re being hunted down by so many Imperial Clans. If you really enter there, hoho, you’ll probably be chased around to be beaten every day,” the little azure dragon said, delighting in Ling Han’s misfortune.
Ling Han smiled, “That won’t happen. With the old man’s intimidation, on the surface, even the Imperial Clans would not dare to do anything to me.”
Just think, how terrifying would a Saint wielding an Imperial Weapon be?

It was presently a crucial period in the resistance against Yin souls. Saints were naturally the most important power, and the Nine Mountains Saint even had an “Imperial Weapon”. Of course, he belonged to the category of people that needed to be united, so how could he be pushed onto the opposing side?
Thus, even if Ling Han swaggered boldly into the ranks of the Imperial Clans, these people would still have to force themselves to bear with it.
Of course, if they were battling at the same cultivation level, and Ling Han was still killed, then the Nine Mountains Saint would have nothing to say. After all, he was the one who had said this.

“Battle at the same cultivation level? Hehe, if I don’t break through to the Spirit Transformation Tier, who in this world would be able to block a single strike from me?” Ling Han was extremely proud.
This was the Tenth Form, and it was definitely peerless in the world!
Even Ding Shu, who was also a ruler of the Genesis World, couldn’t reach the Tenth Form as long as he didn’t have the Imperial Weapon. This required both natural talent and great fortune.
“Brat, are you planning to go to the Ancestral King Academy?” the large black dog asked.
Ling Han nodded, “Of course. I have to suppress those old friends of mine, and let them know how to kneel down and proclaim their conquest.”
“Haha, how arrogant. However, Grandpa Dog likes it.”
“Grandpa Dragon also supports you.”
“Zhi!” The perverted pig humphed, which could be considered as expressing his stand.
“Come, let’s report this to the old man.”
Ling Han and the others went to seek out the Nine Mountains Saint, and expressed their desire to go to the Ancestral King Academy.
“All right.” The Nine Mountains Saint immediately nodded. For Ling Han, this was currently the most suitable choice for him.

As long as he did not expose the fact that the “Imperial Weapon” in his possession was actually a fake, Ling Han would definitely be safe. The Imperial Clans would also have to be cautious, as once a Saint that possessed the Imperial Weapon unleashed his might, the damage caused would be devastating.

Ling Han and the others decided to set out immediately. This time, there were more people going. Not only were there the Three Milk Tea Brothers, there was also the perverted pig, the empress, Hu Niu, and the seven Calabash Brothers. In any case, they had nothing to worry about.
Led by the Nine Mountains Saint, they arrived at the Dark Moon Planet in just a few days.
The Ancestral King Academy was located here.

A very long time ago, the Dark Moon Planet was a great planet. It had once given birth to a Saint, but this Saint encountered misfortune in his later years, and actually went mad, destroying the sect that he had founded with his own hands. From then onwards, the cultivation of the Dark Moon Planet had also fallen into a period of decline.
However, with the establishment of the Ancestral King Academy here, it was clear that the cultivation of the Dark Moon Planet would also undergo a powerful revival.
“Come, let’s go and register.”
They headed to the academy, but when they arrived at the main doors, they all gritted their teeth.
There was a sea of people here, numbering in the millions.
They were all here to register?
Ling Han and the others only had to ask casually, and received a definite answer.

The Ancestral King Academy had gathered all the strongest prodigies in the universe, and in future, they would all be top-notch elites contending for the imperial throne. If they could enter the academy, putting aside whether they would be qualified to contend for the imperial throne in future, merely being classmates with so many Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters, wasn’t that enough to brag about for a lifetime?

Furthermore, a new Emperor would definitely be born in the Ancestral King Academy, and that would be a source of even more boasting — to be Sect Brothers and Sect Sisters with a new Ancestral King, what kind of glory was that?
Thus, everyone tried their best to crawl in.
“A test will begin. Three stages have to be passed first.” The little azure dragon went to gather information, and soon returned.

Because there were really too many people here, and there was an endless stream of them every day, the Ancestral King Academy was completely too busy to deal with them. Thus, they simply set up an extremely difficult test, and eliminated the majority first.
As for the rest, no matter what, they could still be considered prodigies. There was no harm in spending some time to investigate them. Who knows, they might be worth nurturing.
“What test?” Ling Han asked.
“It’s just a matter of fighting and killing anyway,” the little azure dragon said casually.
“All right.” Ling Han nodded, and did not take it to heart.
With his strength, no matter what kind of test it was, he could pass it with his eyes closed.
“Silence!” A cultivator suddenly leaped into the air.
“Who do you think you are? Why do I have to listen to you?” Someone was displeased, and immediately rebuked.
“Humph!” That cultivator looked downwards, his eyes bright, instantly exuding a terrifying aura.
This was a powerful Sect Master elite.
The person who had spoken just now immediately became a coward, not daring to make a sound.

“Everyone, listen up,” the Sect Master elite said. “The Foundation Building Tiers stand here, the Cauldron Forging Tiers stand here, the Core Formation Tiers stand here, the True Self Tiers stand here, the Spirit Transformation Tiers stand here.”
He pointed at them one by one, distributing the places where cultivators of different cultivation levels should stand.

There were no Sect Master-level elites here. Aside from the Golden Generation elites, those who could become Sect Master-level elites were all older people. Firstly, they were not qualified to attempt breaking through to Emperor Tier, and secondly, they were already so old, so how could they bring themselves to compete with young people for cultivation resources?
The Sect Master swept an eye over them, and said coldly, “Let me give you a word of advice. Don’t choose the wrong side. Otherwise, if you’re found out, it won’t be as simple as being kicked out!”
Everyone was stunned. These words were filled with killing intent.
Instantly, a few people quietly stepped out, and went to other teams.

—Initially, they had wanted to bluff, and participate in the competition of a lower cultivation level with their higher cultivation level. In that way, they would be able to pass easily, but with this Sect Master here, who would dare?
Was he seeking death?
“Now, the Foundation Building TIer cultivators will go first and enter the doors ahead,” the Sect Master said. With a shake of his hand, a stone door fell from the sky, but it was tightly closed.
The Foundation Building Tier cultivators instantly started to move toward the stone door.
“Lord, the stone door can’t be pushed open!” The person standing in the first position gave a shove, and said to the elite in the sky.
“You can’t even open the doors, scram!” the Sect Master elite chided coldly.
The person at the forefront could only leave dejectedly. As it turned out, pushing open the stone door was the first stage.
The person in second place continued to walk forwards, and began to push open the doors.
However, he had also failed, and similarly fled with his tail between his legs.

Failure, failure, failure. The first stage was extremely difficult, and only a very few people could pass. But even so, there were really too many people here. The efficiency of testing them one by one was really too low.
The Sect Master was exasperated. He waved his hand again, and stone doors descended one after another. There were a total of five of them.
Each stone door corresponded to a cultivation level. Now, five people with the same cultivation level could undergo the test together, so the speed was naturally greatly sped up.
Martial arts was always the structure of a pyramid. The lowest cultivation level had the highest number, and the higher the cultivation level, the fewer people there would be.

It was the same here. There were the most Foundation Building Tier cultivators, and there were considerably fewer Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators. When it was True Self Tier, there were only about a thousand left, and Spiritual Transformation Tier cultivators were even rarer, only a mere hundred.
After all, the Ancestral King Academy had been established for several years, and the true prodigies had naturally entered the academy long ago.
“Get lost, let me go first!” The line was originally advancing in an orderly manner, but one person suddenly squeezed forward, his attitude very arrogant.

chapters.title: Chapter 4304: The person who cut into the queue
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
This was a young man who looked to be in his twenties. He was dressed in a green embroidered gown, and his expression was filled with arrogance.
With regards to cutting the queue, the majority would definitely have a displeased attitude. Thus, a great many people called out in displeasure.
“What are you cutting into the queue for? Get lost!”
“Who do you think you are!”
“Don’t disturb order!”
The black-robed young man’s gaze was disdainful, as he swept a disdainful glance over everyone, “Because I am Zhang Wei!”
Zhang Wei?
Everyone exchanged looks. None of them had any recollection of this person’s name, so it was obvious that he was not a famous person. Then was it really good for you to be so arrogant?
“My older brother is Zhang Jia, Niu Tengfei, Imperial Son Niu’s follower!” Zhang Wei added.
When these words fell, quite a few people immediately shut up.
Imperial Son!

Whether it was the Golden Generation, the Silver Generation, or the Imperial Son of the third generation, those that could be crowned with the title of Imperial Son were all prodigies, and it was extremely possible that they would become Saints in future, and be respected by the whole world.
Thus, even if Zhang Wei was only the younger brother of Imperial Son Niu Tengfei’s follower, he could still be very awesome.
This was the intimidation of the Imperial Clan, and was also the golden signboard of the Imperial Son.

Zhang Wei saw that everyone had fallen silent, and couldn’t help but show a hint of pride in his expression. Who cares how strong your backers are? Can they compare to the Imperial Son? Thus, in front of me, you had best obediently keep your mouths shut.
He swaggered forwards, his hands dangling back to front, and front to back. There was no doubt how arrogant he was.

Ling Han gave the large black dog a look, and the large black dog understood his signal. When Zhang Wei walked over, he stretched out a leg and tripped him up. Pa, Zhang Wei was caught off guard, and instantly fell forwards.

However, the True Self Tier was already capable of using Regulations, so he naturally wouldn’t be tripped easily. He stretched out a hand and struck the ground, wanting to use the momentum to bounce back up. However, at this moment, a powerful force pressed down on his back, as heavy as a planet, making him unable to bounce back up at all.
Peng, he fell heavily onto the ground, his face covered with dust.
“Pu!”
“Hahaha!”
When everyone saw this, they all laughed loudly.

They were wary of Zhang Wei’s background, and felt that it was better to have less trouble, so they did not stop him from cutting into the queue. However, this did not mean that they did not even have the courage to gloat over his misfortune.
Zhang Wei had suddenly fallen down, and his speed of getting back to his feet was also very fast. Immediately, he looked towards Ling Han and the others.
He had not even seen the large black dog make a move, but he was the closest to these “people”, so there was an 80% chance that it was these people who had done it.
“Was it you?” Zhang Wei pointed at Ling Han, his expression slightly twisted.
He had just introduced himself, and had the backing of an Imperial Son, yet someone actually dared to mess with him. How could he accept this?
Ling Han shook his head, “I hate being pointed at.”
“Hate? Heh, when I trample all over you, you will hate it even more!” Zhang Wei declared coldly.
Pa, he immediately suffered a kick.
“You actually dare to threaten our father!”
“Fight!”
“Beat him so hard that even his mother won’t recognize him!”
The children all rushed forwards, and began to attack Zhang Wei.

The advancement of their cultivation levels was practically inconceivable. They didn’t need any cultivation resources at all, yet their cultivation level soared. By now, they were already in the True Self Tier, which was why they were able to line up with Ling Han and the others. And if it was the empress and Hu Niu, they could only join the ranks of the Core Formation Tier.

Zhang Wei still had some strength. Otherwise, even if he had a powerful backer, he wouldn’t dare to be so full of confidence. After all, if he couldn’t push open the stone door with his bare hands, that would be embarrassing in public.
But in a one-on-one battle, he may not even be a match for the babies, what more when it was seven against one. He naturally did not even have the ability to parry, and could only be beaten up.
It wasn’t long before he was beaten black and blue, on the verge of death.
The seven babies all clapped their hands, looking like they were smiling.
“Father, did we do a good job?” Eldest Baby even asked Ling Han for credit.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Beautiful!”
The seven babies were instantly enraptured, unable to contain their joy.

Everyone gritted their teeth as they watched. This group of people was far too violent. They had actually thrashed someone at the entrance of the academy? Moreover, they had thrashed someone who was related to the Imperial Son!
How could they be so outrageously bold?
However, the Sect Master was clearly watching, yet did not make a move to stop them. This attitude was quite ambiguous.
At this time, the people in front either succeeded or were eliminated. Finally, it was Ling Han and his group’s turn.

“Grandpa Dog will go first.” The large black dog walked up, and with a strong push, the stone door was opened. With a xiu, he entered, and the stone door immediately closed. It was impossible for the people behind him to take advantage of the opening.
Next, it was the little azure dragon, followed by the seven babies, and they all passed easily.
Ling Han was the last. He walked forwards, stretched out a hand and pressed down. A force immediately bounced back. He increased the force slightly, and the stone door was easily pushed open.
After entering the stone door, they arrived in another world. However, this world was extremely small, and there was a person sitting cross-legged in front of them.
“You’ll pass if you can take a single strike from me,” the person said.
Ling Han swept over with his divine sense, and already had an idea.
This was not a real person, but rather something like the Tool Spirit. It was formed by the Regulations of heaven and earth, so even its features were blurred.
“My cultivation level is at the fifth form of the True Self Tier,” the person said. Then, with a wave of his hand, Regulations shot towards Ling Han like a sword.
The fifth form of the True Self Tier?
Ling Han was astonished. He was at the Tenth Form, and no one had ever achieved this before, and it was also possible that no one would be able to achieve this in the future.
Oh, this was not a real person, after all. Hence, it could only tell that Ling Han had broken through the limits of the Fourth Form, but did not know exactly how many times he had broken through.
Which also meant that whether it was the Fifth Form, the Sixth Form, or the Seventh Form, this Tool Spirit would treat them all the same.
The might of this attack, en, was about the peak stage of the Fifth Form.
In other words, the fifth form would actually find it very difficult to parry, but if it was the sixth form, it would be an easy feat.

After all, those the Ancestral King Academy wanted to select were only those who could become Venerate Tier or even Saint Tier prodigies in the future, that could create a prosperous situation in which tens of thousands of prodigies competed for the throne.
If their final accomplishment could only be Spirit Transformation Tier, or even Sect Master Tier?
How could they be in the mood to nurture him? It was completely a waste of time and resources.
Just as he was thinking this, the attack had already arrived.
Ling Han didn’t even move to parry. The Starlight Screen spread open. Peng, the attack landed, but it didn’t even break a crack in the Starlight Screen.
Ka, on the other side of this small place, a stone door opened, which meant that Ling Han could leave now.
He entered, and saw that there was also a person seated here.
“Defeat me, and you’ll pass,” the person said.
It was also formed from Regulations, and was not a real person at all.
Then there was no need to be reserved. Ling Han rushed forwards, and with a series of chaotic blows, knocked this opponent to the ground.
As expected, another stone door quietly opened on the other side.
The third stage had been passed, but it did not mean that he could enter into the Ancestral King Academy. Instead, he had obtained the qualifications for the second round of the test.

After walking out of the stone door, Ling Han discovered that he had arrived inside the Ancestral King Academy. That stone door actually had the effect of Transfer Formation, though the distance of transmission was pitifully short.
The empress, the large black dog, and the others had all passed the test, and were waiting for him ahead.
“The second round is the audition. After passing, you can become one of the members of the Ancestral King Academy,” someone said calmly. It was actually another Sect Master-level elite.

By now, they were already in the True Self Tier, which was why they were able to line up with Ling Han and the others.
And if it was the empress and Hu Niu, they could only join the ranks of the Core Formation Tier.
Zhang Wei still had some strength.
Otherwise, even if he had a powerful backer, he wouldn’t dare to be so full of confidence.
After all, if he couldn’t push open the stone door with his bare hands, that would be embarrassing in public.
But in a one-on-one battle, he may not even be a match for the babies, what more when it was seven against one.
He naturally did not even have the ability to parry, and could only be beaten up.
It wasn’t long before he was beaten black and blue, on the verge of death.
The seven babies all clapped their hands, looking like they were smiling.
“Father, did we do a good job?” Eldest Baby even asked Ling Han for credit.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Beautiful!”
The seven babies were instantly enraptured, unable to contain their joy.
Everyone gritted their teeth as they watched.
This group of people was far too violent.
They had actually thrashed someone at the entrance of the academy?
Moreover, they had thrashed someone who was related to the Imperial Son!
How could they be so outrageously bold?
However, the Sect Master was clearly watching, yet did not make a move to stop them.
This attitude was quite ambiguous.
At this time, the people in front either succeeded or were eliminated.
Finally, it was Ling Han and his group’s turn.
“Grandpa Dog will go first.” The large black dog walked up, and with a strong push, the stone door was opened.
With a xiu, he entered, and the stone door immediately closed.
It was impossible for the people behind him to take advantage of the opening.
Next, it was the little azure dragon, followed by the seven babies, and they all passed easily.
Ling Han was the last.
He walked forwards, stretched out a hand and pressed down.
A force immediately bounced back.
He increased the force slightly, and the stone door was easily pushed open.
After entering the stone door, they arrived in another world.
However, this world was extremely small, and there was a person sitting cross-legged in front of them.
“You’ll pass if you can take a single strike from me,” the person said.
Ling Han swept over with his divine sense, and already had an idea.
This was not a real person, but rather something like the Tool Spirit.
It was formed by the Regulations of heaven and earth, so even its features were blurred.
“My cultivation level is at the fifth form of the True Self Tier,” the person said.
Then, with a wave of his hand, Regulations shot towards Ling Han like a sword.
The fifth form of the True Self Tier?
Ling Han was astonished.
He was at the Tenth Form, and no one had ever achieved this before, and it was also possible that no one would be able to achieve this in the future.
Oh, this was not a real person, after all.
Hence, it could only tell that Ling Han had broken through the limits of the Fourth Form, but did not know exactly how many times he had broken through.
Which also meant that whether it was the Fifth Form, the Sixth Form, or the Seventh Form, this Tool Spirit would treat them all the same.
The might of this attack, en, was about the peak stage of the Fifth Form.
In other words, the fifth form would actually find it very difficult to parry, but if it was the sixth form, it would be an easy feat.

After all, those the Ancestral King Academy wanted to select were only those who could become Venerate Tier or even Saint Tier prodigies in the future, that could create a prosperous situation in which tens of thousands of prodigies competed for the throne.
If their final accomplishment could only be Spirit Transformation Tier, or even Sect Master Tier?
How could they be in the mood to nurture him?
It was completely a waste of time and resources.
Just as he was thinking this, the attack had already arrived.
Ling Han didn’t even move to parry.
The Starlight Screen spread open.
Peng, the attack landed, but it didn’t even break a crack in the Starlight Screen.
Ka, on the other side of this small place, a stone door opened, which meant that Ling Han could leave now.
He entered, and saw that there was also a person seated here.
“Defeat me, and you’ll pass,” the person said.
It was also formed from Regulations, and was not a real person at all.
Then there was no need to be reserved.
Ling Han rushed forwards, and with a series of chaotic blows, knocked this opponent to the ground.
As expected, another stone door quietly opened on the other side.
The third stage had been passed, but it did not mean that he could enter into the Ancestral King Academy.
Instead, he had obtained the qualifications for the second round of the test.
After walking out of the stone door, Ling Han discovered that he had arrived inside the Ancestral King Academy.
That stone door actually had the effect of Transfer Formation, though the distance of transmission was pitifully short.
The empress, the large black dog, and the others had all passed the test, and were waiting for him ahead.
“The second round is the audition.
After passing, you can become one of the members of the Ancestral King Academy,” someone said calmly.
It was actually another Sect Master-level elite.

chapters.title: Chapter 4305: So ordinary?
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
As expected of Ancestral King Academy. Sect Master elites kept watch everywhere.
What was a Sect Master?
That was a person who could establish a sect, and would be treated and respected wherever he went. But in this place, Sect Masters seemed to have become an errand boy, and were not uncommon.
Those who had passed three stages did as they were told, and there were fewer people, which greatly decreased the difficulty of the selection.
There was a courtyard in front of them, and when everyone walked over, they saw a group of people come out, all of them looking dejected.
“I am the Fifth Form, and in the end, I was still eliminated!”
“Sigh, I also cultivated Seven Cauldrons, and I actually didn’t pass!”
“That’s right. With our aptitude, we can already go to a great sect and become Dao Child, yet we still can’t pass.”
“Just how freakish does one’s aptitude have to be?”
These people complained as they walked, their faces filled with defiance and dissatisfaction.

Hearing their words, the expressions of the new batch of people changed drastically. F***, they only had the aptitude of the Fifth Form and Seven Cauldrons. Then wouldn’t they also be kicked out of the Academy?
“Next.” At the entrance, there was a Dao Apprentice standing guard. He waved at Ling Han and the others, “Hurry, don’t dawdle.”
Everyone was a little timid, not daring to be the first to enter.
“Grandpa Dog will go.” The large black dog was the first to run out and enter the courtyard.
After a while, the Dao Apprentice looked surprised, and said to everyone, “Next.”
Yi, the person, no, the dog did not come out, which meant that he had passed the test?
Everyone’s faces were slightly flushed. How could it be that they were no match for a dog?
“I’ll do it!” Immediately, someone entered, but in just a few seconds, he ran out dejectedly, looking despondent.
Obviously, he had not passed the test.
“Next,” the Dao Apprentice was expressionless as he called out again.
This time, no one scrambled to be the first.
“Let’s go!” The seven babies stepped out one after another.
What was going on here?

The Dao Apprentice was also a little dazed. Seven toddlers actually managed to pass the first three stages? Oh, he understood now. They must have deliberately suppressed the growth of their bodies. Otherwise, they looked to be only four or five years old, so how could they have cultivated to the extent that even he could not tell their cultivation level?
“One by one,” he hurriedly said.
“Sigh, how willful!” Eldest Baby spread her hands.
“Alright, just listen to him.”
The babies queued up, and Eldest Baby entered first.
Only after a while, the Dao Apprentice was once again surprised, and said to Second Baby, “Next.”
Yi, she had passed?
Everyone gritted their teeth. Just now, it was a dog, and now it was a child. Even they had passed, so what reason did they have to fail?
It wasn’t long before the seven kids all passed the test.
“Next,” the Dao Apprentice continued.
This time, another person became active and rushed into the courtyard. In the end, in less than three seconds, he ran out with his tail between his legs.
Failure.
F***, what was going on here? Both the dog and the babies could pass, but prodigies like them could not?
“Look at your Grandpa Dragon!” The little azure dragon swaggered forward.
Everyone was even more depressed. Now, they were actually being mocked by a four-legged snake?

However, what made them even more depressed was the fact that the Dao Apprentice quickly shouted “next”, yet they didn’t see the little azure dragon being chased out. It was clear that he had passed the test.
Ling Han smiled, and strode away.
Everyone shook their heads. Judging by the current situation, it was obvious that only freaks could pass the test. You look too normal at first glance, so it is impossible for you to pass.
Ling Han entered the courtyard, only to see an old man drinking tea. He looked at Ling Han, and a strange expression instantly spread across his face. “Ling Han?”
“Yo, Senior recognizes me!” Ling Han said with a smile.
This was naturally a Sect Leader elite. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have been able to suppress the prodigies that had come over. He stared at Ling Han, killing intent in his eyes.
Ling Han knew that this definitely belonged to some Imperial Clan, so by nature, he didn’t like him.
This Sect Master was called Baili Dong, and was naturally a member of the Baili Clan. It could be said that when he saw Ling Han, he wanted to smack him to death.
However, this couldn’t be allowed. Ling Han still had the backing of a Saint who wielded an Imperial Weapon. Killing Ling Han would bring calamity to the Baili Clan.
It was as if Baili Dong had eaten an entire bowl of flies. He was disgusted, but he had no choice but to calm down, and said, “Release the True Self.”
This was the final stage, to examine aptitude.
Ling Han smiled and released the True Self of Destruction.
—The other True Selves were all nine-coloured. This was too dazzling. It was clearly telling others that he had already cultivated to the ninth form.

This undoubtedly trampled all over the Golden Generation. Perhaps it would incite some Imperial Clan elites to take risks and kill him at all costs. Thus, he had best keep a low profile. As long as everyone followed the rules, he would have nothing to fear.
“Yi?” This time, Baili Dong was really shocked. Of course, it was not because Ling Han was really too awesome, but rather because he was too ordinary.

Others could only be considered Fifth Form, then the True Self would also evolve into Glass Fetus, Jade Fetus, Purple Fetus, and so on, and when it reached Seventh Form and above, there would even be Tricolored, Four-coloured or Five-coloured True Selves.
As he saw it, with how freakish Ling Han was, the True Self would have to be at least five-colored.
But the truth was completely different. It was actually so ordinary?
“This?” He pondered for a moment. Wasn’t this crippled?

Ordinarily, this kind of aptitude was not qualified to enroll into the Ancestral King Academy. He could very well chase Ling Han away. As long as he told the truth, no one would accuse him of using his public office to avenge a private grudge.
However, if Ling Han was allowed to stay outside, who knew what kind of good fortune he would obtain. What if he became powerful again?
Why not... leave him in the academy. With such a weak True Self, even if he became Spirit Transformation Tier, he would still become trash, and there was no need to worry.

That’s right, that was the plan. As long as he was tied up in the academy, he would not be able to cause any ripples, and his whole life would be over. Furthermore, Ling Han was here, which was equivalent to having hold of something on the Nine Mountains Saint. He was sure that the Nine Mountains Saint would also work hard to resist the Yin souls.
Not bad, this was a brilliant idea.
“All right, you have passed,” Baili Dong stated calmly, and waved his hand, “Leave from the backyard, and there will naturally be someone to take you through the procedures.”
He was playing favorites, but it didn’t matter, because Ling Han’s freakishness was known to the whole world. For the sake of this, it was reasonable for him to let Ling Han pass the test, right?
Ling Han smiled faintly, and strode out of the courtyard.
As expected, there were a great many manservants here. When they saw him come out, one of them immediately said, “Lord Ling, I will lead you to go through the procedures.”
Ling Han followed him and went through the admission procedures.
This was actually just registering one’s identity and cultivation level.

Ling Han thought for a moment, and filled in “True Self Tier Seventh Form” on the column of cultivation level. This was in line with his freakish identity, but it was not enough to drive the Imperial Clans to madness, to kill him at all costs.
The empress, the large black dog, and the others were still in front of him. Everyone met up, and went to their accommodations.
Everyone was allocated a small courtyard, and they could also choose servants according to their own tastes, who would them deal with trifling matters.
Ling Han did not take it. He had too many secrets on him, and did not want to have the eyes and ears of an Imperial Clans by his side.
Not long after they settled down, someone came to cause trouble.
It was a group led by Zhang Wei.

chapters.title: Chapter 4306: Leaving in Anger
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“Brother, it’s him!” Zhang Wei had been stretching out his head to look around, and soon discovered Ling Han. Immediately, he stretched out a finger and pointed in his direction.
Yi, how did he come in so quickly?
Ling Han felt that this was a little strange. Previously, Zhang Wei had been beaten to the ground. Even if his aptitude had passed the test, there was no way he could have found help so quickly.
Unless, of course, he did not take the test, but rather directly ran off to find help.
His older brother, Zhang Jia, was the follower of an Imperial Son.
Ling Han looked over. There were three other people beside Zhang Wei, and one of them looked a little like Zhang Wei, though he looked slightly older.
This was probably Zhang Jia.

As expected, that person strode out, and only stopped when he arrived in front of Ling Han. However, he did not immediately make a move. Instead, he showed a smile, and said, “This Junior Brother, how should I address you?”
Ling Han shook his head, “You are not yet qualified to call me Junior Brother!”
Zhang Jia couldn’t help but look furious.
He was not qualified?

He himself was a prodigy. Otherwise, he would not have been accepted into the Ancestral King Academy. Furthermore, he was now riding on the coattail of an Imperial Son. Even a great many people with natural talent and higher status than him would have to treat him with respect.
‘I’m only being polite before resorting to force, yet you’re rubbing my nose in it?’
“Hehe, what an arrogant mad man!” The other two young men also walked over, smirking coldly.
“Brother Zhang, there’s no need to be polite with this kind of person. Just beat him into submission.”
Zhang Jia nodded, pointed at Ling Han’s nose, and said, “I gave you face, but you refused. Then you can only suffer the consequences of your own actions.”
Ling Han chuckled and said, “There’s one thing that you and your brother are very similar in. You both like to point at others, and I hate this the most.”
“So what?” Zhang Jia asked proudly.
Pa!
Ling Han moved, and slapped Zhang Jia onto the ground.
At this, the world fell silent. Zhang Jia directly fainted.
This scene caused the other two young men to be dumbfounded. What was going on? That was Zhang Jia.

The three of them were Niu Tengfei’s followers, so their cultivation level and strength were equal. Thus, Zhang Jia was sent flying with a single palm strike. If the two of them went up to fight, they would definitely be delivering themselves up to die.
“Scram,” Ling Han said calmly.
He couldn’t even be bothered to look at this kind of minor character.
“Let’s go.” The other two followers hurriedly turned around and left, while Zhang Wei carried Zhang Jia on his back and ran away dejectedly.
This scene was witnessed by a great many people, and they were all excited.
“Hiss, this newcomer is very awesome, isn’t he? He even dares to trifle with an Imperial Son’s people.”
“Hehe, he can only act arrogant for a while now. When the Imperial Son of the Niu Clan arrives later, he would probably have to lower his head and apologize.”
“You guys have guessed wrongly — do you guys know who he is?”
“Who is it?”
“Ling Han, the Imperial Son Killer!”
“What!”
Ling Han was so famous, so there were definitely people who recognized him. When they revealed his identity, it immediately caused a great many people to be stunned.
Who did not know of Ling Han’s name?

It was rumored that quite a few Imperial Sons had died by his hand. Previously, he had even caused the five great Imperial Clans to join forces, and go to the Nine Suns Holy Land to seek him out. However, they had not thought that Nine Mountains would become a Saint, and furthermore, had hold of the Imperial Weapon, and directly rebuked the five great Imperial Clans.

However, in the last dozen or so years, there had been no more news of Ling Han. At first, it was thought that because he was wary of the Imperial Clans, he had disappeared without a trace. They had not thought that he would appear again now, and directly clash with an Imperial Clan.
The Imperial Son Killer truly lived up to his reputation of specializing in provoking Imperial Sons.
Everyone quietly waited to watch the excitement.
After a while, Zhang Wei, Zhang Jia and the others came again, and this time, there was also an extraordinary-looking young man. His whole body was covered with a warm light.
Imperial Son, Niu Tengfei.

This Imperial Son very quickly focused his gaze on Ling Han. A look of realization appeared on his face, and he said, “I was wondering who would be so outrageously bold to not even give me face. So it is Ling Han.”
What!
When Zhang Wei and the others heard this, their hearts clenched.

They had naturally heard of Ling Han’s great name. That was truly a lawless person. It was said that he had even killed the Imperial Son, yet he was still alive and well. This was proof enough of his abilities.
And now, they had actually come into conflict with this kind of Demon King. Wasn’t that just courting death?
“Brat, don’t speak so sarcastically. Do you dare battle me?” The large black dog immediately jumped out.

A look of fury appeared on Niu Tengfei’s face. As he saw it, Ling Han had the Nine Mountains Saint standing behind him, so he could just barely be considered an Imperial Son, and was qualified to be his equal. However, how could a demonic dog be qualified to strut around in front of him?
“Ling Han, control the creatures around you, so that they will not seek their own suffering!” he said balefully.
Ling Han smiled and said, “Now that they’ve entered the academy, we’re all classmates. Since you look down on your classmates so much, shouldn’t I report this to the leaders of the academy?”
‘F*ck you!’
Niu Tengfei took a few deep breaths, but forcefully suppressed his anger.
He was a third generation Imperial Son, and everyone knew that Ling Han was already capable of beating up a third generation Imperial Son. Only the Silver Generation could stand against him.
Thus, if he were to forcefully use force now, that would only be seeking his own humiliation.

The Ancestral King Academy didn’t punish disciples for sparring with each other, as long as they didn’t cripple or cause death. Thus, if he took the initiative to provoke Ling Han and was beaten up for it, he could only swallow this bitter pill.
“Good! Good! Good!” Niu Tengfei said hatefully, “Since you’re here, then enjoy yourself!”
He couldn’t defeat Ling Han, but wasn’t there still the Silver Generation? If the Silver Generation couldn’t defeat Ling Han, there was still the Golden Generation!

Because he himself had come from the Imperial Clan, he knew better than anyone else just how terrifying the Golden Generation was. That kind of crushing pressure was enough to drive anyone to despair.

Ling Han was already the public enemy of the Imperial Clans. Thus, as long as they knew that Ling Han had come, he was sure that there would be a great many powerful Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters that would make a move, and teach this mad man a harsh lesson.
Niu Tengfei had come aggressively, yet ran away with his tail between his legs, greatly disappointing those who wanted to watch the excitement.
Seriously, they had anticipated for so long for nothing; they actually did not fight.
After this small interlude, everything was peaceful again.
Ling Han found out that the Ancestral King Academy had a very special set of rules.

Usually, if you had any questions on cultivation, you could completely ask for guidance from the teachers of the academy. If a Sect Master could not answer, a Venerate Tier would come out. If a Venerate Tier could not answer, then even a Saint would come out.
However, as for cultivation resources, one would have to fight for them himself.

Every month, the academy would hold a martial arts competition to decide the top ten of each cultivation level, and only these top ten would be able to obtain cultivation resources, a huge amount at that.
—The Ancestral King Academy wasn’t a charity to help everyone grow together. Wrong, elites would become stronger here, while the rest would only become weaker.

Because what was nurtured here was the future Ancestral King. At the very least, they would be competitors on the Imperial Path. Without such natural talent and abilities, what value would there be to nurture them?
Thus, everyone here was working hard on cultivation.
Only 10 people at each cultivation level could receive cultivation resources. This meant that many Imperial Sons would be empty-handed at the end, which showed how fierce the competition was.
Yet Ling Han was very expectant. When would the next tournament begin?

Zhang Jia couldn’t help but look furious.
He was not qualified?
He himself was a prodigy.
Otherwise, he would not have been accepted into the Ancestral King Academy.
Furthermore, he was now riding on the coattail of an Imperial Son.
Even a great many people with natural talent and higher status than him would have to treat him with respect.
‘I’m only being polite before resorting to force, yet you’re rubbing my nose in it?’
“Hehe, what an arrogant mad man!” The other two young men also walked over, smirking coldly.
“Brother Zhang, there’s no need to be polite with this kind of person.
Just beat him into submission.”
Zhang Jia nodded, pointed at Ling Han’s nose, and said, “I gave you face, but you refused.
Then you can only suffer the consequences of your own actions.”
Ling Han chuckled and said, “There’s one thing that you and your brother are very similar in.
You both like to point at others, and I hate this the most.”
“So what?” Zhang Jia asked proudly.
Pa!
Ling Han moved, and slapped Zhang Jia onto the ground.
At this, the world fell silent.
Zhang Jia directly fainted.
This scene caused the other two young men to be dumbfounded.
What was going on?
That was Zhang Jia.
The three of them were Niu Tengfei’s followers, so their cultivation level and strength were equal.
Thus, Zhang Jia was sent flying with a single palm strike.
If the two of them went up to fight, they would definitely be delivering themselves up to die.
“Scram,” Ling Han said calmly.
He couldn’t even be bothered to look at this kind of minor character.
“Let’s go.” The other two followers hurriedly turned around and left, while Zhang Wei carried Zhang Jia on his back and ran away dejectedly.
This scene was witnessed by a great many people, and they were all excited.
“Hiss, this newcomer is very awesome, isn’t he?
He even dares to trifle with an Imperial Son’s people.”
“Hehe, he can only act arrogant for a while now.
When the Imperial Son of the Niu Clan arrives later, he would probably have to lower his head and apologize.”
“You guys have guessed wrongly — do you guys know who he is?”
“Who is it?”
“Ling Han, the Imperial Son Killer!”
“What!”
Ling Han was so famous, so there were definitely people who recognized him.
When they revealed his identity, it immediately caused a great many people to be stunned.
Who did not know of Ling Han’s name?
It was rumored that quite a few Imperial Sons had died by his hand.
Previously, he had even caused the five great Imperial Clans to join forces, and go to the Nine Suns Holy Land to seek him out.
However, they had not thought that Nine Mountains would become a Saint, and furthermore, had hold of the Imperial Weapon, and directly rebuked the five great Imperial Clans.
However, in the last dozen or so years, there had been no more news of Ling Han.
At first, it was thought that because he was wary of the Imperial Clans, he had disappeared without a trace.
They had not thought that he would appear again now, and directly clash with an Imperial Clan.
The Imperial Son Killer truly lived up to his reputation of specializing in provoking Imperial Sons.
Everyone quietly waited to watch the excitement.
After a while, Zhang Wei, Zhang Jia and the others came again, and this time, there was also an extraordinary-looking young man.
His whole body was covered with a warm light.
Imperial Son, Niu Tengfei.
This Imperial Son very quickly focused his gaze on Ling Han.
A look of realization appeared on his face, and he said, “I was wondering who would be so outrageously bold to not even give me face.
So it is Ling Han.”
What!
When Zhang Wei and the others heard this, their hearts clenched.
They had naturally heard of Ling Han’s great name.
That was truly a lawless person.
It was said that he had even killed the Imperial Son, yet he was still alive and well.
This was proof enough of his abilities.
And now, they had actually come into conflict with this kind of Demon King.
Wasn’t that just courting death?
“Brat, don’t speak so sarcastically.
Do you dare battle me?” The large black dog immediately jumped out.
A look of fury appeared on Niu Tengfei’s face.
As he saw it, Ling Han had the Nine Mountains Saint standing behind him, so he could just barely be considered an Imperial Son, and was qualified to be his equal.
However, how could a demonic dog be qualified to strut around in front of him?
“Ling Han, control the creatures around you, so that they will not seek their own suffering!” he said balefully.
Ling Han smiled and said, “Now that they’ve entered the academy, we’re all classmates.
Since you look down on your classmates so much, shouldn’t I report this to the leaders of the academy?”
‘F*ck you!’
Niu Tengfei took a few deep breaths, but forcefully suppressed his anger.
He was a third generation Imperial Son, and everyone knew that Ling Han was already capable of beating up a third generation Imperial Son.
Only the Silver Generation could stand against him.
Thus, if he were to forcefully use force now, that would only be seeking his own humiliation.
The Ancestral King Academy didn’t punish disciples for sparring with each other, as long as they didn’t cripple or cause death.
Thus, if he took the initiative to provoke Ling Han and was beaten up for it, he could only swallow this bitter pill.
“Good!
Good!
Good!” Niu Tengfei said hatefully, “Since you’re here, then enjoy yourself!”
He couldn’t defeat Ling Han, but wasn’t there still the Silver Generation?
If the Silver Generation couldn’t defeat Ling Han, there was still the Golden Generation!
Because he himself had come from the Imperial Clan, he knew better than anyone else just how terrifying the Golden Generation was.
That kind of crushing pressure was enough to drive anyone to despair.
Ling Han was already the public enemy of the Imperial Clans.

Thus, as long as they knew that Ling Han had come, he was sure that there would be a great many powerful Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters that would make a move, and teach this mad man a harsh lesson.
Niu Tengfei had come aggressively, yet ran away with his tail between his legs, greatly disappointing those who wanted to watch the excitement.
Seriously, they had anticipated for so long for nothing; they actually did not fight.
After this small interlude, everything was peaceful again.
Ling Han found out that the Ancestral King Academy had a very special set of rules.
Usually, if you had any questions on cultivation, you could completely ask for guidance from the teachers of the academy.
If a Sect Master could not answer, a Venerate Tier would come out.
If a Venerate Tier could not answer, then even a Saint would come out.
However, as for cultivation resources, one would have to fight for them himself.

Every month, the academy would hold a martial arts competition to decide the top ten of each cultivation level, and only these top ten would be able to obtain cultivation resources, a huge amount at that.
—The Ancestral King Academy wasn’t a charity to help everyone grow together.
Wrong, elites would become stronger here, while the rest would only become weaker.
Because what was nurtured here was the future Ancestral King.
At the very least, they would be competitors on the Imperial Path.
Without such natural talent and abilities, what value would there be to nurture them?
Thus, everyone here was working hard on cultivation.
Only 10 people at each cultivation level could receive cultivation resources.
This meant that many Imperial Sons would be empty-handed at the end, which showed how fierce the competition was.
Yet Ling Han was very expectant.
When would the next tournament begin?

chapters.title: Chapter 4307: Ding Shu is Here
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
A few days later, the Ancestral King Academy welcomed another freakish prodigy.
Ding Shu.

He had shocked the world with a single feat, possessing the Eight Coloured True Self, scaring a large number of people. Even a Saint that was overseeing the academy was alerted, and personally tested it out. Immediately, he expressed the intention to take Ding Shu as disciple.
What was shocking was that Ding Shu actually refused.

Ling Han knew that Ding Shu had still concealed his strength. This guy was the ninth form of the True Self Tier, so he should possess the Nine-colored True Self. However, if he truly displayed the Nine-colored True Self, it probably wouldn’t be a Saint admiring him, but rather the Imperial Clans would kill him by hook or by crook.

Thus, Ding Shu should not have reached the end of the ninth form yet. He only had to show those True Selves that had not yet begun to develop into the ninth form, and he would naturally be able to bluff his way through.
He was the exact opposite of Ling Han. Ling Han showed the Tenth Form, but the effect was the same, and that was to appropriately conceal his strength.
However, the information about Ling Han’s True Self was inexplicably exposed.
Now, everyone in the academy knew that though Ling Han had cultivated to the seventh form, his True Self was actually extremely ordinary.
This similarly alerted a few higher ups, and they deliberately called Ling Han over for a follow-up examination. The result confirmed the rumors.
When the news spread out, the academy was once again shaken.
This time, it was not because they were shocked by how high Ling Han’s natural talent was, but rather because he was too weak.
Instantly, a great many disciples submitted a joint application, requesting that Ling Han be kicked out of the academy.

To have such a person stay in the academy, wasn’t that smearing the reputation of the academy? Oh, when an Ancestral King walked out of the academy in future, and said that he had once shared a class with this kind of weak trash, wouldn’t that be a stain on his whole life?
The higher ups of the academy discussed for a while, and decided to give Ling Han a chance.
In the next competition, if Ling Han could make it into the top twenty, then he could continue to stay in the academy. Otherwise, he would be kicked out of the academy.
This request wasn’t too high. After all, they did not demand that Ling Han make it into the top 10. But it definitely wasn’t a low requirement either. Top 20! With his “mediocre” True Self?

The news quickly spread throughout the entire academy. Everyone was curious and expectant. Would Ling Han, this guy who had risen so powerfully, be able to continue performing miracles, or would he be kicked out of the academy and scram with his tail between his legs?
Ding Shu immediately found Ling Han.
“Hey, what method did you use to actually turn the True Self into a mortal body?” His face was filled with curiosity.
Others might not know, but how could he not know? Ling Han had cultivated the ninth form, and was a freak like him. Thus, how could Ling Han have possibly become a piece of trash?
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, “That’s how it is in the first place. Perhaps you’re overthinking things?”
Ding Shu slanted a sideways glance at him, “Are you setting a trap for someone again?”
Ling Han spread his hands, “I have always kept a low profile.”
“Hehe.” Ding Shu put on a fake smile, obviously not believing him.
“To say nothing of me, didn’t you also deliberately reveal the Eight Coloured True Self?” Ling Han said with a smile. “What is it? Do you want me to rectify your name? You’re the ninth form.”
Ding Shu didn’t say anything else. He glanced at Ling Han and said, “The next tournament will be five days later. You’re not truly aiming to rank in the top twenty, are you?”
“Hehe, haven’t you always wanted to compete with me?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“Then you have to take it easy. Don’t be eliminated before you even come into contact with me.” Ding Shu stood up, and left with a wave of his hand.
“Sure, you should work hard too. Who knows, there may be elites here,” Ling Han said with a smile.
Ding Shu merely laughed loudly, and did not speak. It was as if he disdained from replying.
At Niu Tengfei’s place.
“What? That guy’s True Self is actually a mortal body!” Niu Tengfei immediately stood up, his face filled with hatred.

“The Seventh Form has actually formed a mortal body?” He faltered for a moment, then laughed loudly. He was the Imperial Son, so it was naturally not difficult for him to obtain information about Ling Han.

“We really fell for his intimidation!” Niu Da stopped laughing. A man’s name was like a tree’s shadow. Ling Han’s previous performance was too nature-defying, blasting the pride of the third-generation Imperial Sons to nothing, making him not dare to clash with him at all.

“I... am also in the Seventh Form now!” He clenched his fists. Unlike Ling Han, who could not obtain enough cultivation resources without venturing out, he was the Imperial Son, and had abundant cultivation resources, so there was absolutely no need for him to worry about this problem.
Thus, he had already advanced into the seventh form, and was close to catching up to the tail of the Silver Generation.
“Imperial Son, should we go find that guy now, and teach him a good lesson?” Zhang Jia asked. It could be said that he bore a grudge against Ling Han.
Niu Tengfei pondered for a moment, then quickly shook his head.

“That brat is also a grandmaster of formations, and has mastered the Star Steps. Thus, even if he can’t win, he can still run. Previously, it wasn’t like there hadn’t been a Silver Generation member that had fought with him before, and that was how he managed to play around with him.”
“However, during the academy tournament, it can only be held in a fixed area. This guy’s Star Steps can’t show its might.”
“Hehe, by then, he would only be able to suffer a beating.”
He was already confident, “I will use my connections, and have that guy face me in his first battle. I will defeat him in public, and restore the prestige of our Imperial Clans!”
“Hehe, Imperial Son is brilliant!” Zhang Jia immediately flattered.

The other two hurriedly followed, and said, “Ling Han was too impudent previously, offending so many Imperial Clans. If Imperial Son, you defeat Ling Han, then whatever Ziwei Imperial Clan, and Xuanfeng Imperial Clan would owe Imperial Son a favor.”
“In this way, the Imperial Son’s name could even surpass the Golden Generation!”
Previously, everyone had said that only the Golden Generation could suppress Ling Han. If Niu Tengfei could do so, then wouldn’t aptitude be on par with the Golden Generation?
Niu Tengfei showed an expression of pride. He was definitely going to be a hero!
Time slowly crept by. One day later, the battles between disciples of the Foundation Building Tier began first.

Ling Han didn’t pay any attention to them, because the people by his side were all at least at the Core Formation Tier. What was so fun about watching a bunch of little brothers and sisters that he did not know fight?
After this day, it was time for the Cauldron Forging Tier disciples to battle, and then another day later, it was time for the Core Formation Tier disciples to battle.

With the participation of his two beautiful wives, Ling Han naturally had to attend. He had long since arrived at the tournament grounds. This place had been reinforced by the Saints. To say nothing of the great battle between Core Formation Tier cultivators, even a battle between Sect Masters would find it very difficult to cause too much damage.

The aptitude of the empress and Hu Niu was comparable to the Imperial Son, but even if they now cultivated the Imperial Scroll and Body Art, they could only match the aptitude of an ordinary Imperial Son.

Thankfully, the majority of Imperial Sons had all advanced into True Self Tier, so the two women were ranked fourth and fifth respectively. This result could not be considered too bad, as they had obtained a great amount of cultivation resources.
The competition ended, and Ling Han left. However, he bumped into Niu Tengfei at the door.
“Tomorrow, I will beat the crap out of you!” this Imperial Son declared, his lips curling up slightly, looking extremely arrogant.
Ling Han chuckled upon hearing this. There were actually people who believed his bluff.
“Then, let’s wait and see.” He smiled. Then, he would beat the crap out of you tomorrow.
