chapters.title: Chapter 4308: Battles Begin
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
A day passed, and the True Self Tier battles began.

The top twenty from the previous tournament would not participate in the preliminaries. The others would fight first, and after about twenty to thirty people had been decided, the challenges would begin — the top twenty from the last tournament would be challenged. If they won, they would replace them, and if they lost, they would lose the right to continue fighting.
Thus, Ling Han, the large black dog, and the little azure dragon would have to participate in the preliminaries first.
There were a total of more than three hundred people. After about four rounds, there would only be about twenty to thirty left.
After drawing lots, everyone’s opponents were decided.
Ling Han’s opponent was... Niu Tengfei.
Yi, so coincidental?
Ling Han was astonished. He was the Imperial Son, yet he hadn’t even made it into the top twenty?
He must be deliberately targeting him.

The Ancestral King Academy was founded by the combined forces of the various Imperial Clans. Thus, if Niu Tengfei had done something that allowed the two of them to coincidentally match up with each other, it would not be difficult to imagine.
However, this guy was going to shoot himself in the foot.
Did he really think that he was a mortal and could be bullied as he liked?
Ling Han couldn’t help but smile. Then he’ll beat him to his heart’s content.
Very soon, the first round of eliminations began.
Because there were more people, they were divided into three groups. Ling Han took a look. He was in the last group.
‘Fine, I’ll just have to wait.’
The large black dog and little azure dragon were in the first group, and the two of them easily defeated their respective opponents.

—They had not entered into the Dark Clouds Hell, so the advancement of their cultivation level naturally could not keep up with Ling Han. However, they would be taking alchemical pills concocted by Ling Han every day, and added with the resources provided by the Nine Suns Holy Land, their advancement rate could not be considered slow.
Afterwards, Ling Han returned, and distributed the Source Dao Stones to them, allowing the advancement of the people by his side to rapidly increase.
Thus, the two of them were both in the fifth form of the True Self Tier. They couldn’t compare to Ling Han, but they were definitely elites in this cultivation level.

However, there were many prodigies gathered here. Even if they could pass the first round, they might not be able to pass the second and third rounds of elimination. After all, the fifth form was still a little too low.

The seven babies didn’t participate in the battle. Firstly, they didn’t need cultivation resources, and secondly, there were too many elites here. Ling Han was afraid that something would happen to them.
In the second group, Ding Shu took the field, displaying terrifying abilities. He defeated his opponent with a single strike, and it was in line with his “Eighth Form” battle prowess.
The battles for the third group immediately began.
Ling Han walked into the arena, and Niu Tengfei had already walked in as well. His hands were crossed behind his back, a faint smile curling up the corners of his lips.
“You did it on purpose, didn’t you?” Ling Han asked.
“That’s right,” Niu Tengfei nodded proudly.
“I’ve really troubled you,” Ling Han said with a smile. “However, aren’t you afraid of shooting yourself in the foot?”

“Hahaha!” Niu Tengfei laughed loudly, “Don’t think that just because I am not in the top twenty, my abilities are very, very weak! On the other hand, I too am in the Seventh Form, but I had something on previously, and have only recently returned to the academy, and have not participated in the previous ranking battles.”
Oh, so that was how it was.
Ling Han nodded and said, “By the looks of it, you still won’t be able to enter the top 20 this time.”
“Humph, you are really arrogant!” Niu Tengfei smirked coldly. With a thought, a True Self appeared above his head, and five-coloured light overflowed.
Seeing this scene, quite a number of people exclaimed in shock. Even those higher ups in the academy were nodding repeatedly.
“Five Coloured True Self, almost catching up to Silver Generation.”
“En, among the Silver Generation, he can at least be ranked at the bottom.”
“Who would’ve thought? What heaven-defying fated opportunity did this brat obtain? He actually managed to cultivate a Five Colored True Self!”

Hearing the exclamations of shock from the masses, Niu Tengfei revealed an expression of pride. He had indeed obtained a great opportunity, which allowed him to advance into the Seventh Form. Furthermore, he had even allowed the True Self to form the Five Coloured Fetus.
The gods were blessing him, so they couldn’t be envious.
Ling Han cracked his knuckles, and said, “Although this is still a little weak, this is like beating a child on a cloudy day, when there is nothing else to do. I am free anyway.”
“You!” Niu Tengfei glared angrily. Even at a time like this, you are still so arrogant?
Boom, he charged out, and used the celestial technique. A black-coloured bull appeared, condensing Regulations and high-level energy, which ruthlessly crashed towards Ling Han.
Especially the two bull horns, which were exuding a coldness like Divine Metal. Their destructive power was definitely terrifying.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and with a flash, xiu, he instantly disappeared from where he had been standing. When he reappeared, he had already appeared behind Niu Tengfei. Then, he shot out a punch.
He hadn’t used any celestial technique, but he had instilled his own understanding of martial arts into this punch. This was the path that he had tentatively begun to walk.
In everyone’s eyes, this punch was very ordinary, yet seemed to contain some kind of Regulations, filled with mystery.
Peng, with a single punch, Niu Tengfei did not manage to parry or dodge at all, or perhaps he had forgotten to parry. He was hit solidly, and instantly sprawled out on the ground.
He was just about to bounce up, but a foot had already stepped on his head. If he dared to struggle with all his might, it was possible that his mind would be trampled through.
Niu Tengfei instantly didn’t dare to move.
He couldn’t help but flush red with embarrassment. Yesterday, he had even threatened to beat Ling Han into submission. Who would’ve thought that he would be beaten to the ground in a single exchange?
What kind of strange footwork was this, that it could actually surpass his divine sense?
Star Steps?
That was impossible. There was a suppressing formation here, and he could not communicate with the ley lines. Otherwise, how could he have taken the initiative to ask for a rebuff?
“No way, he was knocked down with a single punch?”
“Too weak!”
“Could it be that his Five Coloured True Self was formed through the use of a natural treasure? Otherwise, his battle prowess definitely wouldn’t be so weak.”
“That’s right. I saw that Ling Han’s punch was very ordinary, but why didn’t he even move to parry?”
“Sigh, what a piece of trash.”
Everyone shook their heads. What Seventh Form and Five Coloured True Self? He was so weak.
The higher-ups were also a little confused. Though they thought that Ling Han’s punch was a little strange, upon closer thought, it seemed to be very ordinary.
Was Niu Tengfei really too weak?
However, the outcome of the battle had already been decided, so they couldn’t worry about this for the time being. In that case, they would just let the battle test Ling Han’s strength.
Not long after, all three groups of battles ended.
After drawing lots again, the second round of eliminations began.

This time, Ling Han’s luck was slightly better. He had drawn an opponent in the sixth form of True Self Tier, so he was naturally able to deal with him easily with his advantage of having a “higher cultivation level”.

It was the same for the third and fourth rounds. After all, those who could cultivate to the seventh form should have the strength to advance into the top thirty. As long as they did not encounter each other in advance, passing four rounds of elimination battles would not be a problem.

The large black dog and little azure dragon also passed four rounds. However, due to the limitations of their cultivation level, it was almost impossible for them to advance any further. No matter what, they had to advance into the peak stage of the sixth form. In fact, only after reaching the seventh form would they be qualified to charge into the top twenty.
Next, they could watch the show.

“Begin.” A Sect Master spoke up.

A day passed, and the True Self Tier battles began.
The top twenty from the previous tournament would not participate in the preliminaries.
The others would fight first, and after about twenty to thirty people had been decided, the challenges would begin — the top twenty from the last tournament would be challenged.
If they won, they would replace them, and if they lost, they would lose the right to continue fighting.
Thus, Ling Han, the large black dog, and the little azure dragon would have to participate in the preliminaries first.
There were a total of more than three hundred people.
After about four rounds, there would only be about twenty to thirty left.
After drawing lots, everyone’s opponents were decided.
Ling Han’s opponent was...
Niu Tengfei.
Yi, so coincidental?
Ling Han was astonished.
He was the Imperial Son, yet he hadn’t even made it into the top twenty?
He must be deliberately targeting him.
The Ancestral King Academy was founded by the combined forces of the various Imperial Clans.
Thus, if Niu Tengfei had done something that allowed the two of them to coincidentally match up with each other, it would not be difficult to imagine.
However, this guy was going to shoot himself in the foot.
Did he really think that he was a mortal and could be bullied as he liked?
Ling Han couldn’t help but smile.
Then he’ll beat him to his heart’s content.
Very soon, the first round of eliminations began.
Because there were more people, they were divided into three groups.
Ling Han took a look.
He was in the last group.
‘Fine, I’ll just have to wait.’
The large black dog and little azure dragon were in the first group, and the two of them easily defeated their respective opponents.
—They had not entered into the Dark Clouds Hell, so the advancement of their cultivation level naturally could not keep up with Ling Han.
However, they would be taking alchemical pills concocted by Ling Han every day, and added with the resources provided by the Nine Suns Holy Land, their advancement rate could not be considered slow.
Afterwards, Ling Han returned, and distributed the Source Dao Stones to them, allowing the advancement of the people by his side to rapidly increase.
Thus, the two of them were both in the fifth form of the True Self Tier.
They couldn’t compare to Ling Han, but they were definitely elites in this cultivation level.
However, there were many prodigies gathered here.
Even if they could pass the first round, they might not be able to pass the second and third rounds of elimination.
After all, the fifth form was still a little too low.
The seven babies didn’t participate in the battle.
Firstly, they didn’t need cultivation resources, and secondly, there were too many elites here.
Ling Han was afraid that something would happen to them.
In the second group, Ding Shu took the field, displaying terrifying abilities.
He defeated his opponent with a single strike, and it was in line with his “Eighth Form” battle prowess.
The battles for the third group immediately began.
Ling Han walked into the arena, and Niu Tengfei had already walked in as well.
His hands were crossed behind his back, a faint smile curling up the corners of his lips.
“You did it on purpose, didn’t you?” Ling Han asked.
“That’s right,” Niu Tengfei nodded proudly.
“I’ve really troubled you,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“However, aren’t you afraid of shooting yourself in the foot?”
“Hahaha!” Niu Tengfei laughed loudly, “Don’t think that just because I am not in the top twenty, my abilities are very, very weak!
On the other hand, I too am in the Seventh Form, but I had something on previously, and have only recently returned to the academy, and have not participated in the previous ranking battles.”
Oh, so that was how it was.
Ling Han nodded and said, “By the looks of it, you still won’t be able to enter the top 20 this time.”
“Humph, you are really arrogant!” Niu Tengfei smirked coldly.
With a thought, a True Self appeared above his head, and five-coloured light overflowed.
Seeing this scene, quite a number of people exclaimed in shock.
Even those higher ups in the academy were nodding repeatedly.
“Five Coloured True Self, almost catching up to Silver Generation.”
“En, among the Silver Generation, he can at least be ranked at the bottom.”
“Who would’ve thought?
What heaven-defying fated opportunity did this brat obtain?
He actually managed to cultivate a Five Colored True Self!”
Hearing the exclamations of shock from the masses, Niu Tengfei revealed an expression of pride.
He had indeed obtained a great opportunity, which allowed him to advance into the Seventh Form.
Furthermore, he had even allowed the True Self to form the Five Coloured Fetus.
The gods were blessing him, so they couldn’t be envious.
Ling Han cracked his knuckles, and said, “Although this is still a little weak, this is like beating a child on a cloudy day, when there is nothing else to do.
I am free anyway.”
“You!” Niu Tengfei glared angrily.
Even at a time like this, you are still so arrogant?
Boom, he charged out, and used the celestial technique.
A black-coloured bull appeared, condensing Regulations and high-level energy, which ruthlessly crashed towards Ling Han.
Especially the two bull horns, which were exuding a coldness like Divine Metal.
Their destructive power was definitely terrifying.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and with a flash, xiu, he instantly disappeared from where he had been standing.
When he reappeared, he had already appeared behind Niu Tengfei.
Then, he shot out a punch.
He hadn’t used any celestial technique, but he had instilled his own understanding of martial arts into this punch.
This was the path that he had tentatively begun to walk.
In everyone’s eyes, this punch was very ordinary, yet seemed to contain some kind of Regulations, filled with mystery.
Peng, with a single punch, Niu Tengfei did not manage to parry or dodge at all, or perhaps he had forgotten to parry.
He was hit solidly, and instantly sprawled out on the ground.
He was just about to bounce up, but a foot had already stepped on his head.
If he dared to struggle with all his might, it was possible that his mind would be trampled through.
Niu Tengfei instantly didn’t dare to move.
He couldn’t help but flush red with embarrassment.
Yesterday, he had even threatened to beat Ling Han into submission.
Who would’ve thought that he would be beaten to the ground in a single exchange?
What kind of strange footwork was this, that it could actually surpass his divine sense?
Star Steps?
That was impossible.
There was a suppressing formation here, and he could not communicate with the ley lines.
Otherwise, how could he have taken the initiative to ask for a rebuff?
“No way, he was knocked down with a single punch?”
“Too weak!”
“Could it be that his Five Coloured True Self was formed through the use of a natural treasure?
Otherwise, his battle prowess definitely wouldn’t be so weak.”
“That’s right.
I saw that Ling Han’s punch was very ordinary, but why didn’t he even move to parry?”
“Sigh, what a piece of trash.”
Everyone shook their heads.
What Seventh Form and Five Coloured True Self?
He was so weak.
The higher-ups were also a little confused.
Though they thought that Ling Han’s punch was a little strange, upon closer thought, it seemed to be very ordinary.
Was Niu Tengfei really too weak?

chapters.title: Chapter 4309: Battling the Number one
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han wasn’t in a hurry to attack. After all, he was an elite, so he definitely couldn’t rush into battle.
The seeds ranked in the top 20 all stood proudly, according to their rankings. Thus, one only had to count which rank this person was ranked in to know his ranking.
First place was Guan Xia.
Guan Xia, Imperial Son of the Xuanfeng Imperial Clan, Silver Generation, and also Guan Yuanming’s cousin. In terms of a large clan, this relationship was quite close.

Ling Han couldn’t help but think. Previously, when he had entered into the True Dragon Abyss, wasn’tCheng Qing from the Thousand Spirit Imperial Clan the one who had stood out in the True Self Tier? Why was it now Guan Xia that was sitting in the position of the number one elite of the True Self Tier?

He asked the large black dog, and only then did he find out that Cheng Qing had already advanced into the SpiritTransformation Tier. In that case, it was naturally impossible for him to participate in the competition for the True Self Tier.

However, at that time, Cheng Qing could do as he liked in the True Self Tier, and was the top elite. However, after advancing into the Spirit Transformation Tier, because his cultivation level was not high, and there were some Golden Generation elites that remained at this cultivation level, he was naturally suppressed very badly, and was not even able to enter into the top twenty.
So that was the case. Ling Han nodded.
“Little Han, who do you plan to challenge?” the large black dog asked.
“Needless to say?” Ling Han said with a smile.
The large black dog finally understood. Ling Han was definitely aiming for the first place.

“Take it easy. Don’t expose the secret that you are the Tenth Form,” the large black dog warned. If this spread out, it was probable that even the caskets of Ancestral Kings would not be able to contain them, and they would turn into zombies, one after another, and come out.
“I know.” Ling Han nodded. As an unreliable guy, he actually dared to remind him. How shameless.

Consecutive challenges were issued, but most of them failed. There were very few who succeeded. Furthermore, those who had previously stood in the 18th, 19th, and 20th places had been defeated, and now, they were fighting their way back. This was an ordinary tug-of-war.
Ling Han saw that Ding Shu was already restless, so he stepped out first.
“Yi, Ling Han is going to issue a challenge!”
“Who would he choose?”

“Although he’s at the Seventh Form, his True Self is far too weak. In fact, he can only rank at the bottom of the Seventh Form. Thus, I believe that he won’t challenge anyone above the fifteenth rank.”
“Hehe, there are those that are weaker than him, such as that Imperial Son of the Niu Clan.”
“Pu!”

A great many people laughed out loud. Niu Tengfei would definitely become a great joke in future. He couldn’t even win against a fellow cultivator of the same cultivation level with a mortal body; how utterly humiliating.
Niu Tengfei didn’t leave. He was unwilling to give up, and wanted to see how Ling Han was defeated. Hearing the gossip of the masses, he couldn’t help but blush.

However, most of the people here were Imperial Sons, and none of them had a background weaker than his. So what if he was furious? They weren’t afraid of him, or they wouldn’t be spouting such words even though they knew he was here.
It was all Ling Han’s fault! It was all this evil villain’s fault!
Niu Tengfei’s eyes were spitting fire, wanting nothing more than to rush up and kill Ling Han.

He was extremely dissatisfied. As the Imperial Son, he had naturally grasped a great many ultimate techniques, but he had not even managed to cast them before he was defeated, which made him feel that he had lost too unjustly.
However, he was also very curious which pushover Ling Han would pick.
Right at this moment, Ding Shu also jumped out.
“I’ll challenge him!”
“I choose him!”
Practically at the same time, Ling Han and Ding Shu both stretched out their hands and pointed at Guan Xia.
This?
Everyone couldn’t help but grit their teeth. That was Guan Xia, a Silver Generation elite. Not only had he long since cultivated to the Seventh Form, he was actually still a Six-Colored Fetus!

If it was not for the fact that he still wanted to attempt the Eighth Form, and challenge the heights of the Golden Generation, he would have long since been able to advance into the Spirit Transformation Tier.
This kind of opponent should be avoided at all costs, and they actually wanted to snatch the opportunity to issue a challenge?
Especially Ling Han. He still had a mission. If he lost this battle, he would not be able to make top twenty, and would be kicked out of the academy.
Under such pressure, he actually dared to challenge Guan Xia, who was ranked number one?
Just how outrageously bold was this?
“Ling Han issued the challenge first,” a Sect Master said.
Ding Shu had no choice but to step aside.
However, this was also good. If Ling Han won, then it would be enough for him to defeat Ling Han, and if Ling Han lost... hoho, that would be impossible.
Just in time. He wanted to have a hearty battle with Ling Han.
Guan Xia walked out, looking down on Ling Han.

This wasn’t the first time they had met, and they had already fought once before. However, at that time, Guan Xia’s cultivation level had far surpassed Ling Han’s. Ling Han could only use the Star Steps to toy around with him, but didn’t have the strength to fight him head-on.
Now, after more than ten years, Ling Han’s cultivation level had greatly improved, and Guan Xia had also advanced from the sixth form to the seventh form. His improvement was actually quite amazing.

“This time, you have nowhere to run!” Guan Xia stated calmly. The Silver Generation elite had moved, and was actually unable to suppress a person whose abilities and cultivation level was far inferior to his. This had become a humiliation to him.
But this time, he would be able to wash away this humiliation.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Why should I flee?”
“Haha, someone seems to have forgotten the scandal of being hunted down by me all over the universe!” Guan Xia said disdainfully.

Ling Han shook his head and said, “At that time, I was in the third form of the True Self Tier, and you were in the sixth form. If I were to face you head-on, that would be an extremely stupid thing to do.”

Guan Xia was speechless for a moment. Indeed, the gap in cultivation level was too wide, so it was very normal that Ling Han was outmatched. On the other hand, with a gap of three minor levels, Ling Han was still able to escape alive from the grasp of a Silver Generation elite. This was the truly awesome thing.

He immediately composed himself, and said calmly, “I understand. You were stimulated by that battle, so you took the crooked path to rapidly increase your cultivation level. Your cultivation level has indeed increased, but the quality of your True Self... heh.”
Needless to say, everyone knew that Ling Han’s seventh form was a mortal body.
The path of cultivation level requiredone to take one firm and solid step at a time. In the end, there was a price to pay for taking a shortcut that could lead to quick success.

The truth was indeed so. Ling Han had paid a price, but it was not having the quality of his True Self decreased, but rather damaged the foundations of his life force, and almost caused a huge problem.
Guan Xia’s deduction was reasonable, and everyone nodded. No wonder Ling Han’s Seventh Form was so weak. So that was the logic.
Ling Han couldn’t help but smile, “Have you come to battle, or to commentate?”
“To defeat you?” Guan Xia shook his head, “It would only be the matter of a few moves.”
“All right, I’ll wait and see.” Ling Han crooked a finger at him.
“Ignorant!” Guan Xia sneered, and pointed a finger at Ling Han. Instantly, the whole sky was filled with stars.
Boom, every streak of starlight was the size of a fist, and Regulations could be vaguely seen. Like raindrops, they enshrouded Ling Han.
Ling Han stood proudly, unafraid in the slightest.
This was natural. He was in the Tenth Form, and even if all the True Self Tier elites here attacked at the same time, he could still suppress them single-handedly.
—If these people knew that he had once easily killed a Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator in the Second Change, their thoughts would definitely be different now.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
When the starlight landed on or near Ling Han, it immediately exploded. Instantly, seals appeared everywhere, and a terrifying energy surged chaotically, turning into golden mushroom clouds.
Ling Han instantly disappeared from sight.

chapters.title: Chapter 4310: Six Coloured Saber
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“This is Guan Xia’s strength!”
“This is the true strength of the Seventh Form.”
“That brat is too arrogant. He actually dared to take this attack head-on.”
“Haha, he’s going to be kicked out of the academy this time.”

Everyone smirked coldly. Most of the people here were descendants of the Imperial Clans and the minority were Dao Child of the Holy Lands. How could they dare to oppose the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters openly by saying differently?
“Pei! Even if you guys die 100 times, Little Han won’t lose a single hair!” the large black dog immediately spat.
“It’s not that Grandpa Dragon looks down on you guys, but you guys are just a bunch of trash in my eyes.” The little azure dragon’s mouth was also unforgiving, its sharpness extremely high.

This caused everyone to be furious. If it was not for the fact that this was the tournament grounds, and there were a considerable number of elites standing guard, they really wanted to rush up and tear the mouths of these two guys.
“Heh, he can’t even withstand a single strike. What else is there left to say?” one of the Imperial Sons asked coldly.
Facts spoke louder than words.
Meanwhile, the little azure dragon and the large black dog wore expressions of disdain. “Has the battle been decided already? Idiot!”
“The victor hasn’t been decided yet?” The Imperial Son laughed in spite of himself, “Why do you people only know how to pester endlessly?”
“Pei, even the Lords have not announced the results, so what are you jumping around for?” the large black dog spat out.
“Grandpa Dragon guesses that this guy might have some shameful relationship with Guan Xia’s a$$hole,” the little azure dragon said with certainty.
That Imperial Son instantly wanted to throw up blood. He had only spoken the truth, so how did it have anything to do with Guan Xia?
“Stop the commotion!” A Sect Master shouted in a deep voice. Instantly, everyone fell silent.
On the battlefield, the light gradually dispersed, and Ling Han was seen standing proudly, completely unscathed.
How was this possible!
Instantly, everyone felt their scalps go numb. This guy had taken a blow from Guan Xia head-on. Even if Guan Xia had not used his full strength, how could he have blocked it so easily?
Could it be that this guy was wearing some treasured armor that could withstand such a violent attack?
“This is unfair!”
“That’s right. In battle, it is not allowed to use any kind of Spirit Tool.”
“Otherwise, if I go and get a Saint Tool, wouldn’t I be able to sweep aside all opposition and be invincible?”
Everyone called out, thinking that Ling Han had severely breached the rules.
“Shut up!” the Sect Master shouted in a deep voice. “Ling Han didn’t use a Spirit Tool.”
‘What?’
Disbelief spread across everyone’s faces. How was this possible?
Meanwhile, Guan Xia took a deep breath, his expression becoming incredibly serious.

Since the Sect Master said that Ling Han didn’t use a Spirit Tool, that must be the case. He recognized this Sect Master, though he wasn’t from his own clan. Instead, he was from the Peacock Imperial Clan. He definitely wouldn’t side with Ling Han.
In other words, Ling Han’s strength... was very strong.
He needed to get serious.
Weng, Guan Xia’s whole body glowed. On his right side, a six-coloured saber appeared, and there were incredibly mysterious veined patterns on the blade.
He stretched out his hand and grabbed it. The colorful saber was already in his hand.
Yi, didn’t they say that Spirit Tools couldn’t be used?
Ling Han focused his gaze, and couldn’t help but look slightly surprised. This colorful saber used Dao as its structure, and high-level energy as its blade. It was not a real saber.
Six colours?
True Self?

“Ling Han, try out the might of my saber strike!” Guan Xia said coldly. He brandished his saber in a slash. Six-coloured light dazzled the skies, as if even the heaven and earth had been sliced apart.
Yi, True Self can be used as a weapon?

Ling Han really didn’t know. Was this a secret technique that only the members of the Imperial Clans had mastered, or was it Guan Xia’s own fortuitous encounter that allowed him to possess such a Mystical Power?
He wanted to test out its might.
Ling Han clenched his hand into a fist, and charged towards the six-coloured saber.
Peng!

chapters.title: Chapter 4311: Getting serious
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han decided to get serious.
His aura immediately changed, and a terrifying power surged. He threw a punch, bringing with it a crushing force, that shot towards Guan Xia.
‘What?’
Guan Xia couldn’t help but feel astonished. Why had Ling Han’s strength suddenly increased so much?
However, could he dodge?
He had been beating down on Ling Han all this while. Oh, now that Ling Han was fighting back, he actually didn’t dare to take it head-on?
With a loud shout, he brandished the colorful saber, slashing out at Ling Han.
Fine, I might as well split you into two.
Peng, fist crashed into colorful saber, but the result this time was completely different. The colorful saber was forcibly shattered, and then crumbled, turning into endless pieces.
At the same time, Guan Xia was also sent flying, drawing a curve in the sky before landing heavily on the ground, raising a cloud of dust.
At this moment, a dead silence fell.
What was going on?
Was Guan Xia sleepwalking? He had actually been smashed with a single punch?
“Hahaha!” The large black dog and little azure dragon laughed loudly.
“How is it? Do you all yield, trash?”
“If you don’t have any abilities, then stop blabbering nonsense, to avoid making a big fool of yourself.”

The two of them began to mock to their heart’s content. Who asked those people from before to be so arrogant? Once these two guys started their mockery, their battle prowess would definitely not be something that a few dozen Imperial Sons could oppose.
“Guan Xia, stand up quickly!”
“You’re one of the strongest members of the Silver Generation!”
“Stand up!”
Everyone was cheering Guan Xia on, but what use was that? He had already been knocked unconscious by Ling Han’s punch.
His cultivation level was three minor levels lower than Ling Han’s, so how could he possibly withstand a single punch from him?
It was already very fortunate that he hadn’t been beaten to death.
Ling Han clapped his hands, and asked, “Am I number one now?”
Seeing how uncaring he was, everyone wanted to slap him.
Too arrogant; he was really too arrogant.
However, even Guan Xia had been defeated. Apart from glaring at him, what else could they do?
None of them could figure it out. Ling Han’s True Self was clearly so ordinary, so how could he burst out with such terrifying battle prowess?

“Unfortunately, Han Dihas gone to the Dark Clouds Hell. He is the Silver Generation elite that has the highest chance of breaking through to Eight Forms,” someone suddenly said, his expression filled with regret.
“En!” This caused quite a number of people to nod.

Han Di was indeed a freakish natural talent. It eben seemed like he had hopes of catching up to the weakest of the Golden Generation. He took a risk by entering into Dark Clouds Hell, and now there was no news from him. It was unknown what had become of him.
“With Han Di’s talent, he’s probably already reached the Eighth Form by now. If he were here, Ling Han wouldn’t be so arrogant!”
“Too bad!”
Everyone gritted their teeth. It could not be helped. They could only watch as Ling Han acted arrogantly and proudly.
However, what they didn’t know was that Han Di had indeed advanced to the Eighth Form. Moreover, he had even battled with Ling Han before being easily killed by Ling Han.
Eight Forms versus Ten Forms, and it was a freak like Ling Han at that. Wasn’t that just courting death?
Ling Han had no intention of exposing this. He peered down at them, appearing extremely arrogant and haughty.
No one issued a challenge. Ling Han stood there in boredom, while his eyes turned towards Ding Shu.
Yet Ding Shu gave him a strange smile. He issued a challenge to Xu Youque, the Imperial Son who was ranked second. Very soon, he defeated him, and took his place as second place.
He walked to Ling Han’s side, crossing his arms over his chest.
“Why aren’t you challenging me?” Ling Han asked through divine sense.
“You and I have too many secrets, so it would be best not to battle here,” Ding Shu replied.
Ling Han nodded. If Ding Shu really challenged him, then he would definitely suppress his battle prowess. If they battled like this, it would really be too dissatisfying.
“Alright, let’s set a time. We’ll go to a desolate planet to battle.”
“Deal.”
After this battle, Ling Han’s name naturally spread throughout the academy again. Previously, everyone thought that he was done for, with how his True Self was only mortal.
However, this battle had redeemed Ling Han’s name. Your uncle is still your uncle, and he was still very awesome.
This also attracted the curiosity of many people. How could Ling Han be so powerful?

Ling Han received a large amount of cultivation resources. Indeed, the Ancestral King Academy wasn’t stingy in this aspect. The rewards for the top ten were extremely generous, so he could improve his cultivation level at a high speed.
However, Ling Han’s hidden danger was still not resolved. His life force was still severely damaged, and he needed a greatly nutritious Celestial medicine to repair the damaged life force.

This kind of Great Herb was extremely valuable even among the Imperial Clans, so it was naturally impossible to be offered a reward. Thus, Ling Han couldn’t possibly obtain such a Great Herb from the Ancestral King Academy.

Forget it, he’ll improve his cultivation first. In any case, he hadn’t reached the end of the tenth form yet, and was still a little far from breaking through to the Spiritual Transformation Tier. He wasn’t in a hurry to consider this problem.
A few days later, Ding Shu ran over and dragged him to an uninhabited planet for a battle.

Ling Han gladly agreed. He very much wanted to know how strong Ding Shu was, and what secret techniques he had grasped. Though they had both come out of Genesis World, and were both poor, and had to start from the beginning again, people like them would all have great opportunities, and definitely could not be underestimated.

The two of them battled fiercely. Ling Han tried his best to appear as if he was exerting his full effort, to avoid Ding Shu from noticing anything off. He suppressed his cultivation level to the middle stage of the ninth form, and battled fiercely with Ding Shu.
In this battle, Ding Shu was definitely going all out, allowing Ling Han to see a great many of his secrets.

Unlike Ling Han, Ding Shu did not have the ability to neutralize attacks within six Heavens, but he could increase his own battle prowess by three Heavens for a short period of time. This was also considerably terrifying. Caught off guard, Ling Han almost suffered a loss.
Thankfully, his defense was so strong that it rendered others speechless. He was only in a flurry for a moment.
Ding Shu attacked a few more times, and couldn’t help but stop, sighing dejectedly.
“The fact that you can dissipate the attacks that you receive is too great an advantage.” He appeared very exasperated, then a little curious, “What is this limit of yours?”
Ling Han pondered for a moment, before replying, “Within six Heavens.”

“Hiss!” Ding Shu inhaled sharply, “I have a Mystical Power that has awakened, that can increase battle prowess by three Heavens. It has always been my trump card that can turn the tables, but when I encounter you, it is as if I am naturally subdued!”
Ling Han laughed loudly, patted his shoulder, and said, “So, remember to call me Boss in the future.”
Ding Shu was naturally unwilling. He was also an incredibly domineering person.
“Why don’t we do this? Let’s make a bet.” His eyes darted around, “If one of us can break through to the Tenth Form, the one who does not succeed would have to admit that he is the lackey.”
Hehe, your awareness is quite high, huh? You’re really made for being a lackey.
“What if both of us break through or fail to break through?” Ling Han asked.
“Then let’s compete to see who can break through the true limit after advancing into the Spirit Transformation Tier,” Ding Shu Ding Shu said.
“All right.” Ling Han nodded decisively, because he was already invincible, “Don’t you regret it.”
“Of course.” Ding Shu was proud, “You can’t regret it either! Hehe, I am very interested in taking you as my underling.”
“Same goes for me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 4312: Baili Luoyang
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ancestral King Academy
A group of Venerate Tier elites were seated. None of them spoke, and the atmosphere appeared extremely oppressive.

“Humph, to have a murderer who killed members of the Imperial Clans wander around in front of our eyes all day long, what kind of great humiliation is that?” A Venerate Tier slammed a hand on the table and exclaimed loudly, his face filled with fury.
This was Venerate Guan from the Xuan Feng Imperial Clan. Their Imperial Son, Guan Yuanming, had died in Ling Han’s hands, so he naturally saw Ling Han as a thorn in his side.

“What can we do?” the Demon Ox Imperial Clan’s Venerate Niu said. There were two black bull horns growing from his head, and mysterious seals lit up, exuding a terrifying pressure. Even a Sect Master could only shiver helplessly in front of him.

“Even Guan Xia is no match for him, and Han Di is still in the Dark Clouds Hell. There should be no one in the Silver Generation that can match him,” a Bodhisattva of the Buddhist Race of South Heavenly Realm said.

All of a sudden, all the Venerate Tier elites were a little speechless. If they were to make a move, killing Ling Han would naturally be child’s play, but unless they no longer wanted their lives, and planned to let the clan behind them take a huge risk, they would definitely not make a move on Ling Han.
“There’s one person who might be able to deal with that despicable brat,” the Golden Cauldron Imperial Clan’s Venerate Shi said calmly.
“Who is it?” All the Venerates asked.
Yet Venerate Shi looked towards the Venerate Tier from the Ziwei Imperial Clan, “You will have to ask Big Brother Hanyun.”
Baili Hanyun couldn’t help but look startled, and asked, “You’re talking about that unfilial brat?”

Meanwhile, Venerate Shi sighed, and said, “Old Brother Hanyun, Luoyang was only too young at that time, and that was why he made such a great mistake. However, he should have gotten the punishment he deserved by now, so it’s about time to let him out.”
Baili Hanyun remained silent, his expression extremely dark.

The other Venerate Tier elites didn’t know the situation, and were all unable to answer. They were also curious. Judging by Venerate Shi’s tone, this “Luoyang” should have extremely shocking natural talent, but because he had committed a grave mistake, he was imprisoned by the Baili Clan.
Venerate Shi continued, “Furthermore, if Luoyang is allowed to come out, it would be just right for him to redeem himself.”
Baili Hanyun considered for a moment, then said, “I will contact the clan and make this suggestion.”
“He, then we’ll wait for Brother Hanyun’s good news,” Venerate Shi said with a nod.
Baili Hanyun, on the other hand, was decisive. He directly tore a rip into the Void and left.
Once he left, the other Venerate Tier elites were all curious, and began to ask who exactly this “Luoyang” was.

“The Baili Clan is blessed by the heavens. The Golden Generation has Baili Tian, the Silver Generation has Baili Yun, but you guys don’t know. The Baili Clan also has a prodigy called Baili Luoyang. It is said that his natural talent is even above Baili Yun, and is close to catching up to the Golden Generation.”
“However, this Baili Luoyang has once caused a huge scandal.”
“He has an illicit relationship with his aunt by marriage. After it was discovered, he was imprisoned by the Baili Clan. Calculating the time, it should have been about forty to fifty years.”
Venerate Shi said slowly.

All the Venerate Tier elites were astounded. To have inappropriate relations with their own aunt, this brat was really bold! Furthermore, he was already a member of the Imperial Clan, so what kind of beauties would not be easily obtainable in this world? Why did he have to target his own aunt?
Because it was too rare, these Venerate Tier elites all felt the urge to gossip.
“However, after committing such a colossal mistake, the Baili Clan actually didn’t kill him, and merely locked him up. This guy’s natural talent can be seen from this.” Venerate Shi continued.
“But he’s already been locked up for forty to fifty years. Can his cultivation level still keep up?” a Venerate Tier elite asked.

“The Baili Clan has no plans to give up on this clansman. Locking him up is only to temper his temperament, and the supply of various cultivation resources is not decreased in the slightest.” Venerate Shi smiled, “Judging by Baili Hanyun’s reaction, that Baili Luoyang should still be in the True Self Tier.”
“He can suppress that despicable brat, Ling Han?”
“His aptitude is comparable to Golden Generation’s. If he can advance into the Eighth Form, then he naturally can.”
“Heh, then let’s just wait and see.”
Ziwei Imperial Clan.
At the foot of a mountain stream, there was presently a naked young man sitting cross-legged beneath the waterfall, enduring the barrage from the waterfall.
Upon a closer look, one would discover that this waterfall was actually formed by Regulations. When it impacted on the young man’s body, endless seals exploded, terrifying without bounds.
Yet this young man was seated like a boulder, multiple divine patterns appearing on his body, intertwining to form incredibly complex veined patterns.
His face was as sharp as a blade, his expression resolute, and there was a coldness that seemed to have seen through everything.
Xiu, his eyes suddenly snapped open, and instantly, two streaks of divine light shot out.

An elder had suddenly appeared in front of him at some unknown time. He looked very ordinary, but upon a closer look, it was as if even the heavens were bowing their heads to him. He was indescribably powerful.
The Divine Fluid Saint of the Baili Clan.

“To be able to withstand the barrage of the Waterfall of Regulations, you should have advanced into the Eighth Form!” the Divine Fluid Saint said. Even though the sound of the waterfall crashing was as loud as thunder, his voice was still clear and distinct.
The young man stood up, and strode out of the waterfall. Then, he bowed to the Divine Fluid Saint, and said, “Luoyang pays his respects to Ancestor Divine Fluid.”
The Divine Fluid Saint nodded, and said, “You’ve already been here for 41 years, so it’s about enough time for you to reflect on your actions. Now, I have a mission for you.”
“Please instruct, Ancestor.” The young man bowed slightly, but there was an untamed expression on his face.
“Kill a person,” the Divine Fluid Saint said.
‘Hmm?’
The young man couldn’t help but be taken aback. The Imperial Clan wanted someone killed, and they actually had to specially assign him?
“Who?” he asked darkly.
“This person’s name is Ling Han!” the Divine Fluid Saint said. “Now, immediately report to the Ancestral King Academy. Your Fourth Uncle will inform you of the subsequent events.”
“Yes,” the young man nodded.
Ancestral King Academy

Ling Han had a large amount of cultivation resources, and his cultivation level instantly increased at a faster pace. Of course, this was completely incomparable to the Source Dao Stone. Otherwise, he would be able to advance to the end of the tenth form in about a year, and now, he would need three to four years.
Unless he could also obtain natural treasures, which could shorten this time.

His cultivation level had already reached a very high level. Cultivation level was something that had been tempered through a long period of time, so it was definitely impossible that it could be achieved overnight.
Peace had not lasted many days, when Ling Han received a mission.
In the Ancestral King Academy, one could not just focus on cultivating.
True elites definitely didn’t come from cultivating, but from battling.
Thus, the disciples of the Ancestral King Academy would be sent out to carry out various missions every once in a while. Basically, there would be some dangers to train themselves.
The mission that Ling Han had received was to destroy a gang that was secretly excavating a True Clouds Metal mine.
True Clouds Metal was a very rare metal, and was a fusion agent for refining Celestial Tool. After adding this thing, it could greatly increase the chances of successfully forging a Celestial Tool.

The Eastern River Planet was a place that produced True Cloud Metal, and it belonged to the Ten Thousand Thunder Imperial Clan. However, it was a subordinate clan of the Ten Thousand Thunder Imperial Clan that actually controlled the mine. Thus, there was an outrageously bold gang of thieves, to be actually stealing True Clouds Metal.

chapters.title: Chapter 4313: Assassin Again
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
This was a solo mission.
Thus, after Ling Han received the mission, he set off for the Eastern River Planet.
After several intergalactic teleportations, Ling Han finally arrived at his destination.

The Eastern River Planet was not considered a great planet. It was not that the planet was not big enough, but rather that the overall level of cultivation of the whole planet was not high enough. The strongest would only be Spiritual Transformation Tier.
Ling Han first went to the Liu Clan that was in charge of the True Clouds Metal mine.

He revealed his identity, and immediately received a warm welcome from the Liu Clan. In fact, just how enthusiastic were they? At the banquet, a few young and beautiful female clansmen of the Liu Clan repeatedly toasted him. As long as Ling Han was willing, they would probably come knocking on his door tonight.
This was a disciple of the Ancestral King Academy. As long as he didn’t die, he would at least become a great elite of the Venerate Tier in the future.
To the Liu Clan, this was naturally an incredibly strong backer that they had to cozy up to.
Ling Han naturally ignored this. There was only one thing on his mind now, and that was to increase his cultivation level, so that he could truly take control of his own destiny.
He asked about the mine, but the Liu Clan knew very little about this gang of thieves.

“To tell you the truth, Brother Ling, these bandits are really slippery.” The clan leader of the Liu Clan began to complain, “We have already set up a large number of people in the mine, but they would always find the weakest spot in the defense, and take advantage of the opening.”
“And by the time we discovered it, and charged over en masse, they had already fled completely.”

Thus, the Liu Clan actually did not know much more than Ling Han. Not only did they not know the identity of the thieves, they did not even know how many people there were in fact, or the cultivation level of the strongest elite.
Sigh.
Ling Han didn’t place any hopes on these guys anymore, and decided to go and take a look himself.
“Brother Ling, let Little Ming accompany you. He could lead the way.” The clan leader of the Liu Clan was very eager, and pushed out his grandson.
If this was a woman, Ling Han would definitely refuse decisively, to avoid trouble, but if it was a man, he didn’t have to worry about that.
Thus, he nodded, “All right.”

Liu Ming, the third generation of the Liu Clan, a young man filled with heroic spirit. At present, his cultivation level was at Cauldron Forging Tier. In a Spirit Transformation Tier-level clan, his cultivation level could not be considered low. He was the most outstanding descendant of the Liu Clan.
This inevitably made him a little proud. After he was called over, he only nodded at Ling Han, looking very proud.
Ling Han didn’t mind, and let Liu Ming lead the way. The two of them set off for the mine.

The mine was very big. Though it had been mined for several hundred years, only one third of it had been excavated, but as far as the eye could see, a large mountain range had suddenly decreased by half, which was still very abrupt.

“Brother Ling, this mine is too big,” Liu Ming said. “There are a total of more than 300 people in our Liu Clan, and there are 274 who has stepped onto the Celestial Path. Now, they’ve all been sent out to patrol, but it’s still impossible to guard against them.”
“Why did the Ancestral King Academy send you alone?” he asked in anger.
—Oh, there are more than 200 of us here yet we still can’t deal with it, so what can you do alone?
Ling Han chuckled, but a powerful aura suddenly spread out, instantly making Liu Ming’s chest constrict and his eyes pop out.
“For better or worse, I am a True Self Tier, so you should maintain appropriate respect.”
Fear appeared on Liu Ming’s face. This was the fear of death.

Previously, he had been extremely indignant. He was clearly older than Ling Han, but why was Ling Han already an elite of the True Self Tier? Furthermore, he had even entered into the Ancestral King Academy. In future, he could at least become a Venerate Tier elite.
Wasn’t it because he came from the “Imperial Clan”?

Just because this was the territory of his clan, he had absolutely no respect for Ling Han, appearing very arrogant. It was only at this moment that he suddenly realized that even if Ling Han killed him, so what? Would the clan dare to complain about anything to an Imperial Clan?
“Go back,” Ling Han said with a wave of his hand. He couldn’t be bothered to argue with this kind of person.
Liu Ming shuddered, and hurriedly turned around to flee.
Ling Han spread out his divine sense and communicated with the ley lines, enveloping the entire mountainous area under his surveillance.
Yi?
He suddenly faltered. It was not that he had discovered that gang of thieves, but rather that he had discovered a person that was presently sneaking towards him.
Strange Shadow Steps.
Ling Han immediately determined that this person was using the Strange Shadow Steps.
An assassin from the Battle God Palace.
Hehe, these guys were really well-informed, finding out his whereabouts so quickly.
Or... had someone in the academy deliberately leaked his information?
Ling Han believed that it was the latter. Otherwise, it was impossible that the assassins from the Battle God Palace would have followed him here as soon as he arrived.
However, merely dispatching a Spirit Transformation Tier assassin, this was looking down on him too much, wasn’t it?

However, for the Battle God Palace, assassins had the initiative in the first place, and the victime was completely unprepared when they intended to kill. Even assassins with weaker abilities could assassinate powerful targets, what more when it was a Spirit Transformation Tier assassin that was dispatched now. Wasn’t that enough?
No one knew that Ling Han’s current strength was enough to kill a Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and sat cross-legged on the ground, quietly waiting for the assassin to arrive.
After a while, he had already caught sight of the assassin approaching.

It could not be helped. Firstly, the strength of his soul had long since reached the level of Spirit Transformation Tier, and secondly, he could also communicate with the ley lines, which was equivalent to having set up countless eyes for him. Thirdly, this was also the most important. His accomplishments in the Strange Shadow Steps had even surpassed this assassin.
Hence, to hide his tracks in front of him, wasn’t that a joke?

Close, close. The assassin was extremely calm. He was clearly at the Spirit Transformation Tier, yet he didn’t make a move at all. Instead, he wanted to get close enough to kill Ling Han with a single strike, preventing Ling Han from even thinking of fleeing.
Finally, this assassin walked to the most suitable position, and suddenly made his move.
Shua, a cold light streaked past, seeming capable of slicing apart even heaven and earth.
The sword swept past. Pu, Ling Han was instantly severed into two halves, blood spraying madly.

The assassin couldn’t help but reveal a smug expression. He, an assassin who had undergone two transformations of the Spirit Transformation Tier, was naturally able to easily kill a True Self Tier with his sword.
But right at this moment, he suddenly felt a pain in his back, and his whole person instantly stumbled forwards.
He turned his head, and couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat.
Ling Han!
The target that he had already killed had actually come back to life. Furthermore, a punch had landed on his back, breaking at least seven of his bones.
“You, why didn’t you die?” He appeared to be extremely disbelieving, because he had personally moved.
Ling Han cracked a smile. He naturally wouldn’t tell him that he had already used the black light of illusion to confuse him.

“Before you die, send a message to the Battle God Palace. Tell them to remember not to send any more trash the next time they come to assassinate me. Also, it won’t be long before I find the location of the Battle God Palace and dispose of them once and for all.”
“How boastful of you!” That killing intent humphed, “All the generations of Ancestral Kings have not been able to destroy our Battle God Palace, so who do you think you are?”
Though he was severely injured, he was sure that he was completely capable of killing Ling Han again.

chapters.title: Chapter 4314: Thieves from inside
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“Come.” Ling Han crooked a finger at him.
In any case, he had to wait for these thieves. Since he had nothing else to do, he would play around with this guy.
“Die!” the assassin roared as he charged forward.
For assassins, this was a very foolish action.
What was an assassin? Naturally, they would attack from the shadows, and kill their target when they were least on guard. Otherwise, they would be called death warriors.
But now, he was a major tier higher than Ling Han. So what if he attacked Ling Han head-on? How could it be that he would lose?

The reason why he had snuck over previously was firstly, it was because of his occupational habit. Secondly, he was afraid that he would alert Ling Han, and this brat would use the Star Steps to escape.
Xiu, xiu, two figures walked out of his body, but their features were very blurry, and could not be seen clearly. However, the aura they exuded was Spirit Transformation Tier-level.
These were his two spiritual bodies.

Most people would mold their spiritual bodies to be like themselves, and use them as manifestations of themselves. They could deal with some trivial matters when their original body was cultivating. However, for assassins, there was absolutely no need to care about how the spiritual bodies looked like, as long as their abilities were strong enough.

The assassin attacked from the front, while the two spiritual bodies attacked from the side. They didn’t have a Spirit Tool in hand, but spiritual bodies were formed by the Regulations of heaven and earth and high-level energy in the first place, so they could be considered human-shaped Spirit Tools.
This time, Ling Han had a lot of time. He casually parried, wanting to see just how strong a Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator was.
After a few moves, he had a considerable understanding of the battle prowess of Spirit Transformation Tier elites.

As expected, the colorful saber that Guan Xia channeled out was the True Self, which could also be considered a pseudo spiritual body, but compared to a real spiritual body, it was still considerably inferior.

The attacks of the two spiritual bodies were quite impressive, and they weren’t made of flesh and blood either. Even if they were shattered, as long as they were nurtured in the mind, they would be able to recover in no time.
It was because of this that the assassin allowed the two spiritual bodies to barge around and act extremely arrogantly.

Of course, he was also incredibly shocked internally. Even if he was heavily injured due to an “accident”, and could not unleash his full battle prowess, a starving camel was still bigger than a horse. Suppressing a True Self Tier cultivator should be a piece of cake.
However, after battling for so long, he actually did not have the slightest bit of advantage, which naturally made him feel fear.
What was going on here?
After fighting for a while longer, Ling Han felt bored.
This opponent was too weak. Even a Spirit Transformation Tier couldn’t give him enough pressure, and he had seen more or less what he needed to see.
It was time to end this battle.
Ling Han’s expression instantly changed. Boom! A terrifying aura surged out, and he finally unleashed the true power of the Ten Forms.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
Who cares if you are a spiritual body or the real one, they were all sent flying with a single punch.
He had already started to walk his own path. His punches didn’t seem to have any rhythm, but they were extremely powerful.
“Impossible!” the assassin exclaimed in shock. He had practically seen a ghost.
A True Self Tier cultivator was actually able to suppress a Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator like him?
Who would believe this?
You’re dizzy from having drank too much, aren’t you?
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “If I told you that I’ve already killed four Spirit Transformation Second Change Tier elites, would you call me a maniac?”
If this had been before the battle, everyone would have thought that Ling Han had gone crazy, but now, that assassin believed it without a doubt.
Without hesitation, he immediately retreated.

This sure-kill target of the Battle God Palace had become stronger again. Even a Spirit Transformation Tier Second Change was no match for him. At least, they would have to send out the Fifth Change or even the gold-medal assassin who had actually undergone Sixth Change.
“You still want to leave?” Ling Han laughed in spite of himself, “Just how much do you look down on me?”
The assassin activated the Strange Shadow Steps and instantly dove into the shadows.
However, he had not even taken a few steps, when he saw an iron fist flying towards him.
‘What?’
He hurriedly dodged, his heart filled with shock.
With the help of the Strange Shadow Steps, Ling Han actually managed to capture him?
Peng!
He could not dodge this punch at all, and was hit solidly. He opened his mouth, and spat out blood madly. There were also large amounts of internal organs mixed in his blood.
Waves of helplessness rose up in him. He felt his vision darken, and he really wanted to immediately pass out.
Ling Han threw another punch, and the assassin was completely unable to dodge. He was killed.

“This Battle God Palace is really like a lingering ghost,” he muttered. Previously, he had stayed in the Dark Clouds Hell for ten years, and had almost forgotten that he had such an enemy. And what happened? Practically the moment he appeared, their assassins came as well.
“I’ll kill whoever comes.”
He tidied up the battlefield, then continued his surveillance.
However, after this night, he did not gain anything.

On the second day, Ling Han rested at the Liu Clan Residence, but in the afternoon, he received a notice from the Liu Clan. That gang of thieves had actually moved, stealing all the True Clouds Metal that the Liu Clan had mined a few days ago and had not yet transported away.
Interesting.

Ling Han couldn’t help but think. He had waited all night yesterday, yet no thieves had appeared, and during the day, he had only rested for a short while at the Liu Residence, when the theft of ores happened again.
Upon further thought, though the Liu Clan had set up all kinds of defenses, they had not even seen a shadow of the other until now.
Was there really a group of thieves that appeared and disappeared mysteriously, or was there a traitor in the Liu Clan?

Originally, Ling Han wasn’t too interested in capturing this group of thieves. This was a matter of the Imperial Clan, and it was already good enough that he wasn’t a hindrance. How could he possibly do things sincerely?
But now, he was curious. If there really was a traitor in the Liu Clan, then this guy was really outrageously bold, daring to even steal from the Imperial Clan.
En, he wanted to see what kind of prodigy this was.
In the next few days, he stayed at the Liu Residence, looking like he was just going through the motions, and actually did not care about anything else.
However, on the fourth day, Ling Han left quietly with the Strange Shadow Steps and entered the mineshaft.
He spread out his divine sense and communicated with the ley lines, taking control of everything in his surroundings.
A few hours later, he discovered a sneaky figure, and cautiously headed towards the mining area.
This man obviously knew the defenses of the Liu Clan like the back of his hand. He circled all the way, avoiding all the sentry guards, and began to steal.

This person wasn’t weak, so the speed of mining wasn’t slow either. In just a few hours, he had excavated a large area of the mountain. Without any care, he stuffed all the rocks into his Spatial Spirit Tool.
Ordinarily, miners would only excavate ores rich in True Clouds Metal, and other useless stones would be discarded. Thus, there was naturally a great difference in the speed of the two.
This person left quietly, avoiding all the sentry guards along the way. Furthermore, this person was also very careful. After making a large circle outside, he actually returned to the Liu Residence.
As expected!
Ling Han could see very clearly. After this person entered into the Liu Clan, he removed the black cloth that was covering his face, and a familiar face appeared.
—Liu Ming.
Yi?
Ling Han was astonished. Although he had already guessed that this thief was most likely a traitor of the Liu Clan, he had never imagined that it was actually Liu Ming.

chapters.title: Chapter 4315: Divine Bird?
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
As the most outstanding member of the third generation of the Liu Clan, Liu Ming even had a chance to take over the position of clan leader in the future. Why did he still have to poach his own clan?

Ling Han’s interest was piqued even further. He stealthily concealed himself. Under the Strange Shadow Steps, to say nothing of Liu Ming, even the clan leader of the Liu Clan, a Spiritual Transformation Tier elite, may not be able to discover his existence.
Liu Ming looked left and right at the door, closing the doors and windows tightly.
However, he didn’t know that Ling Han had already hidden himself in his room. He was just waiting to see what tricks he would play.
Liu Ming moved aside a cabinet, and there was actually a secret door behind it. After he opened it, Ling Han immediately leaped over first.
“Yi?” Liu Ming seemed to have sensed something, but after being stunned for a while, he still entered through the secret door, then returned the cabinet to its original position.

This secret passage was not long, and he soon reached the end. This was a secret room. It was not very big, and the furnishings were very simple. There was only a stone table placed here, and there was a box on top of the stone table. It could not be seen what material it was made of.
Liu Ming walked to the side of the stone table, and showed a hint of excitement as he opened the box on it.
Instantly, a small head poked out of the box.
Ling Han looked closely. This was a small bird, its feathers as bright as fire, incredibly handsome.
“Come, I’ve brought you food,” Liu Ming said as he retrieved the ores from his Spatial Tool and placed them on the stone table.
The little bird immediately jumped out, and picked up a piece of ore in a single bite. Crack, crack, crack, it began chewing, and very soon, it had devoured this piece of ore completely.
So that was the case.
The reason why this Liu Ming had stolen the ores was to feed this little bird.
But why was he willing to take such a risk?
Because of interest? That was obviously impossible.
“Little bird, I’m your father. I feed you and raise you, so you definitely have to listen to me in the future,” Liu Ming said as he continued to feed the bird.
Meanwhile, the little bird merely chirped, as if it was pressing for more.

Liu Ming continued to feed. Even though this small bird was only the size of a fist, its appetite was astonishing. It actually ate all the ores that Liu Ming had stolen, yet its stomach did not bulge at all.
No wonder this guy would steal from the mine every once in a while. With this little bird’s appetite, whoever raised it would feel immense pressure.
Liu Ming continued to blabber, and the little bird was already about to fall asleep. Thus, he could only helplessly place the little bird back into the box. Then, he left through the secret passage.
Ling Han materialized and opened the box.
Hu! Hu! Hu!
This little bird was presently in a deep slumber, and was even snoring loudly.
Ling Han gritted his teeth. Should birds snore? Are you a f****** pig?
He poked the little bird with his finger, but the little bird was still sleeping soundly, showing no signs of waking up.
F***, you really are a pig.
Ling Han poked it again, and only then did he see that this little bird had opened its eyes. He could clearly see that this little bird actually looked impatient.
“Yi, you are not that idiot, Liu Ming.” The little bird looked at Ling Han and said, its voice crisp like a young girl’s.

“You can actually speak?” Ling Han was surprised. Previously, Liu Ming had chattered for who knew how many times, but the little bird was only chirping, causing Ling Han to think that it was just a young bird that had not developed intelligence.
“Isn’t that nonsense?” the little bird asked impatiently, looking very experienced.
“Are you asking for a beating?” Ling Han shook his fist.

The little bird fell silent. Though it was very arrogant, it was also very smart. It knew what kind of people it could trifle with, what kind of people it could deceive, and what kind of people it could not afford to offend.
...The person in front of her was a True Self Tier cultivator, stronger than her!

“Oh, that’s right, what breed are you?” Ling Han was curious. Liu Ming definitely wouldn’t raise a mortal bird. Moreover, this little bird actually fed on True Clouds Metal ore, which showed how extraordinary it was.
“Divine bird, of course,” the little bird said boldly.
“Don’t joke around,” Ling Han said.
The little bird ignored him, looking proud.

“Liu Ming should know of your background. Looks like your background is not weak, either. That’s why this brat is supporting you so closely, and looks like he considers himself your father. He probably hopes that when you grow up in the future, you can become his right-hand man,” Ling Han deduced.
The little bird was proud, “Of course, I am very powerful! But that idiot actually wanted to impersonate my father. I am really about to laugh myself to death. He is really as stupid as can be!”
Indeed.

Ling Han nodded. Even now, Liu Ming still didn’t know that the little bird’s intelligence had long since developed. It was completely impossible for him to deceive it. On the other hand, this little bird was the sneaky one. It was practically treating Liu Ming like a fool, treating him completely like a meal ticket.
“Hey, why are you looking at me with such an expression?” The little bird was a little scared. Ling Han’s eyes were so frightening.
Ling Han snickered, “It’s been a long time since I’ve eaten roast chicken.”
“Get lost, I’m a divine bird!” The little bird immediately exploded. “Didn’t you see that brat Liu Ming almost worshipped me? You actually want to eat me?”
“He’s counting on you to help him conquer the world in the future, but I don’t need you,” Ling Han shrugged.
The little bird blinked its eyes at him, and said with a dry laugh, “Don’t, don’t be like that. Worse come to worst, I’ll just hang out with you in the future.”
“I can’t afford to raise a glutton like you. It’s better to barbeque and eat you,” Ling Han said.
“I can also eat very little,” the little bird hurriedly said. “Although I ate so much previously, most of the energy has been stored up. I’m keeping it to slowly absorb in the future.”
Ling Han looked like he was considering. After a while, he asked, “Then what specialty do you have?”
“I can spit fire,” the little bird said.
“Che,” Ling Han said in disdain. “My third child knows how to spit fire.”
“Tsk!” The little bird also appeared very disdainful, “The flames I spit out are the strongest flames in the world. There is nothing they cannot burn, and nothing they cannot melt!”
“Then try spitting it out.” Ling Han took out a piece of Divine Metal and placed it in front of the little bird.
The small bird opened its mouth and spat. Pu, a fiery flame shot out, and struck the Divine Metal, instantly penetrating through it.
Ling Han was astounded. This was a Three Star Divine Metal, yet it had been directly melted by a mouthful of flames from the little bird. Its might was really quite strong.
“How is it? Impressive, right?” the little bird asked proudly.
“So-so, just passable,” Ling Han said.

“Just passable?” The little bird was unconvinced, “Even if you are in the True Self Tier, and can shatter the Three Star Divine Metal, it is still impossible for you to so easily pierce a hole in the Divine Metal.”

“Is that so?” Ling Han said with a smile. He activated the Divine Metal, and he reached over to touch it. Wherever his hand touched, the Divine Metal would immediately be annihilated, and not even a speck of it would remain.
“F***!” The little bird cursed, then stared at Ling Han as if he was a monster.
She had just boasted, and in the end, reality had mercilessly slapped her in the face.
“Let’s just make roast chicken,” Ling Han said.
“Don’t, don’t, don’t!” The little bird hurriedly flapped its wings, “I’ll follow you. In the future, when I help you fight, I’ll spit fire at whoever displeases you!”
Tsk, she finally had some awareness.

“F***!” The little bird cursed, then stared at Ling Han as if he was a monster.
She had just boasted, and in the end, reality had mercilessly slapped her in the face.
“Let’s just make roast chicken,” Ling Han said.
“Don’t, don’t, don’t!” The little bird hurriedly flapped its wings, “I’ll follow you.
In the future, when I help you fight, I’ll spit fire at whoever displeases you!”
Tsk, she finally had some awareness.
