chapters.title: Chapter 4316: Caught red-handed
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“Do you have a name?” Ling Han asked the little bird.
The standard of his naming skills was chillingly low, yet he just so happened to like naming people.
The little bird shivered for no reason, and hurriedly said, “Yes, yes, yes, my name is Zhu Hongyi.”
“This name is so lame,” Ling Han grumbled. “Why don’t I give you a nickname? En, I’ll call you Little Red.”
The little red bird tried its best to counter, but it naturally didn’t dare to say anything verbally. Her expression said, ‘whatever you like’.
“Let’s go.” Ling Han grabbed the little red bird, and using the Star Steps, xiu, he directly disappeared from the secret room.
This time, no matter how hard Liu Ming wracked his brains, he could not possibly know how the little red bird had disappeared.

After returning to his residence, Ling Han acted as if nothing had happened. This little red bird definitely had a powerful background. Though he did not know what breed it was for the moment, when he returned, he would ask the Nine Mountains Saint. It should not be too difficult to find out.
However, he used the ley lines to control the entire Liu Clan. Two days later, he discovered that Liu Ming had moved again.
He waited first, and when Liu Ming was almost done stealing, he directly used Star Steps to cross over and apprehend Liu Ming.
“You—”
Pa!
Liu Ming had just managed to ask, when he was knocked unconscious by a palm strike from Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled, and roared at the sky. His voice rolled out, reverberating throughout the entire mountainous area.
Not long after, the members of the Liu Clan all ran over.
Looking at Ling Han, and then looking at the person whose face was covered with a black cloth lying by his feet, wasn’t that clear enough?

“Brother Ling, have you caught the thief?” The clan leader of the Liu Clan was overjoyed. He had not been able to catch that group of thieves after so many days, but Ling Han had already reaped some results after just a few days. As expected of a disciple of the Ancestral King Academy.

To be honest, he was also very grateful in his heart. That was because the Liu Clan did not possess this True Clouds Metal mine, and was only acting as a doorman for the Imperial Clan. If the ore was lost, the Liu Clan would naturally bear the brunt of it, and could not escape the blame.
Thankfully, Ling Han had finally caught a thief, and there was finally some progress.
“Clan leader Liu, you had best be mentally prepared,” Ling Han said. With a kick, he kicked Liu Ming to the feet of the clan leader of the Liu Clan.
The clan leader of the Liu Clan did not understand. What did he mean by that?
He stretched out a hand and with a wave, the black cloth on Liu Ming’s face immediately shattered.
Yi!
When they saw that the masked person was actually Liu Ming, all the members of the Liu Clan exclaimed in shock.
How was this possible?
Why was it Liu Ming? How could it be Liu Ming?
This didn’t make sense.

“Brother Ling, did you make a mistake?” The clan leader of the Liu Clan looked towards Ling Han, his face filled with suspicion. Could it be that Ling Han was also unable to catch the culprit, so he knocked Liu Ming unconscious, and made him look like this, so he could use him as a scapegoat?
Ling Han smiled faintly, “The digging marks here are still very new. Furthermore, you guys search the Spatial Spirit Tool on him.”
The clan leader of the Liu Clan picked up the Spatial Tool that Liu Ming had on him. With a thought, a large amount of True Clouds Metal appeared out of thin air, piling up like a small mountain.
This time, the members of the Liu Clan were all in an uproar.
Caught red-handed?
The clan leader of the Liu Clan frowned, and sent out a palm strike, waking Liu Ming up.
“—Who is it!” Liu Ming’s thoughts were still stuck on before he fell unconscious. Thus, the moment he woke up, he continued what he had been saying before he fell unconscious.
He immediately saw the clan leader of the Liu Clan and the others, and couldn’t help but feel a chill in his heart.

Previously, he had been in a coma, and did not know what had happened. Seeing that the members of the Liu Clan were all here, and the ores that he had just stolen had piled up into a small mountain, as the saying goes, guilty conscience makes one lose his composure.
Pa, he immediately knelt down, and cried, “Grandpa, save me! You must save me!”

If he hadn’t said this, the clan leader of the Liu Clan would have still been able to defend him. However, now that Liu Ming had said this, it was equivalent to admitting it in public. How could he continue to defend him?

“Evil creature, how dare you!” Clan leader Liu rebuked harshly. He was both furious and confused. This grandson of his had extraordinary natural talent, and had a bright future ahead of him. How could he be so foolish?
‘You don’t lack cultivation resources, so what’s the point of stealing the True Clouds Metal?’

Liu Ming was usually proud, but he had never experienced any setbacks, what more when it was such a big matter. He was completely stupefied, and only knew to kowtow continuously, begging the clan leader of the Liu Clan to save him.

The clan leader of the Liu Clan was in a very difficult position. On one side, this was his beloved grandson, who was also the most outstanding descendant of the Liu Clan. In future, he would be able to hold up the banner of the Liu Clan, so he naturally was unwilling to allow Liu Ming to die here.
However, if he wanted to protect Liu Ming, there was only one way, and that was to kill Ling Han here to keep him quiet. He could tell others that Ling Han had been killed by a thief.
In any case, he knew that Ling Han had offended a great many Imperial Clan elites. If he really killed Ling Han, he believed that he would even be rewarded by the Imperial Clan elites.
Thinking of this, he couldn’t help but feel a killing intent rise up in his heart.
Ling Han saw this, and smiled faintly, “Clan leader Liu, are you planning to kill me to keep the secret?”

The clan leader of the Liu Clan couldn’t help but laugh drily when his thoughts were pointed out, “Brother Ling really knows how to joke. No matter how courageous I am, how would I dare to bully a prodigy of the Ancestral King Academy?”
“That had better be the case,” Ling Han said. “Perhaps the clan leader of the Liu Clan still doesn’t know yet. I’ve mastered the Star Steps!”
The clan leader of the Liu Clan couldn’t help but feel his heart clench. That’s right, Star Steps!
This was a person that even the Imperial Clan couldn’t kill, so how could he kill him?

He changed his mind again. In any case, the matter of Liu Ming stealing the True Clouds Metal had nothing to do with the clan. Worse come to worst, he could just sever the weak link for the sake of the whole clan’s survival. Otherwise, when Ling Han broke free and returned to the Ancestral King Academy, what awaited the Liu Clan would be a calamity.
Seeing the expression on Clan leader Liu’s face, how could Liu Ming not understand?
He didn’t want to die.
Thus, he could no longer bother to keep the secret, and said, “Grandpa, the reason why I stole the True Clouds Metal is because—”
Pu!
Ling Han moved, and with a heavy punch, Liu Ming was instantly blasted into dust.
He naturally could not allow Liu Ming to reveal the secret of the little red bird.

“You!” The clan leader of the Liu Clan pointed angrily at Ling Han. He was still thinking about how he was going to make excuses for his grandson. At the very least, he would have to save his life. Furthermore, why had Liu Ming robbed the mine for no reason? There must be some hidden reason.
Why had Ling Han suddenly made a move?
“The evidence is irrefutable, so we naturally have to kill him,” Ling Han said calmly. “What is it? Is the leader of the Liu Clan still thinking of how to cover for him?”
The clan leader of the Liu Clan was furious, yet had nothing to say.

“Alright, this matter has been resolved. I’m going to return and report to the academy,” Ling Han said as he took a step forward. He activated his Star Steps and arrived before the Liu Residence. He grabbed the little red bird and directly tossed out the formation foundations that formed the intergalactic Transfer Formation.
He left.
Xiu, he and the little red bird crossed the galaxy. After a few teleportations, they returned to the Ancestral King Academy.

Ling Han went to report the matter, and the Liu Clan had already reported this matter through the Galaxy Network. Since Liu Ming had already been killed, the clan leader of the Liu Clan had naturally given up on tampering with the truth, and reported the matter to the higher-ups in full detail.
Ling Han took out a bit of time to return to the Nine Suns Holy Land. He was going to ask the Nine Mountains Saint to take a look at the breed of the little red bird.

chapters.title: Chapter 4317: Descendant of Vermillion Bird?
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
After returning to the Nine Yang Holy Land, Ling Han paid a visit to the Nine Mountains Saint.
However, the Nine Mountains Saint wasn’t here. Instead, he had gone to the front lines.

The so-called front line was the galaxy where the Mountain Sea Heaven was located. Now, a large number of Yin souls were constantly launching attacks, wanting to expand their territory. The war situation was extremely grim. Thus, the Nine Mountains Saint also stationed himself at the front line.
“Don’t torment yourself. I’ll tell you, all right?” The little red bird couldn’t bear it. Every day, it would be teleported across galaxies. Come on, she was a girl.
“En, tell me,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“I’m really a divine bird!” the little red bird said as if it were serious.
“As I see it, you are really asking for a beating!” Ling Han humphed.
“Let me ask you. In the ancient times, the Divine Beasts were equal, and what was the most powerful?” the little red bird asked.
“True Dragon?” Ling Han asked with a smile.

“How ignorant! How can the True Dragon be considered the strongest in the world?” The little red bird’s mouth was quite derisive. “In my opinion, you should eat more pig brain to help nourish your brain.1”
Fortunately, the pervert pig wasn’t here. Otherwise, he would definitely pluck all your feathers!
Ling Han smiled, “Then tell me, what is the strongest?”
“The Vermillion Bird, of course!” the little red bird said proudly. “I am the descendant of the Vermillion Bird, so you have to treat me with respect!”

“A little bird like you?” Ling Han laughed in spite of himself. According to legends, when the Divine Beast Vermillion Bird spread its wings, it could fill an entire galaxy, and this little red bird in front of him was only the size of a palm, at most.
“That’s because I haven’t grown up yet!” the little red bird said angrily. “If I showed my mystical abilities at this time, wouldn’t I have long since been made into a roast chicken?”
Oh, she didn’t forget to insult others.

Ling Han looked at the little red bird. Perhaps Liu Ming had found out about the little red bird’s background through ancient records, and that was why he worshipped it like it was his ancestor. Of course, it was also possible that the little red bird was full of nonsense, and had deceived Liu Ming into believing it.
However, being able to swallow the raw True Clouds Metal, spit out fiery flames, and easily melt the Three Star Divine Metal, the little red bird was definitely no ordinary breed.
You see, hadn’t the Four-Legged Snake also just been born? It didn’t seem strange for there to be a descendant of the Vermillion Bird as well.
The question was, why did he always encounter this kind of unreliable guy?
Was he specialized in taking in trouble children?

Ling Han was extremely speechless, but since he already knew the origins of the little red bird, there was naturally no need for him to seek out the Nine Mountains Saint. He returned to the Ancestral King Academy.
He had just returned to the academy when the large black dog and little azure dragon came to look for him.
“Little Han, you have a rival again,” the large black dog immediately said.
“Oh?” Ling Han didn’t care. As long as he didn’t break through to the Spirit Transformation Tier, who else could pose a threat to him at the True Self Tier?
Even Ding Shu could not, even if the other had advanced into the Tenth Form.

En, speaking of Ding Shu, if this brat was unable to break through to the Tenth Form, he would have to obediently become his underling. And Ling Han was 90% sure that Ding Shu’s chances of breaking through to the Tenth Form would not exceed 10%.

“A guy called Baili Luoyang. Apparently, he’s here to snipe you.” The little azure dragon continued, then stared at the little red bird in Ling Han’s arms. “Huh, since when did you start rearing birds?”
“Four-Legged Snake, do you have any insight? Who’s worthy of raising me?” the little red bird immediately chirped.
“Yi, your mouth is quite powerful.” The little azure dragon humphed. “Little Han, are we going to eat roast chicken tonight?”
The little red bird was extremely speechless. None of you know what a Divine Beast is?
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Don’t underestimate her. According to her, she is the descendant of Vermillion Bird.”
“What?” The little azure dragon’s eyes bulged.
“Are you dumbfounded now, stinky Four-Legged Snake!” The little red bird was proud of itself, “My mother, my ancestor is the strongest Divine Beast in the world.”
“Bullsh!t, the strongest Divine Beast is clearly my Imperial Father, the True Dragon that sweeps aside all opposition in the world!” The little azure dragon immediately retorted.
“True Dragon?” The little red bird stuck out its tongue, looking disdainful, “In the past, the True Dragon has been defeated by the Vermillion Bird who knows how many times, so save it.”
“Nonsense, the True Dragon is the strongest!”
“The Vermillion Bird is clearly the most powerful!”
The two of them were at loggerheads just like that, each of them raising their necks high, looking like they were determined to convince the other.
Ling Han shrugged, not bothering to pay them any regard.
“Little Han, where did you get this little bird from?” The large black dog clicked his tongue in wonder.

Ling Han briefly explained what had happened, and the large black dog couldn’t help but feel rueful. Ling Han’s luck was truly heaven-defying. He could obtain such good fortune just by completing a random mission.

This was the descendant of a Divine Beast! Moreover, the little red bird had also let the cat out of the bag. It was extremely likely that she was the daughter of the Vermillion Bird, and belonged to the first generation!
If Ling Han could receive the help of the two Divine Beasts in the future, just how terrifying would this power be?

No matter how he thought about it, it would definitely not be difficult for the first generation offspring of Divine Beasts to become a Saint, and it would definitely be an incredibly powerful Saint — who knows, it may even be possible that it could become a Pseudo-Emperor. That would really be boundlessly terrifying.
“Oh, that’s right. What’s with that Baili Luoyang?” Ling Han asked.
“Oh, Grandpa Dog isn’t too sure either, but I’ve heard others say that this guy is extremely awesome, and said that he wants to pull you off your horse,” the large black dog said casually.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Then just wait and see.”
What he was more concerned about was who had leaked his whereabouts to the Battle God Palace.

“Speaking of suspects, everyone in the whole Ancestral King Academy is under suspicion.” Ling Han was extremely speechless. He didn’t seem to have done anything bad, so how did he make so many enemies?

The little red bird fed on ores. Of course, it mainly ate Divine Metal. If there was refined Divine Metal, that was naturally even better. If there wasn’t, she was actually not very picky about her food.ree

She was at the Core Formation Tier now, and she could swallow all Divine Metal below four stars in a single gulp. There were terrifying flames in her body that could melt it immediately, so she didn’t need to worry about indigestion at all.
If it was Four Star Divine Metal, she could just barely eat it, but the speed would be very, very slow.
Thus, if she wanted to rapidly increase her cultivation level, it was best that she ate Divine Metal that corresponded to her cultivation level.

Ling Han was rich and imposing, buying a large amount of Divine Metal and tossing it to the little red bird. In any case, if he needed money, he could just concoct alchemical pills, and there was no need for him to become a thief like Liu Ming.

At present, the little red bird was already familiar with the empress and Hu Niu, and had a very good relationship with them. However, she and the little azure dragon were natural enemies, and the moment they met, they would argue and insult each other, causing even Ling Han to have the thought of matchmaking the two of them.
What a lovey-dovey couple. Furthermore, they were both the first generation of Divine Beasts. If they gave birth to descendants, just how amazing would their natural talent be?
Unknowingly, it was time for the monthly exam again. Whether they could receive cultivation resources would depend on their ranking in the monthly exam.

The large black dog and little azure dragon were both eager to give it a try. They had the Source Dao Stone, and their cultivation level was advancing at a terrifying rate. They were hoping to break into the top twenty this time.

The empress and the others competed first, and their results improved slightly compared to the last time. After all, the empress and the others also had Source Dao Stones, and their cultivation levels were also low, so their improvement was even faster.
After their battle, it was Ling Han’s turn.
Because he had gotten first place last month, there was no need for Ling Han to participate in the knockout battles. He only had to wait for others to challenge him.
It wasn’t long before the elimination battles concluded. As expected, Baili Luoyang won four battles in a row with an absolute advantage.
“I, will challenge you!” He pointed at Ling Han.

“What?” The little azure dragon’s eyes bulged.
“Are you dumbfounded now, stinky Four-Legged Snake!” The little red bird was proud of itself, “My mother, my ancestor is the strongest Divine Beast in the world.”
“Bullsh!t, the strongest Divine Beast is clearly my Imperial Father, the True Dragon that sweeps aside all opposition in the world!” The little azure dragon immediately retorted.
“True Dragon?” The little red bird stuck out its tongue, looking disdainful, “In the past, the True Dragon has been defeated by the Vermillion Bird who knows how many times, so save it.”
“Nonsense, the True Dragon is the strongest!”
“The Vermillion Bird is clearly the most powerful!”
The two of them were at loggerheads just like that, each of them raising their necks high, looking like they were determined to convince the other.
Ling Han shrugged, not bothering to pay them any regard.
“Little Han, where did you get this little bird from?” The large black dog clicked his tongue in wonder.
Ling Han briefly explained what had happened, and the large black dog couldn’t help but feel rueful.
Ling Han’s luck was truly heaven-defying.
He could obtain such good fortune just by completing a random mission.
This was the descendant of a Divine Beast!
Moreover, the little red bird had also let the cat out of the bag.
It was extremely likely that she was the daughter of the Vermillion Bird, and belonged to the first generation!
If Ling Han could receive the help of the two Divine Beasts in the future, just how terrifying would this power be?

No matter how he thought about it, it would definitely not be difficult for the first generation offspring of Divine Beasts to become a Saint, and it would definitely be an incredibly powerful Saint — who knows, it may even be possible that it could become a Pseudo-Emperor.
That would really be boundlessly terrifying.
“Oh, that’s right.
What’s with that Baili Luoyang?” Ling Han asked.
“Oh, Grandpa Dog isn’t too sure either, but I’ve heard others say that this guy is extremely awesome, and said that he wants to pull you off your horse,” the large black dog said casually.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Then just wait and see.”
What he was more concerned about was who had leaked his whereabouts to the Battle God Palace.
“Speaking of suspects, everyone in the whole Ancestral King Academy is under suspicion.” Ling Han was extremely speechless.
He didn’t seem to have done anything bad, so how did he make so many enemies?
The little red bird fed on ores.
Of course, it mainly ate Divine Metal.
If there was refined Divine Metal, that was naturally even better.
If there wasn’t, she was actually not very picky about her food.ree
She was at the Core Formation Tier now, and she could swallow all Divine Metal below four stars in a single gulp.
There were terrifying flames in her body that could melt it immediately, so she didn’t need to worry about indigestion at all.
If it was Four Star Divine Metal, she could just barely eat it, but the speed would be very, very slow.
Thus, if she wanted to rapidly increase her cultivation level, it was best that she ate Divine Metal that corresponded to her cultivation level.
Ling Han was rich and imposing, buying a large amount of Divine Metal and tossing it to the little red bird.
In any case, if he needed money, he could just concoct alchemical pills, and there was no need for him to become a thief like Liu Ming.
At present, the little red bird was already familiar with the empress and Hu Niu, and had a very good relationship with them.

However, she and the little azure dragon were natural enemies, and the moment they met, they would argue and insult each other, causing even Ling Han to have the thought of matchmaking the two of them.
What a lovey-dovey couple.
Furthermore, they were both the first generation of Divine Beasts.
If they gave birth to descendants, just how amazing would their natural talent be?
Unknowingly, it was time for the monthly exam again.
Whether they could receive cultivation resources would depend on their ranking in the monthly exam.
The large black dog and little azure dragon were both eager to give it a try.
They had the Source Dao Stone, and their cultivation level was advancing at a terrifying rate.
They were hoping to break into the top twenty this time.
The empress and the others competed first, and their results improved slightly compared to the last time.
After all, the empress and the others also had Source Dao Stones, and their cultivation levels were also low, so their improvement was even faster.
After their battle, it was Ling Han’s turn.
Because he had gotten first place last month, there was no need for Ling Han to participate in the knockout battles.
He only had to wait for others to challenge him.
It wasn’t long before the elimination battles concluded.
As expected, Baili Luoyang won four battles in a row with an absolute advantage.
“I, will challenge you!” He pointed at Ling Han.

chapters.title: Chapter 4318: Accident
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

Baili Luoyang, a prodigy of the Baili Clan, belonged to the Silver Generation. In terms of natural talent, he could even catch up to the tail of the Golden Generation, which showed how awesome he was.
Because of an inappropriate romance, he was imprisoned and shelved by his clan. Only a rare few people in the outside world knew of him.
Now that he had reappeared, he stood proudly, exuding a powerful aura.

This made everyone sigh with emotion. The Ziwei Imperial Clan was truly doted on by the heavens. Not only did they have a Golden Generation elite like Baili Tian, they also had Baili Yun and Baili Luoyang, two Silver Generation elites.
In fact, Baili Luoyang even had the potential to become a Golden Generation elite.
Ling Han walked out. There were only two options for being challenged: first, accept the challenge, and second, admit defeat.
It was obviously impossible for him to admit defeat, so he naturally accepted the challenge.
“You crippled a cousin of mine,” Baili Luoyang said coldly.

He was naturally referring to Baili Che, who had been crippled by Ling Han just when he was about to break through to the True Self Tier. From then onwards, his cultivation level was eternally stuck at the level of Pseudo True Self Tier, and had completely faded out of the ranks of Imperial Sons.
—There was no Imperial Son that was so useless.
“And then?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“Thus, I will also cripple you!” Baili Luoyang declared balefully.
Ling Han looked at the elites of the academy and said, “Hey, hey, hey, everyone heard that, right? This guy wants to use his public office to avenge a private grudge!”

“Don’t make a mountain out of a molehill. It’s time for the tournament,” Venerate Shi reprimanded. “Moreover, it’s inevitable that one won’t be able to stop in time during the tournament, which is unavoidable.”
Ling Han chuckled and said to Baili Luoyang, “Since that’s the case, I’ll cripple you as well.”
“Haha!” Baili Luoyang sneered, “Do you know what cultivation level I have?”
With a thought, the True Self appeared, exuding a seven-coloured light.
The Seven Colours True Self, even stronger than Guan Xia’s.
“The Eighth Form of the True Self Tier!” he declared proudly.

After so many years, he had been imprisoned all this while. For a prodigy like him, he was naturally filled with pent-up anger. Now, he had risen up aggressively, and should reign supreme, so that his great name would spread throughout the entire universe.
And Ling Han was his stepping stone.
This opponent was very good, and had the reputation of being invincible among his peers. Thus, if he defeated Ling Han, he would naturally become famous overnight.
“Eight Forms!”
“Heavens, it really is the Eight Forms!”
“This is the exclusive territory of the Golden Generation!”

Everyone was exclaiming in shock. Though they had already guessed that Baili Luoyang was very possibly in the Eighth Form, or there would have been no need for him to challenge Ling Han, but with their own eyes, they could not help but feel stunned.
The aptitude of the Golden Generation meant that he would have a chance of breaking through to the Imperial Path in future.
“How is it?” Baili Luoyang asked proudly.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “Not much. It’s still not enough for one hand of mine.”
You!
To say nothing of Baili Luoyang, everyone shook their heads, feeling that Ling Han was too arrogant.
‘You’re only at the Seventh Form, and you’ve only formed a mortal body. Yet, you want to defeat the Eighth Form single-handedly?’
Do you know what the Eighth Form means?
Supreme aptitude!

For such a prodigy, only he would be able to emerge victorious against an opponent with a superior cultivation level, and you still want to emerge victorious against someone with an advantage of a minor level, or even use only one hand in reality?
Hehe, wasn’t this the biggest joke in the world?
“Stubborn!” Baili Luoyang charged over. Boom, a terrifying power was completely displayed, as he unleashed the strength of the Eighth Form to his heart’s content.
After being silent for so long, he was going to explode with brilliance.
Boom, he was wrapped in boundless might, and Regulations turned into divine red clouds that shone behind him, making him seem as if he had transformed into a Celestial King.
This might was too astonishing, and everyone was completely captivated.
True Self Tier could actually be this strong!
As it turned out, this was the height that the Golden Generation had once reached. It was practically enough to make one lose all hope.
Baili Luoyang charged over, boundless power surging. He was going to defeat Ling Han in a single stroke.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and stretched out his right hand, grabbing out at Baili Luoyang.
His movements were clearly very slow, and very casual at that, but they were incredibly precise, as he aimed directly for Baili Luoyang’s neck.
This was going too far, and you actually dare to look down on me like this?
Baili Luoyang roared in fury, his right hand transforming into a saber that slashed out at Ling Han.
Peng!
The hand saber slashed onto Ling Han’s arm, yet was suddenly sent flying back. Meanwhile, Ling Han’s attack was completely unaffected, and he easily gripped Baili Luoyang’s neck.
The battle came to an abrupt stop.
At this moment, everyone’s mouths were wide open, and they couldn’t make a single sound. Even those Venerate Tier elites were dumbfounded.
What was going on?
Ling Han had actually taken down the Eighth Form of True Self Tier with a single move?
How could this be believed?
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said to Baili Luoyang, “How about it? I said I can deal with you with one hand, right?”
Everyone was speechless. This was not something that could be done with a single hand; this was practically an insta-kill.
The gap in strength between the two... was as wide as the gap between heaven and earth!
Was Ling Han really in the seventh form? Was his true self really a mortal?
This question arose in everyone’s mind. Even if the Seventh Form could defeat the Eighth Form, it shouldn’t have been so easy, right?
Ling Han’s eyes sharpened. Boom, under the reverberation of a terrifying power, the True Selves in Baili Luoyang’s mind instantly shattered one after another.
“How dare you!” Baili Hanyun was furious, and immediately stretched out a hand to grab Ling Han.
Since Ling Han had moved, he was naturally prepared. Immediately, he used the Star Steps, and left the range of Baili Hanyun’s attack.
“Yo, are you embarrassed and angry now?” he asked calmly.

Baili Hanyun moved impulsively, but he immediately realized that if he killed Ling Han with his superior strength, the Nine Mountains Saint would definitely stomp in fury, and bring great calamity to himself and the Baili Clan.

He forced himself to calm down, and said, “You have such a vicious heart. It is only an ordinary sparring match, and you actually did such a vicious thing, crippling the cultivation level of your opponent! Going by the rules of the academy, I can also cripple your cultivation level and expel you from the academy.”
‘Oh, you’re trying to reason with me now?’

Ling Han chuckled and said, “Previously, when Baili Luoyang said that he wanted to cripple me, why didn’t anyone say anything, and said that doing so was wrong and against the academy’s rules? Oh, that’s right, I seem to have protested to the Lords before, right?”
“Sorry, it was an accident, an accident!”
Being mocked by Ling Han like this, the Venerate Tier elites all felt slightly awkward. This double standard was really too obvious.
“Luoyang was just saying, and you actually made a move!” Baili Hanyun argued.

“Ya, I already said it was an accident!” Ling Han shook his head, “In a battle, it is inevitable that there would be mistakes. This is also what the Lords have said. Even the Lords would accidentally make mistakes, what more a minor character like me. Hehe.”
At this moment, Baili Hanyun actually didn’t know what to say.

In terms of quibbling, Ling Han was even more skilled at it than he was. Moreover, if he wanted to forcefully suppress Ling Han, Ling Han also had the backing of the Saint and the Imperial Weapon behind him. Thus, he had special privileges.
Thus, what could they do?
If he wanted to deal with Ling Han, he could only follow the rules and have someone at the same cultivation level kill him. In that case, the Nine Mountains Saint would have nothing to say.

Now, everything had returned to square one. If he wanted to kill Ling Han, he could only wait until Ling Han advanced into Spiritual Transformation Tier. Then, there would definitely be many prodigies that could defeat him.
They could only wait.

chapters.title: Chapter 4319: Opening Her Heart
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han felt very pleased.
Crippling Baili Luoyang in front of so many Venerate Tier elites naturally vented his anger greatly.

In fact, he wasn’t an unreasonable person. Just look, he hadn’t been too ruthless against the likes of Guan Xia, had he? Who asked Baili Luoyang to clearly cripple him right from the start? What was there to be polite about?
He had crippled a member of the Imperial Clan, and could even receive the cultivation resources of the Imperial Clan as a reward. Was there anything more pleasurable than this in this world?

Of course, Ling Han’s display of dominance would definitely bring hidden dangers to the empress, the large black dog, and the others. Thus, Ling Han had them be more cautious and attentive. Usually, they had to be more careful when they did things, and not jump into a trap.

During this time, Ding Shu fought a few more times with Ling Han. He slowly cultivated to the end of the ninth form, wanting to break through to the tenth form, and with Ling Han as a whetstone, the possibility of taking this step would be considerably higher.
However, taking this step was really too difficult.

Even though Ding Shu was also the overlord of the Genesis World, he had already used the power of dimensional beings when he had broken through to the ninth form. If he were to attempt the tenth form now, this power would similarly be severely repelled, and would not be of any crucial use.
Thus, he only had a sliver of a chance in theory.
A year had passed, and Ling Han had pushed the third True Self to the end of the tenth form. Going by the look of things, he still needed around three years to be able to succeed.
So slow.

Every once in a while, the Ancestral King Academy would welcome a batch of new students. Some of them were truly extraordinarily talented, and it was unknown where they had come from. They had previously been completely unknown, but now, they were shining brilliantly.
Chi Menghan finally arrived as well. She and the silver-haired little lolita joined the academy at the same time.
“I didn’t see you before, and I thought that you weren’t interested in coming here.” Ling Han found a chance to meet Chi Menghan.
Chi Menghan smiled faintly, “Previously, I was at the crucial moment of breaking through to Spiritual Transformation Tier, so I have been in seclusion all this while.”
“Yi, you’re a Spiritual Transformation Tier elite?” Ling Han was surprised.
Chi Menghan smiled proudly, “Now, you are no match for me.”

“Let me offer my congratulations first,” Ling Han said with a smile. “However, your words are quite confident. Those who have been defeated by me before, even if they have surpassed me in terms of cultivation level, could not possibly defeat me.”
“Then, shall we compete?” Chi Menghan asked, provoking him.
“Sure.”
The two of them went to an uninhabited planet. Previously, when Ling Han and Ding Shu had sparred, they had both chosen this place.
“This place... looks like a great battle happened not too long ago here.” Chi Menghan swept an eye over the area.
Ling Han nodded, “I fought with a very conceited guy. He keeps being unwilling to admit that I am the boss. However, it won’t be long now.”

He had already shown Ding Shu that his cultivation level was Tenth Form, which greatly provoked Ding Shu. He swore that he would also rush up to Tenth Form. Otherwise, he would have to acknowledge Ling Han as his Big Brother.
For him, this was definitely not allowed.
Chi Menghan smiled, and said, “Don’t tell me that you also want me to acknowledge you as my boss?”
These words were very normal, but accompanied with her turning back to look at him with a smile, the effect was completely different. Instantly, there was a kind of indistinct sparks flying.
Ling Han’s heart involuntarily throbbed.

After coming to this great world, he had been very restrained. He had not thought of any kind of emotional entanglement with any woman, but there were some things that really could not be clearly distinguished just by dividing the boundaries.
Chi Menghan had helped him several times when he was in danger. He couldn’t pretend that he hadn’t seen this deep affection.
Sigh, it was all his fault. He was too outstanding.
Ling Han thought shamelessly. He chuckled, “Forget about Boss. If I win, you can just acknowledge me as your husband.”
“Pervert!” Chi Menghan shouted. Her pretty face was flushed red, and she launched an attack at Ling Han.
She didn’t know Ling Han’s strength, so she naturally wouldn’t use her full strength at once, lest she accidentally wound Ling Han or even beat him to death.
Ling Han snickered, and channeled his power, clashing head-on with Chi Menghan.
After a few moves, Chi Menghan couldn’t help but feel stunned. This was because Ling Han’s power was truly no weaker than hers.
How was this possible?

She had broken through from the Eighth Form of True Self Tier, and once she advanced into the Spiritual Transformation Tier, she possessed the power of four Heavens, capable of crushing the Spirit Transformation Tier First Change.
But when it came to Ling Han, she couldn’t even suppress a True Self Tier cultivator?
“Could it be that you’ve advanced to the ninth form?” Chi Menghan exclaimed in astonishment. This was the only possibility.
Ling Han smiled in acknowledgment.
He wasn’t lying either, because he had indeed reached the ninth form of the True Self Tier.

Even so, Chi Menghan was still incredibly stunned. This was the ninth form of the True Self Tier, a cultivation level that only existed in legends. Even the Golden Generation could only look up to it.
However, a sense of pride also rose up in her heart.
This was the man that she had her eye on. As expected, he had not disappointed her expectations.
“Why aren’t you fighting anymore? Do you want to be my wife that much?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
Chi Menghan’s pretty face flushed red, and she hurriedly launched another attack, blasting towards Ling Han.

She was only a Spirit Transformation Tier First Change, so she had only formed a single spiritual body. Moreover, she clearly hadn’t reached the consummate level yet. This “True Self” was extremely vague, and she could just barely make out a human figure.
Spiritual body and main body joined forces, and launched a mad barrage of attacks at Ling Han.
How could a young girl’s heart be guessed so easily?
If he didn’t guess correctly, he would be blamed, and if he guessed correctly, he would still garner a pout.
The two of them battled fiercely, but naturally did not have any animosity. They only wanted to know how strong the other was.
As they fought, it was inevitable that there would be physical contact. Every time they touched, an ambiguous feeling would spread between the two of them.
Ling Han wasn’t a blockhead, either. She was deeply in love with him, and he owed her too many favors, so his resistance had more or less dissipated.
Thus, he no longer suppressed his own heart. Cultivating was all about nature and following one’s heart. It was naturally not good for him to forcefully suppress his emotions.
“From now on, you are my wife,” Ling Han said.
Chi Menghan rolled his eyes, and said, “Have I lost to you?”
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh loudly, “If you lose to me, will you really be my wife?”
Chi Menghan knew that she had made a slip of the tongue, so she stomped her foot and left in a pout.
“Sigh!” Ling Han stroked his chin, and said, “Being as handsome as I am, my luck with women is truly too good. I’ve sinned!”

He returned to the Academy. It had only been a few days, and he had already received a notice. Those at the True Self Tier, Spirit Transformation Tier, and Sect Master Tier would immediately set out for the Mountain Sea Heaven. The battle situation there was tense, and prodigies like them were needed to join.
If they did not arrive in time, they would be severely punished.

Ling Han didn’t like the Imperial Clans, but he was still duty-bound to fight against Yin souls. Thus, he, the large black dog, the little azure dragon, the perverted pig, and the seven babies immediately set out, heading towards the Mountain Sea Heaven.
After half a month’s long journey, they arrived at the Mountain Sea Heaven. The Dark Moon Planet wasn’t too far from here in the first place.
Ling Han had come here once, and had a very deep impression of this place. He discovered that this place had changed greatly.
—There were actually a considerable number of planets that had appeared in the initially empty galaxy. They were spread around the Mountain Sea Heaven, and surrounded it.
— New chapter is coming soon —

He slowly cultivated to the end of the ninth form, wanting to break through to the tenth form, and with Ling Han as a whetstone, the possibility of taking this step would be considerably higher.
However, taking this step was really too difficult.
Even though Ding Shu was also the overlord of the Genesis World, he had already used the power of dimensional beings when he had broken through to the ninth form.
If he were to attempt the tenth form now, this power would similarly be severely repelled, and would not be of any crucial use.
Thus, he only had a sliver of a chance in theory.
A year had passed, and Ling Han had pushed the third True Self to the end of the tenth form.
Going by the look of things, he still needed around three years to be able to succeed.
So slow.
Every once in a while, the Ancestral King Academy would welcome a batch of new students.
Some of them were truly extraordinarily talented, and it was unknown where they had come from.
They had previously been completely unknown, but now, they were shining brilliantly.
Chi Menghan finally arrived as well.
She and the silver-haired little lolita joined the academy at the same time.
“I didn’t see you before, and I thought that you weren’t interested in coming here.” Ling Han found a chance to meet Chi Menghan.
Chi Menghan smiled faintly, “Previously, I was at the crucial moment of breaking through to Spiritual Transformation Tier, so I have been in seclusion all this while.”
“Yi, you’re a Spiritual Transformation Tier elite?” Ling Han was surprised.
Chi Menghan smiled proudly, “Now, you are no match for me.”
“Let me offer my congratulations first,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“However, your words are quite confident.
Those who have been defeated by me before, even if they have surpassed me in terms of cultivation level, could not possibly defeat me.”
“Then, shall we compete?” Chi Menghan asked, provoking him.
“Sure.”
The two of them went to an uninhabited planet.
Previously, when Ling Han and Ding Shu had sparred, they had both chosen this place.
“This place... looks like a great battle happened not too long ago here.” Chi Menghan swept an eye over the area.
Ling Han nodded, “I fought with a very conceited guy.
He keeps being unwilling to admit that I am the boss.
However, it won’t be long now.”
He had already shown Ding Shu that his cultivation level was Tenth Form, which greatly provoked Ding Shu.
He swore that he would also rush up to Tenth Form.
Otherwise, he would have to acknowledge Ling Han as his Big Brother.
For him, this was definitely not allowed.
Chi Menghan smiled, and said, “Don’t tell me that you also want me to acknowledge you as my boss?”
These words were very normal, but accompanied with her turning back to look at him with a smile, the effect was completely different.
Instantly, there was a kind of indistinct sparks flying.
Ling Han’s heart involuntarily throbbed.
After coming to this great world, he had been very restrained.
He had not thought of any kind of emotional entanglement with any woman, but there were some things that really could not be clearly distinguished just by dividing the boundaries.
Chi Menghan had helped him several times when he was in danger.
He couldn’t pretend that he hadn’t seen this deep affection.
Sigh, it was all his fault.
He was too outstanding.
Ling Han thought shamelessly.
He chuckled, “Forget about Boss.
If I win, you can just acknowledge me as your husband.”
“Pervert!” Chi Menghan shouted.
Her pretty face was flushed red, and she launched an attack at Ling Han.
She didn’t know Ling Han’s strength, so she naturally wouldn’t use her full strength at once, lest she accidentally wound Ling Han or even beat him to death.
Ling Han snickered, and channeled his power, clashing head-on with Chi Menghan.
After a few moves, Chi Menghan couldn’t help but feel stunned.
This was because Ling Han’s power was truly no weaker than hers.
How was this possible?

She had broken through from the Eighth Form of True Self Tier, and once she advanced into the Spiritual Transformation Tier, she possessed the power of four Heavens, capable of crushing the Spirit Transformation Tier First Change.
But when it came to Ling Han, she couldn’t even suppress a True Self Tier cultivator?
“Could it be that you’ve advanced to the ninth form?” Chi Menghan exclaimed in astonishment.
This was the only possibility.
Ling Han smiled in acknowledgment.
He wasn’t lying either, because he had indeed reached the ninth form of the True Self Tier.
Even so, Chi Menghan was still incredibly stunned.
This was the ninth form of the True Self Tier, a cultivation level that only existed in legends.
Even the Golden Generation could only look up to it.
However, a sense of pride also rose up in her heart.
This was the man that she had her eye on.
As expected, he had not disappointed her expectations.
“Why aren’t you fighting anymore?
Do you want to be my wife that much?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
Chi Menghan’s pretty face flushed red, and she hurriedly launched another attack, blasting towards Ling Han.
She was only a Spirit Transformation Tier First Change, so she had only formed a single spiritual body.
Moreover, she clearly hadn’t reached the consummate level yet.
This “True Self” was extremely vague, and she could just barely make out a human figure.
Spiritual body and main body joined forces, and launched a mad barrage of attacks at Ling Han.
How could a young girl’s heart be guessed so easily?
If he didn’t guess correctly, he would be blamed, and if he guessed correctly, he would still garner a pout.
The two of them battled fiercely, but naturally did not have any animosity.
They only wanted to know how strong the other was.
As they fought, it was inevitable that there would be physical contact.
Every time they touched, an ambiguous feeling would spread between the two of them.
Ling Han wasn’t a blockhead, either.
She was deeply in love with him, and he owed her too many favors, so his resistance had more or less dissipated.
Thus, he no longer suppressed his own heart.
Cultivating was all about nature and following one’s heart.
It was naturally not good for him to forcefully suppress his emotions.
“From now on, you are my wife,” Ling Han said.
Chi Menghan rolled his eyes, and said, “Have I lost to you?”
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh loudly, “If you lose to me, will you really be my wife?”
Chi Menghan knew that she had made a slip of the tongue, so she stomped her foot and left in a pout.
“Sigh!” Ling Han stroked his chin, and said, “Being as handsome as I am, my luck with women is truly too good.
I’ve sinned!”
He returned to the Academy.
It had only been a few days, and he had already received a notice.
Those at the True Self Tier, Spirit Transformation Tier, and Sect Master Tier would immediately set out for the Mountain Sea Heaven.
The battle situation there was tense, and prodigies like them were needed to join.
If they did not arrive in time, they would be severely punished.
Ling Han didn’t like the Imperial Clans, but he was still duty-bound to fight against Yin souls.
Thus, he, the large black dog, the little azure dragon, the perverted pig, and the seven babies immediately set out, heading towards the Mountain Sea Heaven.
After half a month’s long journey, they arrived at the Mountain Sea Heaven.
The Dark Moon Planet wasn’t too far from here in the first place.
Ling Han had come here once, and had a very deep impression of this place.
He discovered that this place had changed greatly.
—There were actually a considerable number of planets that had appeared in the initially empty galaxy.
They were spread around the Mountain Sea Heaven, and surrounded it.
— New chapter is coming soon —

chapters.title: Chapter 4320: Rushing to the front lines
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han was astonished. These planets had most likely been transported here.
This was really extravagant. In order to oppose the Yin souls, a planetary line of defense had been forcefully built here.

To the Sect Masters, Venerate Tiers, and Saints, battling in space wasn’t a big deal. They could tear a rip in the Void and instantly travel millions and millions of kilometers. However, for cultivators below the level of Sect Master, they still had to be down-to-earth.
Moreover, the power of cultivators wasn’t inexhaustible. They needed to absorb the power of heaven and earth to recover, so they naturally needed planets as a medium.
Ling Han and the others followed the rules and landed on a planet numbered Eleven.

There were a total of 33 planets here, and they were not randomly made up. Instead, every planet was connected to one another, and responded to one another, forming a formation. Thus, if these planets were not destroyed, the formation would not be unravelled, and the Yin souls that was trapped inside would not be able to charge out.
Ling Han couldn’t help but sigh with emotion. Using a planet as a formation foundation wasn’t something that formation grandmasters could do, but Formation Saints!

In order to resist the Yin souls, even the Formation Saint had been invited out of their seclusion. It should be known that this kind of existence was really too transcendent. Even Saints would have to be extremely polite when they saw him, and in the whole universe, there were possibly only three to five of them.
They first went to complete their recruitment report, then were assigned into a team, and could enter into battle at any time.

The 33 planets were the first line of defense against the Yin soul army, and was also the most crucial line of defense. Once it was lost, the Yin soul army would be able to use this as a breakthrough point and advance into the depths of the vast universe.
Thus, every planet could not be lost, and there would be Saints standing guard with the Imperial Weapon on each of them.

Ling Han kept a very low profile. In front of the army of Yin souls, his freakish natural talent was completely useless. It was a competition of pure strength. Furthermore, Yin souls did not have any qualms. Even if it was a Sect Master-level yin soul that encountered him, they would still make a move.
Thus, it was necessary to keep a low profile. After all, he hadn’t matured yet.

Thankfully, though this planet had been forcefully pushed to this position by a great elite with supreme might, the ley lines had not been damaged, and could still be communicated and used. However, this Earth Qi was very weak. Whether it was using Star Steps or extracting Earth Qi to transform into a dragon, the effects were much worse.

There was nothing that could be done. The main power of heaven and earth had been used to turn into the power of the great formation. Though Ling Han was a grandmaster of formations, it was obviously impossible for him to compare to a Formation Saint.
It was already good that he could use it. At least, he would have a way out.
After only three days, the Yin souls launched another large-scale attack.

They pretended to attack a great many planets, and their main targets of attack were the seventh, eleventh and twenty-third planets. Countless Yin souls were teleported over, floating in the skies, practically covering the skies.
This was not just the Yin souls, but also the aura of the Netherworld, which greatly weakened the Regulations of heaven and earth that everyone could draw upon.
The person standing guard here was the Drizzle Saint of the Red Lotus Imperial Clan. Aside from him, there were also seven Saints supporting him. This kind of lineup could be considered exaggerated.
Under the control of the Drizzle Saint, the cultivators on the eleventh planet all moved out to meet the Yin souls.
As soon as they came into contact, the side of the Living Realm suffered heavy casualties.

This was the main attack point of the Yin souls. The Yin souls that came were all very powerful, and the Yin souls would not be injured by mystical power. They could only be hit with high-level energy, or the Regulations of heaven and earth, making them extremely hard to kill.
“Ling Han, let’s see who can kill more Yin souls.” Ding Shu jumped out, appearing extremely heroic.
“Sure!” Ling Han nodded.
If he killed a Yin soul in the Living Realm, he would be rewarded by heaven and earth. Previously, in the Black Divine Temple, Ling Han had thus healed his internal injuries.
Wasn’t it a good opportunity to compensate for the damage to his life force?

The two freaks charged out at the same time, unleashing their full battle prowess. Destructive Energy surged, and with a single strike, one, or even a few Yin souls, were killed. The efficiency was incredibly shocking.

When the number of Yin souls killed had reached a certain extent, the rewards from heaven and earth also came. Ling Han immediately felt warm all over, and a heat surged through his whole body, making him feel so comfortable that he wanted to cry out loudly.
His life force was presently being repaired, so it was naturally very comfortable.
Kill, kill, kill!

Ling Han and Ding Shu weren’t the only ones. The large black dog, the little azure dragon, and the others also mercilessly launched attacks. This wasn’t just for the sake of the Living Realm. It was also extremely beneficial for them, as they had also used many Source Dao Stones.

The eight Saints quickly joined the battle as well. However, the reason why the Drizzle Saint hadn’t unleashed the Imperial Weapon was because she wanted to prevent the Yin Saint from unleashing the Imperial Weapon as well. Otherwise, if the eleventh planet was suddenly obliterated, the restriction of the great formation would also be lifted.

The leading figure of the Yin souls was naturally a Saint as well. He was called Jiuhua Yin Saint, and he was battling fiercely with the Drizzle Saint, not falling into a disadvantage at all. His strength was astonishing.

“Jiuhua, since you have already become a Saint in the Netherworld, you can claim to have transcended, so what need is there for you to start a war?” The Drizzle Saint exchanged blows with the Jiuhua Yin Saint, as she launched verbal attacks.
The Jiuhua Yin Saint merely smirked coldly, “You are merely a chess piece on the chessboard, and can only be manipulated by others. Don’t act as if the whole world is under your control.”
“Becoming a Saint is already transcendent, so what do you mean by a chess piece?” the Drizzle Saint retorted.

“Haha, not only are you a chess piece, you are also a chess piece that knows nothing.” Jiuhua Yin Saint sneered, but his attacks were continuous. Extracting the terrifying Regulations, he launched a mad offensive.
Everyone heard this conversation with their ears, and they were all surprised.
A Saint was only a chess piece?
Then who was the one playing the game?
Ancestral King?
However, who didn’t know that there were no Emperors in the world? How could there be an Ancestral King then?

Moreover, if there really was an Ancestral King, would there be any need for so much trouble? They could suppress the heaven and earth by themselves, so what if there were more Saints? They would all be suppressed with a single palm strike, and no matter how many Imperial Weapons they summoned, it would only be a matter of spending a little more effort.
However, how could they have the time to ponder this problem now? The great battle was still continuing, and there were continuous casualties. The situation was extremely tense.
Fortunately, after confirming that the Yin soul army was attacking these three planets, the Saints guarding the other planets also came over and joined the battle.
With the addition of such a fresh force, the Yin soul army was finally completely defeated.

“Why do you have to do this?” the Drizzle Saint said. “If this continues, both sides will only suffer losses. Yin and Yang should be in order, and only then will they be able to exist eternally. You had best give up on this idea. The matter of the Yin sousl wreaking havoc in the Living Realm has never happened before. It will not happen now, nor will it happen in the future.”
“Hahaha!” Jiuhua Yin Saint laughed loudly, as if everyone else was an idiot.

“The wheel of history is rolling, and no one can stop it!” he said, “Those who go along with it will prosper, and those who go against it will die. Not too long after, you will all know just how ignorant you all are!”
“How pretentious!” a considerable number of Saints exclaimed coldly.

Only the Great Emperor could rule over the universe, and it had never been heard that the Netherworld had produced a Great Emperor. With the order of heaven and earth, the Ancestral King could only be born in the Living Realm.
Without the lead of a Great Emperor, wouldn’t it be a huge joke if the Netherworld beings wanted to conquer the Living Realm?

chapters.title: Chapter 4321: Mending life force
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The soul-stirring battle ended, and everyone hurriedly rested.

A great many people were severely wounded, and a great many had even died in battle on the battlefield. Of course, the Yin souls had paid an even greater price. In the end, a great many Saints moved together, causing a devastating blow to the Yin souls.

However, after death, the soul fragments would head to the Netherworld, which was equivalent to adding battle prowess to the Netherworld out of thin air. Meanwhile, in the case of the Living Realm, nurturing an elite would have to be done step by step, and it would take a very long time.
From this aspect alone, the Living Realm couldn’t afford to waste any more time.
“What do you guys think the Netherworld beings are aiming for?” the large black dog asked.
Ling Han, the large black dog, the little azure dragon, Ding Shu, and Chi Menghan formed a small alliance.
“That’s right. This is really baffling.” Ding Shu also clasped his head, unable to figure it out no matter what.
Launching a war and contesting for territory was for nothing more than population and resources, but what did Yin souls want the population and resources of the Living Realm for?

Indeed, killing yang souls would allow the Netherworld to increase its “population” for a short period of time. However, this would be killing the goose that lays the golden egg. Only by maintaining the endless growth of the yang souls would the Netherworld have an endless supply of new troops.
Yin souls that hadn’t developed intelligence couldn’t think of this, but it wouldn’t be that even Yin Saints couldn’t think of it.
Ordinarily, with Yin and Yang separated, each guarding their own side, minding their own business, this was the best result.
Why did one party have to violate the law?
“There’s definitely a big secret that we don’t know about,” the little azure dragon said in a deadpan voice.
“Che!” Everyone gave him the middle finger. His words seemed to be very profound, but in truth, it was just saying what was obvious.
“Additionally, even the Yin Saint calls himself a chess piece. Could it be that a Great Emperor’s celestial corpse has appeared in the Netherworld?” The large black dog stroked his chin.
Previously, the information that Jiuhua Yin Saint had revealed was really chilling. If even Saints were pawns, then who would be qualified to play the game?
A Great Emperor!

“The Netherworld can’t possibly give birth to a Great Emperor,” Chi Menghan said with absolute certainty. “Our ancestor entered the Netherworld before, and he’s 100% sure that the Netherworld doesn’t have the environment to give rise to a Great Emperor.”
The ancestor she was talking about was definitely the Ancestral King Donglin.

Since an Ancestral King had already said that it was impossible for the Netherworld to give rise to a Great Emperor, then it was definitely impossible. The Ancestral King was one that had already stepped into this threshold, so he was naturally the most qualified to make this declaration.
“Could it be a Great Emperor had died, and after his death, entered into the Netherworld, and became a Great Emperor in a different manner?” Ding Shu speculated.
Everyone nodded in agreement. Although the Netherworld didn’t possess the foundations to give rise to a Great Emperor, what if they had the experience of becoming a Great Emperor originally?

“Impossible,” Chi Menghan said with a shake of her head. “According to our ancestor, the Great Emperor is far too powerful. It’s also because of this that once the Ancestral King dies, his soul will be absorbed by heaven and earth and become a part of the Regulations of heaven and earth.”
“Thus, it is definitely impossible that a Great Emperor would appear in the Netherworld.”
Her words were resolute, and it was clear that she was absolutely certain.
This was the conclusion that the Ancestral King Donglin had come to. There was no doubt that it was true.
Everyone were scratching their heads in confusion. They couldn’t figure it out no matter what.

However, even the Saints were completely confused, so just how knowledgeable were they? Then, with Ling Han and the others, a few True Self Tiers and Spirit Transformation Tier discussing here, what conclusion could they come to?
“Forget it, let’s hurry up and increase our strength.” In the end, everyone could only say helplessly.
Ling Han smiled at Ding Shu and said, “Hey, when are you acknowledging me as Big Brother?”

“Pei! I still haven’t advanced to the Spirit Transformation Tier yet, so as long as I don’t advance to the Spirit Transformation Tier, I’ll always have a sliver of hope!” Ding Shu said with his head held high.
Ling Han’s expression was filled with suspicion, “You won’t never break through to Spirit Transformation Tier for the rest of your life to avoid becoming my underling, right?”
“F*** you, I will definitely reach Tenth Form!” Ding Shu clenched his fists, his fighting spirit blazing.
“Hehe.”
Everyone returned to rest, and Ling Han also needed to make some adjustments.
In this battle, he had profited greatly.

He would be rewarded by heaven and earth for killing Yin souls in the Living Realm, and the Yin souls he had killed this time could be considered uncountable. With Destructive Energy added with his present terrifying battle prowess, even a Spirit Transformation Tier-level Yin soul would be killed.
Thus, the benefits he received were also astonishing.
The damaged life force had already been completely mended!

Of course, he would never be able to recover the lifespan that he had lost. This was the price that he had to pay for the rapid increase of his cultivation level. It was like there was a Regulation of Karma. If you wanted to take a shortcut, you would definitely have to pay a price.
With a lifespan of about a thousand years, Ling Han was still able to afford it.
“Now that the life force has recovered, I have nothing to worry about.”

He was not so foolhardy to use the Source Dao Stone again. Instead, he was anticipating the invasion of the Yin souls that would follow. His life force had recovered to the consummate level, and if he was rewarded again, it would definitely help him increase his cultivation level.
Several days later, the Yin souls once again wreaked havoc.

This time, the main battlefield was not on the eleventh planet, but there were still a considerable number of Yin souls that had come. Ling Han had killed innumerable enemies, and had also received a great many rewards from the heaven and earth. His cultivation level instantly had a clear improvement.
Invigorating!
Ling Han was filled with anticipation. After battling here for a year and a half, he should be able to reach the end of the Tenth Form, and qualify to break through to Spiritual Transformation Tier.
Furthermore, this was improving one’s cultivation level through battle, so there was absolutely no need to worry that his cultivation was advancing too fast, and his foundations would be unstable.

Yin souls launched a minor offensive once every three days, and a major offensive once every ten days, as if they wanted to completely exhaust the accumulation of their forces over these countless years.
The Living Realm’s side suffered great losses, but as long as they survived, they all had astonishing improvements.

However, this kind of benefit was not something that everyone could enjoy evenly, because the Yin souls would not be injured by mystical power, and only high-level energy and Regulations would be able to injure them. It would be extremely straining for those below the True Self Tier to deal with the Yin souls.

Thus, those participating in the battles here were at least at the True Self Tier. If Core Formation Tiers and Cauldron Forging Tiers came, not only would they not be able to reap any benefits, they would even lose their lives.

Ling Han had already cultivated the eighth True Self to the tenth form. He was only missing the last True Self, and he would be able to touch the end of the True Self Tier.

“En?” Ling Han walked out.
“The Yin souls are here again!” the large black dog said in excitement.
For them, the invasion of the Yin souls was actually a gift, and if someone gave a gift, and it was a great gift at that, who would not be happy?
“All right, let’s move out!”
Ling Han charged out with the large black dog, little azure dragon, Chi Menghan, and the seven babies. This was another great opportunity to improve his cultivation.

The Void suddenly tore apart, and a long river surged over.

chapters.title: Chapter 4322: Yin River Reappears
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“Yi!” Ling Han immediately exclaimed in surprise.
“En?” Ding Shu also appeared very stunned.
“What’s wrong?” the large black dog and the others hurriedly asked.
Ling Han took a deep breath, “This river... seems a little familiar.”
“You think so too?” Ding Shu looked towards Ling Han.
Ling Han nodded, “If both of us think that way, then I’m sure we are not mistaken.”
“Hey, what kind of riddle are you guys playing?” The little azure dragon didn’t have much patience, and was already so anxious that it was about to stomp its feet.
“That Yin River from Dark Clouds Hell!” Ling Han said darkly, finally unravelling the mystery.
“What!” Everyone was stunned.

The Dark Clouds Hell was a dangerous place in this universe. It was hidden inside a black hole, and there were great dangers within. Even a Saint with an Imperial Weapon could possibly die if they entered.
But that should be completely unrelated to this place. Why had the Yin River of the Dark Clouds Hell suddenly appeared here?
Moreover, wasn’t the Dark Clouds Hell hidden inside the black hole?
“Little Han, could it be that you’ve both seen wrongly? It just looks similar,” the large black dog said.
“That’s right, that’s right. There are many such great rivers in the world, and it may not be that one.” The little azure dragon also nodded repeatedly.
“Yes or no, it’s very easy to prove,” Ling Han said in a deep voice.
“How?” Chi Menghan asked.
“Is the boatman there?” Ding Shu continued.
The sudden appearance of this great river stunned everyone. In the vast universe, what did the sudden appearance of a great river mean?
In any case, the Yin soul army had already been defeated. A great many people put away their weapons, and looked towards the skies.
The Yin River surged and flowed endlessly. There was clearly no riverbed, but it was as if the great river was controlled by an invisible power, and the waters did not seep out in the slightest.
All of a sudden, everyone felt a frightening Yin Qi seeping directly into their bones, and every single one of them trembled endlessly.
This was a bone-deep chill that could not be erased.
What was going on here?
A cold and sinister river appeared out of nowhere. No matter how they thought about it, this did not seem like a good thing.
Even the Saints came over, and stood on the banks of the river, looking alert.
“Look!” Someone pointed into the distance of the river.
Everyone looked over, and their hearts clenched.

There, there was actually a small ship slowly sailing over. In fact, it couldn’t even be considered a ship. It could only be called a boat, and there was a boatman standing at the bow of the boat, who was presently slowly holding onto a bamboo pole.
If this happened on some planet, that would be very normal.
However, in the universe, a cold river suddenly stretched out, and a boatman appeared in the river. No matter how one thought about it, it didn’t seem right.
Ling Han turned to look at Ding Shu, and Ding Shu coincidentally turned to look at him as well. The two of them frowned, and a powerful chill rose up in their hearts.
And this kind of small boat... there was actually not just one.
Very quickly, another small boat appeared, then a third, and a fourth. There were more and more of them, and they filed off.
As they sailed closer, everyone could clearly see that these boatmen all had greenish-white skin, and their eyes were dull, as if they had been dead for a very, very long time.
This was not a Yin soul. On the contrary, it was like a walking corpse that had lost its soul!
“Humph, how pretentious!” a Saint said coldly. He raised his hand and pressed down, and instantly, a large hand that was comparable to a planet appeared, blasting towards those small rafts.
The attack of a Saint was world-shaking!
However, just as this large hand was about to descend, a sword light flashed past, incredibly stunning, illuminating even the dark universe.
In the skies, that giant hand was suddenly severed into two halves, which fell from either side of the great river, yet did not touch the great river in the slightest.
Such a terrifying attack was dispersed just like that.
Hiss!

Everyone was stunned upon seeing this. The person who had attacked just then was a Saint. Even a Saint’s attack had been so easily blocked, so what cultivation level was the person who had moved just then?
It had to be a Saint!
Where did it come from?
This wasn’t a Yin soul!
Could it be that... aside from Yin souls, there were other kinds of strange existences?
All of a sudden, all the Saints looked like they were facing a great enemy.
Merely the Yin souls causing chaos was enough to give them a headache, and now a new enemy was going to appear?
“Yi!” A Saint’s expression suddenly changed drastically. He was from the Thousand Spirit Imperial Clan.
“Unbroken, what’s wrong?” a Saint beside him asked.
The Unbroken Saint took a deep breath, pointed at a small raft, and said, “The person on board... is a former Saint of our Thousand Spirit Imperial Clan that disappeared a very long time ago!”
“What!”
Though this was a conversation between the two of them, there were Saints all around them, so they naturally managed to easily hear the conversation between the two of them.
“Could it be that person?” A Saint suddenly recalled.
A Saint from the Thousand Spirit Imperial Clan suddenly disappeared, and only the Imperial Weapon flew back to the clan on its own, and this became a mystery for all eternity.

“In the past, this Saint of our clan had once brought the Imperial Weapon to the Dark Clouds Hell to investigate. However, not long after, the Imperial Weapon flew back to our clan on its own, and there was no more news of that Saint from then onwards,” the Unbroken Saint said slowly.

A great many years had already passed, so the blow rendered through the death of a Saint could not possibly shake the foundations of the Thousand Spirit Imperial Clan. Because a new Saint had already appeared, the Unbroken Saint did not mind revealing that secret from all those years ago.
That was something that had happened tens of millions of years ago, but how could it not be shocking that a former Saint had suddenly reappeared?
He also needed the Saints to give him some advice. What was going on here?
How could a Saint live for tens of millions of years? Then what the hell was this former Saint in front of him?
“Dark Clouds Hell!” All the Saints frowned deeply.

This was a land of desolation in the universe. Though it was also the sole source of Source Dao Stones, and had drawn the envy of who knew how many Imperial Clans, none of them dared to launch a large-scale assault.

Now, a river that belonged to the Dark Clouds Hell had suddenly appeared, and a predecessor that had been lost countless years ago had turned into a boatman. No matter how one thought about it, this would make one feel a chill run down their spine.
Just when these Saints were confused, the “boatmen” launched an attack.
Boom!

A terrifying attack was launched. These boatmen were either Saints or Venerate Tiers, and their abilities were too terrifying. In an instant, a hole was torn open in their ranks, and they penetrated deeply, attacking towards the eighteenth planet.
“Stop them!” All the Saints hurriedly shouted. Immediately, Saints revived the Imperial Weapons, and attacked those strange boatmen.

The awakening of the Imperial Weapon was equivalent to the revival of a Great Emperor. This battle prowess was naturally terrifying. With a single strike, those boatmen were like straws, scattering in all directions. They were completely outmatched.
When Saints encountered a Great Emperor, they could only flee upon hearing his arrival. If they clashed head-on, they would definitely die.
Instantly, a few boatmen were smashed into smithereens.
However, there was a strange force that sucked the shattered pieces of these boatmen into the great river. In just a short while, these boatmen emerged from the great river.
...They were complete, and had come back to life!
No, no, no. They should have died long ago. Thus, it was fine even if they were shattered. They just had to rebuild their bodies.
Seeing this scene, everyone’s scalps went numb.
