chapters.title: Chapter 4323: The sea of blood gives rise to might
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
This was too terrifying.

Countless Saint-level and Venerate-level elites joined the battle. This was already enough to give them a headache, and what was more terrifying was that these “things” were actually undying. That naturally caused them to lose all hope.
How were they supposed to continue fighting?
Even if you killed them 10,000 times, they could still be revived 10,000 times. They could not be killed completely at all.
“There’s no such thing as a problem with no solution in this world,” Ling Han said from below. “I believe that Yin River’s ‘revival’ ability is also limited.”
“But the problem is, even if it can only be ‘revived’ two to three times, this is enough to make one’s head hurt,” Ding Shu said with a frown.
That’s right. This was a huge problem. Furthermore, they did not know where the “revival” limit of the Yin River was. This made them feel uncertain, and would make them feel even more hopeless.
Boom!
In the universe, the fierce battle was still continuing.

The Saint that had awakened the Imperial Weapon unleashed a massacre. The Imperial Weapon showed its might, and there was no match for it at all. Groups of boatmen were destroyed, and the Yin River was like a river of life, endlessly reviving them.
However, there was a time limit to the awakening of the Imperial Weapon. Very quickly, that Saint couldn’t hold on any longer, and retreated to the side.
If he continued on, he would be sucked dry by the Imperial Weapon!
Thankfully, another Saint immediately took up the responsibility, and similarly revived the Imperial Weapon, sweeping aside all opposition.

However, the Yin soul army made a comeback, and there was also a Yin Saint that was similarly brandishing the Imperial Weapon, striking the heavens above and shattering the nine earths below. It was boundlessly terrifying.
Close combat had begun, and the situation had become incredibly dire.

This time, the Yin souls had reinforcements. The boatmen that had come out of the Yin River were too terrifying. They were all Saint-level and Venerate-level. With their combined forces, not only were they not inferior to the Living Realm’s side, they even looked like they were about to surpass them.
Thankfully, the Living Realm’s side had many Imperial Weapons, and under the continuous awakening, they were still able to stabilize the situation.
Boom, right at this moment, the Void split open, and a sea of blood appeared.
“F*ck!” Ling Han couldn’t help but curse.
No way!
Chi Menghan’s cherry mouth was also slightly agape, similarly extremely stunned.

She was no stranger to this sea of blood. At that time, three Saints had joined forces, bringing the Imperial Weapon into this sea of blood. In the end, there were endless Saint corpses in this sea of blood, and they were forcefully chased out.
Afterwards, a great many Imperial Clans joined forces, and barged in together with the Imperial Weapon, but it was also useless. In the end, they left in a sorry state.
Why was this sea of blood here to join in on the excitement at such a crucial moment?
Ling Han couldn’t help but think. Jiuhua Yin Saint had said that they were all chess pieces, and the only difference was that the Saint from the Living Realm was a chess piece that was ignorant.
To the Imperial Clans, this sea of blood was naturally not unfamiliar to them. All the Saints looked incredibly livid.
They were done for. If the corpses of the Saints in the sea of blood also joined the battle, and were to help the Yin souls at that, what else could they do but flee in disarray?
Fight with all their might?
It was indeed possible that the Yin souls would be blocked here, but most of the Saints here would probably die as well.
Just ask, how many Saints would have such great awareness, and be willing to sacrifice themselves?
The sea of blood boiled. Xiu, xiu, xiu! One after another, figures appeared and joined the battle, and the target of their attacks... was none other than the Saints from the Living Realm.
They were done for.
Seeing this scene, despair rose up from the bottom of everyone’s hearts.

The two lands of danger contained a great number of Saint corpses, and now these Saint corpses had actually all “revived” at the same time. They could even come back to life after being destroyed by the Imperial Weapon, so how were they supposed to withstand this invasion?
Everyone’s fighting spirit fell drastically, and even the Saints had no desire to continue fighting.

It could be clearly seen that the line of defense formed by the Saints and Venerate Tiers was rapidly crumbling, and a large number of Yin souls took advantage of the opening to charge out, charging towards the 33 planets.
As long as these planets were shattered, the formation would disperse on its own, and the Yin souls would be able to penetrate straight in.
At this moment, Ling Han actually felt a sliver of curiosity.

Yin souls all had the help of the sea of blood, the Saints and Venerate Tiers of the Yin River. When these elites attacked, even the combined forces of the Imperial Clans could only just barely resist. Then what was the point of ordinary Yin souls participating in the battle?

This great formation could only trap Sect Masters, at most. Venerates should be able to forcibly break through. Then, for the Netherworld army, their elites were enough to sweep aside all opposition in the world, so why would they still care about those mere pawns?
Previously, Jiuhua Yin Saint had already said that this was a game of chess. Then, ordinary Yin souls should be considered pawns, right? So, pawns also had the special effect of pawns?
“Little Han, we should retreat!” the large black dog shouted.

Ling Han nodded. It was indeed time to retreat. With the Netherworld coalition army charging over, the defense line formed by the Saints would fall sooner or later. Furthermore, these Saints had clearly lost their fighting spirit, so the rate at which the defense line crumbled would also be sped up.
“Retreat! Retreat!” The Saints also issued the command to retreat. By now, the Yin soul army was already unstoppable. If they fought a bloody battle here, it would only expend their power.
Instantly, the Transfer Formation flashed repeatedly, and everyone began a large retreat.
Ling Han also threw out the formation foundations. Wrapped in white light, they hurriedly retreated.
When they reappeared, they were already very, very far away from the Mountain Sea Heaven.

However, even at such a far distance, they could still see the great battle that was breaking out in the universe. Endless brilliance was flickering, and the aftermath of energy surged over, turning into a terrifying storm.
Boom!
In the sky, a ball of light suddenly exploded. It was extremely blinding, and one couldn’t even open their eyes.
“A planet has been obliterated!” Ling Han said darkly.
“Sigh!” Everyone sighed. The situation was really taking a sharp turn for the worse. Who would have thought that the Netherworld would have such powerful helpers?
One of the planets had been obliterated, and the formation was naturally destroyed. From now onwards, the Yin souls would be able to penetrate deeply, and no one would be able to stop them.
Ling Han grimaced. Why was it not peaceful wherever he went?

There was Hysteria in the Genesis World, wanting to devour all dimensions and destroy all life. He had initially thought that it would be quiet here, but after a few days of peace, the matter of Yin souls wreaking havoc actually appeared again.
It was absolutely impossible for living beings and Yin souls to coexist, so this was another unsolvable situation.
The so-called dark period in history was referring to the invasion of Yin souls?
Then, at this kind of moment, there should be a Great Emperor appearing to pacify the world.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

It was as if fireworks were being set off in the skies. Another planet exploded, releasing a brilliant light. There was an indescribable beauty about it, but everyone only felt a chill. The Yin soul coalition army was unstoppable. If they continued to wreak havoc like this, would there still be a place for living beings in this world?
Next, were they going to enter into an era of complete darkness?
Boom, boom, boom! Right now, only the sound of planets exploding could be heard. Everyone remained silent. No one was in the mood to speak.
“Hehe, you all still haven’t given up!” A voice suddenly rang out in everyone’s minds, and a young monk suddenly appeared in the skies.

He was called a young monk, because he was actually very, very young. He looked to be only 15 or 16 years old. However, his body wasn’t small at all. In fact, his bald head was the size of a whole planet.
The little monk moved, his left palm striking out at the sea of blood, while his right palm struck out at the Yin River. He actually wanted to snipe the two great monsters at the same time.

chapters.title: Chapter 4324: Second Life!
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Boom!

A terrifying scene appeared. The young monk struck out with both hands, and endless Regulations lit up, as if the whole universe had been lit up. The two palms struck, and the Yin River and the sea of blood were actually forced to retreat.
“Motherf*cker!”
“Holy f*ck!”
Everyone was dumbfounded. Meanwhile, a large number of Saints hadn’t retreated too far, and they all started to curse.
Was this little monk trying to defy the heavens?
How many corpses of Saints were there in the Yin River and the sea of blood? Though they were called “corpse”, they still possessed battle prowess on the level of Saints.
Thus, to force the sea of blood and the Yin River back with a single strike, just how terrifying was the power needed?
Could it be that a Great Emperor had already appeared in this universe?
But now that a new Emperor had appeared, how could there possibly be no news of it at all?
“Could it be Buddhist Land’s strongest Buddha Son?” someone asked in a trembling voice.

Buddhist Land was the same as various great Imperial Clans. There was Golden Generation and Silver Generation, and it was said that the Buddhist Son that belonged to Golden Generation had long since reached Sect Master Tier.
Yet now, he had actually become Emperor?
Was it really that exaggerated?
“No, this definitely isn’t that Buddha Son from the Buddhist Land,” a Saint said. He had seen that Buddha Son from the Buddhist Land before, and he was completely different from this young monk.
“This is far too astonishing. This young monk is genuinely only 15 or 16 years old. Such a young Great Emperor?” another Saint said.
“This little monk isn’t a Great Emperor yet, but his abilities have far surpassed that of a nine-star Saint,” the Saint from the Thousand Spirit Imperial Clan said.
“Could it be—”

“Pseudo-Emperor!” All the Saints exclaimed in shock. Indeed, upon closer observation, they discovered that this little monk was indeed not an Ancestral King; he was still slightly away from that, but a great deal stronger than a Saint.
Thus, there was only one possibility, and that was a Pseudo-Emperor.
The little monk was incredibly domineering, and after another few consecutive moves, he blasted the Yin River and the sea of blood into continuous retreat.
Countless Saints and Venerate Tier corpses charged out, but in front of a Pseudo-Emperor, they were not enough at all. With a single blwo, they were all blasted to smithereens.

So what if you could be revived by the Yin River and the sea of blood? A Pseudo-Emperor was not an Imperial Weapon, and did not need to be awakened. At any time, a Pseudo-Emperor could maintain a prime state.

“Six Buddhist Weapons!” the young monk exclaimed softly. He sent out a palm strike, and the Buddhist Staff, Skanda Staff, and the other Divine Weapons appeared behind him. They emitted golden light, and hong, blasted towards Yin River and the sea of blood.
Boom!
This was the ultimate move of a Pseudo-Emperor. With a single strike, the sea of blood and Yin River exploded.
“Doga, who would’ve thought? Not only did you not die, but you even managed to live a second life!” A booming voice reverberated through the Yin River.
It was clearly a sound, but like divine sense, it instantly spread to every corner of the universe, and everyone could hear it clearly.
Who... was this person?
There were only corpses in the Yin River. Though every single one of them had astonishing battle prowess, all of them were walking corpses. They had never seen any of them open their mouths to speak.

And now, someone in the Yin River spoke. This voice... just hearing it would cause one to feel chills all over their body, and reverence rise up from the depths of their hearts. It was as if that was a supreme being that they could only kneel on the ground and look up at it.
The master of the Yin River? The true master of the Dark Clouds Hell?
Hold on!
Doga? Buddha Doga?
After a moment of shock, everyone suddenly realized that the meaning behind these words was also incredibly frightening.
Was this little monk Buddha Doga? No, no, no, not the Buddha Doga from hundreds of millions of years ago, but his second incarnation!
In the past, Buddha Doga was only left with a sheet of skin. Could it be that it was an old sheet of skin that he had shed, while his physical body had lived a second life?
Heavens, living a second life, what kind of shocking news was this?
Ling Han was also taken aback. This young monk with delicate features was actually Buddha Doga? That Buddha Doga that had killed countless Saints in the Black Heaven Divine Temple?
He gritted his teeth. He really needed some time to digest this.
“You should have returned to dust long ago. What are you waiting for?” the small monk asked calmly.
Since he didn’t retort, it meant that he really was the Buddha Doga that had lived a second life.
“Humph, at our level, what we pursue is nothing more than eternal life,” the person in the Yin River said. “Doga, don’t meddle in other people’s business. Otherwise, I will end your life here!”

However, Buddha Doga’s expression was calm as he said, “Those who defy the heavens will ultimately suffer a divine punishment. What’s the point of you hiding in the Yin River and struggling at death’s door? Moreover, you can give it a try. Will you kill me, or will I kill you?”
When he said the last words, he suddenly exploded with a baleful killing intent that was indescribably terrifying.
So what if they were Saints? They all humphed, their expressions extremely pained.

This was a Pseudo-Emperor. Beneath the Black Heaven Divine Temple, who knew how many Saints had been captured by this Lord, and tortured to death. Now, he had lived a second life, and his battle prowess had probably risen instead of decreasing. Suppressing Saints was really child’s play.
In this world, the new Ancestral King had yet to appear, so the Buddha Doga was the strongest existence. There was no other that could compare!

“Gagaga!” A strange laugh rang out from the Yin River. “Doga, you are too arrogant! However, for the sake of your Senior Brother, I will not drop down to your level this time. In any case, there is still a little bit of time left.”
Boom, the Void shattered, and the Yin River instantly retreated, sinking completely into the Void. Then, the Void closed, and the Yin River was no longer seen, as if it had never existed.
No sound was heard from within the sea of blood, but it had also entered into the Void.
The two super threats were resolved by Buddha Doga alone.
With the departure of these two powerful reinforcements, the Yin soul army no longer wreaked havoc, and immediately retreated, returning to the Mountain Sea Heaven.
Buddha Doga stood proudly in the universe. That massive figure seemed to be able to illuminate the entire universe, and everyone in the surrounding galaxy could see it clearly.

“Greetings, Lord Doga!” A Saint stepped forward, and his manifested body was also millions and millions of meters tall. He tried to get closer, “I am the Golden Cauldron Imperial Clan’s Rainbow Saint Light Saint. Lord Doga, do you have time to pay a visit to our humble Clan?”
This was a Pseudo-Emperor, an awesome character who already had one foot into Emperor Tier. He was definitely an ultimate VIP.
Pa!
Buddha Doga sent out a palm strike, and the Rainbow Light Saint was instantly sent flying.
Seeing this scene, everyone gritted their teeth.

That was a Saint, an existence that was close to invincible in this world. He was practically standing at the peak of martial arts. Furthermore, the Rainbow Light Saint was a Saint of the Imperial Clans, and held the Imperial Weapon in his hand.
Was this... really appropriate?
Buddha Doga humphed coldly, and said, “I hate people like you the most. Stop trying to worm your way into being friends with me!”

In the distance, the Rainbow Light Saint had already stood still. An incredibly clear palm print had appeared on his face. He was in an incredibly awkward situation. He had taken the initiative to approach, yet he had actually been slapped?
How humiliating.

Weng, he activated the Imperial Weapon at the first instant, and said harshly, “Doga, even when the Ancestral King appears, he is still incredibly polite towards the Imperial Clans. You are merely a Pseudo-Emperor, and you actually dare to hit me?”
Buddha Doga glanced at him coldly, and said, “If you continue to make noise, I’ll kill you!”
How domineering!
Ling Han couldn’t help but sigh with emotion. This mighty figure from the ancient times was still as awesome as always.
In the past, he had imprisoned and tortured Saints, allowing them to experience the calamity of hell. And now? He had casually slapped a Saint from an Imperial Clan.
That was how a true man should be!

chapters.title: Chapter 4325: Temporarily quelling the chaos
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Faced with the domineering attitude of Doga, the Rainbow Light Saint hesitated slightly.

Being slapped in full public, he naturally wanted to get his pride back, but the problem here was this was a Pseudo-Emperor in front of him, a god of death that had committed boundless sins in the ancient times.
If he couldn’t pacify him, what if he was killed by the other party?

—A Saint and the Imperial Weapon were still unable to deal with a Pseudo-Emperor, so it would be useless even if he died. Who would be able to avenge him? Moreover, if the Pseudo-Emperor wanted to flee, would the Saint be able to catch up with him with the Imperial Weapon?
Unless a deadly trap was set up, and dozens of Saints carried the Imperial Weapons to ambush and kill, it would be impossible to stop a Pseudo-Emperor who wanted to leave.
But to have the Saints of the other Imperial Clans join forces with him, how could that be possible?
Who would be willing to take such a risk?
The Rainbow Light Saint hesitated for a moment before finally calming down the Imperial Weapon and forcefully suppressing his anger.
Er, being outmatched by a Pseudo-Emperor, it should be understandable.
Buddha Doga looked around, and no one dared to make eye contact with him.
This was a Pseudo-Emperor. With the word ‘Emperor’, it was equivalent to being invincible.
After sweeping a glance over them, Buddha Doga turned his gaze to Ling Han.

With a single step, Buddha Doga appeared in front of Ling Han. His colossal figure also returned to his normal form, like an ordinary little monk. However, there was a Buddha Halo at the back of his head that was exuding golden light, making him appear incredibly sacred.
Ling Han didn’t dare to think that this person was a benevolent person. He was someone who could create hell for Saints at the slightest provocation. How could he not be vicious and merciless?
His heart clenched, but he did not panic too much.
If Buddha Doga wanted to kill him, he could have done so in the Black Heaven Divine Temple. He wouldn’t have needed to wait until now.
“Young people grow up very quickly,” Buddha Doga said with a nod. However, he looked like a little monk at this moment, so speaking in this manner naturally made him appear old and experienced.
In front of this person, even the little azure dragon and the large black dog didn’t dare to speak cheekily. They obediently stood on the sidelines.
Ling Han smiled and said, “Thank you for your praise, Senior.”
“I’ve often heard about you,” Buddha Doga said. “Interesting.”
Ling Han was slightly flattered. A Pseudo-Emperor would actually pay attention to him. This was really unexpected.
“I will continue to work hard,” he said.

Buddha Doga couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself. He nodded and didn’t say anything else. He took another step, and a golden path appeared. With a single step, he instantly disappeared into the boundless distance.
The power of a Pseudo-Emperor was indescribably mysterious.
All of a sudden, a great many Saints’ eyes were focused on Ling Han.

Previously, a Saint had stepped forward to strike up a conversation with him, and Buddha Doga had directly sent him flying with a slap. However, he had taken the initiative to talk to a junior just now, and it seemed like they were having a great conversation at that. How could everyone not be surprised?
But why was this person Ling Han?
Now, Ling Han had become a thorn in the side of the Imperial Clans. A great many Imperial Clans wanted to get rid of him, yet Buddha Doga actually concerned himself with Ling Han.
Though he had only said a few words just now, and they could not be sure that Buddha Doga admired Ling Han very much, but what if?
What if they killed Ling Han and made Buddha Doga unhappy?

If it was the Nine Mountains Saint added with the Imperial Weapon, the various great Imperial Clans could at least hold on. Worse come to worst, they could hold on until the Nine Mountains Saint died. They refused to believe that the Nine Suns Holy Land would be able to nurture another Saint in a short amount of time.
—This required background and great fortune.
However, in the case of Pseudo-Emperor, sigh, these Imperial Clan elites shook their heads. They could not afford to trifle with him, not even the slightest bit.
The awakening of the Imperial Weapon could probably intimidate him for a while, but would they be able to maintain this state forever?
Was it so difficult to kill a measly True Self Tier cultivator?
When they saw Ling Han, these Imperial Clan Saints all felt sullen. Now, Ling Han was equivalent to having double insurance, so how were they supposed to make a move!
Even the Battle God Palace had to consider carefully. If they angeredBudha Doga, perhaps this force that had hidden for millions and millions of years would be razed to the ground.

Ling Han, on the other hand, did not think that Buddha Doga was deliberately taking care of him. This kind of elite should only have the goal of becoming Emperor in his eyes. It was purely because he thought that Ling Han was good at causing trouble, so he had deliberately come to praise him.

Right now, the Yin souls of the Mountain Sea Heaven had been suppressed, meaning that they wouldn’t come out to cause trouble for the time being. Thus, this place would be refurbished, with Saints taking turns to stand guard. Meanwhile, the others returned to do whatever they were doing.
However, there was a sword hanging over everyone’s hearts.

There should be two incomparably terrifying beings in the Yin River and the sea of blood. Perhaps, they were also Pseudo-Emperors. Otherwise, with how domineering Buddha Doga was, he couldn’t possibly watch them retreat helplessly.
Right now, they had been chased off by Buddha Doga. However, this didn’t mean that they would never return.
On the other hand, the reason why they had compromised was because they felt that the “time” had not arrived yet.
No one knew what this time was referring to, but the danger would make a comeback. This should be a sure bet.
At that time, the two Pseudo-Emperors would make a comeback with troops of Yin souls and the dead. Morevoer, they would even move personally. Just how terrifying was that?
Moreover, there were already three Pseudo-Emperors now, so how could those of the Golden Generation and Silver Generation not be burning with anxiety?
The path to becoming Emperor had opened, and these three had even set one foot on the finishing line, but they were still at the starting line. How were they supposed to compete!
The tournament had not even begun, and the results had already been announced. Who would be willing to accept this?
After returning to the Ancestral King Academy, the atmosphere of cultivation suddenly became extremely tense.
Since the three Pseudo-Emperors had not taken that last step, it meant that everyone still had a chance.

Furthermore, from the conversation between Buddha Doga and the Master of the Yin River, they should both be antiques, and had only managed to live to this era through special means. Thus, even if they were Pseudo-Emperors, they would definitely face even more difficulties in becoming Emperor.
Thus, though everyone was temporarily lagging behind, and furthermore, they were not just a little bit behind, there was still a sliver of hope that they could become Emperor.
On this path, there was no such thing as first come, first served. There was no such thing as fairness or injustice. There was only hard work, and they could only forge onwards bravely.

What did it matter that they would be bleeding and battered? What did it matter that they had failed in the end? Only by putting in the effort would they be able to live without regrets, and have no regrets of living this life.

“By the looks of it now, the two from the Yin River and sea of blood should both be Pseudo-Emperors as well. Causing so much trouble, their purpose must be for the sake of becoming Emperor,” the large black dog deduced.
It was only a Pseudo-Emperor that could kill so many Saints. Just look at Buddha Doga, and it was clear just how many Saints had been captured and experimented on by him.

“It’s extremely likely that they’re losers from the Imperial Path millions and millions of years ago. However, through some special method, they managed to struggle at death’s door and live to this era.” The little azure dragon also said, “Just like Buddha Doga, who lived a second life and wants to continue contesting for the throne.”
“Sigh, with such an opponent, the pressure is so great,” Ding Shu exclaimed ruefully.
Meanwhile, Ling Han glanced at him, saying, “You’ve lost, so hurry up and acknowledge me as the boss!”
“Pei, as long as I don’t break through to the Spiritual Transformation Tier, this bet will never end.” Ding Shu hurriedly broke into a run, to avoid being mocked by Ling Han again.

chapters.title: Chapter 4326: Enlightenment
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Right now, the Ancestral King Academy appeared especially calm. Everyone was working hard on their cultivation.
Ling Han went to check on the empress and Hu Niu. They had both reached the end of the Core Formation Tier, and could now attempt to break through to the True Self Tier.

However, the advancement of the little red bird’s cultivation level was astonishing, because she was the first to advance into the True Self Tier. When she saw Ling Han, she instantly became aggressive, wanting to duel with him and turn the tables in their relations.
Ling Han directly grabbed the little azure dragon, letting this pair of enemies fight.

Though the little red bird was extraordinary, its cultivation level was not as high as the little azure dragon’s. Furthermore, the little azure dragon was also a Body Arts user, so its power was even more violent. Even if the little red bird’s flames could burn Four Star Divine Metal, against the little azure dragon’s physique, that was still somewhat difficult, and its flames could not burn through it at the first instant.
In the end, the little red bird was ruthlessly beaten, and obediently continued to follow Ling Han.

Looking at the little red bird whose feathers were all disheveled, Ling Han sighed, and said to the little azure dragon, “You don’t know how to have tender feelings for the fairer sex at all. You won’t be able to find a girlfriend like this.”
“Why would Grandpa Dragon want a girlfriend?” the little azure dragon asked directly.
“When you grow up, it’ll be too late for regrets.”

The little azure dragon was still in the form of a four-legged snake, and the growth of the Dragon Race was slow in the first place. It would need at least ten thousand years to be considered mature. Thus, even though this guy’s cultivation level increased very quickly, his mind was still like a child’s.
“I curse that you won’t be able to get a wife for the rest of your life!” Meanwhile, the little red bird poked a straw doll1. It hated the little azure dragon to the core.
Sure enough, they were truly a quarrelsome but loving couple.

However, after returning to the Ancestral King Academy, although there was still a large amount of cultivation resources provided, the rate of advancement of cultivation level was completely incomparable to refining the Source Dao Stone, or killing a Yin soul to obtain a reward from heaven and earth.
After three months, Ling Han had only cultivated the eighth True Self to the tenth form. He was only one True Self away from being able to completely cultivate the entire True Self Tier.
“I still need about three months.” Ling Han sighed.

Under the stimulation of the supreme elites the likes of Buddha Doga and the others, every single one of them was cultivating with all their might, trying to rush their cultivation level as soon as possible.
For example, the Silver Generation had all advanced into the Spiritual Transformation Tier, and the well-known ones had already become Sect Master elites, qualified to be called great elites.
The Golden Generation was even more incredible. It was said that two of them already had one foot into Venerate Tier, and the day they became Venerates could possibly be within two to three years.
It could not be helped. Those walking at the forefront of the Imperial Path were already Pseudo-Emperors. If they still did not rush, even if they were supremely talented, so what?
There could only be one Emperor in a single era!

Ling Han first stopped cultivating. Only by striking a balance between work and rest, would he be able to maintain the continuous improvement of his cultivation level. Otherwise, it was possible that he would not be able to reach it even if he tried his best.
He left, planning to walk around in the academy to change his mood.

The Ancestral King Academy was very large. If he did not use his movement technique, and just walked slowly step by step, it would take him at least half a year to complete a full circle, and if he wanted to tour every corner, that would be need even more time than that.

Ling Han was in no hurry. He merely admired the mountains and waters, and his next step was to break through to Spiritual Transformation Tier. Naturally, he needed to comprehend the Dao of Heaven and Earth, and where was the Dao of Heaven and Earth?
It was in the environment.

When he walked to the side of a lake, he saw the rippling waves, and when the sunlight danced wildly on the surface of the lake like golden snakes, he suddenly felt something. He sat down in a cross-legged position, and endless enlightenment dawned on him.
Boom! Energy from heaven and earth surged over, and in his mind, the ninth True Self was actually rapidly advancing towards the Tenth Form.
Enlightenment!
If anyone saw this, they would definitely be incredibly envious, jealous, and hateful.
Others may not even be able to get a chance of enlightenment in their lifetime, but what about Ling Han?
Being able to gain enlightenment while taking a stroll, what could be more infuriating than that?

One day, two days, three days. Ling Han sat as still as a rock, and the nine-coloured light exuded by the ninth True Self In his mind was also becoming dimmer and dimmer. This naturally was not a bad thing, but rather a great thing. It meant that he was rapidly advancing towards the tenth form.
Enlightenment was the most awesome. It was like heaven and earth had given you a cheat code. It wouldn’t be strange for someone to even advance three minor levels of cultivation level.

However, Ling Han had truly experienced enlightenment too many times, so it wasn’t as exaggerated as this. However, as long as he could quickly cultivate to the tenth form, he would have profited greatly.

“Yi, isn’t that Ling Han?” On the fourth day, two people passed by. They were both enchanting young men, and one of them holding a leash attached to a fierce beast in hand. That was a blood-coloured fierce tiger, its wild nature still present, its eyes shining fiercely.

These were two Imperial Sons of the Silver Generation. One was Xu Youque of the White Feather Imperial Clan, and the other was the Kong Wuyang of the Peacock Imperial Clan. It was him who was had the leash on that fierce beast, the great tiger.
“This guy is actually still in the mood to sit idly by the lake?” Xu Youque appeared slightly surprised.
What time was it now?
Even the Golden Generation cultivated diligently, trying to catch up to the likes of Buddha Doga and the others. However, what about Ling Han?
‘Have you given up on becoming Emperor?’
“No, can you sense the power of heaven and earth?” Kong Wuyang was startled, then asked Xu Youque solemnly.

“The energy of heaven and earth is flowing towards him, and the Regulations have also been captured.” After Xu Youque sensed for a moment, he immediately looked surprised, “Hiss, this speed is too astonishing. Could it be that he has broken through?”
“Who do you think would break through in public?” Kong Wuyang countered.
Xu Youque instantly came to a realization. “He experienced enlightenment.”
Both of them looked extremely jealous. Enlightenment! This was a once in a lifetime opportunity for every cultivator.
Even if they were Silver Generation elites, and had indeed experienced enlightenment before, they had only experienced enlightenment once or twice in total.
Thus, they naturally knew just how beneficial enlightenment could be.
—The bottleneck in cultivating was nonexistent in the face of enlightenment.
“We can’t let this brat succeed!” Kong Wuyang suddenly said.
Xu Youque frowned, and said, “This is the Academy. If we publicly harass him, it will be very difficult for us to escape cleanly.”
This was mainly because Ling Han had the support of a Saint who wielded an Imperial Weapon. In fact, there was even a Pseudo-Emperor behind him, so they didn’t dare to provoke Ling Han.

“Hehe, I came out to walk around with the cat, and accidentally caused the cat to alert him. You can’t blame me for that, right?” Kong Wuyang smiled, “After all, who asked him not to be in his own room?”
“Wonderful!” Xu Youque instantly clapped his hands.
Kong Youyang undid the chains on the Blood Tiger, allowing it to move freely.

This was a ferocious beast. The moment it regained its freedom, it immediately growled at Xu Youque and Kong Wuyang, as if it wanted to attack them. However, Kong Wuyang’s eyes only sharpened, and this ferocious beast was so frightened that it fled with its tail between its legs.
—It was only a True Self Tier cultivator, so how could it possibly be a match for a Spiritual Transformation Tier cultivator?
Vicious beasts may not have developed intelligence, but it did not mean that they were as stupid as pigs. Avoiding elites was the instinct of living beings.
However, this fierce beast had only taken two steps when it spotted Ling Han, and instantly, its viciousness increased again.

It snuck forwards, slowly advancing towards Ling Han. Only when it was extremely close, did it suddenly launch an attack. With a xiu, it darted out, opened its eerie bloody mouth, and bit out at Ling Han’s neck.

You can’t blame me for that, right?” Kong Wuyang smiled, “After all, who asked him not to be in his own room?”
“Wonderful!” Xu Youque instantly clapped his hands.
Kong Youyang undid the chains on the Blood Tiger, allowing it to move freely.
This was a ferocious beast.
The moment it regained its freedom, it immediately growled at Xu Youque and Kong Wuyang, as if it wanted to attack them.
However, Kong Wuyang’s eyes only sharpened, and this ferocious beast was so frightened that it fled with its tail between its legs.
—It was only a True Self Tier cultivator, so how could it possibly be a match for a Spiritual Transformation Tier cultivator?
Vicious beasts may not have developed intelligence, but it did not mean that they were as stupid as pigs.
Avoiding elites was the instinct of living beings.
However, this fierce beast had only taken two steps when it spotted Ling Han, and instantly, its viciousness increased again.
It snuck forwards, slowly advancing towards Ling Han.
Only when it was extremely close, did it suddenly launch an attack.
With a xiu, it darted out, opened its eerie bloody mouth, and bit out at Ling Han’s neck.

chapters.title: Chapter 4327: Going too far
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Seeing this scene, both Kong Wuyang and Xu Youque smirked coldly.

If the blood tiger succeeded, then even if Ling Han didn’t die, he would be crippled. If it didn’t, then Ling Han’s enlightenment would definitely be interrupted. Whichever the result was, they would be happy to see it.
Moreover, this was indeed somewhat related to them. However, they had been walking a cat, so it was impossible for them to keep a constant eye on the cat, right?

Moreover, if you wanted to cultivate, you should have stayed inside your room. Who could you blame for running outside to cultivate? Moreover, you are also a True Self Tier, and being wounded by a True Self Tier fierce beast, that is also because you yourself are not strong enough, right?
No matter how one looked at it, more of the responsibility laid wiht Ling Han. As for them? Hehe, they had only made a small mistake.
Chila, the blood tiger bit down solidly.
It was done!
Kong Wuyang and Xu Que were both overjoyed. They had not thought that such a difficult person like Ling Han would actually die in the mouth of a wild beast.
It was too easy, practically as easy as blowing off dust.
Yi?
However, they were soon stunned, because Ling Han was still sitting there completely unscathed. The scene of his neck being bitten off did not appear.
F***, what kind of neck do you have?
“Is it Divine Metal?”

Even if it was Divine Metal, with the sharp fangs of fierce beasts, it would still be able to cause considerable damage to Divine Metals of the same level. Otherwise, with fierce beasts being unable to use celestial techniques, how could they possibly pose a great threat to cultivators?
The blood tiger was also taken aback. With its limited intelligence, it felt that this was extremely strange.
It refused to give up. Crackle! It bit down again.
It was still useless. On the contrary, the impact caused its teeth to hurt.
What was going on?
Right at this moment, it felt the prey it was biting move. It stood up, and a terrifying aura instantly surged out, making it instinctively feel fear.
That was a kind of... fear towards a supreme great beast.
“Wu!” The blood tiger hurriedly loosened its jaws, and retreated repeatedly, its tail clamped between its legs.
“How disappointing, it didn’t bite him to death!” Xu Youque said harshly.

“He’s the number one elite of the True Self Tier, after all. If he were so easily bitten to death, he wouldn’t deserve the name of number one,” Kong Wuyang said calmly. “However, his enlightenment has also been interrupted. We’ve reached our goal.”
“True,” Xu Youque said with a nod. A smile tugged at the corners of his lips.
But why didn’t they think about why Ling Han hadn’t stood up previously?
That was because he had already completed his appreciation. In his mind, the ninth true self was also like a mortal body, not showing any brilliance, and looking very ordinary.
“Come, let’s go provoke him,” Kong Wuyang said with a smile.
“All right.” Xu Youque’s interest was instantly piqued.
The two of them walked side by side, heading towards Ling Han.

“Aiyo, I’m really sorry,” Kong Wuyang said. “I was walking around with the cat. I just let it walk around on its own. I didn’t expect its wild nature to be so hard to tame, and it actually disturbed Junior Brother Ling. Oh, right, why is Junior Brother Ling cultivating here?”
“You weren’t affected, were you?” Xu Youque asked pretentiously.
Ling Han glanced at the two of them, and said calmly, “If I was affected, how do you plan on compensating?”

“Compensation?” Kong Wuyang laughed loudly, “I was only slightly negligent, yet you’re already putting on airs? Hehe, why aren’t you cultivating in your room? Why have you come here? And you still want compensation? What a huge joke!”
“No compensation?” Ling Han also smiled.

Kong Wuyang issued a command through his divine sense, commanding the blood tiger to continue attacking Ling Han. Under his training, though this ferocious beast’s wild nature was still hard to calm, it was still very willing to obey the command to attack.
Even if it knew that Ling Han was powerful, the blood tiger was even more aware of its master’s might. This was a Spiritual Transformation Tier elite that had subdued it completely.
Thus, after receiving the command, the blood tiger practically did not hesitate at all. With a leap, it bit out at Ling Han.
Peng!
Ling Han didn’t even turn his head. With a single punch, this blood tiger was forcefully killed.
“You actually dared to beat my beast pet to death!” Kong Wuyang immediately said coldly, “I spent a lot of effort to buy this, so how are you going to compensate me?”
‘Hehe, I’m going to make you suffer a great loss, and you would still have to humbly offer your apologies!’
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself, “You allow wild beasts to injure others, and still want me to compensate you?”
“Firstly, don’t spout nonsense. Secondly, so what if I bully you?” Kong Wuyang’s expression was filled with pride, “Could it be that you want to use force against me?”
He was a Spiritual Transformation Tier elite!

Spirit Transformation Tier, as well as aptitude as one of the Silver Generation, allowed his battle prowess to sweep aside ordinary Spirit Transformation Tiers. His battle prowess could easily defeat Spirit Transformation Tier Second Change or even Third Change, so wouldn’t it be easy to deal with a True Self Tier?
He was deliberately trying to anger Ling Han, so that Ling Han would take the initiative to attack him. Then, even if he severely injured Ling Han, no one would be able to say anything.

In the martial arts world, the hierarchy of status was maintained. If a lower cultivation level cultivator actively attacked a higher cultivation level cultivator, then it would already be considered merciful if they weren’t killed.

“Ling Han, don’t be rash. You are nothing but a True Self Tier.” Xu Youque deliberately tried to mediate, but every word was stoking the flames of anger. “Moreover, it was indeed you who had beaten Brother Kong’s beast pet to death. Logically speaking, you should apologize to Brother Kong.”
Ling Han smiled and said, “You two think I’m at the True Self Tier, so you can humiliate me as you please, right?”
“So what if I am? Come bite me?” Kong Wuyang said proudly. His appearance was really a little despicable.
“All right, I’ll oblige you!” Ling Han leaped out, and charged towards Kong Wuyang.

Kong Wuyang was not shocked, but rather overjoyed. Haha, you were the one who took the initiative to attack. He had already recorded this. At that time, he would only have to erase the previous content, and directly broadcast the scene of Ling Han taking the initiative to attack. There was irrefutable evidence. Who would be able to speak up for Ling Han?
You definitely have to swallow this loss in silence!
“How dare you!” he shouted loudly, and delivered a palm strike at Ling Han.

Of course, he still didn’t dare to kill Ling Han. He had only used one percent of his power in this palm strike, but for a Spirit Transformation Tier, one percent of his power was enough to severely wound the Eighth Form of the True Self Tier.
Ling Han was unafraid, and greeted the incoming attack with a punch.
Peng!
The two of them exchanged a blow, and the scene of Kong Wuyang and Xu Youque’s eyes popping out in shock appeared.
Ling Han blocked it!
Not only had he blocked it, but he had even forced Kong Wuyang to retreat continuously.
W-what was going on?
Kong Wuyang and Xu Youque were both numb with shock.
You are only a True Self Tier!
Hold on, did this guy break through at some time?
The two of them observed closely, sensing the aura that Ling Han was exuding.
True Self Tier, definitely the True Self Tier.
Then... this was terrifying.
A True Self Tier cultivator was actually capable of competing with a Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator in power, and had even won?
What kind of monster was this!
Ling Han didn’t give the two of them any time to ponder. He immediately charged over again.
Boom!
Kong Wuyang hurriedly counterattacked. This time, he naturally went all out; he did not want to be forced back again. Right now, his chest was still slightly burning.
In this exchange of blows, both of them took a few steps back, and it was actually a tie.
‘Holy f*ck!’
Kong Wuyang and Xu Youque both wanted to curse the heavens. Was this real?
A measly True Self Tier cultivator could actually fight a SpiritTransformation Tier cultivator head-on. Moreover, it was an Imperial Son, and even a Silver Generation cultivator at that!

chapters.title: Chapter 4328: Slapped instead
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
This should be a completely impossible feat.
However, the truth was right in front of their eyes, so how could they deny it?
Monster, he was definitely a monster.
Kong Wuyang was in a very passive position. He was presently in an incredibly stunned state, and being bombarded madly by Ling Han, he could only parry.
However, his strength was ultimately not inferior to Ling Han. Very soon, he had adjusted his condition, and immediately turned the situation around.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The two of them continued to exchange blows. Energy fluctuations spread into the distance.
Kong Wuyang couldn’t help but feel anxious. If the scene of him and Ling Han fighting forcefully was seen by others, what face would he have left?
Would he become the first Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator in history to tie with a True Self Tier?
If he were to be recorded in the history books in this manner, his name would stink for all eternity.
He roared loudly, and his spiritual body walked out of his body. Both himself and his spiritual body used the Imperial Technique at the same time, which blasted madly towards Ling Han.

The Imperial Technique was indeed awesome. Furthermore, the higher the cultivation level, the greater the gap between the Imperial Technique and the Saint Technique, and the ordinary celestial technique. This had increased his battle prowess by a whole twelve Heavens!
Furthermore, this was the simultaneous upgrade of oneself and one’s spiritual body, so how terrifying was it?
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t be reserved either. He similarly used the Imperial Technique. The heavenly saber was fierce, and his battle prowess was similarly shocking.
However, he wasn’t a Spirit Transformation Tier elite, after all, so it was impossible for him to manifest a spiritual body. Thus, he was naturally at a disadvantage.

It was a one-on-two battle, and both “enemies” possessed strength that was not inferior to his own, so Ling Han appeared to be slightly strained. However, he had already taken the preliminary step of creating his own path, and every casual move he made was an amazing move, forcibly holding up the situation.
It was hard to determine the victor!
Xu Youque could only gape in shock upon seeing this. There was actually such a powerful True Self Tier in this world?
Had he seen wrongly?
Was he dreaming?
Heavens!
Sensing the great commotion here, people soon ran over to investigate the situation. When they discovered that a battle had broken out, they naturally did not mind watching the excitement.
But when they saw clearly that Kong Wuyang’s opponent was Ling Han, everyone felt as if their heads were about to explode.
“That, is that really Ling Han?”
“I didn’t see wrongly, right?”
“Hiss!”
“...Ling Han is actually battling with a Spirit Transformation Tier!”

Kong Wuyang was a Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator. This news had already spread throughout the entire academy. Moreover, even if one hadn’t received the news, he could easily confirm this fact just by looking at the spiritual body that he had summoned.
“... Ling Han should have also advanced into Spirit Transformation Tier, right?”

“That’s right. He has long since reached the Seventh Form. Furthermore, he has cultivated a mortal body, so it is impossible for him to break through to the Eighth Form. Thus, it would be very normal for him to break through to the Spirit Transformation Tier.”

Everyone thought the opposite way around. It should be Ling Han who was more low-key, and did not make any big boasts about breaking through to Spirit Transformation Tier. After all, there were really quite a number of people who had broken through to the Spirit Transformation Tier in this period of time in the Academy.
“That’s not right!” Immediately, someone said in a trembling voice, “You guys sense again. Is the aura that Ling Han is exuding really Spirit Transformation Tier?”
Everyone sensed it, and then, all of them revealed expressions of extreme shock.
The True Self Tier!
‘F*ck! He’s actually at the True Self Tier!’
How was this possible?
Everyone inhaled sharply. They were all deeply stunned, and could not say a single word.
So what if it was the Golden Generation?
Had they ever reached such heights when they were in the True Self Tier? Capable of standing against a Spirit Transformation Tier?

Was this guy really only capable of tailing the Golden Generation? Or had he already reached the level of being one of the most outstanding members of the Golden Generation? In fact, he had even surpassed them?
Now, the only feeling that everyone had left was shock.

Kong Wuyang became more and more anxious. There were too many people watching. If he was still so sloppy, and was still unable to deal with Ling Han after so long, how would he be able to face others in the future?
However, he had already used the Imperial Technique, so how was he supposed to further increase his battle prowess?
Burning Imperial Blood?
What a joke. The Imperial Blood was the trump card of trump cards, so how could it be used casually? Furthermore, even if he won with the Imperial Blood, how could he convince the masses?
However, without using the Imperial Blood, Kong Wuyang would really be unable to suppress Ling Han.
Could it be that it was going to end in a draw?
Ling Han humphed, and his attacks became incredibly powerful. Every move he made looked like he wanted to drag Kong Wuyang down with him.
Kong Wuyang naturally didn’t want to die with Ling Han, so he could only choose to retreat. This caused him to instantly fall into a disadvantage.
Everyone was even more stunned, shaking their heads and sighing.
Ling Han was really too strong. This True Self Tier was going to defy the heavens.
The more Kong Wuyang fought, the more displeased he felt. He could not accept such a result.
He was a dignified Spirit Transformation Tier and Silver Generation elite; he definitely couldn’t lose!
Fine, do you think I don’t dare to fight you head-on?
Kong Wuyang no longer dodged. Instead, he looked like he was going to take Ling Han head-on.
Scare me? Humph, could it be that you would not be afraid of both sides being wounded?
Boom!
However, he had guessed wrongly. Faced with an attack that looked like he was going to drag Ling Han down with him, Ling Han did not dodge at all, and directly charged towards him.
‘F*ck!’
At this moment, Kong Wuyang was dumbfounded. At least a few thousand curse words raced through his mind.
‘Why do you f*cking want to drag me down with you?’
If I had known this earlier, I would rather be humiliated than do this!
However, it was already too late for regrets now. Both of their attacks had landed on each other.
Kong Wuyang was instantly sent flying. All the bones in his body were broken, and he opened his mouth, spitting out blood.
After sustaining such a heavy injury, the spiritual body immediately dissipated.
Thankfully, he had not died. Furthermore, he did not seem to have suffered any fatal or crippling injuries. He only had to rest for a few months, and he would be able to recover completely.
He relaxed slightly, but when he looked at Ling Han again, he instantly couldn’t help but throw up blood madly.
He looked as if nothing had happened. In other words, he was completely unscathed.
You should be called Ling Wuyang, right1?
He tragically discovered that Ling Han was perfectly fine. To say nothing of being severely injured and throwing up blood, not even a single hair of his was missing.

No wonder this guy kept looking like he was going to fight him to the death. It wasn’t that the other party wanted to scare him with this kind of attitude, but rather that this guy’s defense was practically freakish.
He felt so wronged!
To actually fight a guy with freakish defense to the death, wasn’t that just courting death?
“Pu!” He spat out blood continuously, feeling extremely depressed.

Ling Han smiled faintly. He had cultivated Body Art, so how strong was his physique? Moreover, he could automatically disperse all attacks within six Heavens, and it was enough as long as he retained a little power to form a shield.
Wasn’t it a joke to fight him to the death?
Ling Han actually won?

The fact that a True Self Tier cultivator could fight a Spirit Transformation Tier head-on, and a Silver Generation Imperial Son at that, was already enough to make one’s scalp go numb, all right? But Ling Han actually won, and this was even more inconceivable.
Ling Han looked at Xu Youque and said, “Do you also want to seek justice from me?”
Xu Youque’s strength was no weaker than Kong Wuyang’s, but after seeing Ling Han’s strength and freakishness, what confidence did he still have?
Without saying a word, he turned around and left.
Ling Han didn’t give chase. This was the academy, after all, and it was established by the Imperial Clans. No matter what, he had to restrain himself.

He smiled, turned and left as well. The enlightenment this time directly allowed him to reach the consummate level of the True Self Tier, and he could now attempt to break through to the Spirit Transformation Tier.
— New chapter is coming soon —

Now, the only feeling that everyone had left was shock.
Kong Wuyang became more and more anxious.
There were too many people watching.
If he was still so sloppy, and was still unable to deal with Ling Han after so long, how would he be able to face others in the future?
However, he had already used the Imperial Technique, so how was he supposed to further increase his battle prowess?
Burning Imperial Blood?
What a joke.
The Imperial Blood was the trump card of trump cards, so how could it be used casually?
Furthermore, even if he won with the Imperial Blood, how could he convince the masses?
However, without using the Imperial Blood, Kong Wuyang would really be unable to suppress Ling Han.
Could it be that it was going to end in a draw?
Ling Han humphed, and his attacks became incredibly powerful.
Every move he made looked like he wanted to drag Kong Wuyang down with him.
Kong Wuyang naturally didn’t want to die with Ling Han, so he could only choose to retreat.
This caused him to instantly fall into a disadvantage.
Everyone was even more stunned, shaking their heads and sighing.
Ling Han was really too strong.
This True Self Tier was going to defy the heavens.
The more Kong Wuyang fought, the more displeased he felt.
He could not accept such a result.
He was a dignified Spirit Transformation Tier and Silver Generation elite; he definitely couldn’t lose!
Fine, do you think I don’t dare to fight you head-on?
Kong Wuyang no longer dodged.
Instead, he looked like he was going to take Ling Han head-on.
Scare me?
Humph, could it be that you would not be afraid of both sides being wounded?
Boom!
However, he had guessed wrongly.
Faced with an attack that looked like he was going to drag Ling Han down with him, Ling Han did not dodge at all, and directly charged towards him.
‘F*ck!’
At this moment, Kong Wuyang was dumbfounded.
At least a few thousand curse words raced through his mind.
‘Why do you f*cking want to drag me down with you?’
If I had known this earlier, I would rather be humiliated than do this!
However, it was already too late for regrets now.
Both of their attacks had landed on each other.
Kong Wuyang was instantly sent flying.
All the bones in his body were broken, and he opened his mouth, spitting out blood.
After sustaining such a heavy injury, the spiritual body immediately dissipated.
Thankfully, he had not died.
Furthermore, he did not seem to have suffered any fatal or crippling injuries.
He only had to rest for a few months, and he would be able to recover completely.
He relaxed slightly, but when he looked at Ling Han again, he instantly couldn’t help but throw up blood madly.
He looked as if nothing had happened.
In other words, he was completely unscathed.
You should be called Ling Wuyang, right1?
He tragically discovered that Ling Han was perfectly fine.
To say nothing of being severely injured and throwing up blood, not even a single hair of his was missing.
No wonder this guy kept looking like he was going to fight him to the death.
It wasn’t that the other party wanted to scare him with this kind of attitude, but rather that this guy’s defense was practically freakish.
He felt so wronged!
To actually fight a guy with freakish defense to the death, wasn’t that just courting death?
“Pu!” He spat out blood continuously, feeling extremely depressed.
Ling Han smiled faintly.
He had cultivated Body Art, so how strong was his physique?
Moreover, he could automatically disperse all attacks within six Heavens, and it was enough as long as he retained a little power to form a shield.
Wasn’t it a joke to fight him to the death?
Ling Han actually won?
The fact that a True Self Tier cultivator could fight a Spirit Transformation Tier head-on, and a Silver Generation Imperial Son at that, was already enough to make one’s scalp go numb, all right?
But Ling Han actually won, and this was even more inconceivable.
Ling Han looked at Xu Youque and said, “Do you also want to seek justice from me?”
Xu Youque’s strength was no weaker than Kong Wuyang’s, but after seeing Ling Han’s strength and freakishness, what confidence did he still have?
Without saying a word, he turned around and left.
Ling Han didn’t give chase.
This was the academy, after all, and it was established by the Imperial Clans.
No matter what, he had to restrain himself.
He smiled, turned and left as well.
The enlightenment this time directly allowed him to reach the consummate level of the True Self Tier, and he could now attempt to break through to the Spirit Transformation Tier.

chapters.title: Chapter 4329: Breaking through to Spirit Transformation Tier
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The Ancestral King Academy was filled with tumultuous waves.

Those who had not witnessed it with their own eyes could not believe that this True Self Tier cultivator could actually battle a Spiritual Transformation Tier cultivator, and even win at that. Wasn’t that the biggest joke in the world?

However, Imperial Son after Imperial Son expressed that it was true, and added with the fact that there were also recorded images as proof, others had no choice but to believe that there really was a freakish heaven-defying freak in this world.
This time, the members of the Golden Generation were all rendered speechless.
Were they this powerful in the past?
Since they were not so powerful, what else could they say?

Now, there were undercurrents surging, and the threat that Ling Han posed was too great. He was even more freakish than the Golden Generation. If his cultivation level really increased, then in the competition on the Imperial Path, who else would be a match for him?
Even if Ling Han didn’t become Emperor in the end, no one at the same cultivation level could rival him. Who would the heaven and earth allow to become Emperor then?
Get rid of him?

In the past, this would have still been possible. Although the combination of the Nine Mountains Saint and the Imperial Weapon were terrifying, faced with the threat of a future Great Emperor, a great many Imperial Clan Clans would still steel their hearts and kill Ling Han while he was still maturing.
But now?
Buddha Doga was a Pseudo-Emperor. If he was really angered, it was probable that even an Imperial Clan would be destroyed.

This was also why Ling Han dared to unleash his full strength. He was aware that his relations with Buddha Doga was not very close. However, others didn’t know this, and they naturally couldn’t verify this with Buddha Doga.
Ling Han couldn’t care less. He closed his doors, and began to concentrate on breaking through to the Spiritual Transformation Tier.
In his mind, the nine True Selves were all like mortal bodies, but occasionally, a terrifying aura would circulate, as if it could suppress the heavens.
Ling Han immersed himself in the great dao.
This took two months’ time.
He finally obtained enough comprehension, and began to break through to Spiritual Transformation Tier.

The Spiritual Transformation Tier meant being able to transform the True Self, one after another, into a spiritual body in one’s mind. How many True Selves do you have? In the end, that was how many changes you would be able to reach.
Thus, these two cultivation levels were closely related.

Ling Han began to stimulate the first True Self to transform into a spiritual body. He naturally chose the True Self of Destruction. This was the most powerful True Self with Destruction Energy as its core.
Even though it was only a change in form, taking this step was extremely difficult.
Because the change in form was only superficial, what truly caused a qualitative change was the soul, and the grasp of the Dao of Heaven and Earth.
Without being able to take this crucial step in the understanding of great dao, there was no way he could succeed.

Ling Han’s accumulation over the past two months was both his appreciation of the Dao of Heaven and Earth, as well as the final tempering of his cultivation level. Since he had taken this step, it meant that he was already confident.

Moreover, for him, the difficulty of breaking through to the ninth and tenth form was even higher than breaking through to the Spirit Transformation Tier. Thus, now that he had overcome both of the great difficulties, how difficult would it be to break through to the Spirit Transformation Tier?

The True Self of Destruction was only a virtual body. Ling Han had experimented with it before, and after unleashing it, it would not have the effect of wounding the enemy at all. However, it would be different if it was a spiritual body. This would unleash a terrifying battle prowess that was not inferior to the original.
‘Come!’

He activated the Power of Dimension in his body, stimulating the transformation of the True Self of Destruction. This was the only way, because with his current cultivation level, he was still not qualified to come into contact with such a profound level of energy.

However, the Power of Dimension was like a super nutritious tonic to the True Self of Destruction. In any case, Ling Han’s comprehension was already enough, so the True Self began to undergo a qualitative change.
Multiple mysterious seals appeared on the True Self of Destruction. With the boost from the Regulations of heaven and earth, it transformed from virtual to solid, changing rapidly.

Correspondingly, Ling Han’s physique was also rumbling loudly. This was because the upper limit of his physique was also further lifted. The energy of heaven and earth surged over, increasing his power.

“Wu!” Ling Han released a muffled groan. His power had increased too quickly, causing his body to be slightly unable to bear it. Pa, pa, pa! His skin immediately split apart, and blood gushed out, causing him to instantly turn into a figure of blood.
Not only that, but the bones in his body were also cracking. They were actually grinding themselves, as if they were about to turn into dust.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel shocked. If this continued, he wouldn’t even have broken through, and his whole person would be finished before then.
Stop?
How could that be allowed!
Ling Han immediately ruled out this option. He only hesitated slightly, and then continued this process.
He had broken through to Ten Forms, so he was definitely different from the rest.
Ling Han’s eyes flashed with madness. On the path of pursuing the strongest, he was definitely a maniac.
There was no room for retreat on this path.
Again!
Pa, pa, pa! His skin exploded, and his bones shattered. Ling Han’s whole person collapsed. In fact, cracks even appeared on his skull, which was densely covered with small cracks like a spider’s web.
However, his life essence was actually still as vigorous as fire, his vitality soaring sky-high.
Ling Han gritted his teeth and continued.
Pa, all the bones in his body were shattered, and it was as if his whole person had turned into blood clay. Only his mind was unbroken, and was undergoing that incomparably crucial evolution.
Ling Han guarded this precious territory, and the True Self of Destruction gradually took solid form.
Three days passed in the blink of an eye, and the True Self of Destruction finally turned completely into a spiritual body.
Spiritual Transformation Tier!
Instantly, an ancient battle drum sounded in the heaven and earth. Countless flowers fluttered, and fragrance wafted for millions and millions of miles.
Ling Han’s body quickly began to reforge. This was a new fetus that had evolved from an old body, and was rapidly growing. In just a few hours, it was already no different from before.
However, Ling Han could feel that this new body had a qualitative change, and was even more energetic than the old body.
When he completed the growth of his new body, the phenomenon of heaven and earth also rapidly disappeared, and in its place, there were thunderclaps and dark clouds.
Kuang!
Ling Han only felt a tremor in his mind, and a small golden figure appeared. It held a crystalline sword in hand, and charged towards the Spiritual Body of Destruction in his mind.
It was an internal demon.
The Spiritual Body of Destruction immediately charged forwards. It was only a single punch, and peng, the tiny golden figure was annihilated.
Er... that was it?
Even Ling Han faltered for a moment. ‘You can be considered an internal demon for better or worse, yet you’re actually dealt with with with a single punch?’
However, this was indeed the case. The dark clouds in the sky had already dispersed, and no new internal demon had appeared.
Fine then.
With a thought from Ling Han, the Spiritual Body of Destruction walked out of his body. It was in human form, but its features and body were a little blurry, and could not be seen clearly at all.

It couldn’t be helped. He was only at the early stage of the Spiritual Transformation Tier, so he naturally hadn’t cultivated his first spiritual body to the extreme yet. Otherwise, this spiritual body would look exactly like him.
Of course, there was no rule stating that the spiritual body had to be completely the same as the original, and could also be molded into the form of a weapon.
In short, the spiritual body was used to assist in battle and cultivation. It was fine as long as it could achieve this effect.
“How strong am I now?”
Ling Han was extremely curious. He activated the Star Steps and instantly exited the Ancestral King Academy. He appeared in a primitive forest.
“I’ll find a wild beast to spar with.”
He strolled forward, and not long after, a giant wolf that was as long as three hundred meters walked out.
=True Self Tier.
Ling Han shook his head. How could a True Self Tier be enough for him to test his abilities now?
He only glared at it, and the giant wolf was instantly scared out of its wits. It directly sprawled out on the ground, trembling as it waited for death.

chapters.title: Chapter 4330: Astonishing battle prowess
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han didn’t make a move. He had only come to test his strength, and there was no need for him to kill for no reason.
He continued to walk, searching for Spiritual Transformation Tier beasts.

However, there were really too few vicious beasts of this level. Thankfully, Ling Han was a formations grandmaster. Using the ley lines to explore, he soon found a vicious beast that met the criteria. With a flash, he had already arrived in a valley.
He released a battle cry, and instantly, a golden-haired ape leaped out. It was only thirty meters tall, but the aura it exuded was more than a hundred times stronger than the giant wolf from before.
The golden ape was filled with ferocity. Two fangs protruded from its mouth, and killing intent exuded from its eyes. However, it did not attack at the first instant, but merely stared at Ling Han.
Ferocious beasts were bloodthirsty and violent, but they had an instinctive fear of powerful beings.
In the eyes of this golden ape, Ling Han was this kind of elite.
“Come!” Ling Han smiled, and took the initiative to charge out.
In the face of provocation, the wild beast naturally would not cower either. The golden ape immediately roared, and clapped its arms on its chest. Then, it charged towards Ling Han.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The man and ape battled fiercely, and Ling Han unleashed his full power.

This ferocious beast was very powerful, and in terms of power, it was even superior to Ling Han. Furthermore, the golden ape’s claws were incredibly sharp, not inferior to a Celestial Tool of the same level. It also posed a certain amount of threat to Ling Han, tearing his clothes.

However, that was all there was to it. Ling Han’s skin was frighteningly tough, and such sharp massive claws only caused some white claw marks to appear on his body. It was completely unable to break through his defenses.

“After growing a new body, my body has undergone a qualitative change. Not only has my vitality increased greatly, my defense has also increased greatly.” Ling Han nodded internally. Combined with the fact that he could disperse attacks within six Heavens, he was practically a freak.
“My power is more or less equivalent to 15 Heavens of Spirit Transformation Tier!”

Even Ling Han was gritting his teeth. Every time a normal Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator raised their cultivation level by a minor level, they would probably be able to increase their power by three Heavens. Then, even if it was a Spirit Transformation Tier Fifth Change cultivator, they would only be able to possess 15 Heavens of power.
This was completely related to the quality of the True Selfves that had been formed in the past, and not the number of True Selves.
Thus, this was also why everyone thought that Ling Han was done for when they found out that the True Self that he had formed was a “mortal body”.
That’s right. How much power could a spiritual body formed from a mortal body have?
An advance of two Heavens? Or one Heaven?
“Let’s try the spiritual body again.” With a thought from Ling Han, the spiritual body immediately manifested, and he threw a punch at the golden ape.

Vicious beasts didn’t need to cultivate; they only needed to eat and eat, and they would naturally be able to grow to the heights that they should have. Thus, although vicious beasts would also be divided into the likes of Spiritual Transformation Tier and True Self Tier, the two systems were completely different.
—Ferocious beasts did not have a spiritual body!
The spiritual body and main body joined forces, and the pressure on the golden ape instantly increased.
This was not a good test. Ling Han immediately withdrew from the battle, and had the spiritual body fight the golden ape one-on-one.
Peng!
The spiritual body threw a punch, clashing with the golden ape. The spiritual body instantly retreated rapidly, but though the golden ape had the advantage in power, it was still crying out in pain.
As it turned out, its claws were badly mangled.
It should be known that the spiritual body was manifested from the True Self of Destruction, and contained Destructive Energy, so just how terrifying was its destructive power?
No matter how stubborn one was, he shouldn’t clash head-on with Destructive Energy.
His spiritual body charged forward aggressively.

Whether it was himself or his spiritual body, they were both controlled by Ling Han with a single thought. It was as if he had an additional pair of arms and legs, and he could use them extremely smoothly.
Fight, fight, fight.
The more the golden ape fought, the more it was at a disadvantage. In terms of power, it was completely at an advantage, but against the Destructive Energy, it was only seeking its own suffering.

Moreover, vicious beasts didn’t know any celestial technique, and were mostly focused on close-quarter combat. Only in this way could they display their advantage in power. The problem was, this just happened to be Ling Han’s strongest aspect.
Going head-on against Destructive Energy? Hehe.
After exchanging a few more blows, the golden ape screamed in agony before turning around to flee.
Its survival instincts took the upper hand. It didn’t want to die.
Ling Han chuckled, but did not make a move.
There was no reason, so he did not want to commit murder.
Using the Star Steps, he returned to the Ancestral King Academy.

After breaking through to the next major tier, Ling Han had to report this to the academy. This concerned what level he would be assigned to in the next monthly exam. Otherwise, if a Spirit Transformation Tier went to fight with a True Self Tier, wouldn’t that be torturing noobs?
After making his report, he also told the empress and the others the good news, causing everyone to be overjoyed, and express that they wanted to have a good celebration.

And when the news that Ling Han had broken through to Spiritual Transformation Tier spread throughout the entire academy, it also caused those Silver Generation elites who had long since broken through to Spiritual Transformation Tier, and even those Golden Generation elites, to smirk coldly.
‘You’ve finally come!’
No matter how freakish you were, you had just broken through to Spiritual Transformation Tier, after all, so how strong could your battle prowess be?
Seizing the chance, they would kill this guy.
Of course, it had to be done openly and publicly, so that neither the Nine Mountains Saint nor Buddha Doga could fly into a rage because of this.
“Little Han, come, Grandpa Dog offers you a toast.” The large black dog held the wine cup in his paws.
“Grandpa Dragon also gives you a toast.” The little azure dragon also joined in on the excitement.
“All right.” Ling Han raised his cup in return.

Meanwhile, the women didn’t join in on the excitement. They talked about feminine topics, especially Chi Menghan, who had just joined. She was bombarded with questions from the empress and Hu Niu, especially some sensitive questions, causing her face to flush bright red.

“However, you were invincible in the True Self Tier, and now that you’ve advanced into the Spiritual Transformation Tier, there should be a lot of people stronger than you. You have to be careful.” It was rare for the large black dog to be serious.
Ling Han nodded, and said, “I know.”

“Looks like you’ll have to keep a low profile for a while,” the little azure dragon said with a smile. “That’s just right. Once you leave, the first place of the True Self Tier will fall to Grandpa Dragon.”
“There’s still Ding Shu. You have to wait for a while longer,” Ling Han said with a smile.

“Pei, this guy has long since reached the peak stage of the ninth form. Why hasn’t he broken through yet?” The little azure dragon was extremely displeased. With the help of the Source Dao Stone, he had already cultivated to the eighth form. Once Ding Shu advanced, there would definitely be no one in the True Self Tier that could be a match for him.
Ling Han naturally knew that Ding Shu was putting up a stubborn resistance. To avoid acknowledging him as the boss, he was fixated on the Tenth Form.
However, this really wasn’t a matter of how long he would continue to fixate on it. This guy had better not be stubborn, and stay in the True Self Tier for the rest of his life, right?
Ling Han smiled. It was not to that extent. Ding Shu had once been the overlord of the Genesis World, so he should know how to choose.
Moreover, the Ancestral Kings from ancient times had only cultivated to the ninth form, at most, and that was enough to attain dao.
Time flew by, and the next monthly assessment had already arrived.

The empress and Hu Niu were already qualified to charge into the top three. This attracted the attention of a great many people. After all, the empress was extraordinarily beautiful, and her natural talent in cultivation was also so astonishing, which naturally made them dazzling.
However, because of Ling Han, no one dared to harrass them.

In the True Self Tier battles, Ding Shu was still ranked first. Previously, Ling Han was absent, so he naturally took first place. The little azure dragon was second, and the large black dog was fifth.
This day passed, and it was now the turn for the Spirit Transformation Tiers. The entire academy was also waiting to see how Ling Han would perform.
