In the face of provocation, the wild beast naturally would not cower either.
The golden ape immediately roared, and clapped its arms on its chest.
Then, it charged towards Ling Han.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
The man and ape battled fiercely, and Ling Han unleashed his full power.
This ferocious beast was very powerful, and in terms of power, it was even superior to Ling Han.
Furthermore, the golden ape’s claws were incredibly sharp, not inferior to a Celestial Tool of the same level.
It also posed a certain amount of threat to Ling Han, tearing his clothes.
However, that was all there was to it.
Ling Han’s skin was frighteningly tough, and such sharp massive claws only caused some white claw marks to appear on his body.
It was completely unable to break through his defenses.
“After growing a new body, my body has undergone a qualitative change.
Not only has my vitality increased greatly, my defense has also increased greatly.” Ling Han nodded internally.
Combined with the fact that he could disperse attacks within six Heavens, he was practically a freak.
“My power is more or less equivalent to 15 Heavens of Spirit Transformation Tier!”
Even Ling Han was gritting his teeth.
Every time a normal Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator raised their cultivation level by a minor level, they would probably be able to increase their power by three Heavens.
Then, even if it was a Spirit Transformation Tier Fifth Change cultivator, they would only be able to possess 15 Heavens of power.
This was completely related to the quality of the True Selfves that had been formed in the past, and not the number of True Selves.
Thus, this was also why everyone thought that Ling Han was done for when they found out that the True Self that he had formed was a “mortal body”.
That’s right.
How much power could a spiritual body formed from a mortal body have?
An advance of two Heavens?
Or one Heaven?
“Let’s try the spiritual body again.” With a thought from Ling Han, the spiritual body immediately manifested, and he threw a punch at the golden ape.
Vicious beasts didn’t need to cultivate; they only needed to eat and eat, and they would naturally be able to grow to the heights that they should have.
Thus, although vicious beasts would also be divided into the likes of Spiritual Transformation Tier and True Self Tier, the two systems were completely different.
—Ferocious beasts did not have a spiritual body!
The spiritual body and main body joined forces, and the pressure on the golden ape instantly increased.
This was not a good test.
Ling Han immediately withdrew from the battle, and had the spiritual body fight the golden ape one-on-one.
Peng!
The spiritual body threw a punch, clashing with the golden ape.
The spiritual body instantly retreated rapidly, but though the golden ape had the advantage in power, it was still crying out in pain.
As it turned out, its claws were badly mangled.
It should be known that the spiritual body was manifested from the True Self of Destruction, and contained Destructive Energy, so just how terrifying was its destructive power?
No matter how stubborn one was, he shouldn’t clash head-on with Destructive Energy.
His spiritual body charged forward aggressively.
Whether it was himself or his spiritual body, they were both controlled by Ling Han with a single thought.
It was as if he had an additional pair of arms and legs, and he could use them extremely smoothly.
Fight, fight, fight.
The more the golden ape fought, the more it was at a disadvantage.
In terms of power, it was completely at an advantage, but against the Destructive Energy, it was only seeking its own suffering.
Moreover, vicious beasts didn’t know any celestial technique, and were mostly focused on close-quarter combat.
Only in this way could they display their advantage in power.
The problem was, this just happened to be Ling Han’s strongest aspect.
Going head-on against Destructive Energy?
Hehe.
After exchanging a few more blows, the golden ape screamed in agony before turning around to flee.
Its survival instincts took the upper hand.
It didn’t want to die.
Ling Han chuckled, but did not make a move.
There was no reason, so he did not want to commit murder.
Using the Star Steps, he returned to the Ancestral King Academy.
After breaking through to the next major tier, Ling Han had to report this to the academy.
This concerned what level he would be assigned to in the next monthly exam.
Otherwise, if a Spirit Transformation Tier went to fight with a True Self Tier, wouldn’t that be torturing noobs?
After making his report, he also told the empress and the others the good news, causing everyone to be overjoyed, and express that they wanted to have a good celebration.

And when the news that Ling Han had broken through to Spiritual Transformation Tier spread throughout the entire academy, it also caused those Silver Generation elites who had long since broken through to Spiritual Transformation Tier, and even those Golden Generation elites, to smirk coldly.
‘You’ve finally come!’
No matter how freakish you were, you had just broken through to Spiritual Transformation Tier, after all, so how strong could your battle prowess be?
Seizing the chance, they would kill this guy.
Of course, it had to be done openly and publicly, so that neither the Nine Mountains Saint nor Buddha Doga could fly into a rage because of this.
“Little Han, come, Grandpa Dog offers you a toast.” The large black dog held the wine cup in his paws.
“Grandpa Dragon also gives you a toast.” The little azure dragon also joined in on the excitement.
“All right.” Ling Han raised his cup in return.
Meanwhile, the women didn’t join in on the excitement.
They talked about feminine topics, especially Chi Menghan, who had just joined.
She was bombarded with questions from the empress and Hu Niu, especially some sensitive questions, causing her face to flush bright red.
“However, you were invincible in the True Self Tier, and now that you’ve advanced into the Spiritual Transformation Tier, there should be a lot of people stronger than you.
You have to be careful.” It was rare for the large black dog to be serious.
Ling Han nodded, and said, “I know.”
“Looks like you’ll have to keep a low profile for a while,” the little azure dragon said with a smile.
“That’s just right.
Once you leave, the first place of the True Self Tier will fall to Grandpa Dragon.”
“There’s still Ding Shu.
You have to wait for a while longer,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“Pei, this guy has long since reached the peak stage of the ninth form.
Why hasn’t he broken through yet?” The little azure dragon was extremely displeased.
With the help of the Source Dao Stone, he had already cultivated to the eighth form.
Once Ding Shu advanced, there would definitely be no one in the True Self Tier that could be a match for him.
Ling Han naturally knew that Ding Shu was putting up a stubborn resistance.
To avoid acknowledging him as the boss, he was fixated on the Tenth Form.
However, this really wasn’t a matter of how long he would continue to fixate on it.
This guy had better not be stubborn, and stay in the True Self Tier for the rest of his life, right?
Ling Han smiled.
It was not to that extent.
Ding Shu had once been the overlord of the Genesis World, so he should know how to choose.
Moreover, the Ancestral Kings from ancient times had only cultivated to the ninth form, at most, and that was enough to attain dao.
Time flew by, and the next monthly assessment had already arrived.
The empress and Hu Niu were already qualified to charge into the top three.
This attracted the attention of a great many people.
After all, the empress was extraordinarily beautiful, and her natural talent in cultivation was also so astonishing, which naturally made them dazzling.
However, because of Ling Han, no one dared to harrass them.
In the True Self Tier battles, Ding Shu was still ranked first.
Previously, Ling Han was absent, so he naturally took first place.
The little azure dragon was second, and the large black dog was fifth.
This day passed, and it was now the turn for the Spirit Transformation Tiers.
The entire academy was also waiting to see how Ling Han would perform.

chapters.title: Chapter 4331: Everyone’s Anticipation
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Under the anticipation of countless people, the monthly assessment for Spirit Transformation Tier began.
Because Ling Han didn’t have a rank for Spirit Transformation Tier, he naturally had to start from the knockout battles.

Following the breakthrough of a large number of True Self Tier cultivators, there were many Spirit Transformation Tier cultivators. There were some from the Golden Generation that had not broken through for a long time, as well as outstanding elites of the Silver Generation. It was said that they had already cultivated to the Sixth Change or even the Seventh Change.

There were also some powerful Dao Childs from the Holy Lands. They were the same batch as the Golden Generation, or even from an earlier batch. Some were Spirit Transformation Tier Fifth Change, and some were Spirit Transformation Tier Sixth Change. They too could not be underestimated.

Of course, after advancing into the Spirit Transformation Tier, while cultivation level was important, the quality of the spiritual body was also important, directly affecting the strength of battle prowess.

Thus, it was not impossible that a Spirit Transformation Tier Fifth Change would lose to a Spirit Transformation Tier Third Change. Of course, for a Spirit Transformation Tier Fifth Change to lose to a Spirit Transformation Tier First Change, the possibility of this was practically non-existent.
There were too many people, and Ling Han had to fight four knockout battles before he could enter into the ranking battles.

In the first round, his luck was not too bad. He drew an opponent that was a Spirit Transformation Tier Second Change. Furthermore, it was not an Imperial Son, but rather a Dao Child from a Holy Land.
This Dao Child was only around two hundred years old. In the outside world, he really couldn’t be any more outstanding. A two-hundred-year-old Spirit Transformation Tier elite was terrifyingly young.
However, in the case of the Ancestral King Academy, this advancement was only so-so. There were a lot of hundred-year-old Spirit Transformation Tiers.

This Dao Child’s name was Wu Qinghuai. He was very handsome, and had a lanky figure. There were two spheres formed from Regulations on his body. One was fire, and the other was ice, and they endlessly revolved around his body.

“Imperial Son Xuan has asked me to pass on a message to you. If you want to live, it would be best for you to cripple your own cultivation level and apologize to him,” he said through divine sense the moment he arrived.
Lin Xuan?
Ling Han chuckled and said, “Then tell him that before long, I’ll chop off his head and use it as a ball!”
Demanding him to cripple his own cultivation level; was this any way to resolve the problem peacefully?
Since you are using your superior strength as a bullying tactic, then don’t blame me for being ruthless.

“Ling Han, how are you worthy of opposing Imperial Son Xuan?” Wu Qinghuai asked coldly, “Lord Xuan is loved by the heavens, and has been blessed by a strange phenomenon at his birth. Now, he is only a hundred years old, yet has already cultivated to the consummate level of the Minor Advanced Tier!”
“If it was not for the fact that Lord Xuan still wishes to break the supreme limit, he would have long since become a Venerate Tier elite!”
“Compared to him, you are still very far off!”
Ling Han couldn’t be bothered to speak any more nonsense. He crooked a finger at Wu Qinghuai, “Cut the crap. I am going to beat you up now!”

“Haha, you are really arrogant!” Wu Qinghuai declared coldly. ‘Though you are indeed very freakish, I am a Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator at the peak stage of Second Change, which is practically two minor levels higher than you.’ No matter how he thought about it, there was no reason for him to lose.
“Humph!” With a flash, two spiritual bodies walked out.
He had cultivated the Second Change to the end, so the two spiritual bodies were completely identical to him.
If there had to be any difference, it would be that both of his spiritual bodies were flickering with red and white light, though they were very faint.
“Die!”

The three Wu Qinghuai charged towards Ling Han at the same time. In this battle, Spirit Tools were prohibited. Thus, their six hands formed into fists, palms and claws respectively, striking out different celestial techniques. Regulations boomed, their might terrifying.
Ling Han wanted to test out his opponent’s strength, so he didn’t use his spiritual body. Instead, he simply brandished his fists in response.
Peng!
With this strike, though Ling Han’s figure trembled, the three Wu Qinghuai were all sent backwards.
What!
Seeing this scene, everyone couldn’t help but inhale sharply.
Everyone was very clear about Wu Qinghuai’s abilities.
—He had cultivated to Sixth Form when he was in the True Self Tier, and furthermore, it was a Two Colour True Self.

Thus, after advancing into the Spirit Transformation Tier, every spiritual body could provide him with six Heavens of power. Two complete spiritual bodies would be the power of twelve Heavens, and with the combined power of three “people”, the power would naturally be even greater.
But even so, Ling Han actually had the upper hand in terms of power.
Hiss, what kind of freak was this?

Wu Qinghuai had suffered a loss in a single strike, but did not lose his fighting spirit because of this. Instead, he immediately made a comeback, and directly used the Saint Technique His three bodies channelled three different Saint Techniques respectively, complementing each other, causing his battle prowess to increase even further.

With the boost from the Saint Technique, the battle prowess of each body had reached 21 Heavens. With the three of them working together, and added with the amplification of each other, their total battle prowess could reach twenty-three or even twenty-four Heavens!
Ling Han also channelled the Saint Technique, exchanging blows with Wu Qinghuai.

One strike after another, with his freakish physique, this was naturally no big deal, but Wu Qinghuai did not have the kind of ability that he did. Under such a head-on clash, he very soon could not hold on any longer, and his face was as pale as could be.
After a few more exchanges, he had no choice but to admit defeat. Otherwise, he would attain a great loss.
Ling Han smiled faintly before turning around to leave the arena.
This time, he did not show off, but everyone’s shock did not decrease in the slightest.
In a situation when the spiritual body’s quality was about the same, then every difference of a minor level would lead to an overwhelming advantage.
It was very simple to understand. The other side had an additional spiritual body.
Every spiritual body had battle prowess that was on par with oneself, so how crucial was it to have one more or one less?

However, Ling Han was one minor level below Wu Qinghuai, and he didn’t even use his spiritual body, but that was still enough to force Wu Qinghuai to have no option but to lower his head and admit defeat. This meant... just how high-level was his spiritual body?
Mortal body? Mortal your sister!

Everyone knew that they had definitely been deceived by Ling Han. This guy should have cultivated some kind of secret technique that could hide the quality of the True Self. Thus, while he looked like a mortal, in truth, he could possibly be a Seven-Colored True Self!
“With how freakish this guy is, he’s definitely no weaker than the Golden Generation. Thus, he’s at least a Seven Colours True Self!”

“No, the Golden Generation wouldn’t have been able to defeat a Spirit Transformation Tier while still in True Self Tier. At the very least, the Spirit Transformation Tier couldn’t be at the Imperial Son’s level! So, it’s extremely likely that this guy has reached the legendary ninth form, possessing the Eight Colours True Self!”
“Hiss!”
Everyone gritted their teeth. This was the ninth form; even among the Golden Generation, how many had reached this kind of height?
Was there? Was there one?
“Let’s just wait and see. We should be able to see his true strength soon.”
After the first round of elimination battles, very soon, the second round began.
This time, it was only natural that Ling Han’s opponent was stronger. In a knockout battle, it would definitely that the strong would win, and the weak would lose.
However, this still wasn’t the Imperial Son. It was still a Dao Child. His name was Liu Yue, a Spirit Transformation Tier Third Change.
The moment they clashed, Liu Yue directly summoned all three spiritual bodies, surrounding Ling Han.
“Four Directions Celestial Killer Formation!”
Liu Yue gave a soft exclamation, and his four bodies moved at the same time, blasting towards Ling Han.
He was clearly a level stronger than Wu Qinghuai.

Liu Yue’s Spiritual Body should also be Two Colours, but he was a Spirit Transformation Tier Third Change, and his base power was as high as 18 Heavens, which was above Ling Han’s. Added with the four bodies joining forces and forming a formation, his battle prowess was naturally further boosted.
Ling Han took this strike head-on, and his body instantly trembled. He was almost sent flying.
His fighting spirit rose, and with a battle cry, he used an Imperial Technique, Regulations channelled, and his battle prowess soared to thirty Heavens in a single stroke!
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Although Liu Yue possessed four bodies, he was still suppressed by Ling Han.
W-what!
— New chapter is coming soon —

chapters.title: Chapter 4332: Suppressed
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Everyone was once again shocked. They had already overestimated Ling Han, but only after fighting did they realize that they had still underestimated Ling Han.
“It’s clear now.”
“His power should be 15 Heavens.”
“With the use of the Imperial Technique, his battle prowess has soared to 30 Heavens.”
“Yi, isn’t the Imperial Technique only able to boost one’s battle prowess by 12 Heavens?”
“It is indeed very strange. On this guy, the Imperial Technique can actually burst out with the battle prowess of 15 Heavens!”
Meanwhile, those Venerate Tier elites frowned slightly. Their eyes were naturally sharp, and they had guessed the truth.
“This brat has already begun to walk his own path.”
“Thus, he was able to use the Imperial Technique to the extent that it surpasses ordinary people.”
“That’s because the Ancestral Kings have all walked their own paths, and only then could they be strong enough to suppress the heaven and earth!”

This caused all the Venerates to feel uneasy. Ling Han had such natural talent, and had even forged his own path. As long as he became a Saint, he would be the strongest competitor on the Imperial Path.

‘Members of the Golden Generation, perhaps your true opponent isn’t Buddha Doga, or the two in the sea of blood and Yin River. Instead, it’s this newcomer who hasn’t even advanced to the Minor Advanced Tier yet.’
Ling Han used the Imperial Technique, and instantly gained the upper hand. Under wave after wave of attacks, Liu Yue could only hold on stubbornly, and no longer had the ability to fight back.
In the end, Liu Yue could only bow his head in submission.
Two consecutive wins!

This was an inconceivable accomplishment. Even for the Silver Generation, when they had just entered the Spiritual Transformation Tier, they could only obediently withdraw their arrogance, becausea Spirit Transformation Tier First Change could at most burst out with battle prowess of over a dozen Heavens, so how could they possibly be a match for a veteran Spiritual Transformation Tier?
Even if their opponent was only Dao Child-level.
However, Ling Han had overturned all of this. He had even defeated a Dao Child that had undergone Spirit Transformation Tier Third Change, and what was most troubling?
He had not gone all out yet.
Up until now, Ling Han still hadn’t summoned his spiritual body. In other words, he had only used half of his strength.
This was too terrifying.
In the third round, Ling Han finally drew out an Imperial Son. Moreover, it was a Spirit Transformation Tier Third Change.
The Thousand Spirit Imperial Clan’s Cheng Qing.

Ling Han had seen this Imperial Son in the True Dragon Abyss before. At that time, Cheng Qing was the strongest in the True Self Tier. Now, he had long since stepped into the Spiritual Transformation Tier, and furthermore, cultivated to the Third Change. Just how strong would his battle prowess be?
As an Imperial Son, his aura was extraordinary. There was a full moon shining behind him, exuding a golden brilliance.
This was a powerful opponent.
Ling Han took a deep breath, not daring to be careless in the slightest.

Cheng Qing was naturally very cautious as well. If he won, that was natural. What was there to be proud of if a Third Change had won against a First Change? But if he lost, then he, an Imperial Son, would become a laughing stock.
Thus, he could only win this battle, but could not lose.
Three spiritual bodies materialized from within his body. Their expressions were solemn, and there were six-colored rays of light around them.
This meant that when Cheng Qing had been in the True Self Tier, he had formed a Six-Coloured True Self.
“Come!”

A fierce battle could break out at any moment. The moment they exchanged blows, Ling Han discovered that his strength was inferior to his opponent’s. Cheng Qing had already cultivated the Third Change to the middle stage. Thus, his power reached as high as 20 Heavens.
With the boost of the Imperial Technique and the combined power of three spiritual bodies, Cheng Qing’s battle prowess was at least superior to Ling Han by three Heavens.
There was a publicly acknowledged standard in the cultivation world, and that was once there was a gap of three Heavens in battle prowess, it would be a crushing advantage.
As expected, Cheng Qing immediately had the upper hand. Every move was fierce, blasting Ling Han so hard that he could only parry.
This caused everyone to nod repeatedly. They had finally suppressed this guy.

But upon further thought, a Silver Generation elite actually had to depend on the advantage of two minor levels of cultivation level to be able to suppress Ling Han. Wasn’t this proof of how terrifying Ling Han was?
However, though Ling Han was at a disadvantage, he did not look like he was about to collapse at all.
His defenses were too strong. Even if he was hit a few times, so what? He would only be scratched, and be completely unharmed.

However, there was a time limit to the battle, and it was far from lasting until the moment Cheng Qing’s power was exhausted. The battle would then be forcefully stopped, and the outcome of the battle would naturally be judged based on the advantage and disadvantage of the situation.
Thus, if this continued, Ling Han would definitely lose.
With a thought from Ling Han, his spiritual body appeared.
This was the first time he had revealed his spiritual body in front of everyone, instantly attracting everyone’s attention. Even those Venerate Tier elites were no exception.
However, no matter how they looked, they couldn’t find anything special about this spiritual body. It was just as ordinary as the True Self that Ling Han had previously displayed.

Everyone knew that the quality of the spiritual body directly determined the strength of the cultivator. Ling Han was so powerful, so the quality of his spiritual body must also be incredibly shocking. How could it be so mediocre?
“This guy is really cautious, to still keep his spiritual body secret!”
Everyone shook their heads, feeling that Ling Han was being too cautious.
Again!
Ling Han and the spiritual body charged out together, greeting Cheng Qing.

The spiritual body took the lead. This was formed by a combination of Regulations and the soul. Though it could cause massive damage to a physical body, it itself was not a physical body. It was difficult for the mystical power to injure it, and even if it was damaged, it was fine. As long as it was nurtured in the mind, it would be able to recover to its original state in no time.
Thus, spiritual bodies could be used without any scruples, and there was basically no need to worry that they would be destroyed.
Peng!

The Spiritual Body of Destruction struck out with both fists, each fist attacking one of Cheng Qing’s spiritual bodies respectively. Under the boiling of the terrifying power, the Spiritual Body of Destruction was instantly sent backwards, but Cheng Qing’s two spiritual bodies began to tremble rapidly, flickering inconsistently.
Upon another exchange, the battle prowess of these two spiritual bodies had clearly dropped greatly.
What!

This caused everyone to go numb with shock. What was going on here? Could it be that Ling Han’s spiritual body could still restrain other spiritual bodies? Otherwise, why did Cheng Qing’s spiritual body seem to have been severely injured after the exchange of blows, and his battle prowess had decreased drastically?
Others might not be able to see clearly, but with the cultivation level and insight of the Venerate Tier elites, how could they not see clearly!
“This boy’s spiritual body seems to have a special ability that can restrain other spiritual bodies.”
“That’s right. The spiritual body is formed from Regulations. Theoretically speaking, the higher the level of Regulations that forms the spiritual body, the more powerful it would be.”
“However, it can even suppress the spiritual body of an Imperial Son. This... is too shocking!”
All the Venerate Tier elites frowned deeply. Ling Han’s performance was becoming more and more amazing, and he was looking more and more capable of becoming Emperor.

Most importantly, the majority of Imperial Clans were standing on the opposing side of Ling Han. Naturally, they were unwilling to see Ling Han become Emperor. Otherwise, without the invasion of the Netherworld, they would be dealt with first.

Ling Han’s main body was slightly inferior to Cheng Qing’s main body in terms of battle prowess, but his spiritual body was invincible in destructive power. Under the barrage of punches, Cheng Qing’s three spiritual bodies were all severely injured, and he had no choice but to withdraw them into his mind to nurture.
In this way, it became Ling Han and the Spiritual Body of Destruction that joined forces to battle Cheng Qing’s main body, so it was hard to say who would win.
However, before they could determine the victor, the time limit for the battle had already arrived.
The Venerates discussed among themselves, and judged Ling Han as having lost.

This was too unfair. On the surface, it was a tie, but Ling Han was battling Cheng Qing, who was Third Change while Ling Han was a First Change. No matter what, he should be judged to have won, right?
Hehe, in order to suppress Ling Han, these mighty figures were really shameless.

chapters.title: Chapter 4333: A kickass rookie
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han merely smiled faintly at this.

Though his battle prowess could match a Silver Generation like Cheng Qing, even if he really passed four rounds of elimination battles, and challenged the top ten, he would definitely not have the slightest chance of winning.
Those were all Imperial Sons above the level of Spirit Transformation Tier Fifth Change. In fact, there were even Golden Generation elites among them.

If it was just a gap of one or two minor levels, Ling Han was confident that he could crush him, but if the gap was too wide, no matter how freakish he was, he could not do anything. After all, those people were also geniuses of the present generation.
Thus, since he couldn’t obtain cultivation resources anyway, what was there to be concerned about?
As for worthless fame? He didn’t take it to heart. Moreover, did his freakishness need these rankings to prove it?
What worried Ling Han was where he was going to obtain cultivation resources.

There was no need to think about the Ancestral King Academy for the moment. No matter what, he had to be at least Third Change, or even Fourth Change first. Only then would he be able to charge towards the top ten, right?
Then, Yin soul?

Ling Han shook his head again. Under the powerful suppression of Buddha Doga, the Netherworld army had currently retreated into the Mountain Sea Heaven. If he went over to kill Yin souls... en, he would be killed at any moment.
Dark Clouds Hell?

This was fine. His life force had already recovered. Though the life force he had lost could not be recovered, compared to the long lifespan he had left, he was completely capable of sustaining the expenditure.

However, he now knew that it was suspected that there was a Pseudo-Emperor in the Dark Clouds Hell, and if he thought about it carefully, the Source Dao Stone appearing out of thin air, was it also related to this Master of the Yin River?
The more he thought about it, the more terrifying it was. He had best not touch this trouble again.
Then what was he to do?
It didn’t work like this, and it didn’t work like that either. Could it be that he had to cultivate diligently on his own?

Though the Ancestral King Academy had been modified by many Saints, and the power of heaven and earth here was dense, and the Regulations were lively, so it was very easy to sense them, this was only an environmental factor. It could not replace cultivation resources.
Thus, he still had to go and see if there were any ancient sites that had opened, which could allow him to earn some extra income, and obtain some natural treasures.
As he kept an eye out for news on the Galaxy Network, he kept a low profile and cultivated in the academy.

However, those Silver Generations that had been in the Spiritual Transformation Tier previously were all clamoring, waiting for Ling Han to charge up to the Spiritual Transformation Tier. Sure enough, after this monthly exam, Ling Han’s strength was revealed. Occasionally, there would be people challenging him, and they were all Imperial Sons that were in the Spirit Transformation Tier Third Change and above.
Wasn’t it obvious that they wanted to use their superior cultivation level to suppress him?
Furthermore, sparring would have to be done in a place where the formations would suppress Ling Han. The so-called “fairness” was only targeted at Ling Han’s Star Steps.
Faced with this kind of provocation, Ling Han naturally ignored it completely. He wasn’t stupid. He clearly knew that he would definitely lose and be beaten, yet he still foolishly rushed forwards?

But in this way, he continuously forfeited the battle, which also caused many people’s impression of him to rapidly deteriorate, thinking that he was cowardly and weak. This was only sparring, and could not possibly kill or cripple. You don’t even have the courage to fight?
The empress, the large black dog, and the others were all indignant on Ling Han’s behalf. He had clearly suffered injustice, so why was it that Ling Han was in the wrong instead?
Ling Han, on the other hand, was completely unconcerned. The best way to respond to all this was through strength.
Just you wait!
Not long after, Ding Shu also broke through.
It wasn’t the Tenth Form, but rather the Spiritual Transformation Tier.
In the end, he gave up. If he were to continue fixating on the Tenth Form, it was possible that he would be trapped in the True Self Tier for the rest of his life.
In any case, in the past, it was possible that the Great Emperor was only the ninth form, or in fact, only the eighth form.
“B-Boss!” He was willing to admit defeat. After breaking through, he came to find Ling Han.
Ling Han cracked a smile, and nodded, “En, Little Ding.”
“Don’t call me that!” Ding Shu said angrily.
“Alright, Little Shu,” Ling Han readily agreed.
Ding Shu was even more depressed. However, he was the boss here, so what could he do?
“Although I recognize you as my boss now, our battle hasn’t ended yet!” Ding Shu said. “If I surpass you in any cultivation level, you’ll have to turn around and recognize me as your boss!”
“Sure.” Ling Han nodded. On the path of the strongest, he did not think that anyone could surpass him. At most, they could only fight to a tie.

Moreover, the Spiritual Transformation Tier was directly linked to the True Self Tier. Thus, Ding Shu would at least have to wait until the Minor Advanced Tier to be able to compete with him again. There was still a lot of time.
Once Ding Shu broke through, the little azure dragon naturally became the number one cultivator in the True Self Tier, making him extremely conceited and arrogant.
The empress and Hu Niu had also advanced into the True Self Tier, and similarly maintained the high rate of improvement in their cultivation level.
On this day, he was walking around in the academy, wanting to see if he could encounter another chance of enlightenment.

Unfortunately, this was something that could only be encountered by luck. It was not something that could come just because he wanted it to. After walking for half a day, he was only here to look at the mountains and waters. Thankfully, he still had Hu Niu, the empress and Chi Menghan by his side. This could be considered as accompanying these beauties.
“Yi, why are so many people running towards the entrance?” Hu Niu suddenly asked curiously.
In just a short while, they saw at least four groups of people rushing past, all heading in the direction of the academy’s entrance.
“Let’s go take a look, let’s go take a look,” Hu Niu said excitedly.
Since they had nothing else to do, the four of them headed towards the entrance of the academy.
When they arrived, they were all surprised. Why were there so many people here?
After asking around, they finally found out what had happened.

As it turned out, someone wanted to join the academy, but this person was very arrogant. He wanted to see if the Ancestral King Academy was qualified to take him in. Thus, he sat at the academy’s entrance, and requested a battle of equal cultivation levels. If anyone could defeat him, then he would join the academy.
F***, so cocky?
Ling Han and the others were all surprised. Faced with this kind of mad man, those big shots in the academy could tolerate it?
This person... was only in the True Self Tier.
“Have you guys heard of the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan?” someone beside them asked. These words were directed at Chi Menghan.
Chi Menghan pondered for a moment, and seemed to recall something. “Descendant of the Thousand Bird Saint Emperor? Yi, wasn’t there no news of this clan since hundreds of millions of years ago?”
“That’s right. The Thousand Bird Imperial Clan has indeed disappeared for a long time, but they have reappeared now.” That person nodded.
“Could it be that the person is the Imperial Son of the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan?” Chi Mengan immediately made the connection.

Yet that person shook his head, “This person is the son-in-law of the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan. This time, he has been accompanied by a Saint from the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan. Thus, though the higher ups of the academy are very displeased, it would not be appropriate for them to say anything.”
Chi Menghan found this strange. “This person is still sitting here, so how could it be that no one that can defeat him?”

“That’s true.” That person smiled bitterly, “Recently, it seems like a great many freaks have appeared. This guy has already won seventeen consecutive battles, and there is no one that can match ten moves from him.”
This was quite impressive. After all, this was the Ancestral King Academy. There were many Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters here, and not one of them was able to withstand ten moves from him.
“What’s his name?” Chi Menghuan asked again.
“Hehe, Fairy Chi, you must have heard of his name,” that person said, his face filled with certainty.
“Oh?” Chi Menghan was astonished. “Who is it?”
“Origin!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4334: Powerful Origin
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Origin!
Years ago, there were three outstanding freaks, who broke records madly on the Galaxy Network. They were Origin, Myriad Dao, and Heaven Crushing.
Of course, following Ling Han’s arrival on the Galaxy Network, he also broke the records of these people again. “Number One in the Galaxy” could be considered very well-known.
Ling Han had always wanted to know the true identities of these three people, but these three people had hidden themselves very well, and had not revealed themselves all this while.
He had never imagined that he would actually meet Origin, and this guy had actually become the son-in-law of the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan!
Ling Han’s interest was piqued, and he turned to look at Origin.

This was a young man in plain clothes. His appearance was average, and could not be considered ugly, nor could he be considered handsome. However, he had an aura of might and dignity. He was clearly just sitting very ordinarily, yet it was as if he was the centre of heaven and earth, causing others to involuntarily turn to look at him.

“With such a large Ancestral King Academ, are there no elites?” A woman said. She was truly beautiful, with eyebrows as white as snow and skin as fair as snow. She held a seven-colored treasured sword in her hand, and her heroic appearance was captivating.
This woman was a beauty on the same level as the empress, Chi Menghan, and the others. Thus, when they saw her, quite a number of men revealed expressions of infatuation.
However, which one of those who could enroll into the Ancestral King Academy wasn’t a prodigy?
When they heard this woman’s words, they all looked furious.
“Humph, now that the Imperial Sons has advanced into the Spirit Transformation Tier, how many of them are still stuck at the True Self Tier?” they retorted.

The beauty waved the treasured sword in her hand, “Alright, then please send out Spirit Transformation Tiers and Minor Advanced Tiers. We’ll have a fair battle and see who can block ten moves from Brother Origin.”
Brother Origin?
Looks like this woman was the noble daughter of the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan, and the wife of Origin.
Looking at this woman’s exquisite beauty, and looking at Origin’s calm expression that showed a faint mockery, it naturally made a great many Imperial Sons angry.
“All right, I’ll battle you!” Cheng Qing was the first to jump out.

He had once been the strongest of the True Self Tier. Though his abilities could not be ranked in the Spirit Transformation Tier at present, suppressing his cultivation level in a battle of True Self Tier, his battle prowess was definitely astonishing.
“Seventh Grandfather, please set it up!” That beauty turned her head, and said respectfully in a certain direction.
Peng!
Instantly, a massive piece of damaged rock dropped down from the skies, landing heavily on the empty space in front of the academy gates.
This rock was extraordinarily heavy, shaking the ground so much that it trembled madly.
Everyone looked over. This rock looked ordinary, but there were streaks of light flickering at its fractures, giving it a mysterious feeling.
“If you battle on this rock, everyone’s cultivation level will be pulled to the same level,” the beauty said. “Come on.”

F***, this was too exaggerated, wasn’t it?

“He only broke some records on the Galaxy Network. Does he really think he’s all that impressive?”
“The Imperial Clans have never been on the Galaxy Network.”
“Without the participation of the Imperial Clans, what meaning is there to this kind of first place?”

“How arrogant!” Another Silver Generation exchanged blows with him, but he did not manage to avoid Cheng Qing’s fate. He first delivered three moves, and then was defeated in a single move by Origin.

The third, the fourth, the fifth... so what if he suppressed his cultivation level? Origin displayed a powerful dominance, and on the level of True Self Tier, he was not only invincible, but also overwhelming.
Later on, even a Golden Generation elite made a move, but he was still defeated in two to three moves.
This triggered an earthquake.

The Golden Generation was the strongest generation, and even if this Golden Generation that had made a move was the weakest existence among them, he was still a whole lot stronger than the Silver Generation.
Hiss!
Was this guy who had created a freakish record on the Galaxy Network really invincible among his peers?
But no matter what, they could not allow him to be so arrogant.
If they were really blocked at the door, and all of them bowed their heads in submission, how would they be able to face others in future?
The problem was, even the Golden Generation had lost. Was there really anyone who could defeat Origin?
“Imperial Son Xuan should be able to. Unfortunately, in order to break through his limits, he has gone to some barren land to train!”
“On the other hand, Imperial Son Qing and Imperial Son Ming have already advanced into Venerate Tier, and have long since left the academy.”
“Even the three strongest members of the Golden Generation are unable to move. The others probably won’t be able to suppress Origin either.”
“What do we do? Are we really going to allow him to continue being so arrogant?”
Right at this moment, the little azure dragon stepped onto the stage and issued a challenge to Origin.

At present, he was the number one elite in the True Self Tier of the Ancestral King Academy. However, even the Golden Generation had lost, so everyone naturally did not have much confidence in him. When they saw him ascend the stage, no one cheered him on.
This infuriated the little azure dragon. Why was there no one optimistic about him?
“Grandpa Dragon is very angry, and the consequences are very serious!” the little azure dragon said.
Meanwhile, Origin smiled and said, “Not bad, you’re even stronger than those trash from before! To defeat you, I might need 100 moves, or even more.”
No one would’ve thought that Origin would have such a high opinion of the little azure dragon.
Yet the little azure dragon wasn’t happy at all. It took the initiative to attack, and said loudly, “Pei, how could Grandpa Dragon possibly lose to you!”
The two of them immediately began a fierce battle.

The little azure dragon was extraordinary. In the past, he had been able to exchange blows with Ling Han. Now that he had cultivated the Imperial Scroll his abilities had naturally increased even further.
Sure enough, he was locked in a fierce battle with Origin. At this moment, it was hard to decide who was stronger between the two of them.

chapters.title: Chapter 4335: Extortion
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Everyone was captivated by the sight.
Who would’ve thought that the little azure dragon would be so powerful!

Although he was currently number one in the True Self Tier, there were the likes of powerful characters like Ling Han and Ding Shu, and added with the fact that the Silver Generation had all broken through to the Spiritual Transformation Tier, the value of the little azure dragon being number one was naturally insufficient.
Only now did they know that the little azure dragon was truly awesome.

“That’s right. You are worthy of me showing my true strength!” Origin stated calmly. Boom, nine streaks of dense black mist suddenly surged out of his body, and his whole aura changed immediately. Boom, he sent out a palm strike, and terrifying divine patterns intertwined.
“Pei! Grandpa Dragon is also going to show his true abilities!” The little azure dragon never let people off the hook easily. It immediately opened its mouth and spat out saliva.
“Yo!” The little red bird immediately covered its nose, its expression filled with disgust.
She was not the only one. The expressions of the others were more or less the same. This fighting style was too shameless.
Yet Origin was expressionless. He continued to strike with his palm, and under the boiling of energy, his saliva was immediately annihilated. It was impossible for his saliva to spit onto anyone.
Boom, the attack landed, its might indescribably terrifying.
The little azure dragon was instantly sent flying, blood seeping from the corner of its mouth.
With his powerful physique, he was still wounded?
Origin’s strength was truly terrifying.
The little azure dragon wanted to continue fighting, yet Ling Han leaped over and forcefully dragged it away.
“You’re not going to battle me?” Origin suddenly asked.
“Me?” Ling Han smiled faintly, “Why should I battle you?”
He had come to the Ancestral King Academy for the sake of cultivation resources and to disgust the Imperial Clans. How could he possibly fight for them?
Origin faltered for a moment, then nodded at Ling Han, but didn’t say anything.
“Let go, Grandpa Dragon hasn’t lost yet!” The little azure dragon was still defiant.
“You’re no match for him,” Ling Han said with certainty.
The little azure dragon humphed, but didn’t say anything else. Just now, he was just being stubborn as per usual.
After a while, he said, “This Origin’s strength is not inferior to Ding Shu.”
Ling Han nodded in understanding. He had the same feeling.
“Next.” Origin continued to provoke, his voice calm. He did not look the slightest bit smug just because he had defeated a few Imperial Sons.
But the more this was the case, the more furious everyone was.
Showing off subconsciously was the most detestable thing.
“Ding Shu!” These Imperial Sons all thought of one person.
Very quickly, Ding Shu was invited over.
When he found out the identity of Origin, Ding Shu immediately cried out. Without anyone provoking him, he himself leaped onto the damaged rock.
“I’ve always wanted to meet the four of you,” he said loudly.

These words came out of nowhere, but Ling Han knew that Ding Shu had always wanted to battle Origin, Myriad Dao, Heaven Crushing, and Number One in the Galaxy. Now that his chance had come, he was naturally excited.
A solemn expression appeared on Origin’s face, and he said, “You are a good opponent.”
“Haha, come fight me!” Ding Shu charged out, striking out furiously with his palms.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The two of them battled fiercely. Neither of them used their Spirit Tool, and merely used their own strength to their heart’s content.
Ding Shu was indeed strong, not the slightest bit inferior to Origin. The two of them exchanged blows, and it was hard to decide who was stronger between them.
After several hundred exchanges, Ding Shu finally unleashed his trump card. A mysterious glow enveloped his body, and his battle prowess instantly soared by three Heavens.
In this kind of fierce battle, if one’s battle prowess suddenly increased by three Heavens, that could directly decide the outcome of the battle.

However, it was clear that Originhad also been guarding against Ding Shu’s ultimate move. Eighteen streaks of black aura suddenly exploded from his body, turning into eighteen giant demonic snakes that counterattacked Ding Shu.
Boom!
Their most powerful attacks clashed, and both of them trembled. They both retreated, and then began to vomit blood.

Both of their powerful attacks were directed at each other. Thus, once they unleashed their powerful attacks, it was inevitable that their attacks would be stronger, while their defenses would be weaker. This would cause considerable damage to both of them.
“I’ve lost.” Ding Shu sighed.
Everyone was curious. Wasn’t this clearly a tie?
“In that attack just now, I also used a sliver of Spirit Transformation Tier-level comprehension,” Ding Shu said.
‘F*ck! You’re far too honest!’
If you didn’t reveal it, who would know?
Everyone was speechless. How could there be such a person?
Origin, on the other hand, smiled, and said, “All right. When I break through to Spiritual Transformation Tier, I’ll go all out in battle with you again.”
“All right!” Ding Shu nodded, and very decisively jumped off the damaged rock. “Great! Great!” He strode off, still laughing loudly.
Crazy!
Everyone shook their heads, but even Ding Shu admitted that he was outmatched, so who else could they look for?
Ling Han?
Everyone turned to look at Ling Han. Then, they all frowned, their expressions awkward, as if they had swallowed flies.

To put it bluntly, the Ancestral King Academy was jointly established by a great many Imperial Clans, and in the eyes of the Imperial Clans, Ling Han was like a thorn, prickly, bothersome, and heart-piercing! Thus, after Ling Han entered into the academy, he was repeatedly targeted.
If it was not for the fact that he still had the Nine Mountains Saint behind him, he would probably have long since been killed, and his corpse thrown into a smelly ditch.
And now, they had to depend on Ling Han to fight against Origin?
No matter how they thought about it, it was a headache.
But aside from Ling Han, who else could stand against Origin?
They couldn’t let this guy sit at the academy’s entrance forever, right? Otherwise, the Ancestral King Academy would really become a joke in the world.
“Ling Han, you take the field,” a Silver Generation elite said to Ling Han. However, this wasn’t a request, but rather a command.
Ling Han pretended not to hear.
“Ling Han, this concerns the academy’s honour and humiliation, don’t be too selfish!” Another Silver Generation attacked Ling Han.
F***, why didn’t you guys say this when you all came to issue a challenge?
Ling Han ignored him.

With him being so profligate, no one could do anything about it. However, they couldn’t allow Origin to continue being arrogant, so some higher ups of the academy came to find Ling Han, hoping that he could make a move.
“Sigh, I’ve been challenged for the past few days, so my body is very weak now,” Ling Han immediately complained to this big shot.
‘F*ck you!’
The big shot’s expression was strange. It wasn’t like he didn’t know that Ling Han hadn’t fought at all these days, so how could he be weak?
Oh, this guy was taking advantage of the opening to extort him.

“All right, as long as you can defeat Origin, I will give you a portion of cultivation resources,” he said through gritted teeth. There was nothing else that could be done. At present, he could only allow Ling Han to extort him.
Ling Han shook his head and said, “My body is weak, so one portion isn’t enough nutrition.”
That big shot gritted his teeth, “Two portions!”
“Ten portions!” Ling Han made an exorbitant demand. This was a rare opportunity.
“Impossible!” That big shot refused immediately.
“Ten portions would only be equivalent to ten months’ worth. I haven’t even asked for a year yet,” Ling Han said with a smile. “How about it? If it’s a deal, I’ll go. If not, then forget it.”
That big shot stared at Ling Han with a fierce gaze.
Ling Han was unafraid, and merely smiled.
They wanted him to make a move, yet did not give him any benefits. How could that be possible!
“All right!” That big shot agreed, “The prerequisite is that you must win.”
“Don’t worry, I can’t lose,” Ling Han said calmly. He strode forwards, and had already leaped onto the damaged rock.

chapters.title: Chapter 4336: Ling Han makes his move
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“I thought you didn’t want to fight me?” Origin asked with a smile.
Ling Han rubbed his hands together, and said, “I’ve already been paid enough appearance fees, so I naturally don’t mind making a move.”
“Haha!” Origin laughed loudly, but he soon shook his head, “However, there is no way you would be a match for me.”
“Oh?” Ling Han raised a brow slightly.
“At the same cultivation level, there is no one that can be my match,” Origin said calmly, as if he was just talking about something that could not be more ordinary.
Ling Han also smiled, “That’s good. I am also invincible among my peers, and can sweep aside all opposition.”
Hearing the conversation between these two people, all the Imperial Sons felt an urge to beat someone up.
You guys are really too condescending. To say such words in front of so many Imperial Sons, aren’t you afraid that they would be forced to eat their words?

But in truth, Ling Han had indeed swept aside all opponents at the same cultivation level, and Origin had also used his abilities to prove that no one was a match for him in a battle of equal cultivation levels.
Now, this was the stage for the competition between the two of them. The others were all mediocre, and were only qualified to stand below the stage and watch the battle.
“There is no first place in literature, and no second place in martial arts,” Origin said, and beckoned Ling Han over, “Between the two of us, only one can be invincible among his peers!1”
“Come!”
Ling Han laughed loudly, and charged towards Origin.
How could Origin possibly dodge? He charged towards Ling Han.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Neither of them used any kind of feint. The moment they started fighting, they attacked madly, unleashing their full battle prowess.
After a few moves, Ling Han had a complete understanding of Origin’s strength.
The peak stage of the ninth form of the True Self Tier, which was equivalent to Ding Shu.

Ling Han somewhat understood why he had come here to issue a challenge at the beginning. That was because this guy also had the idea of breaking through to the Tenth Form, and wanted to obtain the appreciation of breaking through by fighting with top prodigies.

He shook his head. If he wanted to break through to the tenth form, not only would he need appreciation, he would also need the Power of Dimension, and he couldn’t even have used it while breaking through to the ninth form.
What did this signify?
Origin was the master of a Genesis World!
Was that possible?
How could there be so many masters of Genesis Worlds in this universe? It should only be him and Ding Shu.
However, Origin was indeed very strong. No wonder he could fight Ding Shu to a stalemate. In fact, in the end, it was still Ding Shu that was slightly inferior.

Ling Han shook his head. If he was also in the ninth form, then Origin could be considered an excellent opponent. However, he had broken through to Spiritual Transformation Tier from the tenth form. Even if he suppressed his cultivation level to True Self Tier, he would still have the terrifying battle prowess of the tenth form.
Who could stand against him?
Ling Han instantly gained the upper hand, completely suppressing Origin.
This caused the Imperial Sons to have mixed feelings.

On the one hand, they could not bear to see how arrogant Origin was, and hoped that his arrogance would be suppressed, but on the other hand, they too did not want to see Ling Han being so awe-inspiring. In fact, they hoped to see Ling Han being defeated.
Why weren’t they the one who was so powerful?
Origin was extremely tenacious. Even though he was at a disadvantage, he still persisted, searching for a chance to turn the tables.
However, in front of Ling Han, how could such an opportunity possibly exist?
Ling Han was decisive and agile. With a few heavy punches, he defeated Origin.
This was a crushing advantage. Even if Origin still had powerful moves that he had yet to use, it would not be able to affect the outcome.
“I’ve lost.” He smiled calmly, then communicated through divine sense, “You have attained the tenth form!”
This was very obvious. To be able to crush his Ninth Form, there could only be the Tenth Form.
Ling Han neither denied nor admitted. He merely smiled slightly, turned and left.

After Origin was defeated, he quickly completed the admission procedures. He was sent here by the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan. Even if the Ancestral King Academy had previously been humiliated, how could they not accept him?

Ling Han obtained ten portions of cultivation resources. Though the academy didn’t like him, it wasn’t to the extent that they would go back on their word. Thus, Ling Han refined these resources happily, but even ten portions of cultivation resources were only enough for a few months.
The Spiritual Body of Destruction was gradually becoming complete, and it wouldn’t be long before it reached the consummate level of First Change.
But what was he to do next?
Ling Han sighed. In terms of cultivation resources, it was really worrying him to death.
However, at this moment, a piece of news spread out from the academy.
The lair of an ancient Divine Beast had been discovered!
What Divine Beast?
The True Phoenix!

In ancient myths, the True Dragon and the True Phoenix were equals. If one could discover some Celestial medicine, rare treasure or whatnot in the lair of the True Phoenix, the gains would naturally be nature-defying.
After learning of the news, even the little red bird couldn’t sit still any longer. It wanted to go and explore the lair of the True Phoenix.

According to her, the Vermillion Bird and the True Phoenix both belonged to the Fire Element category. Although the True Phoenix was slightly inferior to the Vermillion Bird, their Mystical Power was similar, so it still had great value in cultivation.
Che, speaking as if once she entered into the lair of the True Phoenix, the secret technique of the True Phoenix would be placed in front of her.

Very soon, further information was revealed. As it turned out, this lair of the True Phoenix was discovered by the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan. However, to enter into this lair of the Divine Beast, it was difficult!

According to the Saint’s deduction, the True Phoenix should have died here. There was a Great Emperor-level killing formation here. Thus, it was unrealistic to rely on a Saint to charge in with the Imperial Weapon.
If one wanted to enter, they would need to use the blood of a large number of prodigies to be able to create an opening.
The Thousand Bird Imperial Clan had already tried, but even all the prodigies of an entire Imperial Clan could only create a small opening, and it could not be passed through at all.

It was also because of this that the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan had come to the Ancestral King Academy. Firstly, they wanted to announce their reappearance, and secondly, they wanted the Ancestral King Academy to send out a large number of outstanding disciples to open the lair of the True Phoenix with them.
The elites of the academy discussed for a while, and then decided to send their disciples to the lair of the True Phoenix.
Thus, the next step was to select people.

Naturally, everyone wanted to go to this lair of the True Phoenix, but the more people that went, the lesser their gains would definitely be. Thus, the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan only gave them a hundred spots.
The elites made their arrangements, and as expected, Ling Han didn’t get a spot.
He wasn’t the only one. The large black dog, the little azure dragon, and the others also didn’t get a spot.
It was obviously deliberate.
In terms of talent, Ling Han was no weaker than the Golden Generation at all. In fact, he was even more talented than them. If even he wasn’t qualified to receive a spot, who else was?
However, the Ancestral King Academy was controlled by the various Imperial Clans. They didn’t want to give Ling Han and the others a spot, so what could Ling Han and the others do?
Make a protest?

Hehe, even if the Nine Mountains Saint came over with the Imperial Weapon, there was absolutely no need for them to give any face. Not killing Ling Han was their bottom line, and they still had to help Ling Han become stronger? What a joke.
This caused Ling Han and the others to feel both angered and exasperated. How could them, being as weak as they were, be able to oppose the will of Saints and Venerate Tiers?
What could they do? Could it be that they would have to miss out on such a good opportunity?
Right at this moment, someone came to visit Ling Han.
Origin.
“I heard that you were targeted, and didn’t get a spot?” Origin came straight to the point.
Ling Han smiled and said, “It can’t be helped. I am too outstanding. As the saying goes, the tallest tree in the forest will be destroyed by the wind.”
Origin laughed loudly, “I can give you a few spots.”
“Oh?”

chapters.title: Chapter 4337: Who is mocking who?
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han looked at Origin.

Ling Han didn’t doubt that the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan could give him a spot. In fact, they could even give him a few spots. He was the ideal son-in-law of the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan. Moreover, the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan also seemed to want to nurture him as the future Ancestral King, pouring a lot of effort into raising him.
Thus, Origin definitely had this bit of value to get a few spots.
However, he would not accept a reward without doing something for it.
“What requests does Brother Origin have?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“A favor.” Origin smiled faintly, and raised a finger.
Ling Han shrugged and said, “There are a little too many people I want to bring.”
“That would be a very big favor.” Origin’s expression did not change, and he still maintained a slight smile.
“Deal.” Ling Han stretched out his hand.
Origin also stretched out his hand. The two of them shook hands, and a deal was reached.
Next, the disciples selected through the Ancestral King Academy’s selection set out, heading first to the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan.
“Ling Han, hoho.”
“After all, they are not real members of Imperial Clans, so what right do they have to compete with us?”
“Just obediently stay home.”
“No matter how freakish you are, so what? If your cultivation level can’t keep up, what right do you have to talk about competing for the throne?”
When these Imperial Sons set out, they couldn’t help but run over to mock and ridicule Ling Han when they saw him standing at the gates of the academy.
Could you still be so awesome now?
Hehe, he was just a lowly commoner, so how could he compare to them?
Pei!
Ling Han stood calmly with his hands clasped behind his back.
“Yo, you’re still pretending to be calm?” An Imperial Son laughed loudly, an expression of disdain on his face.
“Who knows how much pain he’s feeling now.”
“That’s for sure. He could only watch us leave, while he himself could only look and sigh. If it was me, I would also feel bitter.”
These people continued to mock him. This was a rare opportunity.

“Bunch of idiots.” The large black dog gave the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters the middle finger in return. “When you’re slapped in the face later, I hope your faces are thick enough and won’t swell.”
The Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters sneered at the large black dog’s provocation. With their status, how could they bicker with a demonic dog?
The hundred people were divided into ten groups, each led by a Venerate Tier elite. They tore a rip into the Void and headed towards the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan.
Because some Venerate Tiers came earlier, while some came later, a portion of them set out first.
After about half of the group had left, Origin and his wife walked over.
“Brother Ling!” Origin called out from afar.
“Brother Origin!” Ling Han nodded as well.
Yi, what was going on?
The remaining people were all watching in a daze. Wasn’t Ling Han the one who had defeated Origin? Why did the two of them look like good friends now?
At this time, Origin and hsi wife had also come close.
“Come, let me introduce. This is my wife, Lao Pengpeng.” Origin pointed at the beauty beside him.
Meanwhile, this beauty acted reserved for a while. After all, she was a member of the Imperial Clan, so she was putting on a lot of airs.
Ling Han naturally didn’t mind this. He smiled at Lao Pengpeng and said, “Miss Lao.”

“These are all of you?” Origin swept an eye over Ling Han and the others. Aside from Ling Han, there was also the empress, Hu Niu, the large black dog, the little azure dragon, the little red bird, the perverted pig and Ding Shu—since he had taken in this lackey, he had to take care of him.
“Too much?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“It’s fine.” Origin nodded. He didn’t even need to ask for Lao Pengpeng’s opinion, and directly agreed.

On the sidelines, Lao Pengpeng had no intention of objecting at all. The gaze she directed at Origin was filled with admiration and reverence. By the looks of it, she had already been completely captivated.

With Origin’s talent, he was completely on the level of the Golden Generation, or even surpassed it. Thus, the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan definitely placed great importance on him, and nurtured him like an Imperial Son.
“Seventh Grandfather, we can set out now,” Origin said to a certain place, his expression respectful.
Ling Han knew that the two of them had been escorted here by a Saint. Thus, this Seventh Grandfather must be the Saint of the Lao Clan.

As expected, as his words fell, a white-browed and white-bearded old man suddenly appeared. He first looked at Ling Han for a while, then tore open the Void. Then, he stretched out a hand, and grabbed Ling Han and the others. Xiu, they sank into the Void.
“Haha, you’ve become stupid, haven’t you?” The large black dog laughed loudly, his eyes sweeping over the Imperial Sosn and Imperial Daughters who were dumbfounded outside the Void.
Xiu, the rip in the Void had already closed.
The remaining Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters were indeed dumbfounded. What was going on here?

At first, they had thought that Ling Han and his group could not possibly go to the lair of the True Phoenix, and the big shots from the academy had deliberately suppressed them. No matter how naturally talented Ling Han was, so what?
But who would have thought that Ling Han would actually make a connection with the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan, and directly go to the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan through this connection?
How was the academy going to stop Ling Han now?
“Perhaps... they are only inviting them as guests, and may not be able to enter into the lair of the True Phoenix.” An Imperial Son was still stubborn.
“That’s right. After all, that is the lair of the True Phoenix. One more person entering would mean a smaller share of the gains,” someone nodded in agreement.
However, most people wore gloomy expressions. If they were just going to pay a visit, was there any need to choose this kind of time?
Don’t deceive yourself.
Damn it, they had been mocking him so hard just now, but in the end, the other party did not even need to say a word, and had slapped them all in the face.
There was only one word for it: depressed!

Though Ling Han and his group were not the first to set out, because it was a Saint bringing them with him on their journey, their speed naturally far surpassed that of Venerate Tier. Merely three days later, they were the first to break through the Void and arrive on a planet.

This planet was enshrouded by a great formation, and from the outside, it looked completely empty, as if it did not exist at all, and if anyone dared to barge in forcefully, even a Saint would be killed.
Great Emperor killing formation!

This was the ancestral grounds of the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan. They had been protected by the Great Emperor killing formation for generations, and as long as there was no internal strife, they could exist for eternity.

After arriving, Ling Han and the others had accommodations arranged for them. After waiting for a few more days, the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters were all in place, and they would then go to the lair of the True Phoenix.
A few days later, the first batch of people to set out arrived.
They were also arranged to stay in a courtyard nearby. The group was enraptured, and seemed to be very happy.
“... Haha, I really reminisce about Ling Han’s expression at that time.”
“He couldn’t even say a single word!”
“That’s right. A lowly commoner is a lowly commoner. The moment it comes to this, he would show his true colors. Aside from scowling, what else could he do?”
“After this adventure to the lair of the True Phoenix ends, I still have to give him a good mocking when I return.”
“En, we have to let him know what we have gained, and make him die of envy.”
These people chatted as they walked, and very soon, a figure appeared ahead of them. He was presently sitting under a large tree and drinking tea.
“Yi, why does this figure look a little familiar?”
“Impossible, we’re the first batch of people to arrive, and in the case of the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan, we don’t know anyone.”
“So strange, I also feel that this person looks a little familiar.”
“Let’s go take a look.”
These people quickened their pace, and soon reached him. Then, the latter turned around to take a look.
‘F*ck!’
In that instant, everyone was turned into stone.
F***, Ling Han!
— New chapter is coming soon —

Great Emperor killing formation!
This was the ancestral grounds of the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan.
They had been protected by the Great Emperor killing formation for generations, and as long as there was no internal strife, they could exist for eternity.
After arriving, Ling Han and the others had accommodations arranged for them.
After waiting for a few more days, the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters were all in place, and they would then go to the lair of the True Phoenix.
A few days later, the first batch of people to set out arrived.
They were also arranged to stay in a courtyard nearby.
The group was enraptured, and seemed to be very happy.
Haha, I really reminisce about Ling Han’s expression at that time.”
“He couldn’t even say a single word!”
“That’s right.
A lowly commoner is a lowly commoner.
The moment it comes to this, he would show his true colors.
Aside from scowling, what else could he do?”
“After this adventure to the lair of the True Phoenix ends, I still have to give him a good mocking when I return.”
“En, we have to let him know what we have gained, and make him die of envy.”
These people chatted as they walked, and very soon, a figure appeared ahead of them.
He was presently sitting under a large tree and drinking tea.
“Yi, why does this figure look a little familiar?”
“Impossible, we’re the first batch of people to arrive, and in the case of the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan, we don’t know anyone.”
“So strange, I also feel that this person looks a little familiar.”
“Let’s go take a look.”
These people quickened their pace, and soon reached him.
Then, the latter turned around to take a look.
‘F*ck!’
In that instant, everyone was turned into stone.
F***, Ling Han!

chapters.title: Chapter 4338: Face-slapping Again
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
How could it possibly be Ling Han?
Shouldn’t this guy be filled with envy in the Ancestral King Academy?
But was there anyone in this world that looked so similar?
All of a sudden, these Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters were all dumbfounded, completely rendered speechless.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and put down his teacup, “What is it? I haven’t seen you for a few days, and you don’t recognize me anymore?”
This tone... that’s right, it must be Ling Han!
The Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters were all certain that Ling Han was definitely the only one who could say such a very ordinary thing but would attract so much hatred.
“Why are you here?” Guan Xia asked.
This was also what the others were curious about. They all turned their eyes to Ling Han.
“Oh, I asked the people of the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan for help, and they brought me here,” Ling Han said very casually.
Pei!
This was a chance to enter into the lair of the True Phoenix, so how precious was it? How could it be given to you just because you asked for it?

You see, the Ancestral King Academy only had a hundred slots. Furthermore, this was still because opening the lair of the True Phoenix required a great amount of blood from prodigies. Otherwise, the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan would definitely have benefited from it on their own. Why would they have taken out such a great opportunity to share with others?

However, the problem was that Ling Han was indeed sitting here. Moreover, he had arrived here before them. Thus, he had definitely been brought here by a Saint. After some calculations, the person was definitely a Saint from the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan.
‘Ah, ah, ah, I’m about to go crazy!’

These Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters all wore awkward expressions. At first, they had thought that they would be able to leave Ling Han far behind them — so what if you are freakishly talented? If your cultivation level is low, you would still be trampled on by others.
But now? Ling Han had come!
Previously, they had been mocking and conceited, but now, it seemed like they were mocking themselves. How embarrassing!

“Ling Han, you’re too despicable!” Kong Wuyang shouted angrily. Previously, he had been thrashed by Ling Han, and even now, he was still unable to raise his head in the academy. Now, he had been tricked by Ling Han, which made him extremely furious.
“You clearly could have come here as well, yet chose to keep it a secret, and laugh at us. How shameless!”
Ling Han was astounded. ‘This can become a reason for you to reprimand me?’
Oh, if I can’t get a place, I’ll be mocked by you guys. If I get a place, you guys wouldn’t be able to mock me, and it’s my fault?
This was too ridiculous, wasn’t it?
“Are you asking for a beating?” Ling Han asked calmly. Towards someone who couldn’t even make heads or tails of the situation, “convincing others with strength” was the best choice.
Kong Wuyang was instantly rendered speechless. In terms of battle prowess, he was truly no match for Ling Han.

“Ling Han, you’re very arrogant!” another Imperial Son said. He was the Silver Generation elite of the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan. His name was Di Luo, and he was one of the top ten elites of the Spiritual Transformation Tier. He had most likely reached the Sixth Change or above that.
Ling Han smiled calmly, “If you have the strength, so what if you act a little arrogant?”
“You are courting death!” Di Luo’s baleful voice rang out, “If I want to kill you, it would not exceed ten moves, at most.”
This was not an exaggeration, but rather because he already knew Ling Han’s strength, and that was why he had such confidence.
“Come on then.” Ling Han crooked a finger at him, “Within ten moves, if you can even touch the corner of my robes, you win.”
Boom!
Di Luo took a step forwards, his terrifying aura surging. Even if those around them were Imperial Daughters and Imperial Sons, they still felt their scalps go numb.
Too strong!
“Brother Di, it’s time to teach this brat a lesson.”
“Humph, always avoiding battle in the academy. Now that we’re here, where else do you have to hide?”
“Beat him up!”
A considerable number of Imperial Sons hooted. Naturally, they had all been personally taught a lesson by Ling Han. For example, Kong Wuyang, Guan Xia, and Xu Youque.
The image of a silver wolf appeared behind Di Luo, and it suddenly howled at the sky. A soundless wave rippled out.
This was divine sense, and it instantly surged into everyone’s minds.
Even if this attack was aimed at Ling Han, and the others were only affected by a slight ripple, they still felt as if their souls were about to be sucked away.
This was a Mystical Power of the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan. Its name was Demon Wolf Soul Devourer, and it was an extremely terrifying Mystical Power that could penetrate one’s mind.
Boom, Ling Han’s mind rippled.
The Spiritual Body of Destruction immediately unleashed a supreme might, easily dispersing the Demon Wolf Soul Devourer.
It would be rude not to reciprocate.
Ling Han wanted to unleash his murderous aura attack, but it wasn’t as if he didn’t have soul-level attacks!
Hold on, the Imperial Son had a precious tool left behind by the Great Emperor to protect his soul. The barrage of murderous aura would not be effective. He had long since experimented with this.
Yi, that horn?
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s mind. This horn had astonishing effects on the Wolf Tribe. He wondered if it would be useful for this Di Luo?
“Die!” When Di Luo saw that the Demon Wolf Soul Devourer was ineffective, he immediately launched another attack.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

He was at least a Spiritual Transformation Tier Sixth Change elite, and was also a Silver Generation elite. Thus, his battle prowess naturally far surpassed Ling Han’s. As he delivered his attack, he turned into a snow-white wolf that was formed by Regulations. High-level energy surged, and its destructive power was incredibly terrifying.
Even Ling Han didn’t dare to come into contact with it. The gap in battle prowess was too wide. If he was hit, even if he didn’t die, he would be severely injured.
His figure retreated rapidly, and with a wave of his hand, the Earth Dragon rose up, blocking that fierce wolf.
Peng!
The ferocious wolf was terrifying. With a single crash, the Earth Dragon was shattered, and it pounced towards Ling Han again.
Thankfully, with this buffer, it was enough for Ling Han to put some distance between them.

However, Di Luo continued to attack, and more and more silver wolves appeared on the scene. Each silver wolf possessed great destructive power, causing Ling Han to have less and less space to move around.
“Good one!”
“It’s time to extinguish this brat’s spirit. Does he really think that he can blot out the heavens with one hand?”
“This world still belongs to us, the Imperial Clans!”
All the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters were cheering for Di Luo. Though the battle was not over yet, the result was already clear.
Ling Han had definitely lost. The only difference was when he would lose.
Was that the case?
Ling Han took out the horn, and with the help of the Earth Dragon, he quietly blew it.
A soundless shockwave spread out, and Di Luo’s attack came to an abrupt stop.
What was going on?

All the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters were curious. As long as he continued to press his advantage, Ling Han’s defeat should have been within a few moves. Why had Di Luo wasted such a good opportunity?
Before anyone could ask, they could clearly see that Di Luo had suddenly sprawled out on the ground. Then, they heard pa, pa, pa.
This was the sound of clothes tearing.
Yi?
They were all dumbfounded with shock, and they could see that Di Luo’s clothes had already been forcefully torn apart, revealing his snow-white fur.
—This Silver Generation elite had actually turned back into his original form in public!
This?
The Demon Wolf Imperial Clan was a member of the Demon Race and Wolf Tribe. Everyone knew this, so it was not strange that Di Luo could take the form of a wolf.
The question is, why are you in wolf form now?
And what was even more shocking was that after Di Luo turned into a wolf, he actually wagged his tail happily, and jogged towards Ling Han, using his head to rub against Ling Han’s leg.
Are you really an Imperial Son? Are you really a member of the Wolf Tribe?
This was clearly a dog, trying to please its master!
At this moment, everyone was dumbfounded.
