chapters.title: Chapter 4339: Imperial Son acts like a dog
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
In truth, Ling Han was only giving it a try. After all, Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters all had treasures to protect their souls.
However, this Great Emperor Horn had extraordinary effects on the Wolf Tribe. Thus, Ling Han took it out to give it a try.

He had not deliberately targeted Di Luo, but in truth, the others were not affected at all, that all of them were howling at the skies, but Di Luo had uncontrollably taken the form of a wolf, and treated him like his master.
Hiss, this horn was really aimed at the Wolf Tribe.
Who exactly had made it?
An enemy of the Wolf Tribe?
Firstly, this had to be the bone of a Great Emperor. Otherwise, others could not possibly have obtained the bone of a Great Emperor, and refined it.
But what Great Emperor would do something so pointless?
If they were dissatisfied with the Wolf Tribe, they could directly erase them.
Could it be that this Great Emperor had a wicked sense of humor, and wanted to make the Wolf Tribe his eternal slave?
Hold on, that wasn’t right either.
You see, the power of other Imperial Clans could all resist the Great Emperor Horn, but only Di Luo could not... er, could it be that this was a technique of the Wolf Emperor?

Only if the Wolf Emperor acted, would he be able to avoid being affected by the great power of a Great Emperor. That was because the precious tool that Di Luo possessed was created by him in the first place, so he naturally could easily render it ineffective.
That should be the case.
The surroundings were completely silent, with only the sound of Di Luo continuously sticking out his tongue and wagging his tail. He could not be any more obedient.
Ling Han cracked a smile, looked towards Kong Wuyang and the others, then pointed with his finger, “Bite!”
“Ao!” Di Luo immediately pounced out.

At this moment, it was as if all his intelligence had been erased, and he had turned into a wild wolf. The only difference there was between him and wild beasts was that he would obey Ling Han’s commands.
Chaos instantly swept through the surroundings.
Di Luo was extremely powerful, ranked in the top 10 of the Spiritual Transformation Tier. If he attacked, he alone would be enough to suppress the combined forces of Kong Wuyang and the others.
“Yi!”
At this time, the second batch of Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters arrived. Seeing this scene, they couldn’t help but be dumbfounded.
—Di Luo had actually taken the form of a Demonic Beast, and was hunting down Kong Wuyang and the others?
What kind of enmity was this? Moreover, you have the absolute advantage in strength, so what do you mean by turning into the original form of the Demon Race?
“The situation is slightly off!” the Imperial Daughter of the Wentian Imperial Clan, Yan Feiyao, said. She immediately charged out, approaching Di Luo.

At present, Di Luo was no longer under the control of his reason. He was completely supported by his instincts, that he could only obey Ling Han’s commands. Seeing that someone was stopping him from completing his command, he naturally moved to attack without any reservations.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

The two of them battled fiercely. Yan Feiyao was similarly strong. She was also one of the top ten Spiritual Transformation Tier elites, and her battle prowess was not inferior to Di Luo at all. But now, one of them seemed to have gone mad, completely disregarding the possibility that he would be injured or crippled. Every move was fatal, and this naturally caused great pressure on Yan Feiyao.
She was still rational, so how could she possibly fight so desperately with Di Luo?
Thus, she was naturally at a disadvantage.

Thankfully, it wasn’t long before a third wave of people arrived. This time, there was a Sect Master elite that had already advanced into the Minor Advanced Tier. He moved, and directly suppressed Di Luo.
After asking about the situation, the two groups of people that came later all looked towards Ling Han.
It was already inconceivable that this guy could come here, and now, as they fought, he actually caused Di Luo to lose all reason, and directly turn into the form of a Demon Wolf?
What the hell?
Imperial Sons had a precious tool that had been personally forged by the Great Emperor. It could protect the soul, and even Saints could not affect it.
Thus, Di Luo’s sudden loss of reason was incredibly bizarre.
“Ling Han, what despicable means have you used?” the Sect Master-level the Imperial Son shouted at Ling Han, his expression extremely proud.
This was natural. He was the Golden Generation, and after advancing into the Minor Advanced Tier, a Sect Master could be called a great elite.
He was... Imperial Son Kui!

Ling Han had seen him in the True Dragon Abyss before. At that time, this person had even wanted to kill him. He had never thought that just as he was about to enter the lair of the True Phoenix, the two of them would meet again.
Was this considered fate?
Ling Han smiled calmly, “Don’t use your knowledge as a frog at the bottom of a well to guess my abilities.”
Hiss, this was publicly provoking him.
Imperial Son Kui smiled coldly and balefully. Without another word, he immediately attacked.

Boom, he was too strong. This was Sect Master-level. As he stretched out his right hand, black-coloured demonic clouds blotted out the skies and covered the earth. At least, everything within a radius of 50km was within the range of his attack.
However, Ling Han was no ordinary Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator!
He activated the Star Steps, and xiu, he instantly disappeared.

Imperial Son Kui frowned upon hearing this. He truly deserved to die. The Star Steps was far too freakish. In fact, he could even manage to escape from the hands of a Venerate Tier elite. He was only at the level of Sect Master, so it was even more impossible for him to capture Ling Han.
How could a mere SpiritTransformation Tier cultivator be so difficult to kill?
At this time, Di Luo also slowly recovered.
He did not dare take human form, because his clothes had all burst when he had “transformed” just now. If he took human form now, he would be completely naked.
Er, he might as well just play dumb.
Di Luo lay motionless on the ground, his heart filled with killing intent.

He had actually made such a huge fool of himself in front of so many people, causing him to be filled with hatred towards Ling Han. However, the moment he thought of that figure, he actually felt a sense of reverence rise up from the depths of his heart.
How was this possible?
His strength was clearly far superior to Ling Han, so why did he revere such a human?
After a few Star Steps, Ling Han returned to his room. The battle with Di Luo and the others could only be considered a diversion, and he did not take it to heart.
Several days later, everyone had arrived.
All right, he could go to the lair of the True Phoenix now.
The Saint from the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan moved out, bringing everyone into the depths of the universe. Not too long after, they stopped in an empty galaxy.
This was the lair of the True Phoenix?
That Saint summoned the Imperial Weapon. After awakening it, hong, a terrifying Imperial Might surged out, causing a great many people to involuntarily tremble.
And this was still because the people that had come here were all Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter-level. Otherwise, they would not just be shivering, but would directly kneel down.
Weng, at this moment, the Void in front of them seemed to have reacted. A ray of light circulated, and then a massive bird’s nest appeared.
This was really a bird’s nest, though it had been enlarged countless times over. In fact, it was even larger than most planets.
The bird’s nest was crimson red in colour, and circulated with brilliance, as if it was burning. There was an indescribable majesty about it.
This was the lair of the True Phoenix?
“Blood,” the Saint from the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan said.
Everyone had long since prepared themselves, and they all slit their wrists, squeezing out some blood.
The Saint from the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan collected all of this blood, then pressed it forwards.
Boom, the red light trembled, and a passageway suddenly appeared.
“It’s open!”
“A secret technique of the True Phoenix!”
Everyone looked expectant.

“According to legends, the most powerful secret technique of the True Phoenix is the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. This is a movement technique. In the past, when the True Phoenix ventured out, as she passed, supreme flames lit up the surrounding galaxy.”
“Not only that, but Phoenix Wings Divine Flight also possess a powerful offensive ability. The Extermination True Flames they stimulate are also incredibly terrifying.”
“We must obtain it!”
The Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters’ eyes lit up.

It was already inconceivable that this guy could come here, and now, as they fought, he actually caused Di Luo to lose all reason, and directly turn into the form of a Demon Wolf?
What the hell?
Imperial Sons had a precious tool that had been personally forged by the Great Emperor.
It could protect the soul, and even Saints could not affect it.
Thus, Di Luo’s sudden loss of reason was incredibly bizarre.
“Ling Han, what despicable means have you used?” the Sect Master-level the Imperial Son shouted at Ling Han, his expression extremely proud.
This was natural.
He was the Golden Generation, and after advancing into the Minor Advanced Tier, a Sect Master could be called a great elite.
He was...
Imperial Son Kui!
Ling Han had seen him in the True Dragon Abyss before.
At that time, this person had even wanted to kill him.
He had never thought that just as he was about to enter the lair of the True Phoenix, the two of them would meet again.
Was this considered fate?
Ling Han smiled calmly, “Don’t use your knowledge as a frog at the bottom of a well to guess my abilities.”
Hiss, this was publicly provoking him.
Imperial Son Kui smiled coldly and balefully.
Without another word, he immediately attacked.
Boom, he was too strong.
This was Sect Master-level.
As he stretched out his right hand, black-coloured demonic clouds blotted out the skies and covered the earth.
At least, everything within a radius of 50km was within the range of his attack.
However, Ling Han was no ordinary Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator!
He activated the Star Steps, and xiu, he instantly disappeared.
Imperial Son Kui frowned upon hearing this.
He truly deserved to die.
The Star Steps was far too freakish.
In fact, he could even manage to escape from the hands of a Venerate Tier elite.
He was only at the level of Sect Master, so it was even more impossible for him to capture Ling Han.
How could a mere SpiritTransformation Tier cultivator be so difficult to kill?
At this time, Di Luo also slowly recovered.
He did not dare take human form, because his clothes had all burst when he had “transformed” just now.
If he took human form now, he would be completely naked.
Er, he might as well just play dumb.
Di Luo lay motionless on the ground, his heart filled with killing intent.
He had actually made such a huge fool of himself in front of so many people, causing him to be filled with hatred towards Ling Han.
However, the moment he thought of that figure, he actually felt a sense of reverence rise up from the depths of his heart.
How was this possible?
His strength was clearly far superior to Ling Han, so why did he revere such a human?
After a few Star Steps, Ling Han returned to his room.
The battle with Di Luo and the others could only be considered a diversion, and he did not take it to heart.
Several days later, everyone had arrived.
All right, he could go to the lair of the True Phoenix now.
The Saint from the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan moved out, bringing everyone into the depths of the universe.
Not too long after, they stopped in an empty galaxy.
This was the lair of the True Phoenix?
That Saint summoned the Imperial Weapon.
After awakening it, hong, a terrifying Imperial Might surged out, causing a great many people to involuntarily tremble.
And this was still because the people that had come here were all Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter-level.
Otherwise, they would not just be shivering, but would directly kneel down.
Weng, at this moment, the Void in front of them seemed to have reacted.
A ray of light circulated, and then a massive bird’s nest appeared.
This was really a bird’s nest, though it had been enlarged countless times over.
In fact, it was even larger than most planets.
The bird’s nest was crimson red in colour, and circulated with brilliance, as if it was burning.
There was an indescribable majesty about it.
This was the lair of the True Phoenix?
“Blood,” the Saint from the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan said.
Everyone had long since prepared themselves, and they all slit their wrists, squeezing out some blood.
The Saint from the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan collected all of this blood, then pressed it forwards.
Boom, the red light trembled, and a passageway suddenly appeared.
“It’s open!”
“A secret technique of the True Phoenix!”
Everyone looked expectant.
“According to legends, the most powerful secret technique of the True Phoenix is the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.
This is a movement technique.
In the past, when the True Phoenix ventured out, as she passed, supreme flames lit up the surrounding galaxy.”
“Not only that, but Phoenix Wings Divine Flight also possess a powerful offensive ability.
The Extermination True Flames they stimulate are also incredibly terrifying.”
“We must obtain it!”
The Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters’ eyes lit up.

chapters.title: Chapter 4340: Lair of the True Phoenix
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“Go on.” The Saint from the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan led the way, wanting to enter into the passageway.
However, he had only taken one step when he stopped. It was not that he had changed his mind at the last minute, but rather that he had been blocked by an invisible force.
He had a feeling that if he tried to be stubborn, he would be torn to shreds.

When the Imperial Weapon awakened, he would naturally be safe. However, the problem was that a Saint couldn’t keep the Imperial Weapon in a constant awakened state. Thus, he definitely couldn’t be stubborn.
This was most likely the Great Emperor killing formation. Even though it could only act as a static defense, it was a hundred times more terrifying than the Imperial Weapon.
Saints couldn’t enter, and when the Venerate Tiers tried, their expressions also changed drastically.
Right, even Venerate Tiers wouldn’t be able to.
Then what about Sect Masters?
It still wouldn’t work.
It wasn’t until the Spirit Transformation Tiers took their turn, that they weren’t affected by the Great Emperor killing formation, allowing them to pass safely.
The Spiritual Transformation Tier was fine, the True Self Tier was fine, and even slightly lower cultivation level could enter.
In other words, this Great Emperor killing formation only placed a maximum limit on cultivation level, and had no requirements for the minimum level.

Ling Han’s heart calmed. Without a Sect Master elite competing with him, even if he was no match for a Seventh Change or Eighth Change when he encountered them, he would still be able to escape easily, and would not have to depend on the Star Steps.
It could be imagined that in this lair of the True Phoenix, ley lines should not exist.
Everyone entered one after another, and those Golden Generation elites that had long since advanced into Sect Master Tier looked livid.
Such a great opportunity, and they could only watch helplessly as it passed them by?

To say nothing of the fact that the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters of the other clans couldn’t possibly share their gains with them, even if it was from their own clan, who didn’t want to become Emperor? Would they take it out to share?
Thus, they could only miss out on this great opportunity.
“Humph!” The Golden Generation elites all flicked their sleeves before turning around to leave.
They had lost blood essence for nothing, yet it was only paving the way for others. They were furious.

Ling Han walked in front, while Ding Shu was the last. After walking for a long time, they suddenly felt a powerful suction force. Even Ling Han was unable to resist. With a xiu, they were all sucked in.
Instantly, their figures sped up, and the scene that they saw also underwent a massive change. The stars and the sun flashed past them like a revolving lantern1.
“Aiyo!”
Their bodies suddenly trembled, and they were sent flying.
Where was this?

They looked around, and saw that this was actually a primeval forest. Huge trees grew everywhere. These trees were very strange. The trunks were crimson red, and the leaves that grew were like flames. There was clearly no wind, but every single leaf was flickering and burning.

They came closer to take a look, and saw that the leaves of this tree were really flames. However, the strange thing was that though the leaves were burning flames, the tree trunk did not look like it was burning at all.
Huala, right at this moment, endless flames suddenly boiled from the forest, soaring into the skies.
No, these weren’t flames, but rather firebirds!
These birds were all formed from flames, and as they flapped their wings, they released strange screeches as they swooped towards Ling Han and the others.
Everyone hurriedly counterattacked, but the moment they came into contact, they felt tremendous pressure.

These firebirds weren’t difficult to kill, but what was terrifying was that when they were burnt to death, they would all self-explode. Terrifying energy surged, capable of easily burning a Spirit Transformation Tier elite to severe injury.
One or two was still fine, but the point was that there were too many fire birds here. If they exploded in groups, that would be terrifying.
To say nothing of Ling Han, even Spirit Transformation Tier elites such as Di Luo and the others couldn’t withstand it. They immediately turned around and fled.

However, firstly, the path of return was already gone. They had been sucked in, and secondly, even if the path that they had come from was stil there, they would not leave. Oh, they had just entered, and were already chased off, and they still wanted the secret technique of the True Phoenix?
Thus, everyone fled in all directions. At this time, it was naturally themselves that was most important, so how could they have the time to care about others?

Ling Han protected the empress and the others as they retreated. Ding Shu was his capable assistant while the perverted pig barely managed to avoid being a burden for them.. As for the others, because the large black dog, the little azure dragon, and the others hadn’t stepped into the Spirit Transformation Tier yet, they didn’t dare to make a move at all. Otherwise, if the firebird exploded beside them, that would really be a suicidal action.
As the group battled, they retreated, leaving the forest far behind. Only when a large river appeared ahead of them did those fire birds finally give up their pursuit, and turned around to return.
Everyone examined themselves, and all of them were injured.

Ling Han and Ding Shu were the main force, so they naturally bore the brunt of it. Meanwhile, the empress, the large black dog, and the others were affected because their cultivation level was too low. Merely being affected by the flames that had exploded from the firebird was enough to cause them serious injury.
They had gained some time to catch their breath, and hurriedly stopped to rest.

Thankfully, everyone had cultivated the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique. This was Body Arts, which also had astonishing effects on healing injuries. As long as their foundations were not damaged, they could still recover very quickly.
Ling Han was the first to finish resting. He stood up and explored the surrounding environment.
Soon, his attention was focused on that great river.
Previously, he had not had the time to pay attention, but from the look of things now, Ling Han couldn’t help but bare his teeth, because this was not a river, but rather surging lava!
He walked closer, and saw that there were seals continuously popping up in the lava. That was the concentrated energy of high-level flames. If he was burned, he would definitely be in trouble.
It was said that the True Phoenix had passed away in the True Phoenix’s lair. Thus, was the forest of flames and river of lava formed from the Regulations of the True Phoenix after its death?
That was the level of a Great Emperor, so no matter how powerful it was, it was understandable.
Yi?
Ling Han looked ahead, only to see that there was actually a small mountain floating in the lava river.
What kind of mountain was this, that it could actually not be melted by the lava?
Ling Han was very curious. This was no ordinary lava, but rather the condensation of high-level energy, which could easily burn Divine Metal.
Treasure?
He walked in the direction up course of the flow of the river, heading towards that small mountain.
One was going down the river’s course, while the other was going up the river’s course. Naturally, they met very quickly.
Now that they were closer, Ling Han naturally could see more clearly. This small mountain was shaped like a regular ball, but it was not rounded, and was exuding an ancient aura.
However, was there really something strange about this?
Ling Han activated his eye technique, wanting to see clearly. However, the power of the boiling flames blocked his vision, and he couldn’t see clearly.
Hua!
Right at this moment, the river of lava suddenly boiled, and a large amount of crimson lava was poured out, falling towards Ling Han.
Ling Han retreated quickly. With a swoosh, the lava landed on the bank, immediately burning fiercely.
Boom, a massive soundwave rippled out, and that small mountain suddenly rose up. Then, a massive pillar was seen crashing towards Ling Han.
This wasn’t a pillar.
This time, Ling Han could clearly see that what was floating in the river wasn’t a small mountain at all, but a fire turtle!
Presently, it was precisely this fire turtle that was attacking him. With a stomp, its skin was covered with dark red divine patterns.
Boom!

chapters.title: Chapter 4341: Swarm of bees
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han rapidly retreated.

This fire turtle was at the peak stage of the Spirit Transformation Tier, and it was at least on the level of the Sixth Change or even the Seventh Change. If he faced it head-on, he would only be making things difficult for himself.
Boom, the fire turtle’s leg stomped down, shaking the ground madly.
The large fellow missed its target, and immediately emerged from the river of lava, chasing after Ling Han.
“Ha, you’re getting more excited?” Ling Han chuckled lightly, and a murderous aura burst forth.
Weng, the fire turtle’s movements instantly paused.

Even if you are Spirit Transformation Tier Sixth Change or Seventh Change, so what? As long as one didn’t have a special technique or a treasure that could block spiritual attacks, they would still be hit.
Ling Han took advantage of the opening to slash out with the divine saber. Wrapped in a cold, high-level energy, it just happened to be the complete opposite of the fire turtle’s attributes.
Pu!
The divine saber struck, but the fire turtle didn’t even sway, showing its terrifying defense.
Turtle had always been synonymous with high defense, and it was indeed true.
On the other side, the fire turtle also recovered from the barrage of murderous aura, and stepped over again.
Ling Han still didn’t face it head-on. This time, he used the black light of illusion, immediately stopping the fire turtle’s movements.

Though this fire turtle’s cultivation level was above Ling Han’s, its Spiritual Power was not all that impressive. Otherwise, even if it had been hit, the effects should not have been able to last for so long.
The heavens were just, bestowing on the Turtle Race an incredibly tough outer shell, but the soul was relatively much weaker.

Relying on the two spirit-level secret techniques, Ling Han battled with the fire turtle, not falling into a disadvantage at all. However, the fire turtle’s powerful defense also took effect, preventing Ling Han from wounding it.
This battle was boring. Ling Han feinted and turned to run.
The fire turtle only gave chase for a while, then stopped, turned and left, returning to the river of lava.
Ling Han returned to where the empress and the others were. At this time, they had mostly recovered.
“Let’s go.”
“Where are we going?”
“Let’s walk against the flow of this lava river.”

The True Phoenix was of the Fire Element, so it was extremely likely that the end of this lava river was related to the True Phoenix. In fact, it was even possible that it was born from the True Phoenix.
They did not get too close. There may be other fire turtles in the lava river. This kind of fierce beast had thick hide, and was really not easy to deal with.
They had not walked too far, when they felt waves of heat surge towards them. They could clearly see that there were sparks floating in the air. No wonder the temperature had begun to spike.
Everyone hurriedly raised their mystical power shields. Firstly, it was to resist the high temperature, and secondly, these sparks were extremely terrifying, posing a threat to them.
And even if they had put up the mystical power shield, after getting hit by the sparks, cracks soon appeared on the mystical power shield, which then shattered.
They had no choice but to decrease their speed to reduce the intensity of the sparks that they had to sustain.
“It’s so hot.” Ling Han, Ding Shu, and the perverted pig were all fine, but the empress and the others were all covered in sweat.

It made sense for this place to allow cultivators of the Spiritual Transformation Tier to enter. Those at the True Self Tier and Cauldron Forging Tier could indeed enter, but against such high temperatures, how many people would be able to resist?

Only the little red bird was like a fish in water. She was born with a natural love for fire, and not only did she not feel the slightest bit of discomfort, she instead seemed to feel very comfortable.
They continued to advance. As long as they could withstand it, they might as well challenge their own limits, which would be helpful in cultivation.
After walking for a few more days, they had not yet reached the end of the lava river, when they saw that a large field of flowers had appeared on their right side, fiery red in colour.
“Is that... the Flower of Flames?” Everyone looked over, and they all looked surprised.

This kind of plant was only knee-height in height. Its roots were like blood jade, and had no leaves. There were only flowers blooming on its top, bright red like fire. Furthermore, they were also flickering like flames.
When they got a little closer, everyone could feel the waves of fire rolling out, easily disintegrating the mystical power shield.
“Come, let’s go take a look,” Ding Shu said to Ling Han.
Ling Han nodded, then looked towards the lecherous pig, “Together?”
“Wu!” The perverted pig hurriedly shook its head. It was best not to call it over for this kind of thing. If it was an invitation to go out to eat, drink, and have fun, it would gladly agree.
However, the little red bird flapped its wings and landed on Ling Han’s shoulder.
“Hey, is it appropriate for you to stand on your Master’s shoulder?” Ling Han turned his head and asked.
The little red bird pouted proudly, and did not reply.

The two of them advanced, their speed not very fast, because the closer they were to the continuous expanse of flowers, the more astonishing the waves of fire would be, causing even them to be slightly wary, and not dare to run too fast.
However, the little red bird was completely unafraid. It flapped its wings again and flew into the flower field.
This was the awesomeness of bloodline. It had a natural affinity with flames, that had nothing to do with its cultivation level.
Weng, above the flower field, fiery red Regulations would occasionally appear.

These were Regulations of Fire, and their level was considerably high, causing both Ling Han and Ding Shu to be dumbfounded. If they came into contact with them, they would probably be burnt to death in an instant.
They circled around the flower field, wanting to see if there was anything special about it. However, because they couldn’t approach, and couldn’t go deeper, they naturally didn’t discover anything.
“Let’s go.”
The two of them said at the same time. They couldn’t tell what was going on here.
They turned around, and just as they were about to return, they saw the little red bird fly up from the distance. Then, as if it was fleeing for its life, it shot towards them.
Then, they saw a large mass of fiery red things soar into the air, chasing after the little red bird.
“Save me!” the little red bird shouted as it flew.

Ling Han focused his gaze. This fiery red thing was a swarm of bees, and every single one of them was the size of a fist. However, their numbers were endless, and there were still a great many that were flying out of the flower field.
These swarms of bees had been harvesting honey, and in the end, they were alerted by the little red bird?
“Run!” Without another word, Ling Han immediately turned around and fled.
Ding Shu didn’t try to be brave either, and he similarly broke into a run.

These swarms of bees were all at the Spiritual Transformation Tier. Even if Ling Han and Ding Shu were freakishly powerful, firstly, they had just advanced to the Spiritual Transformation Tier, after all. Secondly, even if both sides were at the same cultivation level, they would only be able to fight against a thousand opponents at most.
The numbers of the swarms of bees?
As far as they could see, there were at least tens of thousands of them, what more when there was still an endless swarm of bees flying out.
Block?
How were they supposed to block this?
Neither Ling Han nor Ding Shu ran towards the empress and the others. If they attracted the swarm of bees there, the casualties would be great.
“Little Red Bird, what did you do?” Ling Han asked as he ran.
Had it dug up their ancestral grave? Otherwise, how could it have caused such a huge commotion?
“No, I just flew over to take a look. Who knew that these demonic bees would attack me indiscriminately?” the little red bird said very aggrievedly. She was also very depressed.
They ran madly, but these swarms of bees did not stop their pursuit just because they were too far away, and continued to pursue them relentlessly.
“F***!” Ding Shu was enraged. He turned around and shot out a murderous aura attack.
Instantly, weng, weng, weng! The demonic bees that were in the lead all fell straight down onto the ground.
But it was not of much use. The demonic bees behind them followed, endlessly.
— New chapter is coming soon —
WRITE A REVIEW

This kind of fierce beast had thick hide, and was really not easy to deal with.
They had not walked too far, when they felt waves of heat surge towards them.
They could clearly see that there were sparks floating in the air.
No wonder the temperature had begun to spike.
Everyone hurriedly raised their mystical power shields.
Firstly, it was to resist the high temperature, and secondly, these sparks were extremely terrifying, posing a threat to them.
And even if they had put up the mystical power shield, after getting hit by the sparks, cracks soon appeared on the mystical power shield, which then shattered.
They had no choice but to decrease their speed to reduce the intensity of the sparks that they had to sustain.
“It’s so hot.” Ling Han, Ding Shu, and the perverted pig were all fine, but the empress and the others were all covered in sweat.
It made sense for this place to allow cultivators of the Spiritual Transformation Tier to enter.
Those at the True Self Tier and Cauldron Forging Tier could indeed enter, but against such high temperatures, how many people would be able to resist?
Only the little red bird was like a fish in water.
She was born with a natural love for fire, and not only did she not feel the slightest bit of discomfort, she instead seemed to feel very comfortable.
They continued to advance.
As long as they could withstand it, they might as well challenge their own limits, which would be helpful in cultivation.
After walking for a few more days, they had not yet reached the end of the lava river, when they saw that a large field of flowers had appeared on their right side, fiery red in colour.
“Is that... the Flower of Flames?” Everyone looked over, and they all looked surprised.
This kind of plant was only knee-height in height.
Its roots were like blood jade, and had no leaves.
There were only flowers blooming on its top, bright red like fire.
Furthermore, they were also flickering like flames.
When they got a little closer, everyone could feel the waves of fire rolling out, easily disintegrating the mystical power shield.
“Come, let’s go take a look,” Ding Shu said to Ling Han.
Ling Han nodded, then looked towards the lecherous pig, “Together?”
“Wu!” The perverted pig hurriedly shook its head.
It was best not to call it over for this kind of thing.
If it was an invitation to go out to eat, drink, and have fun, it would gladly agree.
However, the little red bird flapped its wings and landed on Ling Han’s shoulder.
“Hey, is it appropriate for you to stand on your Master’s shoulder?” Ling Han turned his head and asked.
The little red bird pouted proudly, and did not reply.

The two of them advanced, their speed not very fast, because the closer they were to the continuous expanse of flowers, the more astonishing the waves of fire would be, causing even them to be slightly wary, and not dare to run too fast.
However, the little red bird was completely unafraid.
It flapped its wings again and flew into the flower field.
This was the awesomeness of bloodline.
It had a natural affinity with flames, that had nothing to do with its cultivation level.
Weng, above the flower field, fiery red Regulations would occasionally appear.
These were Regulations of Fire, and their level was considerably high, causing both Ling Han and Ding Shu to be dumbfounded.
If they came into contact with them, they would probably be burnt to death in an instant.
They circled around the flower field, wanting to see if there was anything special about it.
However, because they couldn’t approach, and couldn’t go deeper, they naturally didn’t discover anything.
“Let’s go.”
The two of them said at the same time.
They couldn’t tell what was going on here.
They turned around, and just as they were about to return, they saw the little red bird fly up from the distance.
Then, as if it was fleeing for its life, it shot towards them.
Then, they saw a large mass of fiery red things soar into the air, chasing after the little red bird.
“Save me!” the little red bird shouted as it flew.
Ling Han focused his gaze.
This fiery red thing was a swarm of bees, and every single one of them was the size of a fist.
However, their numbers were endless, and there were still a great many that were flying out of the flower field.
These swarms of bees had been harvesting honey, and in the end, they were alerted by the little red bird?
“Run!” Without another word, Ling Han immediately turned around and fled.
Ding Shu didn’t try to be brave either, and he similarly broke into a run.
These swarms of bees were all at the Spiritual Transformation Tier.
Even if Ling Han and Ding Shu were freakishly powerful, firstly, they had just advanced to the Spiritual Transformation Tier, after all.
Secondly, even if both sides were at the same cultivation level, they would only be able to fight against a thousand opponents at most.
The numbers of the swarms of bees?
As far as they could see, there were at least tens of thousands of them, what more when there was still an endless swarm of bees flying out.
Block?
How were they supposed to block this?
Neither Ling Han nor Ding Shu ran towards the empress and the others.
If they attracted the swarm of bees there, the casualties would be great.
“Little Red Bird, what did you do?” Ling Han asked as he ran.
Had it dug up their ancestral grave?
Otherwise, how could it have caused such a huge commotion?
“No, I just flew over to take a look.
Who knew that these demonic bees would attack me indiscriminately?” the little red bird said very aggrievedly.
She was also very depressed.
They ran madly, but these swarms of bees did not stop their pursuit just because they were too far away, and continued to pursue them relentlessly.
“F***!” Ding Shu was enraged.
He turned around and shot out a murderous aura attack.
Instantly, weng, weng, weng!
The demonic bees that were in the lead all fell straight down onto the ground.
But it was not of much use.
The demonic bees behind them followed, endlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 4342: Stealing honey
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“F***, damn bird, what sins have you committed!” Ding Shu couldn’t help but complain.
The little red bird was speechless. She really hadn’t done anything.
Ling Han grabbed the little red bird and threw it away.
Xiu, the little red bird deviated from its original course, and headed diagonally to the side.

It could be seen very clearly that the swarm of bees immediately changed their course, and all of them set off in pursuit of the little red bird. Not one of them charged towards Ling Han and Ding Shu at all.
As expected.
Ling Han dashed over, catching up to the little red bird and grabbing onto it.
The little red bird: “...”
‘You’re having a lot of fun.’
“As expected, you’re not a good bird,” Ding Shu immediately said.
Just look, the swarm of bees are targeting you, and you still claim that it wasn’t you who dug up their ancestral grave?
Meanwhile, the little red bird was extremely depressed. She was really very innocent.
Meanwhile, Ling Han shook his head and said, “The swarm of bees has indeed targeted Little Red. However, it’s extremely likely because they discovered her bloodline.”
The True Phoenix and Vermillion Bird were both Divine Beasts, and they both belonged to the Fire Element, so the two had something in common.
Perhaps, this was the reason.
“No matter what the reason is, it looks like the swarm has high hopes for this little bird,” Ding Shu said. “Why don’t we just toss her back?”
When the little red bird heard this, it was so scared that it spread its wings and wrapped them around Ling Han’s wrist. It wouldn’t let go even if it died.
Ling Han turned around to look. The swarm of bees blotted out the sky and covered the earth, and there was practically no end in sight.
‘You really think I can’t deal with you guys?’
Ling Han retrieved the Great Emperor Horn, and forcefully blew on it.
A soundless wave rippled out, and instantly, the swarm of bees paused, then howled at the sky.
A group of demonic bees suddenly imitated the howls of wolves. What kind of scene was this?
In any case, Ding Shu and the little red bird were both dumbfounded, their faces twitching.
This scene, f***.
Not only them, but even the swarm itself was quite dumbfounded.
What was going on?
They were the Bee Race, so why had they howled like wolves? What reason was there? Was there something wrong with their brains?
Or could it be that our ancestors actually have the bloodline of the Wolf Tribe?
Of course, the difficult problem of reproduction could be set aside for the moment.
After a pause, the swarm of bees gave chase again.
Just see if I won’t scare you guys off!
Ling Han continued to blow, and the swarm of bees instantly howled like wolves again.

“This thing is so useful!” Ding Shu was envious. He had seen Ling Han use this precious tool in the Dark Clouds Hell. At the time, even Venerate Tiers would be affected, and now, he was facing mere Spirit Transformation Tiers, so it was naturally more impossible for them to be a match.
“Lend it to me for a few days?” he asked.
“Hehe.” Ling Han naturally wouldn’t agree.

And just like that, they continued to blow the Great Emperor Horn to stop the swarm of bees. The distance between the two sides became larger and larger, and finally, they managed to successfully break free.
“Hu!” Ling Han and Ding Shu both breathed a sigh of relief. There were hundreds of thousands of these bees, and even they felt a headache coming on.
After a short rest, Ling Han looked towards Ding Shu, and Ding Shu was also looking towards Ling Han.
“Is what you’re thinking exactly what I’m thinking?” the two of them asked at about the same time.
“Haha!” They laughed loudly.
Meanwhile, the little red bird shrugged its shoulders and flapped its wings. Men were truly strange creatures. The words they spoke were all baffling.
The two of them turned around and headed towards the flower field.
“Oi, oi, oi!” The little red bird was extremely anxious. They had just barely managed to break free from the swarm, so what was the point of them going back?
“Where there are bees, there will be honey!” Ling Han said with a smile. “Those are Spirit Transformation Tier-level demonic bees, and the honey they produce, tsk tsk!”
Ding Shu also licked his lips, and looked tempted.
This kind of honey was definitely very nutritious.
“Are you all crazy?” the little red bird shouted.

The swarm of bees was terrifying in number. Once they were surrounded, they would definitely be done for. Oh, they had just barely managed to escape, and you guys actually want to run back on your own?
‘I’ve never seen anyone like you before.’
“Then I’m not going to accompany you!” the little red bird said. It hurriedly flapped its wings and fled.
“Hehe, be loyal!” Ling Han grabbed the little red bird, not allowing her to escape.
—The little red bird was unafraid of the Regulations of Fire. In this place, she could go deeper into some places that they could not enter. How could such a good helper be wasted?
The little red bird chirped strangely, and was about to curse. However, how could it compare to Ling Han’s strength? It was tightly gripped.
The two of them returned, and soon arrived near the field of flowers.
“Let’s find out where the beehive is.”
The two of them surveyed the surroundings, while they released their spiritual bodies to increase the efficiency of their search.
After a while, Ding Shu made a discovery.
They walked over, and saw that there was a massive beehive growing on top of a rock.

This beehive was really huge. It was practically a small-scale castle. It was completely fiery red in colour, and there was also lava-like liquid flowing out of the nest. Without even coming close, they could feel a powerful wave of heat assaulting them.

Ling Han and Ding Shu were also unable to approach. That fiery red liquid should have been manifested by the Regulations of Fire, and had surpassed the level that they could touch at present. They could not block it at all.
Hence — both of them looked towards the little red bird.
“Hey, hey, hey, what do you mean by looking at me like that?” The little red bird suddenly felt a strong sense of foreboding.
Ling Han chuckled, “Little Red, do I treat you well?”

“If you suddenly ask this, how am I supposed to answer!” the little red bird said coyly. Honestly, Ling Han was still quite nice to her. Though he forcibly considered himself her Master, he did not really treat her like a servant. Furthermore, he gave her as much Divine Metal of all types as she wanted.
“Now, it’s time for you to show your worth.” Ling Han pointed at the beehive.
“F***, you’re not going to ask me to steal honey, are you?” The little red bird bristled, and hurriedly shook its head vigorously.
“You’re right.” Ling Han nodded.
“I don’t want to die at all!” the little red bird shouted.
“I’m not sending you to your death. I’m just harvesting some honey. Look at how agitated you are,” Ling Han said with a smile.
The little red bird rolled its eyes madly. Was this just plucking some honey? That was going deep into the wolves’ den!
“I’m not going!” She refused to agree.
Ling Han cracked a smile, and the little red bird instantly had a bad premonition.
“What do you want?” the little red bird asked in a trembling voice.
Ling Han raised his hand and threw it. Xiu, the little red bird was thrown out.
The little red bird was about to cry. This was the second time, b@stard!
Pa, the little red bird directly crashed into the beehive.

If it had been Ling Han or Ding Shu, they would probably have been burnt to death by now. However, though the little red bird’s cultivation level was low, it was born with a natural affinity for flames, so this was no big deal. It was just a little dizzy from the impact.
Weng, at this moment, at least over a thousand demonic bees rushed out, all of them exuding vicious might.
“Save me!” The little red bird hurriedly ran back.
Ling Han took out the Great Emperor Horn, and blew it strongly. Instantly, the swarm of bees all stopped, and then howled at the sky.
This scene, tsk tsk.
However, the little red bird flew back in a flash, and did not stop at all. It continued to flap its wings, wanting to leave Ling Han and Ding Shu, the two maniacs, far behind.
“Hehe!” Ding Shu moved, and grabbed the little red bird back. Then, he threw it back at the beehive.
Pa, the little red bird was once again dizzy from the impact.
This was the third time, and while there were some things that could be tolerated, there were some things that could not.

chapters.title: Chapter 4343: Opening the doors to the palace
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

At this moment, the little red bird even wanted to commit murder. It secretly swore that as long as her cultivation level surpassed Ling Han and Ding Shu, it would definitely use the two of them as punching bags every day.
Of course, she was also prepared now, and knew that it was useless even if she ran back. Those two rough guys didn’t know how to treat a female tenderly at all!
As she lamented the hardship of her life, she began to harvest the honey.
One after another, Ling Han continued to blow the horn of the Great Emperor, causing the swarm of bees to howl like wolves endlessly.

Hence, in truth, the little red bird was not the slightest bit endangered. Though it looked very frightening from the surface, and she was surrounded by furious demonic bees, they would occasionally raise their heads and howl like a wolf. Taking a moment to savor it, it was actually still very comical.
Not long after, the little red bird had already emptied the beehive, and hurriedly ran back.
“Are you satisfied now?” The little red bird threw the honey at Ling Han, looking very angry.
Ling Han put away the honey, and stroked the little red bird’s head, “This little guy is quite capable.”
Damn it!
The little red bird really wanted to turn Ling Han bald with a single breath of fire. She was the daughter of a Divine Beast, and who knew how precious she was.
“Stop playing, let’s retreat quickly,” Ding Shu said.
Without the suppression of the Great Emperor Horn, these demonic bees that had their home base dug out were already about to go crazy.
“Run!”
The two of them hurriedly fled, while using the Great Emperor Horn to delay their pursuers, successfully shaking off the swarm of bees.
After going around in a circle, they found the empress and the others.
“Where did you guys go?” Hu Niu asked.

“Big Sister Niu Niu!” The little red bird hurriedly pounced over, and immediately began to tell on Ling Han. It chattered endlessly, and spoke at an extraordinarily fast speed, recounting how Ling Han had “abused” her.
“Big Sister Niu Niu, you have to seek justice for me!” she said coquettishly.
“Whatever Niu’s Ling Han wants you to do, you’ll do.” Hu Niu said with a very strange expression. She really didn’t know where the little red bird’s resentment came from.
The little red bird: “...”
‘You two are truly a family. I’m impressed!’
“Come, there’s something good.” Ling Han took out some honey, and everyone had a share.
—Most people were only at the True Self Tier, so a single piece of honey was enough for them to refine for a very long time.
“Refine it first,” Ling Han said. “Although only Spirit Transformation Tier-level vicious beasts have appeared so far, there are too many of them. At present, we are still unable to resist.”
Thus, every bit of strength that could be increased would be useful.
Everyone nodded, and began to refine it.
After a month, all the honey had been consumed, and everyone’s strength had improved greatly.

The little azure dragon had already cultivated to the Ninth Form, but the large black dog couldn’t break through the restrictions of the Eighth Form no matter what. It couldn’t be helped. Although it had also obtained a lot of opportunities, it could only match the Golden Generation at most, but couldn’t surpass it.
Actually, this was already awesome enough. However, compared with Ling Han and Ding Shu=, it seemed to pale in colour.
Ling Han also successfully advanced into the Spirit Transformation Tier. Now that he had two spiritual bodies, his battle prowess increased greatly.
Ding Shu was not outdone either. He had actually surpassed Ling Han, and had similarly advanced into the Second Change.
“What a good thing,” Ling Han said ruefully. “If we empty out a few more beehives, we’ll be able to soar to the peak stage of the Spiritual Transformation Tier.”
When the little red bird heard this, it involuntarily took a few steps back.
F***, were they planning to have designs on her again?
“Come, let’s set out.”
They continued to advance along the lava river, and after walking for about seven days, a palace actually appeared ahead of them. It was completely crimson red, as if it was burning.
“The habitat of the True Phoenix?” Everyone showed an expression of delight.
However, this was too smooth, wasn’t it? They had found it just like that?
They continued to walk forwards, and soon arrived at the great doors of the palace.

However, the palace doors were tightly shut, and a large number of people had gathered in the plaza in front of the palace doors. They were all the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters who had entered this time.
By the looks of it, no one could open the palace doors, so everyone was blocked outside.
However, because they suspected that the inheritance of the True Phoenix was here, no one was willing to give up and leave.
“Ling Han!” A cold rebuke rang out, and one of the Imperial Sons looked towards Ling Han.
One of the well-known members of the Silver Generation, Yi Xiangyang of the Blood Flame Imperial Clan, Spirit Transformation Tier Seventh Change!
He was Di Luo’s good friend, so when he found out that Di Luo had been humiliated by Ling Han, he was naturally furious.
“I’ve finally found you!” He moved directly, launching an attack at Ling Han.
They were all in the Spiritual Transformation Tier, so even if he killed Ling Han in public, the Nine Suns Saint wouldn’t be able to say anything.
The words of a Saint were naturally like the Regulations. If one disobeyed, they would be punished by the heavens.
Ling Han let out a battle cry and charged towards Yi Xiangyang.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The two of them exchanged blows, but the moment they came into contact, Ling Han was at a complete disadvantage.

The Seventh Change was far too powerful. Not only did he have a crushing advantage over Ling Han in terms of power, but he also had seven spiritual bodies. Thus, the boost to his battle prowess was far too great.
Weng, right at this moment, the cracks in the tiles in the plaza lit up at the same time. Instantly, no one dared to move again. Even Yi Xiangyang suddenly stopped his attack, and stood on a tile.
“Watch your steps.” Ling Han immediately transmitted a message to the empress and the others, “Don’t place your foot over two floor tiles.”
The empress and the others naturally wouldn’t ignore Ling Han’s words, and they all acted accordingly.
Weng, the light in the crevices in the tiles suddenly rose up, which was equivalent to instantly dividing this plaza into tens of thousands of squares.
Ling Han merely swept an eye over these rays of light, and felt a strong sense of fear.
This was definitely capable of instantly piercing through his physique.
No wonder even Yi Xiangyang had stopped attacking. Otherwise, he would have been dismembered.
The beam of light rose to the height of half a human, then stopped.
At this time, everyone was sprawled out on the ground.
When Ling Han saw this, he immediately crouched down as well. There was no need to issue any further commands. The empress and the others followed suit.
Shua, the light that had risen began to spin, as if it was stirring.
If anyone was still standing at this moment, they would definitely be sliced in half.
These rays of light channelled endlessly, and kept changing shapes. However, the people here seemed to be familiar with it, and could always react in advance. Thus, it was a close call.
After about ten minutes, these beams of light disappeared.
Boom!

Yi Xiangyang charged over once more. This was not the academy grounds. In a competition over treasures in ancient sites, casualties and injuries were inevitable, and he did not have to bear any responsibility.
Ling Han didn’t take it head-on. The gap in cultivation level was really too wide.
Retreat.
Hong long long, right at this moment, a loud sound was heard, and the doors to the palace actually opened!
Yi?
At this moment, everyone withdrew their gazes from the battle between Ling Han and Yi Xiangyang, and looked towards the inside of the palace.
However, it was pitch-black inside, and nothing could be seen clearly.
Ling Han looked over, only to see the innocent little red bird standing at the entrance. It was she who had opened the palace doors just then.

—This little bird was incredibly eager to obtain the inheritance of the True Phoenix. Thus, she quietly ran to the doors of the palace, wanting to sneak in. Unexpectedly, the doors were unexpectedly opened.
Perhaps it was because of her bloodline.
As if fearing that Ling Han would reprimand it, the little red bird covered its mouth and hurriedly ran into the palace.

sentences.text: Editor: Henyee Translations
At this moment, the little red bird even wanted to commit murder.
It secretly swore that as long as her cultivation level surpassed Ling Han and Ding Shu, it would definitely use the two of them as punching bags every day.
Of course, she was also prepared now, and knew that it was useless even if she ran back.
Those two rough guys didn’t know how to treat a female tenderly at all!
As she lamented the hardship of her life, she began to harvest the honey.
One after another, Ling Han continued to blow the horn of the Great Emperor, causing the swarm of bees to howl like wolves endlessly.
Hence, in truth, the little red bird was not the slightest bit endangered.
Though it looked very frightening from the surface, and she was surrounded by furious demonic bees, they would occasionally raise their heads and howl like a wolf.
Taking a moment to savor it, it was actually still very comical.
Not long after, the little red bird had already emptied the beehive, and hurriedly ran back.
“Are you satisfied now?” The little red bird threw the honey at Ling Han, looking very angry.
Ling Han put away the honey, and stroked the little red bird’s head, “This little guy is quite capable.”
Damn it!
The little red bird really wanted to turn Ling Han bald with a single breath of fire.
She was the daughter of a Divine Beast, and who knew how precious she was.
“Stop playing, let’s retreat quickly,” Ding Shu said.
Without the suppression of the Great Emperor Horn, these demonic bees that had their home base dug out were already about to go crazy.
“Run!”
The two of them hurriedly fled, while using the Great Emperor Horn to delay their pursuers, successfully shaking off the swarm of bees.
After going around in a circle, they found the empress and the others.
“Where did you guys go?” Hu Niu asked.
“Big Sister Niu Niu!” The little red bird hurriedly pounced over, and immediately began to tell on Ling Han.
It chattered endlessly, and spoke at an extraordinarily fast speed, recounting how Ling Han had “abused” her.
“Big Sister Niu Niu, you have to seek justice for me!” she said coquettishly.
“Whatever Niu’s Ling Han wants you to do, you’ll do.” Hu Niu said with a very strange expression.
She really didn’t know where the little red bird’s resentment came from.
The little red bird: “...”
‘You two are truly a family.
I’m impressed!’
“Come, there’s something good.” Ling Han took out some honey, and everyone had a share.
—Most people were only at the True Self Tier, so a single piece of honey was enough for them to refine for a very long time.
“Refine it first,” Ling Han said.
“Although only Spirit Transformation Tier-level vicious beasts have appeared so far, there are too many of them.
At present, we are still unable to resist.”
Thus, every bit of strength that could be increased would be useful.
Everyone nodded, and began to refine it.
After a month, all the honey had been consumed, and everyone’s strength had improved greatly.
The little azure dragon had already cultivated to the Ninth Form, but the large black dog couldn’t break through the restrictions of the Eighth Form no matter what.
It couldn’t be helped.
Although it had also obtained a lot of opportunities, it could only match the Golden Generation at most, but couldn’t surpass it.
Actually, this was already awesome enough.
However, compared with Ling Han and Ding Shu=, it seemed to pale in colour.
Ling Han also successfully advanced into the Spirit Transformation Tier.
Now that he had two spiritual bodies, his battle prowess increased greatly.
Ding Shu was not outdone either.
He had actually surpassed Ling Han, and had similarly advanced into the Second Change.
“What a good thing,” Ling Han said ruefully.
“If we empty out a few more beehives, we’ll be able to soar to the peak stage of the Spiritual Transformation Tier.”
When the little red bird heard this, it involuntarily took a few steps back.
F***, were they planning to have designs on her again?
“Come, let’s set out.”
They continued to advance along the lava river, and after walking for about seven days, a palace actually appeared ahead of them.
It was completely crimson red, as if it was burning.
“The habitat of the True Phoenix?” Everyone showed an expression of delight.
However, this was too smooth, wasn’t it?
They had found it just like that?
They continued to walk forwards, and soon arrived at the great doors of the palace.
However, the palace doors were tightly shut, and a large number of people had gathered in the plaza in front of the palace doors.
They were all the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters who had entered this time.
By the looks of it, no one could open the palace doors, so everyone was blocked outside.
However, because they suspected that the inheritance of the True Phoenix was here, no one was willing to give up and leave.
“Ling Han!” A cold rebuke rang out, and one of the Imperial Sons looked towards Ling Han.
One of the well-known members of the Silver Generation, Yi Xiangyang of the Blood Flame Imperial Clan, Spirit Transformation Tier Seventh Change!
He was Di Luo’s good friend, so when he found out that Di Luo had been humiliated by Ling Han, he was naturally furious.
“I’ve finally found you!” He moved directly, launching an attack at Ling Han.
They were all in the Spiritual Transformation Tier, so even if he killed Ling Han in public, the Nine Suns Saint wouldn’t be able to say anything.
The words of a Saint were naturally like the Regulations.
If one disobeyed, they would be punished by the heavens.
Ling Han let out a battle cry and charged towards Yi Xiangyang.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
The two of them exchanged blows, but the moment they came into contact, Ling Han was at a complete disadvantage.
The Seventh Change was far too powerful.
Not only did he have a crushing advantage over Ling Han in terms of power, but he also had seven spiritual bodies.
Thus, the boost to his battle prowess was far too great.
Weng, right at this moment, the cracks in the tiles in the plaza lit up at the same time.
Instantly, no one dared to move again.
Even Yi Xiangyang suddenly stopped his attack, and stood on a tile.
“Watch your steps.” Ling Han immediately transmitted a message to the empress and the others, “Don’t place your foot over two floor tiles.”
The empress and the others naturally wouldn’t ignore Ling Han’s words, and they all acted accordingly.
Weng, the light in the crevices in the tiles suddenly rose up, which was equivalent to instantly dividing this plaza into tens of thousands of squares.
Ling Han merely swept an eye over these rays of light, and felt a strong sense of fear.
This was definitely capable of instantly piercing through his physique.
No wonder even Yi Xiangyang had stopped attacking.
Otherwise, he would have been dismembered.
The beam of light rose to the height of half a human, then stopped.
At this time, everyone was sprawled out on the ground.
When Ling Han saw this, he immediately crouched down as well.
There was no need to issue any further commands.
The empress and the others followed suit.
Shua, the light that had risen began to spin, as if it was stirring.
If anyone was still standing at this moment, they would definitely be sliced in half.
These rays of light channelled endlessly, and kept changing shapes.
However, the people here seemed to be familiar with it, and could always react in advance.
Thus, it was a close call.
After about ten minutes, these beams of light disappeared.
Boom!
Yi Xiangyang charged over once more.
This was not the academy grounds.
In a competition over treasures in ancient sites, casualties and injuries were inevitable, and he did not have to bear any responsibility.
Ling Han didn’t take it head-on.
The gap in cultivation level was really too wide.
Retreat.
Hong long long, right at this moment, a loud sound was heard, and the doors to the palace actually opened!
Yi?
At this moment, everyone withdrew their gazes from the battle between Ling Han and Yi Xiangyang, and looked towards the inside of the palace.
However, it was pitch-black inside, and nothing could be seen clearly.
Ling Han looked over, only to see the innocent little red bird standing at the entrance.
It was she who had opened the palace doors just then.
—This little bird was incredibly eager to obtain the inheritance of the True Phoenix.
Thus, she quietly ran to the doors of the palace, wanting to sneak in.
Unexpectedly, the doors were unexpectedly opened.
Perhaps it was because of her bloodline.
As if fearing that Ling Han would reprimand it, the little red bird covered its mouth and hurriedly ran into the palace.

chapters.title: Chapter 4344: Nine Star Saint Bird
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
With her fleeing, the others naturally could no longer hold themselves back. They all followed, and rushed into the palace.
“Humph!” Yi Xiangyang swept a cold glance at Ling Han before turning around to leave. He dashed into the palace.

He was an elite among those who had entered into the lair of the True Phoenix this time, and his abilities could be ranked in the top ten. Thus, he had a very high chance of obtaining the inheritance of the True Phoenix. In comparison, this was naturally more important. As for killing Ling Han, that could be left for later.
Most importantly, his major tier in cultivation level was the same as Ling Han’s. If Ling Han was determined to run, it would be very difficult for him to catch up to him.
The empress and the others all walked over. Ding Shu asked, “Shall we go in and play as well?”
Ling Han smiled, “Since we’re already here, we naturally have to go in.”
“That damn bird can actually open the palace?” the little azure dragon asked curiously. “Perhaps she lied? In fact, she’s not Vermillion Bird’s descendant, but the daughter of the True Phoenix?”
It was possible.

Firstly, no one had seen her original form. Secondly, she could obviously travel freely in this place, and the Regulations of Flames could not harm her. Perhaps, it was precisely because of her True Phoenix bloodline. Thirdly, the swarm of bees previously had been targeting her, probably wanting to devour her bloodline.
Fourthly, this was even more obvious. She had opened the doors to the palace that even the Imperial Sons could not open.
“After we capture her, we have to interrogate her properly,” Ling Han said with a nod.
They walked forwards, and soon arrived at the entrance of the palace.
After hesitating for a moment, Ling Han stepped forward and entered the palace.
From the outside, it was pitch-black inside, but after entering, he discovered that this place was completely bright.

This palace was very empty, and only thick pillars could be seen. It was unknown what stone they were made of, but they were exuding a faint red light. Furthermore, all kinds of patterns were engraved on these stone pillars.

Though the images were different, they had one thing in common. In every image, there was a giant purple eagle. It was either battling in the skies, descending into the Nine Seas to catch giant turtles, or being worshipped by thousands of birds.
“This shouldn’t be the Palace of the True Phoenix,” Ling Han said.
“En.” Everyone nodded.
If it was the Palace of the True Phoenix, then the main character in the stone carvings should be the True Phoenix, and not this giant purple eagle.
“Perhaps this is a subordinate of the True Phoenix,” the large black dog guessed.

This made a lot of sense. The True Phoenix was a Divine Beast, and it was an outstanding talent at that, being able to stand side by side with the True Dragon. Thus, it was very normal for it to take in a few powerful lackeys.
“Then it should be Saint-level.” Everyone deduced.
Another Divine Beast?
Impossible!

Though there were definitely differences in strength among Ancestral Kings, which one of those that could advance into this level was not proud and arrogant? Even in the ancient times, when the Divine Beasts coexisted, it was impossible that any Divine Beast would be willing to submit to another.
“Who knows what good stuff there would be.” The little azure dragon rubbed its hands together, its thieving eyes shining.
“Let’s look around.”
This palace was very big. When a few dozen people entered, it was like a few drops of water had been dripped into a lake, and they had instantly disappeared without a trace.

Ling Han and the others didn’t split up. There were many Spiritual Transformation Tier elites here, and there were even Silver Generation elites like Yi Xiangyang. If they faced them alone, the space here would be limited, and it would be difficult for them to escape. It was very likely that they would be killed.
They were very careful. After all, there were enemies everywhere.
Xiu, a red shadow flashed, as if a fiery flame was flying towards them.
Ling Han didn’t dodge. Instead, he reached over to grab it.
A small red bird was instantly caught by him. It could only flap its wings in vain, unable to struggle free at all.
Wasn’t this Zhu Hongyi?
“Hehehe!”
“Heng, heng, heng!”
Everyone rubbed their fists together. This little red bird was really too unfriendly. It had secretly gone to open the palace doors, and actually did not even inform them.
The little red bird knew that it was in the wrong, and said shamelessly with a smile, “Everyone, don’t be too excited. We can talk things out.”
“We’ll beat you up first,” the large black dog jeered.
“I surrender, I surrender!” The little red bird took out a key, “I just have to hand over what I have obtained, all right?”

Ling Han took the key and examined it carefully. He shook his head. There was nothing special about the key itself, so it seemed that only the corresponding door could possibly contain something valuable.
“Let’s go. There’s nothing left here,” the little red bird said.
“How do you know?” the large black dog asked.
“I obtained the formation hub of this palace, so I naturally know,” the little red bird said proudly.
So that was how it was.
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head, “Are there any mechanisms or restrictions here?”
“Of course.” The little red bird nodded.
“Little Han!” The large black dog’s eyes lit up.
Ling Han snickered, “Let’s go and trick those people!”
If they wanted to control the formations in the palace, they would definitely have to control the hub. Led by the little red bird, they headed to the second floor of the palace.
On the way, the little red bird also talked about the origins of this palace.

The giant purple eagle was a great general subordinate to the True Phoenix in the past. It was a Nine Star Divine BIrd, and its battle prowess was terrifyingly strong. It was only a sliver away from the level of Pseudo-Emperor.

It was a shame that there hadn’t been any cultivation techniques in that era. Thus, the Purple Eagle had only managed to advance from the level of One Star Divine Bird to the level of Nine Stars in the end. It hadn’t reached the level of Emperor Tier.
“This is also an awesome existence,” the little azure dragon said. “There’s also a mountain of difference among Saints. It’s child’s play for a nine-star Saint to kill a one-star Saint.”

Because the little red bird was the descendant of the Vermillion Bird, its bloodline was somewhat similar to that of the True Phoenix. Thus, she was able to open the palace doors here, and successfully obtain the approval of this Purple Eagle Palace Hall. She could control it, and also learnt so much information because of that.
They soon arrived at the second floor of the palace, and found a room that was not very eye-catching.
However, there was a person searching everywhere in the room.
Xu Youque.
Ling Han couldn’t help but smile. Enemies were really bound to meet on a narrow road.

Sensing that someone was approaching, Xu Youque also stopped searching, and turned to look towards Ling Han. When he discovered that it was this old enemy, he couldn’t help but reveal a hint of wariness in his expression.
“Apologies, I was the one who discovered it first!” he said calmly. As a member of the Silver Generation, he still had this bit of composure. “If you want to come in, fine. Wait until I get out.”
“It’s fine. If I kill you, there won’t be any problem,” Ling Han said with a smile.

Xu Youque couldn’t help but explode in anger, saying, “Ling Han, you’re far too arrogant! Who knows how many Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters are here? If you dare to kill them, you’ll definitely be punished!”
Ling Han nodded and said, “Thank you for your suggestion. It’s not bad. I’ve decided to kill everyone here to prevent them from leaking the secret.”

Xu Youque faltered for a moment before laughing in spite of himself, saying, “You’re far too arrogant. To say nothing of others, even Yi Xiangyang is powerful enough to kill you a hundred times over. Kill him to keep him quiet? What a huge joke!”
“Then just wait and see,” Ling Han said as he lashed out at Xu Youque.
He went all out from the very beginning, and two spiritual bodies walked out of his body respectively.

Xu Youque was only a Spirit Transformation Tier First Change. In a situation when their cultivation levels were equal, he was no match for Ling Han, what more when Ling Han had the advantage of cultivation level.
How was he supposed to continue fighting?

chapters.title: Chapter 4345: Playing around
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Under the destructive power of Destructive Energy, Xu Youque was quickly killed. Substitution Seal didn’t have the chance to take effect at all.
Xu Youque died with remaining grievances.
Even at the instant of death, he still didn’t believe that Ling Han would really dare to kill him. Moreover, he didn’t even have the chance to use the Substitution Seal.
“Can I control the formation?” Ling Han asked the little red bird.
The little red bird nodded, and said, “Let me hand the control over to you first.”
In a short while, Ling Han suddenly felt as if he had fused into this palace. At the same time, it was as if this palace had become an extension of his body.
It was a little similar to controlling Earth Qi.
This was a piece of cake for Ling Han. With a single thought, his divine sense seemed to have covered the entire palace.
He discovered that a great many people were presently heading in his direction.
Clearly, though he had not spent too much time killing Xu Youque just now, it had still alerted some people.
He also saw Yi Xiangyang, but when he turned his attention to Yi Xiangyang, the latter also stopped what he was doing, revealing a suspicious expression.
Obviously, he had sensed something off.
As expected of a Spirit Transformation Tier Seventh Change. His senses were truly powerful.

“Stop,” Ling Han murmured softly. He controlled the formation, and instantly, it was as if the people who rushed over had encountered ghosts building walls1. No matter how they walked, they would only be going around in circles.
He smiled faintly. He didn’t care about the others, but he wanted to settle a score with Yi Xiangyang.
On the other side.
Yi Xiangyang frowned slightly. He sensed that he was being monitored, but when he swept his gaze around, he did not discover anything.
Was it his misconception?
A thought flashed in his mind, and he shouted, “Come out, don’t think that you can hide your tracks in front of me!”
After a rebuke, there was no unusual movement in the surroundings.
Not falling for it?
Yi Xiangyang pondered for a moment. Could it be that he had really misunderstood?
Pa, pa, pa! Right at this moment, he heard footsteps.
Heh, he finally lost his cool and came out on his own.
Yi Xiangyang smirked coldly, then turned around, and looked behind him.
This person’s whole body was enshrouded in black cloth. Every step he took was very slow, but the sound of his footsteps was extremely heavy.
“Who are you? How dare you spy on me, an Imperial Son!” Yi Xiangyang shouted in a deep voice, appearing very displeased.

He was no ordinary Imperial Son, but rather a Silver Generation elite, and one of the strongest among them. He was close to advancing into the ranks of Sect Masters—once he became a Minor Advanced Tier elite, he would be crowned with the title of “great elite”.
The mysterious person was unmoved, and continued onwards.
Yi Xiangyang was furious, and shot out a punch, which turned into a blazing ball of light that shot towards the mysterious person.

This mysterious person had absolutely no intention of parrying or dodging this attack. Peng, he was instantly hit, and that black cloth was immediately turned into pieces, that fluttered around like butterflies.
It was resolved so easily?
Yi Xiangyang frowned, and instead became serious.
That was because it was completely empty beneath the black cloth, and there was no one there at all.
What was going on here?
To play with him like he was in the palm of his hand, who exactly was the mastermind behind all this? Furthermore, he was too outrageously bold, to actually dare to toy with even him!

Yi Xiangyang was extremely cautious. This person didn’t come with good intentions. Moreover, this was a Mystery Realm, so there were unfathomable dangers lurking around. Thus, it was best to remain cautious.
Only after a while, the sound of footsteps was heard again. Then, a person covered in a black cloth walked over.
Again!
Yi Xiangyang couldn’t help but feel enraged. ‘Have you become addicted to toying around with others?’
He threw another punch, and without a doubt, the black cloth shattered, and there was nothing inside.
“Who’s acting pretentious here!” Yi Xiangyang shouted loudly, his anger already soaring.
However, pa, pa, pa. Footsteps were heard again, and it was still that mysterious “person” that was shrouded in black cloth.
Yi Xiangyang naturally moved without any reservations, destroying it, but the result was still the same. He did not see anyone.
He couldn’t help but frown. Who exactly was the mastermind?
Again and again it happened; he became irritated.
“All right, don’t let me find you. Otherwise, you will die very horribly!” Yi Xiangyang declared harshly, then began his search. He was determined to find the mastermind behind all this.
He actually dared to toy with him? Humph!
However, he immediately paused.
He could not advance any further, because there was an invisible screen blocking his way.
What was going on?
Previously, when he had entered, there was clearly no such barrier.
He tried to break it, but there was nothing he could do.
After stopping for a moment, he turned around and walked towards the other side.
However, he soon stopped again, because he still encountered an invisible barrier.
He was actually trapped here?
“Coward, do you only know how to play tricks in the shadows?” he asked coldly.
Finally, a voice rang out, causing Yi Xiangyang to feel energized.
“If I come out, you will be afraid!”
“Ling, Ling Han?” Yi Xiangyang faltered. This was clearly Ling Han’s voice.

However, Ling Han was clearly only a Spiritual Transformation Tier Second Change cultivator. Whether it was his cultivation level or abilities, he was far inferior to him, so how could he be so elusive?
“You guessed correctly. Unfortunately, there is no reward.” Ling Han’s voice rang out again, “How is it? Are you afraid?”
“Afraid?” Yi Xiangyang couldn’t help but laugh loudly, “If you dare to appear in front of me, I will kill you with my own hands!”
He paused, then continued, “Do you dare?”
“Sure,” Ling Han’s voice rang out.
Multiple rays of light condensed, turning into a human figure that quietly appeared.
“Ling Han, you dare to trick me!” Yi Xiangyang shouted angrily.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Are you too naive, or do you think that I am ridiculously stupid to actually appear personally to battle you?”

I would just let you have an advantage of two minor levels, and killing you would be as easy as killing a chicken.”

The human figure formed by the formation had already charged over, and grabbed out at Yi Xiangyang’s head.

On the other side.

This person didn’t come with good intentions.
Moreover, this was a Mystery Realm, so there were unfathomable dangers lurking around.
Thus, it was best to remain cautious.

Again!
