chapters.title: Chapter 4346: Second Palace Hall
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
However, there were some aspects that even a Saint-level formation could not match Ling Han.

—If he was killed by Ling Han’s Destructive Energy, he would definitely be done for. The Substitution Seal would not be effective either, but it was a different story now. Yi Xiangyang immediately “came back to life”.
He obviously knew that there was no way he could match this formation, and hurriedly tried his best to break out of the siege.
However, this was a Saint-level formation. So what if he was a supreme prodigy? He was completely no match.
In just an instant, he was killed once more.
“Ling—”
“Han!”
He died twice in a row, and only then did he shout out these two words.
Ling Han stopped the formation, “You want to beg for mercy, right? Fine, hand over the Imperial Scroll and I can consider letting you live.”

“In your dreams!” Yi Xiangyang immediately said. The Imperial Scroll was the foundation of an Imperial Clan. Whoever had a deeper grasp of the Imperial Scroll would be able to obtain control of the Imperial Weapon. What kind of concept was that?

He could not possibly become the eternal sinner of the Yi Clan. Furthermore, even if he was willing to hand over the Imperial Scroll, it was not possible. A restriction had been placed on his soul by the Saint of his clan, and he would die if it was touched.
“Moreover, even if you obtain the Imperial Scroll, the clan will still kill you at all costs.”

If this hurt the foundations of the Imperial Clan, then who cares if you have the Nine Mountains Saint or Buddha Doga behind you? Kill, kill, kill, kill. Worse come to worst, they could just hide in the Imperial Clan in the future after the deed. With the dual protection of the Imperial Weapon and the Great Emperor formation, they would naturally be fine.
After all, if he wasn’t a true Great Emperor, there was no way he could break through the dual protection of the Great Emperor formation and the Imperial Weapon.
Ling Han shook his head, “Then what are you still talking about?”
“That’s right, he’s completely worthless!” The large black dog nodded.
“What Silver Generation, ptui!” The little azure dragon also spat.
This infuriated Yi Xiangyang so much that he trembled. However, the formation activated again, easily “killing” him again.
After a few more times, Yi Xiangyang was really getting anxious.
The Substitution Seal was about to be used up.
“We can talk things over peacefully!” he called out loudly, “I can buy my own life!”
Ling Han stopped the formation, and said, “Buy your life? Hehe, once you’re dead, the things on you will naturally be mine, so what need is there for me to place a price on your life?”
“I guarantee that I’ll crush my Spatial Tool before I die. In that case, the things inside will remain in the void forever,” Yi Xiangyang shouted. “Kill me, and you won’t get anything.”
Ling Han shrugged, “If I won’t get anything, then so be it!”
Boom! The formation channeled again.
Yi Xiangyang wanted to curse. How could he encounter such a character?
The formation surged over, and Yi Xiangyang was killed once more. There was no doubt about it, and now, he no longer had Substitution Seal to use.
He steeled his heart, and pa, he crushed the Spatial Tools he had on him, one after another.
If he died, then Ling Han wouldn’t be able to get any benefits either.
Boom! The formation swept over for the final time, and Yi Xiangyang was finally killed this time. His body was directly crushed into dust.
So what if he was a Silver Generation elite? He had died an extremely worthless death.
Ling Han felt rueful internally. No matter how prodigious you are, so what? In front of some irresistible power, you are so weak that it is practically laughable.
“Let’s go.”

He didn’t pay attention to the other people here. As long as they didn’t offend him, he couldn’t be bothered to target anyone. However, if anyone wanted to kill him, he definitely wouldn’t be merciful.
The group left, continuing to walk along the river of lava. After walking for a few days, they were surprised that the path ahead was blocked.
It was not that there was no path to take, but rather there was an invisible barrier blocking their way.
The scenery ahead could be clearly seen. The lava was also surging, but they were still unable to pass.

Perhaps, after entering into the lava river, they would be able to smoothly swim upstream, but with their present physique, if they were to bear the might of the lava, hoho, they would probably be incinerated into ashes in an instant.
Apart from the little red bird.
“Let’s walk around here.”
They walked around this barrier, and after a few days, another large river of lava actually appeared ahead of them.
“Yi, have we circled around so quickly?” The large black dog asked curiously.
Ling Han observed his surroundings, and shook his head, “That’s not right. We didn’t circle back. This is another lava river.”
Everyone exchanged looks, and cast their gazes downwards.
“Let’s go.”
They travelled along the river, and after walking for a few more days, a palace suddenly appeared ahead of them, laid out on top of the river.

“From the looks of the current arrangements, the True Phoenix Palace should be behind the barrier, and Purple Eagle Palace and the others are outside. If we want to break through the barrier, the key is still these palaces outside.”
“If we can obtain a key at every palace, then gathering all the keys should open the barrier, or open the True Phoenix Palace.”
Everyone gathered their thoughts to make a deduction, and all thought that this deduction was extremely logical.

They walked around to the front of the palace, which was similar to the Purple Eagle Palace from before. At the entrance of the palace, there was also a massive plaza, and there were a few dozen people standing in the plaza. The majority of them should still be members of the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan. After all, they were the ones who had discovered it, so the number of people that had entered from the clan was a good few times more.
Unfortunately, it was Spirit Transformation Tiers that had the say here. No matter how many Cauldron Forging Tiers and Core Formation Tiers came in, it would all be in vain.
Obviously, they had no way to open the palace, so they could only wait at the doors.
Since the palace hadn’t been opened, they wouldn’t know that this wasn’t the True Phoenix Palace, but rather the temporary residence of a subordinate of the True Phoenix.
Ling Han and the others walked over. By the looks of it, the way to open the palace was still up to the little red bird.
“Ling Han!” A voice rang out, filled with pleasant surprise.
Ling Han looked over, a smile appearing on his face.
Chi Menghan.

She was a noble daughter of the Donglin Imperial Clan, so it was only natural that she could obtain a spot. However, no matter how much face she had, she couldn’t bring Ling Han with her. She didn’t expect to see Ling Han here, so she was naturally happy.

It was also because she had left the Ancestral King Academy at a slightly coincidental time that she didn’t know that Ling Han had also followed her here. Otherwise, she would have long since gone to meet with Ling Han.
Yi?

Ling Han felt as if someone was staring at him, and it was as if he were being pricked by needles. He looked over, only to see a man slowly walking over from behind Chi Menghan. There was a cold expression on his face.
Did I offend you?
“If you don’t want to die, stay away from Menghan,” the man said through divine sense. Although this wasn’t a voice, it still made Ling Han feel a powerful sense of pride radiating from him.
“And this is?” Ling Han looked at Chi Menghan.

“Oh, this is my cousin, Lian Yutang,” Chi Menghan said. “I have an aunt who married into the Heavenly Sorrow Imperial Clan. My cousin is a Golden Generation elite of the Heavenly Sorrow Imperial Clan.”

Ling Han gave an ‘oh’. He had not thought that there would be an alliance through marriage among the Imperial Clans, and had not imagined that a clansman of the Donglin Imperial Clan would actually give birth to a Golden Generation elite of the Heavenly Sorrow Imperial Clan.
If they had known this would happen, the Donglin Imperial Clan probably wouldn’t have married one of their daughters outside of the clan.
Judging by Chi Menghan’s expression, she most likely regarded Lian Yutang as her cousin. However, Lian Yutang clearly didn’t think so.
Hehe, he was going to battle again.

chapters.title: Chapter 4347: Cousin
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Lian Yutang definitely had other thoughts about Chi Menghan. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have spoken to warn him.
Such a blatant threat clearly showed his wild ambitions.

Originally, Ling Han wouldn’t have cared, but now that he had already opened his heart and confirmed Chi Menghan’s status as his wife, if Lian Yutang still dared to have designs on his woman, that was definitely impossible.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Cousin Lian, right? Nice to meet you.”
‘Who’s your cousin?’

Lian Yutang faltered upon hearing this. Only then did he realize that Ling Han was already referring to himself as Chi Menghan’s husband. Thus, he was addressing him like how Chi Menghan would address him.
F***, you are really outrageously bold!
I just warned you not to let your imagination run wild, but you haven’t even turned around, and you’ve already forgotten completely?
However, it wouldn’t be appropriate for him to lose his temper in front of Chi Menghan. He still had to squeeze out a smile, and said, “Hello.”
When he said these words, he really felt a stabbing pain in his heart.
But what was even more hurtful was the fact that Ling Han had actually turned his head away, and was now conversing with Chi Menghan, completely ignoring him.
‘F*ck!’

Lian Yutang almost flipped out immediately. He was one of the Golden Generation, a supreme prodigy that had a chance of breaking through to Emperor Tier in future! Furthermore, he was now Spirit Transformation Tier Ninth Change. If it was not for the fact that he still wanted to charge at the limit, he would have long since broken through to Sect Master Tier.
‘You’re nothing, yet you actually dare to ignore me?’
Why don’t you ascend to the heavens while you’re at it!

In the Ancestral King Academy, he was basically in a state of seclusion, because he had long since reached the end of the Spiritual Transformation Tier. There was absolutely no need for him to ask for anything from the Ancestral King Academy, which led to Ling Han being completely unaware of the existence of such a character.
When he came out this time, he saw his cousin that he had never met before, and his heart instantly beat wildly.
What a good match!
Thus, when he approached with the identity of a cousin, Chi Menghan was completely unguarded.
Everything had initially been fine, yet now, Ling Han had suddenly appeared.
Humph, having designs on a woman that I have my eye on?
‘You’re seeking death!’
In a mere instant, Lian Yutang had recovered. He said calmly, “Ling Han, is it? I have heard of you. A while ago, you seemed to have caused a very great commotion in the Academy.”
Ling Han turned his head, and said, “Hehe, no big deal, no big deal. How could it be worthy of such praise from Cousin Lian?”
Pei!

‘Can you f*cking be more shameless? Am I praising you? Don’t you have any idea?’ He had almost become a despised rat in the academy. If it weren’t for the Nine Mountains Saint and the Buddha Doga, he would have long since been stomped into mush.
Just how thick-skinned was he to be able to say such shameless words?
“Our Little Han is indeed a supreme prodigy. He has suppressed the prodigies of the academy to the point that they have lost their temper,” the large black dog said in a timely manner.
“En, though he’s slightly inferior to Grandpa Dragon, stepping on others shouldn’t be a problem,” the little azure dragon also said.
Lian Yutang almost spat out a mouthful of blood. How could all of you have such thick skin?
They were weirdoes.
Meanwhile, Ling Han laughed loudly, pointed at the great doors ahead of them, and asked, “What is it? Still unable to break through?”

“Those who are slightly familiar with formations are all studying it, but from the look of things now...” Chi Menghan shook her head. They had already stayed here for a great many days, yet were still unable to break open the doors to the palace.
Thankfully, they knew that the more difficult it was now, the greater their gains would be in future. None of them were discouraged.
They still had this bit of patience.

‘Holy f*ck!’
Lian Yutang really wanted to move, and smack all three of them to death.
‘Why are you thanking me? Do you think you’ve already won?’
This was too detestable.
Ling Han grabbed the little red bird and strode forward.
“You still haven’t said what your wager is,” Lian Yutang said from behind.
“No need to go to so much trouble. In any case, I’m definitely going to win,” Ling Han said with a smile. In just a few steps, he had already walked to the side of the main doors.
“Everyone, please move aside,” he said to a few people who were studying the restriction.
“Ling Han!” When they saw him, those people all showed an unfriendly expression.

“Why should I?”
“If we don’t leave, are you planning to use force?”

There were two people here who were Silver Generation elites. Their cultivation level was as high as Spirit Transformation Tier Sixth Change, and they could suppress Ling Han in a one-on-one battle, let alone two people working together.
“Cousin Lian, come and clear the area,” Ling Han turned around and said. He didn’t waste his breath on them.
Shua, instantly, a great many people turned their eyes on Lian Yutang.
Cousin?

At this moment, Lian Yutang really wanted to commit murder, but he still wanted to humiliate Ling Han after Ling Han was unable to break through the restrictions. Thus, no matter what, he had to swallow this anger.
“Move aside,” he said calmly. Though his voice was not loud, it was filled with intimidation.

Now that the Golden Generation had spoken, so what if they were the Silver Generation? They could only obey obediently. This was not only a gap in natural talent, but most importantly, it was a gap in cultivation level. There was too much of a gap.
Though those people were dissatisfied, they could only glare at Ling Han, then turn and leave.

“You may begin.” Lian Yutang stated calmly. He did not even care that Ling Han would renege on the bet after losing, and not take out any stakes — he was about to advance into Minor Advanced Tier, so what good stuff could Ling Han take out for him?
Thus, all he wanted was to humiliate Ling Han, so that he would be embarrassed in front of Chi Menghan.
“Please step aside first,” Ling Han said to Lian Yutang. “I’m using a secret technique that belongs solely to me. I can’t allow others to learn it.”
Lian Yutang almost exploded in anger again.
He was the dignified Golden Generation, so what did he care about this kind of technique?

Meanwhile, the little red bird’s expression was filled with disdain. He was clearly going to make use of the power of her bloodline, yet still said it so boldly and confidently. He was really too shameless.

chapters.title: Chapter 4348: A sure win
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Lian Yutang stepped aside, while Ling Han stood at the door.
“Little Red, it’s all up to you now,” Ling Han said. Then, he added, “You definitely can’t create any trouble. Otherwise, the consequences would be very serious.”
The little red bird indeed wanted to mess around with Ling Han and watch him be humiliated, but after being frightened by Ling Han, she couldn’t help but shudder.
She had best behave herself.
Ling Han held her in his hands, then she stretched out two wings, and pressed them on the palace doors.
A light that was very hard to see with the naked eye surged past, and with a bang, the doors of the palace were instantly opened.
Yi?
Ah!
Seeing this scene, everyone was dumbfounded.

How long had they been in here? All of them were busy here, yet it was only a waste of effort. However, what about Ling Han? He had not been here for more than half an hour, and the doors were already open.
You have no choice but to admit defeat!
“Cousin Lian, thank you.” The large black dog stretched out a hand, and demanded the stakes from Lian Yutang.
Though Lian Yutang was extremely displeased, in front of Chi Menghan, how could he possibly lose face?
He retrieved the Jade Lotus Fruit and tossed it toward the large black dog.
There was only one thought in his mind—this bunch of shameless people!
The large black dog snickered. Now, Little Han’s cultivation level could increase by another level. This was naturally a very good thing.
However, after everyone was stunned for a moment, they hurriedly rushed into the palace.
However, Ling Han wasn’t in a hurry to enter. This was because he had already told the little red bird to be go on ahead. As long as he obtained the key, what was the point of exploring this palace?
In the face of the temptation of the secret technique of the True Phoenix, even Lian Yutang could not remain calm. He hurriedly said to Chi Menghan, “Cousin, we should move.”
Though his strength could overwhelm everyone else, the majority of them were members of the Imperial Clans. If he was too forceful, it was inevitable that he would be targeted when he left.

—The Imperial Clan had long since reached an agreement, and that was when they were fighting over the treasures from the ancient sites, they could fight with all their might, but if one of them had already obtained it, the other Imperial Clans would not be able to make another move.
It was also because of this agreement that the various Imperial Clans maintained a relatively friendly relationship.
Chi Menghan smiled faintly, and said, “I still have something to say to Ling Han. Cousin, you can go in first.”
Lian Yutang couldn’t help but feel his expression darken. They still had something to say between the two of them?
Killing intent rose up in his heart, but his expression did not change. He merely nodded, “All right, then please be careful, cousin. This place is dangerous, after all.”
Chi Menghan nodded with a smile, and said, “Alright, thank you, Cousin.”

Though Lian Yutang wanted to stay behind as a third wheel, he could not resist the temptation of the inheritance from the True Phoenix. For now, he had best abandon his beauty. In any case, he only had to kill Ling Han in the future.
After Lian Yutang leaped into the palace hall, Chi Menghan also walked gracefully towards Ling Han.
“Why aren’t you guys going in?” She was extremely curious. With her understanding of Ling Han and the others, shouldn’t they be the most proactive?
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Little Red has already gone in. She alone is enough.”
“What’s going on?” Chi Menghan asked.
Ling Han related the matter, and Chi Menghan couldn’t help but shake her head. This guy was too mean. Poor Lian Yutang, being screwed over by him just like that.
“Let’s go in and put on an act.”
They entered the palace as well. Meanwhile, Ling Han found a corner to refine the Jade Lotus Fruit.

Ding Shu thought for a moment, and decided to temporarily part ways with Ling Han and the others. That was because he was also a prodigy, and together with Ling Han, his effects were actually suppressed. Furthermore, there was also the problem of allocating resources for cultivation.
Thus, it was more appropriate for him to act alone. In any case, everything depended on fate. He was also a person with great fortune.
Ling Han swallowed the Jade Lotus Fruit and channeled the Imperial Scroll to refine it.
In the heaven and earth, a mysterious power was extracted by him. In his mind, the second spiritual body was accelerating its evolution into a complete state.
Unfortunately, when the medicinal effects were completely refined, he was still unable to cultivate to the end of the Second Change.
One Jade Lotus Fruit was still too little. He needed at least four, and only then would he be able to completely cultivate a minor level.
“Cousin Lian isn’t awesome enough,” Ling Han said with a smile. He was thinking about how he could trick this guy again and earn more benefits.
At this moment, the little red bird pounced back.
“Success,” she said. As expected, she took out another key.
This was already two keys.
Ling Han and the others walked around in the palace. The layout here was similar to the first palace, but the main character engraved on the stone pillars was a peacock.
“In the past, Peacock didn’t become Emperor. Instead, a Saint Emperor appeared in the future generations!” Ling Han mused ruefully.
He had dealt with the Peacock Imperial Clan before, and he had almost beaten the Silver Generation Imperial Son of their clan, Kong Wuyang, into a retard.
Not long after, Lian Yutang and the others returned one after another. Looking at their expressions, it was clear that they must not have gained anything.
Of course, the expressions of Ling Han and the others were also solemn. They naturally couldn’t give themselves away.
“Strange, this is actually an empty palace.”
“We’ve wasted so much of our time!”
A great many people were complaining. They had gained nothing, and wasted their time for nothing.
Of course, there were also a great many people that turned to look at Ling Han.
This was opened by Ling Han, and the speed was astonishingly fast. Could it be that this guy knew this place like the back of his hand?
Thus, even if others entered first, the most important thing was still obtained by Ling Han.
Ling Han acted as if he didn’t know they were looking at him. Since everyone had finished exploring, it was about time for them to leave.
Since Chi Menghan had encountered Ling Han, she was naturally leaving with Ling Han. Moreover, Lian Yutang would definitely be dissatisfied, so he naturally followed her.
Thus, even though Ding Shu had left their team, with the addition of Chi Menghan and Lian Yutang, they had one additional person joining their team.
They didn’t walk up the lava river again. Instead, they calculated the direction and distance and walked towards the third palace that existed.
This was how Ling Han explained things to Chi Menghan. When all the palaces were opened, perhaps the barrier at the lava river would disappear.
This was indeed his deduction, and in the case of the key, it was probably to open some secret trove of the True Phoenix Palace. He naturally would not say this.
Regarding Ling Han’s deduction, even Lian Yutang felt that it was reasonable, and did not speak out in objection. Instead, he quietly followed Ling Han and the others.
Right now, he was pondering on how he could find a chance to kill Ling Han without letting Chi Menghan notice anything off.
It would be best if they encountered a pack of ferocious beasts. That way, he only had to trip him up, and kill Ling Han sneakily. Wouldn’t that be fine?
En, he would just wait until all the palace halls were opened.
They travelled for two days, and with a ‘ang’, they heard a terrifying roar that shook the heavens and earth.
Everyone shuddered, but they did not show any hint of fear. Instead, they looked intrigued.
In these two days, they had seen all the fiery red plants, and had not encountered a single living creature. Now, they suddenly heard a beast’s roar, which instead made them feel a sense of life.
“Let’s go and take a look,” Lian Yutang said.
No one objected. So be it if they went to take a look. Who knows, there might be some gains.
They followed the roar of the beast, but they had not walked too far, when they saw a shadow streak past in the skies.

chapters.title: Chapter 4349: Nine Vines Fire Origin Fruit
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Everyone raised their heads to look.

That was a massive fierce beast that looked like a lion. Its neck was covered with a fiery red mane, and there were two massive wings growing on its back. When they spread open, it was as if they could blot out the skies and cover the earth.
Even if Ling Han and the others were very far below, when the ferocious beast flapped its wings, they could still feel a very strong gust of wind sweep over, like a hurricane.

“Flame-Winged Lion!” Lian Yutang immediately said to Chi Menghan. “It’s a very rare beast. It’s said that they have long since gone extinct. The Flame-Winged Lion has the Heart of Seven Apertures, which is extraordinarily effective in healing dao injuries. Thus, the majority of them have been poached a long time ago. I didn’t expect to encounter one here.”
Naturally, he was deliberately showing off his knowledge in order to gain the astonished and impressed gaze of the beauty.
However, before Chi Menghan could say anything, the little azure dragon and the large black dog, the two jokers, were already “shocked”.
“Cousin Lian, you know so much!”
“I’m impressed!”
There were stars in the eyes of these two b@stards, and they looked like they had been enchanted to death, causing Lian Yutang to get goosebumps.
This Flame-Winged Lion’s claws also held a wild bull, obviously its prey. This wild bull was obviously thirty feet long, but in the Flame-Winged Lion’s claws, it appeared very insignificant.
“Where there is a Flame-Winged Lion, there would definitely be Nine Vines Fire Origin Fruit.”
“That’s good stuff.”
Lian Yutang continued, appearing slightly excited.
The Nine Vine Fire Origin Fruit could allow his cultivation level to advance by leaps and bounds after he advanced into Minor Advanced Tier. Thus, even he was tempted.
“Let’s go.”
He issued commands. As a Golden Generation, as well as a Spirit Transformation Tier Ninth Change, it was only natural that he considered himself the captain of this team.
Ling Han didn’t object, because he was also very interested in the Nine Vine Fire Origin Fruit.
However, if he really defeated the Flame-Winged Lion, how was he supposed to snatch it from Lian Yutang’s hands?
As he pondered, he followed the others in their pursuit of the Flame-Winged Lion in the skies.
—If Lian Yutang knew what he was thinking, he would definitely scoff and laugh loudly.
Haha, this was really too laughable. A mere Spirit Transformation Tier Second Change actually wanted to snatch something from a Spirit Transformation Tier Ninth Change? He was dreaming!
Not too long later, this Flame-Winged Lion’s figure descended, entering into a valley.
Everyone hurriedly followed, but slowed down their speed, and quietly entered into the valley.

The lair of the Flame-Winged Lion was very easy to find. It was on a large rock that jutted out of the cliff, and this Flame-Winged Lion had landed on it, and was currently feasting to its heart’s content.
—That wild bull was not dead yet, and released a mooing sound.
On the cliff to the left of this large rock, there was an old vine that was completely crimson in colour. It had borne nine bright red fruits.

“Nine Vines Fire Origin Fruit!” Lian Yutang immediately exclaimed, a hint of pleasant surprise on his face, “What great luck. This Celestial medicine has grown its ninth vine, and the number and quality of the fruits it bears have reached the peak stage.”

The Nine Vine Fire Origin Fruit sprouted out of the ground. Only one vine would grow out of it every three thousand years, and then it would blossom and bear fruit. However, there would only be one fruit. Then, another three thousand years later, a second vine would grow out of it, and two fruits would be borne.
It would take close to 30,000 years to grow nine vines and bear nine fruits. Even for Saints, this was a considerably long time.
Even at such a far distance, they could still smell a refreshing fragrance, causing everyone’s pores to open up. The Regulations seemed to be right in front of their eyes, within reach.
Without another word, Lian Yutang immediately dashed out.

He was very conceited, and did not use any ultimate moves. He merely delivered a palm strike, which turned into a blade of Regulations that was as long as three hundred meters, slashing out at the Flame-Winged Lion.

It was very fierce. With a wave of one claw, it sent out a crescent-shaped force, which blasted towards the blade of Regulations that was attacking.
Pu!
The force clashed with the blade of Regulations, and both instantly crumbled.

At this time, the Flame-Winged Lion had already pounced. With a wave of its claws and a flap of its wings, endless Regulations turned into sharp swords that swept madly towards Lian Yutang.
Lian Yutang humphed, and used his bare fists to exchange blows with the Flame-Winged Lion.
The Golden Generation was truly powerful. Under the barrage of punches, the Flame-Winged Lion was completely outmatched.

One had to realize that the most powerful trait of cultivators was that they could summon their spiritual bodies for battle. Summoning one would double their battle prowess, and if there were nine... just how terrifying would that be?
What was the strength of the wild beasts?
Individual battle prowess, tough physique!
Thus, the fact that Lian Yutang could suppress the Flame-Winged Lion in close-quarter combat without using his spiritual body was proof of how freakish his battle prowess was.
The Golden Generation Generation cultivated Body Arts as well, maintaining it at an equal level to their cultivation level. They were not just cultivating around randomly.

Because the value of the Flame-Winged Lion lay in its heart, there was absolutely no need for Lian Yutang to be merciful. Under his forceful suppression, in just a dozen over moves, he had killed this Flame-Winged Lion.
Peng!

The wild bull that had been treated as prey actually leaped down from the large rock on the cliff. A large hole had been torn in its abdomen by the Flame-Winged Lion, and some of its internal organs had also been eaten. However, the vitality of a Spirit Transformation Tier beast was incredibly tenacious, and with the hope of survival, it was determined to flee from this place.
“Ling Han, meat! Meat!” Hu Niu hurriedly exclaimed, her eyes shining.
Ling Han nodded, and moved to take down this wild bull.
“Moo!” The bull called out. Even if it had not gained intelligence, there were probably 10,000 curse words racing through its mind.
It was still inevitable that it would be eaten.
Lian Yutang released a battle cry, and leaped towards that large rock on the cliff.
His target was naturally the Nine Vine Fire Origin Fruit.

The air here was filled with Fire Element, and as long as their speed was slightly faster, they could sweep past like a knife, possessing astonishing destructive power. However, this naturally was no problem for a Golden Generation and a Spirit Transformation Tier Ninth Change, whose physique was tough enough.
“Wu!” However, when he stretched out his hand to pluck the Nine Vine Fire Origin Fruit, he couldn’t help but grunt, and hurriedly withdrew his hand, showing an expression of pain.
He looked at the palm of his hand, and saw that there was shockingly a burn mark on it.
What was going on?

He sensed with his divine sense, and only then did he discover that there was a layer of Regulations sealing off the Nine Vine Fire Origin Fruit in front of him. Just now, when he had touched it, it was precisely this Regulations that had burned him.
No wonder the fruits on the vines had already ripened, but the Flame-Winged Lion had not eaten them. It was not that it did not want to, but rather it could not.

He tried to unravel the Regulations, but it was useless. The level of these Regulations was at least on the level of Sect Master, or even a higher level, and was far from something that he could stand against.
However, there were clearly nine Treasured Fruits right in front of his eyes, yet they could only be seen but not plucked. Just how annoying was this?
He tried repeatedly, but there was nothing he could do at all. He could only leap down again.
“It can’t be helped,” he said. “With the powerful Regulations of Flames sealing them off, those fruits can’t be harvested at all.”
“Too bad!” He shook his head.
If he managed to harvest it, he would give one to Chi Menghan. As for Ling Han and the others, they naturally shouldn’t even think about it.
“Can I give it a try?” Ling Han asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 4350: Make another Bet
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Lian Yutang was taken aback. ‘You want to give it a try?’
“Haha, even I can’t do anything, so what can you do?” He couldn’t help but mock, because Ling Han saying that he wanted to give it a try was equivalent to provoking him.
“Cousin Lian, don’t forget that it was Ling Han who opened the doors to that palace previously,” the large black dog said from the sidelines.
Cousin your sister!
Lian Yutang really wanted to stomp the large black dog to death. He was a human, and the large black dog was a demon. ‘Calling Cousin repeatedly, why are you calling me so familiarly?’

He humphed, and said, “The palace was the palace, and the formation is a restriction, but this place is completely different. That is Regulations of Fire, which has blocked the Nine Vines Fire Origin Fruit behind it. As long as your strength is not strong enough, it is impossible to break through.”
This was raw strength, and had absolutely nothing to do with whether one understood formations or not.
“Then let’s make another bet,” Ling Han said.
Speaking of betting, Lian Yutang’s expression became awkward.
Previously, he had also made a bet with Ling Han, yet had suffered a terrible defeat. And now, he was going to do it again?
Looking at how confident Ling Han was, he really felt a little nervous.
“How do we bet? What are we betting?” Of course, he definitely couldn’t back down.

Ling Han smiled and said, “Bet if I can obtain the Nine Vines Fire Origin Fruit. If I can, then the Treasured Fruit will all belong to me. If I can’t, hehe, then there’s naturally no need to mention anything else.”

Lian Yutang pondered for a moment. He naturally did not believe that Ling Han would be able to break through the lockdown of the Regulations of Fire. This was completely based on brute strength. However, if Ling Han failed, he would not lose anything either.
Asking the other party to admit that he was trash?
No.
He similarly could not open the Regulations of Flames, so wouldn’t that mean that he would be cursing himself as well?
“All right.” He considered for a moment, then nodded. This brat was really too smug. Did he think that just because he had opened the great doors of the palace, he had extraordinary means?
Humph, I’ll let you have have a good encounter with a dead end.
Ling Han smiled, and began to climb towards the cliff.

He had long since brought the little red bird with him, and she was presently using its claws to grab onto his shoulder. Meanwhile, her expression was filled with disdain, because she knew that Ling Han was going to use her to show off again.
It wasn’t long before Ling Han climbed onto the large rock.
“Little Red, it’s all up to you now,” Ling Han said.
The little red bird rolled its eyes at him before flapping its wings and flying away.
She flew towards the Regulations of Fire, then slowed down. Carefully, she plucked a feather, and stretched it forwards.
The feathers touched the Regulations of Fire, but did not cause any commotion.

Ling Han also saw this, and couldn’t help but nod his head. The little red bird was indeed born with a natural affinity with Regulations of Fire. For example, Lian Yutang’s hand was directly burned, but the little red bird was completely unharmed.
The little red bird sighed in despair. Sigh, having encountered such a guy, he did not treat it like the descendant of a Divine Beast at all. Instead, it was like a coolie, doing this and that.
What could be done?
She began to harvest the Nine Vines Fire Origin Fruit. In a few moments, the nine celestial fruits had all fallen into her hands.
“Here, take it.” She tossed the celestial fruits to Ling Han.
Unlike the others, she fed on Divine Metal. Celestial fruits like this could not increase her cultivation level, and could only satisfy her cravings.
The coordination of man and bird was very good. With Ling Han blocking her, the people below could not see what was happening above at all.
Ling Han leaped up and landed on the ground.
“You—” Lian Yutang was speechless. He saw that on the vines above, the nine fruits had already disappeared.
He could not understand. What was going on here?

Destroying the Regulations of Fire required complete strength, and definitely not some cheap tricks. Thus, he couldn’t figure it out. Ling Han was clearly much weaker than him, so how could he do something that he couldn’t?

He wanted nothing more than for Ling Han to hand over the nine celestial fruits. However, he had personally agreed to a bet with Ling Han, and it was in front of Chi Menghan at that. He naturally couldn’t bring himself to do so.
If Chi Menghan was not here, he would have directly killed Ling Han in his anger and embarrassment.

“Nine Vines Fire Origin Fruit... is it for sale?” he asked Ling Han, feeling extremely sullen. This was the celestial fruit that he had discovered, him that had killed the vicious beast, so the celestial fruits should have belonged to him as well. Why did he have to turn around and beg Ling Han for them instead?
Ling Han shrugged, “Apologies, I have no plans to sell.”
Having been rebuffed, Lian Yutang’s expression became even worse.
He very much wanted to kill Ling Han with a single punch, but when he saw Chi Menghan, he forcefully suppressed this urge.
He definitely had to find a chance to kill Ling Han. In that way, the Nine Vines Fire Origin Fruit would return to his possession.
Ling Han was extremely pleased. The Nine Vines Fire Origin Fruit wasn’t a five-star celestial fruit, but rather a six-star celestial fruit. Even for a Sect Master, this fruit would be of some help.
However, now was not the time to distribute and refine them.
“Come on, let’s continue forward.”
They set out, heading towards the third palace — if there was one.
Another few days later, they finally arrived at their destination.

Just like before, there were still many people standing in the plaza here. They were unable to break through the restrictions on the main doors, and could only wait in the plaza as they continuously attempted.
“Brother Ling!” Origin was also here. He strode towards Ling Han.
“Brother Origin.” Ling Han nodded.
The two of them chatted for a while, then Ling Han said, “Alright, I have to go and open the doors.”
“Yi, Brother Ling actually has this ability?” Origin appeared very surprised.
“Hehe.”
Ling Han brought the little red bird and headed towards the main doors of the palace, causing the little red bird to stick out its tongue. He was going to use it to show off again.
Using the same trick, the great doors of the palace easily opened. After everyone was shocked, they immediately surged in.
It was very likely that this was the Palace of the True Phoenix.
Though Lian Yutang had already been disappointed once, he still couldn’t help but search again. What if it was?
After these people had left, Ling Han took out the Nine Vine Fire Origin Fruit and distributed them.

Hu Niu, the empress, Chi Menghan, the large black dog, the little azure dragon, and even the perverted pig received one. The remaining three all belonged to Ling Han. This was a unanimous decision of the others.
They immediately started to refine the celestial fruits. If these people wanted to search the entire palace, they would need at least a few days.
Time was precious, and could not be wasted.
Everyone ate the fruits, then sat down in cross-legged positions.
With the support of the Imperial Scroll, they refined the celestial fruits extremely quickly.

Merely two days later, the medicinal effects were completely absorbed, and the large black dog and little azure dragon were no longer able to suppress their cultivation level. They had to break through.

If they broke through here, there would be some flaws. After all, this was not the real world, but with the Nine Vines Fire Origin Fruit, especially one that had been produced from these old vines that were close to thirty thousand years old, its effects were astonishingly strong.
Thus, even if the little azure dragon and the large black dog broke through, it wouldn’t be a big deal. After they went out, they could re-establish their foundations and solve the problem.
Meanwhile, Ling Han advanced triumphantly. He first reached the end of the Second Change, then leaped over, forming a third spiritual body.
— New chapter is coming soon —
